    // ==========================================
    // [SAFE STORAGE WRAPPER FOR GAS SANDBOX / WORKSPACE IFRAME]
    // Mencegah SecurityError pada iframe Google Apps Script agar eksekusi skrip tidak terhenti
    // ==========================================
    const _sipMemoryStorage = {};
    function sipSafeStorageGet(key) {
      try {
        if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' && localStorage) {
          const val = localStorage.getItem(key);
          if (val !== null && val !== undefined) return val;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      try {
        if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined' && sessionStorage) {
          const val = sessionStorage.getItem(key);
          if (val !== null && val !== undefined) return val;
        }
      } catch (e2) {}
      return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(_sipMemoryStorage, key) ? _sipMemoryStorage[key] : null;
    }

    function sipSafeStorageSet(key, value) {
      const strVal = String(value);
      _sipMemoryStorage[key] = strVal;
      try {
        if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' && localStorage) {
          localStorage.setItem(key, strVal);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      try {
        if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined' && sessionStorage) {
          sessionStorage.setItem(key, strVal);
        }
      } catch (e2) {}
    }

    function sipSafeStorageRemove(key) {
      delete _sipMemoryStorage[key];
      try {
        if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' && localStorage) {
          localStorage.removeItem(key);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      try {
        if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined' && sessionStorage) {
          sessionStorage.removeItem(key);
        }
      } catch (e2) {}
    }

    const DEFAULT_GAS_API_URL = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwT-PHfrjzIQeYiJiW-yXLtFCFQsyxmetroboeMkt_aEIi4qOG6mFrj_9luG6CK1CNe/exec";
    const LEGACY_GAS_DEPLOYMENT_IDS = ["AKfycbxKE-klcKo_Z_WVoCEASMtUN96pBMBT6A2dr6UywY5fy4SFfMLzF98DXyFptXDrbvkN", "0AKfycbxKE-klcKo_Z_WVoCEASMtUN96pBMBT6A2dr6UywY5fy4SFfMLzF98DXyFptXDrbvkN"];

    function normalizeAndMigrateGasUrl(rawUrl) {
      let val = String(rawUrl || "").trim();
      if (!val) return DEFAULT_GAS_API_URL;
      if (LEGACY_GAS_DEPLOYMENT_IDS.some(id => val.includes(id))) {
        return DEFAULT_GAS_API_URL;
      }
      return val;
    }

    function getGasApiUrl() {
      let val = sipSafeStorageGet("SIP_GAS_API_URL") || sipSafeStorageGet("uika_gas_api_url") || "";
      if (val && typeof val === 'string' && val.trim()) {
        const migrated = normalizeAndMigrateGasUrl(val);
        if (migrated !== val.trim()) {
          sipSafeStorageSet("SIP_GAS_API_URL", migrated);
          sipSafeStorageSet("uika_gas_api_url", migrated);
        }
        return migrated;
      }
      return DEFAULT_GAS_API_URL;
    }

    function setGasApiUrl(newUrl) {
      const cleanUrl = normalizeAndMigrateGasUrl(newUrl);
      sipSafeStorageSet("SIP_GAS_API_URL", cleanUrl);
      sipSafeStorageSet("uika_gas_api_url", cleanUrl);
      GAS_API_URL = cleanUrl;
    }

    let GAS_API_URL = getGasApiUrl();

    const EXPECTED_GAS_SCRIPT_VERSION = "2026.11.24-gas-login-fix-v1";
    let gasVersionCheckState = {
      checked: false,
      checking: false,
      matches: null,
      serverVersion: null,
      supportsActorIdentity: null,
      supportsArchiveSemester: null,
      lastError: "",
      checkedUrl: ""
    };

    function updateGasVersionBadgeFromInitialData(res) {
      if (!res || res.isLocalFallback) return;
      const meta = res.backendMeta || null;
      gasVersionCheckState.checked = true;
      gasVersionCheckState.checkedUrl = typeof getGasApiUrl === "function" ? getGasApiUrl() : "";
      if (meta && meta.scriptVersion) {
        gasVersionCheckState.serverVersion = String(meta.scriptVersion);
        gasVersionCheckState.supportsActorIdentity = Boolean(meta.supportsActorIdentity);
        gasVersionCheckState.supportsArchiveSemester = Boolean(meta.supportsArchiveSemester);
        gasVersionCheckState.matches = (String(meta.scriptVersion).trim() === EXPECTED_GAS_SCRIPT_VERSION);
        gasVersionCheckState.lastError = "";
      } else {
        gasVersionCheckState.serverVersion = "Versi Lama (Tanpa Metadata Versi)";
        gasVersionCheckState.supportsActorIdentity = false;
        gasVersionCheckState.supportsArchiveSemester = false;
        gasVersionCheckState.matches = false;
        gasVersionCheckState.lastError = "Endpoint Web App GAS aktif masih menjalankan Code.gs versi lama.";
      }
    }

    async function checkGasBackendVersion(showModal = true) {
      const targetUrl = (typeof getGasApiUrl === "function" ? getGasApiUrl() : GAS_API_URL || "").trim();
      gasVersionCheckState.checking = true;
      if (typeof renderMasterDataTable === "function") {
        try { renderMasterDataTable(); } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (showModal && typeof Swal !== "undefined") {
        Swal.fire({
          title: "Memeriksa Versi Skrip GAS...",
          html: "Menghubungi endpoint Web App Google Apps Script untuk mengecek versi Code.gs yang aktif.",
          allowOutsideClick: false,
          didOpen: () => { Swal.showLoading(); }
        });
      }

      try {
        let res = null;
        if (typeof google !== "undefined" && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
          res = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(resolve)
              .withFailureHandler(reject)
              .getBackendVersionInfo();
          });
        } else if (targetUrl) {
          const resp = await fetch(targetUrl, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=utf-8" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ action: "getBackendVersionInfo", args: [] })
          });
          if (!resp.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + resp.status);
          res = await resp.json();
        } else {
          throw new Error("URL Endpoint API GAS belum dikonfigurasi.");
        }

        gasVersionCheckState.checking = false;
        gasVersionCheckState.checked = true;
        gasVersionCheckState.checkedUrl = targetUrl;

        if (res && res.success && res.scriptVersion) {
          gasVersionCheckState.serverVersion = String(res.scriptVersion);
          gasVersionCheckState.supportsActorIdentity = Boolean(res.supportsActorIdentity);
          gasVersionCheckState.supportsArchiveSemester = Boolean(res.supportsArchiveSemester);
          gasVersionCheckState.matches = (String(res.scriptVersion).trim() === EXPECTED_GAS_SCRIPT_VERSION);
          gasVersionCheckState.lastError = gasVersionCheckState.matches ? "" : "Versi Code.gs di GAS (" + res.scriptVersion + ") berbeda dari versi web (" + EXPECTED_GAS_SCRIPT_VERSION + ").";
        } else {
          gasVersionCheckState.serverVersion = "Versi Lama";
          gasVersionCheckState.supportsActorIdentity = false;
          gasVersionCheckState.supportsArchiveSemester = false;
          gasVersionCheckState.matches = false;
          gasVersionCheckState.lastError = (res && res.message) ? res.message : "Fungsi pengecekan versi belum tersedia di Web App GAS aktif.";
        }
      } catch (err) {
        gasVersionCheckState.checking = false;
        gasVersionCheckState.checked = true;
        gasVersionCheckState.checkedUrl = targetUrl;
        gasVersionCheckState.matches = false;
        gasVersionCheckState.serverVersion = "Tidak Terjangkau / Offline";
        gasVersionCheckState.lastError = err?.message || String(err);
      }

      if (typeof renderMasterDataTable === "function") {
        try { renderMasterDataTable(); } catch (e) {}
      }

      if (showModal && typeof Swal !== "undefined") {
        if (gasVersionCheckState.matches) {
          Swal.fire({
            icon: "success",
            title: "Versi Code.gs Sinkron!",
            html: `<div class="text-left text-xs space-y-2">
              <p>Web App Google Apps Script aktif sudah menjalankan <b>Code.gs versi terbaru</b> (<code>${gasVersionCheckState.serverVersion}</code>).</p>
              <p class="text-slate-600">Seluruh aksi termasuk <b>Update Status Persetujuan</b> otomatis mencatat <b>Nama Lengkap</b> ke kolom <i>Pengguna</i> dan <b>Role</b> ke kolom terpisah.</p>
            </div>`,
            confirmButtonColor: "#059669"
          });
        } else {
          const isMaster = typeof currentUser === "object" && currentUser && ["master admin", "master_admin"].includes(String(currentUser.role || "").toLowerCase());
          Swal.fire({
            icon: "warning",
            title: "Web App GAS Masih Versi Lama",
            html: `<div class="text-left text-xs space-y-2.5 leading-relaxed">
              <p>Endpoint Web App GAS yang aktif di situs ini belum menjalankan <code>Code.gs</code> terbaru (<b>${gasVersionCheckState.lastError || "Versi tidak cocok"}</b>).</p>
              <div class="p-2.5 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-lg text-amber-900">
                <b>Penyebab paling umum:</b> Saat deploy di Google Apps Script Anda menekan <i>Deployment baru</i> (menghasilkan URL <code>/exec</code> baru) sehingga URL lama di situs ini masih memanggil versi skrip sebelumnya.
              </div>
              <ol class="list-decimal pl-4 space-y-1 text-slate-700">
                <li>Salin seluruh skrip terbaru dari menu <b>Source Code &amp; Skrip</b> &rarr; <code>Code.gs</code> dan simpan di Apps Script.</li>
                <li>Klik <b>Deploy &rarr; Kelola deployment &rarr; ikon pensil (Edit) &rarr; Versi: Versi baru &rarr; Deploy</b> agar URL yang sama ikut terbarui.</li>
                <li>Atau jika membuat deployment baru, salin URL <code>/exec</code> barunya lalu tempel ke menu <b>Endpoint API GAS</b>.</li>
              </ol>
            </div>`,
            showCancelButton: isMaster,
            confirmButtonText: isMaster ? "Buka Endpoint API GAS" : "Mengerti",
            cancelButtonText: "Tutup",
            confirmButtonColor: "#1e3a8a"
          }).then((r) => {
            if (r.isConfirmed && isMaster && typeof openApiConfigModal === "function") {
              openApiConfigModal();
            }
          });
        }
      }
    }

    function openApiConfigModal() {
      const roleLower = (currentUser && currentUser.role ? currentUser.role : '').toString().toLowerCase().trim();
      const isMaster = roleLower === 'master admin' || roleLower === 'master_admin';
      if (!isMaster) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Akses Dibatasi',
          text: 'Pengaturan Endpoint API hanya dapat diakses oleh Master Admin.'
        });
        return;
      }

      const statusText = gasVersionCheckState.checked
        ? (gasVersionCheckState.matches
            ? `Status terakhir: Code.gs sinkron (${gasVersionCheckState.serverVersion}).`
            : `Status terakhir: Versi GAS belum terbaru (${gasVersionCheckState.serverVersion || 'Versi lama'}). Pastikan deploy menggunakan Kelola Deployment -> Versi baru atau masukkan URL /exec terbaru.`)
        : "Masukkan URL Web App Deployment Google Apps Script Anda (akhiran /exec):";

      Swal.fire({
        title: "Konfigurasi URL REST API GAS",
        text: statusText,
        input: "url",
        inputValue: getGasApiUrl(),
        inputPlaceholder: "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycb.../exec",
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: "Simpan & Cek Versi",
        cancelButtonText: "Batal",
        confirmButtonColor: "#1e3a8a"
      }).then((res) => {
        if (res.isConfirmed && res.value) {
          setGasApiUrl(res.value);
          Swal.fire("Tersimpan!", "Endpoint REST API berhasil diperbarui dan disinkronkan.", "success");
          loadAppData();
        }
      });
    }

    if (typeof google === "undefined" || !google.script || !google.script.run) {
      window.google = window.google || {};
      window.google.__isProxy = true;
      window.google.script = window.google.script || {};
      
      function createProxyRunner(successCb, failureCb) {
        return new Proxy({}, {
          get(target, fnName) {
            if (fnName === "withSuccessHandler") {
              return (s) => createProxyRunner(s, failureCb);
            }
            if (fnName === "withFailureHandler") {
              return (f) => createProxyRunner(successCb, f);
            }
            return function(...args) {
              callGasApi(fnName, args, successCb, failureCb);
            };
          }
        });
      }

      window.google.script.run = createProxyRunner(null, null);
    }

    // Helper persisten lokal untuk mencatat Log Aktivitas dengan Nama Lengkap pada kolom 'Pengguna' & role di kolom terpisah 'Role'
    function appendLocalActivityLog(actorVal, aksiVal, targetVal, ketVal, roleVal) {
      try {
        if (typeof appData !== 'object' || !appData) {
          appData = { success: true, version: '1', master: {}, pendaftaran: [], jadwal: [] };
        }
        const roleOnlyRegex = /^(admin|admin\s*tu|admintu|master\s*admin|master_admin|mahasiswa|dosen|kaprodi|dekanat|dekan|wakil\s*dekan|sekprodi|staff|petugas|user|sistem|system|pengguna|pengguna\s*sistem)$/i;
        let storedUser = null;
        try {
          const rawSession = sipSafeStorageGet('sip_user');
          if (rawSession) storedUser = JSON.parse(rawSession);
        } catch (eParse) {}

        const activeUserObj = (typeof currentUser === 'object' && currentUser) ? currentUser : storedUser;
        const activeUserName = activeUserObj
          ? String(activeUserObj.nama || activeUserObj.namaLengkap || activeUserObj['Nama Lengkap'] || activeUserObj['Nama Mahasiswa'] || activeUserObj.fullName || '').trim()
          : '';
        const candidateActor = String(actorVal || '').trim();
        const safePreferred = (candidateActor && !roleOnlyRegex.test(candidateActor)) ? candidateActor : activeUserName;

        let resolvedActor = (typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function')
          ? getCurrentActorName(safePreferred, 'Pengguna Sistem')
          : (safePreferred || (activeUserObj && activeUserObj.username) || 'Pengguna Sistem');

        if (!resolvedActor || roleOnlyRegex.test(String(resolvedActor).trim())) {
          resolvedActor = (activeUserName && !roleOnlyRegex.test(activeUserName))
            ? activeUserName
            : ((activeUserObj && (activeUserObj.username || activeUserObj.npm || activeUserObj.nim)) || 'Pengguna Sistem');
        }

        const candidateRole = String(roleVal || '').trim();
        const resolvedRole = (typeof getCurrentActorRole === 'function')
          ? getCurrentActorRole(candidateRole || (activeUserObj && activeUserObj.role) || 'User')
          : (candidateRole || (activeUserObj && activeUserObj.role) || 'User');

        const now = new Date();
        const pad2 = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
        const pad3 = n => String(n).padStart(3, '0');
        const rand2 = String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 100)).padStart(2, '0');
        const item = {
          ID: 'LOG-' + now.getFullYear() + pad2(now.getMonth() + 1) + pad2(now.getDate()) + '-' + pad2(now.getHours()) + pad2(now.getMinutes()) + pad2(now.getSeconds()) + '-' + pad3(now.getMilliseconds()) + '-' + rand2,
          Waktu: `${now.getFullYear()}-${pad2(now.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(now.getDate())} ${pad2(now.getHours())}:${pad2(now.getMinutes())}:${pad2(now.getSeconds())}`,
          Pengguna: String(resolvedActor).trim(),
          Role: String(resolvedRole).trim(),
          Aksi: String(aksiVal || '').trim(),
          Target: String(targetVal || '').trim(),
          Keterangan: String(ketVal || '').trim()
        };
        appData.activityLogs = Array.isArray(appData.activityLogs) ? appData.activityLogs : [];
        appData.activityLogs.unshift(item);
        appData.master = appData.master || {};
        appData.master.logs = appData.activityLogs;
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        return item;
      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function extractRegNumberClient(idStr) {
      const m = String(idStr || '').trim().match(/^REG-(\d+)$/i);
      if (!m) return 0;
      const n = parseInt(m[1], 10);
      return Number.isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
    }

    function getNextLocalRegId() {
      const activeList = (typeof appData === 'object' && appData && Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
      const trashList = (typeof appData === 'object' && appData && Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran)) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];
      const used = new Set();
      let maxNum = 1000;
      activeList.concat(trashList).forEach(item => {
        if (!item) return;
        const raw = String(item.ID || item.id || '').trim();
        if (!raw) return;
        used.add(raw.toUpperCase());
        const num = extractRegNumberClient(raw);
        if (num > maxNum) maxNum = num;
      });
      let nextNum = maxNum + 1;
      let candidate = 'REG-' + nextNum;
      while (used.has(candidate.toUpperCase())) {
        nextNum++;
        candidate = 'REG-' + nextNum;
      }
      return candidate;
    }

    function getNextLocalJadwalBaseNum() {
      const list = (typeof appData === 'object' && appData && Array.isArray(appData.jadwal)) ? appData.jadwal : [];
      let maxNum = 1000;
      list.forEach(item => {
        if (!item) return;
        const m = String(item.ID || item.id || '').trim().match(/^JDW-(\d+)/i);
        if (m) {
          const n = parseInt(m[1], 10);
          if (!Number.isNaN(n) && n > maxNum) maxNum = n;
        }
      });
      return maxNum + 1;
    }

    function findDuplicatePendaftaranIdsClient() {
      const list = (typeof appData === 'object' && appData && Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
      const trashIds = new Set();
      const trashList = (typeof appData === 'object' && appData && Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran)) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];
      trashList.forEach(t => {
        const tid = String((t && (t.ID || t.id)) || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (tid) trashIds.add(tid);
      });
      const seen = new Set();
      const duplicateIds = [];
      let affectedCount = 0;
      list.forEach(item => {
        if (!item) return;
        const rawId = String(item.ID || item.id || '').trim();
        const upperId = rawId.toUpperCase();
        if (!rawId || seen.has(upperId) || trashIds.has(upperId)) {
          affectedCount++;
          duplicateIds.push(rawId || '(Kosong)');
        } else {
          seen.add(upperId);
        }
      });
      return {
        affectedCount,
        duplicateIds: Array.from(new Set(duplicateIds))
      };
    }

    function repairDuplicatePendaftaranIdsLocal(actor, role) {
      if (typeof appData !== 'object' || !appData) {
        return { success: false, repairedCount: 0, changes: [], message: 'Data lokal belum tersedia.' };
      }
      appData.pendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
      appData.sampahPendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];
      const used = new Set();
      let maxNum = 1000;
      appData.pendaftaran.concat(appData.sampahPendaftaran).forEach(item => {
        if (!item) return;
        const raw = String(item.ID || item.id || '').trim();
        if (!raw) return;
        const n = extractRegNumberClient(raw);
        if (n > maxNum) maxNum = n;
      });
      appData.sampahPendaftaran.forEach(item => {
        const raw = String((item && (item.ID || item.id)) || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (raw) used.add(raw);
      });
      const changes = [];
      appData.pendaftaran.forEach(item => {
        if (!item) return;
        const raw = String(item.ID || item.id || '').trim();
        const upper = raw.toUpperCase();
        if (!raw || used.has(upper)) {
          maxNum++;
          let newId = 'REG-' + maxNum;
          while (used.has(newId.toUpperCase())) {
            maxNum++;
            newId = 'REG-' + maxNum;
          }
          used.add(newId.toUpperCase());
          item.ID = newId;
          if ('id' in item) item.id = newId;
          changes.push({ oldId: raw || '(Kosong)', newId, nama: item['Nama Mahasiswa'] || '' });
        } else {
          used.add(upper);
        }
      });
      if (changes.length > 0) {
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        appendLocalActivityLog(actor || 'Admin', 'Perbaiki ID Duplikat', `${changes.length} berkas`, `Deduplikasi ID lokal: ${changes.map(c => `${c.oldId} -> ${c.newId}`).join('; ')}`, role || 'Admin TU');
      }
      return {
        success: true,
        repairedCount: changes.length,
        changes,
        message: changes.length > 0
          ? `Berhasil memperbaiki ${changes.length} ID Pendaftaran duplikat ke nomor urut terbaru.`
          : 'Seluruh ID Pendaftaran sudah unik.'
      };
    }

    // Helper fallback lokal ketika endpoint GAS offline atau terblokir CORS di peramban
    function handleLocalGasFallback(action, args, onSuccess, onFailure, err) {
      if (typeof appData !== 'object' || !appData) {
        appData = { success: true, version: '1', master: {}, pendaftaran: [], jadwal: [] };
      }
      appData.success = true;

      // 1. Ambil data awal
      if (action === "getInitialData") {
        if (typeof loadCachedAppData === 'function') {
          const cached = loadCachedAppData();
          if (cached && cached.success) {
            appData = Object.assign({}, appData, cached);
          }
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran)) appData.sampahPendaftaran = [];
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess(Object.assign({}, appData, { isLocalFallback: true }));
        return;
      }

      // 2. Sinkronisasi realtime
      if (action === "checkRealtimeSync") {
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, changed: false, updated: false, version: (appData && appData.version) || '1', data: appData });
        return;
      }

      // 3. Tambah / Update Pendaftaran
      if (action === "addPendaftaran" || action === "updatePendaftaran") {
        const payload = args && args[0];
        if (payload) {
          appData.pendaftaran = appData.pendaftaran || [];
          const isAllowedDupBypass = payload.statusPersetujuan && String(payload.statusPersetujuan).trim().toLowerCase() === 'ditolak';
          if (!isAllowedDupBypass && typeof findCrossFormPendaftaranDuplicatesClient === 'function') {
            const conflicts = findCrossFormPendaftaranDuplicatesClient(payload, appData.pendaftaran, payload.id || '');
            if (conflicts.length > 0) {
              const firstC = conflicts[0];
              if (onSuccess) {
                onSuccess({
                  success: false,
                  code: 'DUPLICATE_REGISTRATION',
                  message: `Pendaftaran ganda ditolak: Mata kuliah "${firstC.mataKuliah}" dengan dosen "${firstC.dosenPengampu || '-'}" sudah terdaftar pada pengajuan ${firstC.existingId} (Status: ${firstC.existingStatus}) untuk periode dan layanan yang sama.`
                });
              }
              return;
            }
          }
          if (!payload.id) {
            const newId = getNextLocalRegId();
            const newRec = {
              ID: newId,
              Tanggal: new Date().toLocaleDateString('id-ID'),
              'Tahun Akademik': payload.tahunAkademik || '2026/2027',
              Semester: payload.semester || 'Semester 1',
              'Semester Type': payload.semesterPeriode || payload.semester || 'Ganjil',
              NPM: payload.nim,
              NIM: payload.nim,
              'Nama Mahasiswa': payload.namaMahasiswa,
              'Kode Prodi': payload.kodeProdi,
              'Program Studi': payload.prodi,
              Kelas: payload.kelas,
              'Kategori Kelas': payload.kategoriKelas,
              'Mata Kuliah': payload.mataKuliah,
              'Dosen Pengampu': payload.dosenPengampu,
              mataKuliahList: payload.mataKuliahList,
              'Jenis Layanan': payload.jenisLayanan,
              Alasan: payload.alasan,
              'Bukti Foto': payload.buktiFoto,
              'Status Jadwal': payload.statusJadwal || 'Belum Terjadwal',
              Nominal: payload.nominal || 0,
              'Status Pembayaran': payload.statusPembayaran || 'Lunas',
              'Status Persetujuan': payload.statusPersetujuan || 'Disetujui'
            };
            appData.pendaftaran.unshift(newRec);
            appendLocalActivityLog(payload.actor || payload.namaMahasiswa, 'Tambah Pendaftaran', `${newId} (${payload.namaMahasiswa || payload.nim || ''})`, 'Pengajuan pendaftaran baru (lokal)', payload.role || 'Mahasiswa');
          } else {
            const item = appData.pendaftaran.find(d => String(d.ID || d.id) === String(payload.id));
            if (item) {
              if (payload.nim !== undefined) {
                item.NPM = payload.nim;
                item.NIM = payload.nim;
              }
              if (payload.namaMahasiswa !== undefined) item['Nama Mahasiswa'] = payload.namaMahasiswa;
              if (payload.kodeProdi !== undefined) item['Kode Prodi'] = payload.kodeProdi;
              if (payload.prodi !== undefined) item['Program Studi'] = payload.prodi;
              if (payload.kelas !== undefined) item.Kelas = payload.kelas;
              if (payload.kategoriKelas !== undefined) item['Kategori Kelas'] = payload.kategoriKelas;
              if (payload.angkatan !== undefined) item.Angkatan = payload.angkatan;
              if (payload.tahunAkademik) item['Tahun Akademik'] = payload.tahunAkademik;
              if (payload.semester) item.Semester = payload.semester;
              if (payload.semesterPeriode) item['Semester Type'] = payload.semesterPeriode;
              if (payload.jenisLayanan) item['Jenis Layanan'] = payload.jenisLayanan;
              if (payload.mataKuliah) item['Mata Kuliah'] = payload.mataKuliah;
              if (payload.dosenPengampu) item['Dosen Pengampu'] = payload.dosenPengampu;
              if (payload.mataKuliahList) item.mataKuliahList = payload.mataKuliahList;
              if (payload.nominal !== undefined) item.Nominal = payload.nominal;
              if (payload.statusPembayaran !== undefined) item['Status Pembayaran'] = payload.statusPembayaran;
              if (payload.statusPersetujuan) item['Status Persetujuan'] = payload.statusPersetujuan;
              if (payload.statusJadwal) item['Status Jadwal'] = payload.statusJadwal;
              if (payload.alasan) item.Alasan = payload.alasan;
            }
            appendLocalActivityLog(payload.actor, 'Edit Data Pendaftaran', `${payload.id} (${payload.namaMahasiswa || ''})`, 'Pembaruan data pendaftaran (lokal)', payload.role);
          }
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, message: 'Data pendaftaran tersimpan di sistem lokal.' });
        return;
      }

      // 4. Tambah / Update Jadwal Ujian
      if (action === "addJadwal" || action === "updateJadwal") {
        const isPayloadObj = args && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null;
        const payload = isPayloadObj ? args[0] : (args && args[1]);
        if (payload) {
          appData.jadwal = appData.jadwal || [];
          const baseNum = getNextLocalJadwalBaseNum();
          const editTargetId = !isPayloadObj ? (args && args[0]) : '';
          const baseId = payload.id || editTargetId || ('JDW-' + baseNum);

          if (Array.isArray(payload.items) && payload.items.length > 1 && !payload.id && !editTargetId) {
            payload.items.forEach((it, idx) => {
              const subId = `${baseId}-${idx + 1}`;
              const isDirect = typeof isHubungiDosenSchedule === 'function' && isHubungiDosenSchedule(it);
              const newJadwal = {
                ID: subId,
                id: subId,
                pendaftarId: payload.pendaftarId || payload.pendaftaranId,
                pendaftaranId: payload.pendaftarId || payload.pendaftaranId,
                'Tanggal Ujian': it.tanggalUjian || payload.tanggalUjian || (isDirect ? 'Hubungi Dosen' : ''),
                'Jam Mulai': (it.jamMulai !== undefined && it.jamMulai !== '') ? it.jamMulai : ((payload.jamMulai !== undefined && payload.jamMulai !== '') ? payload.jamMulai : (isDirect ? '-' : '08:00')),
                'Jam Selesai': (it.jamSelesai !== undefined && it.jamSelesai !== '') ? it.jamSelesai : ((payload.jamSelesai !== undefined && payload.jamSelesai !== '') ? payload.jamSelesai : (isDirect ? '-' : '10:00')),
                Ruangan: it.ruangan || payload.ruangan || (isDirect ? 'Hubungi Dosen' : ''),
                'Kode Prodi': payload.kodeProdi || 'MNJ',
                'Program Studi': payload.programStudi || '',
                Semester: payload.semester || '',
                Kelas: payload.kelas || '',
                'Mata Kuliah': it.mataKuliah,
                'Dosen Pengampu': it.dosenPengampu,
                'Jenis Ujian': payload.jenisUjian || 'UTS Susulan',
                Keterangan: it.keterangan || payload.keterangan || ''
              };
              appData.jadwal.unshift(newJadwal);
            });
          } else {
            const firstItem = (payload.items && payload.items[0]) || {};
            const isDirect = typeof isHubungiDosenSchedule === 'function' && (isHubungiDosenSchedule(payload) || isHubungiDosenSchedule(firstItem));
            const newJadwal = {
              ID: baseId,
              id: baseId,
              pendaftarId: payload.pendaftarId || payload.pendaftaranId,
              pendaftaranId: payload.pendaftarId || payload.pendaftaranId,
              'Tanggal Ujian': payload.tanggalUjian || firstItem.tanggalUjian || (isDirect ? 'Hubungi Dosen' : ''),
              'Jam Mulai': (payload.jamMulai !== undefined && payload.jamMulai !== '') ? payload.jamMulai : ((firstItem.jamMulai !== undefined && firstItem.jamMulai !== '') ? firstItem.jamMulai : (isDirect ? '-' : '08:00')),
              'Jam Selesai': (payload.jamSelesai !== undefined && payload.jamSelesai !== '') ? payload.jamSelesai : ((firstItem.jamSelesai !== undefined && firstItem.jamSelesai !== '') ? firstItem.jamSelesai : (isDirect ? '-' : '10:00')),
              Ruangan: payload.ruangan || firstItem.ruangan || (isDirect ? 'Hubungi Dosen' : ''),
              'Kode Prodi': payload.kodeProdi || 'MNJ',
              'Program Studi': payload.programStudi || '',
              Semester: payload.semester || '',
              Kelas: payload.kelas || '',
              'Mata Kuliah': payload.mataKuliah || firstItem.mataKuliah || '',
              'Dosen Pengampu': payload.dosenPengampu || firstItem.dosenPengampu || '',
              'Jenis Ujian': payload.jenisUjian || 'UTS Susulan',
              Keterangan: payload.keterangan || firstItem.keterangan || ''
            };
            const idx = appData.jadwal.findIndex(j => String(j.ID || j.id) === String(baseId));
            if (idx >= 0) {
              appData.jadwal[idx] = Object.assign({}, appData.jadwal[idx], newJadwal);
            } else {
              appData.jadwal.unshift(newJadwal);
            }
          }

          const targetPid = payload.pendaftarId || payload.pendaftaranId;
          if (targetPid && Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) {
            const p = appData.pendaftaran.find(item => String(item.ID || item.id) === String(targetPid));
            if (p) {
              p['Status Jadwal'] = 'Terjadwal';
            }
          }
          appendLocalActivityLog(
            payload.actor,
            action === 'updateJadwal' ? 'Update Jadwal Ujian' : 'Tambah Jadwal Ujian',
            `${baseId} (${payload.mataKuliah || ''})`,
            `Penjadwalan ujian (lokal)`,
            payload.role
          );
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Jadwal ujian berhasil disimpan di sistem lokal.' });
        return;
      }

      // 5. Hapus Jadwal
      if (action === "deleteJadwal") {
        const id = args && args[0];
        const delActor = args && args[1];
        const delRole = args && args[2];
        if (id && Array.isArray(appData.jadwal)) {
          const removed = appData.jadwal.find(j => String(j.ID || j.id) === String(id));
          appData.jadwal = appData.jadwal.filter(j => String(j.ID || j.id) !== String(id));
          if (removed && Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) {
            const ketMatch = String(removed.Keterangan || '').match(/\[ID:\s*(REG-\d+)\]/i);
            const targetRegId = removed.pendaftaranId || removed.pendaftarId || (ketMatch ? ketMatch[1] : '');
            if (targetRegId) {
              const p = appData.pendaftaran.find(item => String(item.ID || item.id) === String(targetRegId));
              if (p) p['Status Jadwal'] = 'Tepat Waktu';
            }
          }
          appendLocalActivityLog(delActor, 'Hapus Jadwal Ujian', id, 'Penghapusan data jadwal ujian dari sistem', delRole);
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Jadwal ujian berhasil dihapus.' });
        return;
      }

      // 6. Update Status Pendaftaran
      if (action === "updateStatusPendaftaran") {
        const id = args && args[0];
        const statusJadwal = args && args[1];
        const statusPersetujuan = args && args[2];
        const statusPembayaran = args && args[3];
        if (id && Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) {
          const item = appData.pendaftaran.find(d => String(d.ID || d.id) === String(id));
          if (item) {
            if (statusJadwal) item['Status Jadwal'] = statusJadwal;
            if (statusPersetujuan) item['Status Persetujuan'] = statusPersetujuan;
            if (statusPembayaran) item['Status Pembayaran'] = statusPembayaran;
          }
          appendLocalActivityLog(null, 'Update Status Pendaftaran', id, 'Pembaruan status pendaftaran (lokal)', null);
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, message: 'Status pendaftaran berhasil diperbarui.' });
        return;
      }

      // 7. Tambah User Mahasiswa
      if (action === "addUserMahasiswa") {
        const payload = args && args[0];
        const mhsActor = (args && args[1]) || (payload && payload.actor);
        const mhsRole = (args && args[2]) || (payload && payload.role);
        if (payload && appData.master) {
          appData.master.user_mahasiswa = appData.master.user_mahasiswa || [];
          appData.master.user_mahasiswa.push({
            NPM: payload.npm,
            'Nama Lengkap': payload.nama || payload.namaMahasiswa,
            'Nama Mahasiswa': payload.namaMahasiswa || payload.nama,
            'Kode Prodi': payload.kodeProdi,
            'Program Studi': payload.prodi,
            'Kata Sandi': payload.password,
            'Status Akun': 'Aktif'
          });
          appendLocalActivityLog(mhsActor, 'Tambah User Mahasiswa', `${payload.npm || ''} (${payload.nama || payload.namaMahasiswa || ''})`, 'Pendaftaran akun mahasiswa (lokal)', mhsRole);
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, message: 'User mahasiswa berhasil ditambahkan.' });
        return;
      }

      // 8. Migrasi Base64 ke Drive
      if (action === "migrateBase64ToDrive" || action === "convertAllBase64ToDrive") {
        const migActor = args && args[0];
        const migRole = args && args[1];
        let count = 0;
        if (Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) {
          appData.pendaftaran.forEach((p, idx) => {
            const foto = String(p['Bukti Foto'] || '');
            if (foto.startsWith('data:image')) {
              p['Bukti Foto'] = 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DEMO_CONVERTED_FILE_' + (idx + 1) + '/view?usp=sharing';
              count++;
            }
          });
          appendLocalActivityLog(migActor, 'Migrasi Bukti Drive', `${count} berkas`, 'Konversi bukti pendaftaran base64 ke Google Drive (lokal)', migRole);
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, convertedCount: count, message: count + ' Bukti foto berhasil dikonversi ke link Google Drive.' });
        return;
      }

      // 9. Batch Sync Master Data
      if (action === "batchSyncMasterData") {
        const sheetKey = args && args[0];
        const uploadedData = args && args[1];
        const syncActor = args && args[2];
        const syncRole = args && args[3];
        if (sheetKey && Array.isArray(uploadedData) && appData.master) {
          appData.master[sheetKey] = uploadedData;
          appendLocalActivityLog(syncActor, 'Upload & Sync Data Master', sheetKey, `Sinkronisasi ${uploadedData.length} baris data (lokal)`, syncRole);
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, message: 'Sinkronisasi master data berhasil di memori lokal.' });
        return;
      }

      // 10. Tambah / Update Periode Pendaftaran
      if (action === "addPeriode" || action === "updatePeriode") {
        const payload = (args && typeof args[0] === 'object' && args[0] !== null) ? args[0] : (args && args[1]) || {};
        const targetId = String(payload.id || (args && typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : '')).trim();
        if (appData.master) {
          appData.master.periode = appData.master.periode || [];
          const idx = appData.master.periode.findIndex(p => String(p.ID || p.id).trim() === targetId);
          const pObj = {
            ID: targetId || ('PRD-REG-' + String(appData.master.periode.length + 1).padStart(2, '0')),
            'Tahun Akademik': payload.tahunAkademik || '2026/2027',
            Semester: payload.semester || 'Ganjil',
            'Jenis Layanan': payload.jenisLayanan || 'UTS Susulan',
            'Kategori Kelas': payload.kategoriKelas || 'Reguler',
            'Tanggal & Jam Mulai': String(payload.tglMulai || '').replace('T', ' '),
            'Tanggal & Jam Selesai': String(payload.tglSelesai || '').replace('T', ' '),
            'Mulai Terlambat': String(payload.tglTerlambatMulai || '').replace('T', ' '),
            'Selesai Terlambat': String(payload.tglTerlambatSelesai || '').replace('T', ' '),
            'Biaya Keterlambatan': payload.biayaKeterlambatan !== undefined ? payload.biayaKeterlambatan : (payload.biaya || 50000),
            Status: payload.status || 'Aktif'
          };
          if (idx !== -1) {
            appData.master.periode[idx] = Object.assign({}, appData.master.periode[idx], pObj);
          } else {
            appData.master.periode.unshift(pObj);
          }
          appendLocalActivityLog(payload.actor, action === 'updatePeriode' ? 'Edit Jadwal Periode' : 'Tambah Periode', `${pObj.ID} (${pObj['Jenis Layanan']})`, 'Pembaruan jadwal periode (lokal)', payload.role);
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, message: 'Jadwal periode berhasil disimpan di memori lokal.' });
        return;
      }

      // 11. Hapus Periode Pendaftaran
      if (action === "deletePeriode") {
        const id = args && args[0];
        const delActor = args && args[1];
        const delRole = args && args[2];
        if (id && appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.periode)) {
          appData.master.periode = appData.master.periode.filter(p => String(p.ID || p.id).trim() !== String(id).trim());
          appendLocalActivityLog(delActor, 'Hapus Jadwal Periode', id, 'Menghapus jadwal periode dari sistem (lokal)', delRole);
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, message: 'Periode berhasil dihapus dari memori lokal.' });
        return;
      }

      // 12. Hapus Log Aktivitas (Khusus Master Admin)
      if (action === "clearActivityLogs") {
        const reqRole = String((args && args[0]) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const reqActor = (typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function') ? getCurrentActorName(args && args[1], 'Master Admin') : String((args && args[1]) || 'Master Admin').trim();
        if (reqRole !== 'master admin' && reqRole !== 'master_admin') {
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: false, message: 'Akses Ditolak: Hanya Master Admin yang berhak menghapus log aktivitas.' });
          return;
        }
        const now = new Date();
        const pad2 = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
        const auditLog = {
          ID: 'LOG-' + now.getFullYear() + pad2(now.getMonth() + 1) + pad2(now.getDate()) + '-' + pad2(now.getHours()) + pad2(now.getMinutes()) + pad2(now.getSeconds()),
          Waktu: `${now.getFullYear()}-${pad2(now.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(now.getDate())} ${pad2(now.getHours())}:${pad2(now.getMinutes())}:${pad2(now.getSeconds())}`,
          Pengguna: reqActor,
          Role: 'Master Admin',
          Aksi: 'Pembersihan Log',
          Target: 'Log_Aktivitas',
          Keterangan: `Master Admin (${reqActor}) mengosongkan riwayat log aktivitas sistem.`
        };
        appData.activityLogs = [auditLog];
        appData.master = appData.master || {};
        appData.master.logs = [auditLog];
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, logs: [auditLog], message: `Seluruh riwayat log aktivitas berhasil dibersihkan oleh Master Admin (${reqActor}).` });
        return;
      }

      // 13. Update Status Persetujuan (Tunggal)
      if (action === "updateStatusApproval") {
        const id = args && args[0];
        const statusPersetujuan = args && args[1];
        const actName = args && args[2];
        const actRole = args && args[3];
        if (id && Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) {
          const item = appData.pendaftaran.find(d => String(d.ID || d.id).trim() === String(id).trim());
          if (item) item['Status Persetujuan'] = statusPersetujuan;
        }
        appendLocalActivityLog(actName, 'Update Status Persetujuan', String(id || ''), `Status persetujuan diubah menjadi: ${statusPersetujuan} (lokal)`, actRole);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: `Status persetujuan ${id} berhasil diubah menjadi: ${statusPersetujuan}` });
        return;
      }

      // 14. Persetujuan Massal
      if (action === "bulkApproveRegistrations" || action === "bulkUpdateStatusApproval") {
        const selectedIds = Array.isArray(args && args[0]) ? args[0] : [];
        const isBulkApprove = action === "bulkApproveRegistrations";
        const newStatus = isBulkApprove ? 'Disetujui' : (args && args[1]) || 'Disetujui';
        const actRole = isBulkApprove ? (args && args[1]) : (args && args[2]);
        const actName = isBulkApprove ? (args && args[2]) : (args && args[3]);
        const idSet = new Set(selectedIds.map(v => String(v).trim()));
        let count = 0;
        if (Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) {
          appData.pendaftaran.forEach(item => {
            if (idSet.has(String(item.ID || item.id).trim())) {
              item['Status Persetujuan'] = newStatus;
              count++;
            }
          });
        }
        appendLocalActivityLog(actName, 'Persetujuan Massal', `${count || selectedIds.length} Berkas Pendaftaran`, `Persetujuan massal diubah menjadi: ${newStatus} (lokal)`, actRole);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, count: count || selectedIds.length, message: `${count || selectedIds.length} pendaftaran berhasil diperbarui menjadi ${newStatus}.` });
        return;
      }

      // 15. Update Status Pembayaran
      if (action === "updateStatusPayment") {
        const id = args && args[0];
        const newStatus = args && args[1];
        const catatan = args && args[2];
        const actName = args && args[3];
        const actRole = args && args[4];
        if (id && Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) {
          const item = appData.pendaftaran.find(d => String(d.ID || d.id).trim() === String(id).trim());
          if (item) {
            if (newStatus) item['Status Pembayaran'] = newStatus;
            if (catatan) item.Catatan = catatan;
          }
        }
        appendLocalActivityLog(actName, 'Update Status Pembayaran', String(id || ''), `Status pembayaran diubah menjadi: ${newStatus}${catatan ? ' (' + catatan + ')' : ''} (lokal)`, actRole);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: `Status pembayaran ${id} berhasil diubah menjadi: ${newStatus}` });
        return;
      }

      // 16. Hapus Pendaftaran (Soft Delete -> Pindah ke Tong Sampah)
      if (action === "deletePendaftaran") {
        const id = args && args[0];
        const actName = args && args[1];
        const actRole = (args && args[2]) || (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '';
        const roleLower = String(actRole).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin'].includes(roleLower)) {
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: false, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Akses ditolak: Hanya Master Admin atau Admin TU yang dapat memindahkan berkas ke Tong Sampah.' });
          return;
        }
        appData.pendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
        appData.sampahPendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];
        const idx = appData.pendaftaran.findIndex(d => String(d.ID || d.id).trim() === String(id).trim());
        if (idx === -1) {
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: false, isLocalFallback: true, message: `Berkas ${id} tidak ditemukan.` });
          return;
        }
        const target = Object.assign({}, appData.pendaftaran[idx], {
          'Deleted At': new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' '),
          'Deleted By': actName || (currentUser && currentUser.nama) || 'Admin TU',
          'Deleted Role': actRole || 'Admin TU'
        });
        appData.pendaftaran.splice(idx, 1);
        appData.sampahPendaftaran.unshift(target);
        appendLocalActivityLog(actName, 'Pindah ke Tong Sampah', String(id || ''), 'Berkas pendaftaran dipindahkan ke Tong Sampah (lokal)', actRole);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, movedToTrash: true, trashedItem: target, message: `Berkas ${id} dipindahkan ke Tong Sampah.` });
        return;
      }

      // 16b. Pulihkan Pendaftaran dari Tong Sampah (Master Admin & Admin TU)
      if (action === "restorePendaftaran" || action === "bulkRestorePendaftaran") {
        const rawIds = action === "restorePendaftaran" ? [args && args[0]] : (Array.isArray(args && args[0]) ? args[0] : []);
        const actName = args && args[1];
        const actRole = (args && args[2]) || (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '';
        const roleLower = String(actRole).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin'].includes(roleLower)) {
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: false, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Akses ditolak: Hanya Master Admin atau Admin TU yang dapat memulihkan berkas.' });
          return;
        }
        appData.pendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
        appData.sampahPendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];

        const restoredIds = [];
        const restoredItems = [];
        const failedItems = [];

        rawIds.forEach(rawId => {
          const cleanId = String(rawId || '').trim();
          if (!cleanId) return;
          const sIdx = appData.sampahPendaftaran.findIndex(d => String(d.ID || d.id).trim() === cleanId);
          if (sIdx === -1) {
            failedItems.push({ id: cleanId, message: `Berkas ${cleanId} tidak ditemukan di Tong Sampah.` });
            return;
          }
          const candidate = Object.assign({}, appData.sampahPendaftaran[sIdx]);
          let finalRestoreId = cleanId;
          if (appData.pendaftaran.some(p => String(p.ID || p.id).trim().toUpperCase() === cleanId.toUpperCase())) {
            finalRestoreId = getNextLocalRegId();
            candidate.ID = finalRestoreId;
            if ('id' in candidate) candidate.id = finalRestoreId;
          }
          const isBypass = String(candidate['Status Persetujuan'] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'ditolak';
          if (!isBypass && typeof findCrossFormPendaftaranDuplicatesClient === 'function') {
            const dupPayload = {
              id: finalRestoreId,
              npm: candidate.NPM || candidate.NIM || '',
              namaMahasiswa: candidate['Nama Mahasiswa'] || '',
              tahunAkademik: candidate['Tahun Akademik'] || '2026/2027',
              semester: candidate.Semester || 'Ganjil',
              semesterPeriode: candidate['Semester Type'] || candidate.Semester || 'Ganjil',
              jenisLayanan: candidate['Jenis Layanan'] || '',
              mataKuliah: candidate['Mata Kuliah'] || '',
              dosenPengampu: candidate['Dosen Pengampu'] || ''
            };
            const conflicts = findCrossFormPendaftaranDuplicatesClient(dupPayload, appData.pendaftaran, finalRestoreId);
            if (conflicts.length > 0) {
              failedItems.push({ id: finalRestoreId, message: `Pendaftaran ganda ditolak: ${conflicts[0].mataKuliah} sudah aktif pada ${conflicts[0].existingId}.` });
              return;
            }
          }
          delete candidate['Deleted At'];
          delete candidate['Deleted By'];
          delete candidate['Deleted Role'];
          appData.sampahPendaftaran.splice(sIdx, 1);
          appData.pendaftaran.unshift(candidate);
          restoredIds.push(finalRestoreId);
          restoredItems.push(candidate);
          appendLocalActivityLog(actName, 'Pulihkan Pendaftaran', finalRestoreId, 'Berkas pendaftaran dipulihkan dari Tong Sampah (lokal)', actRole);
        });

        if (action === "restorePendaftaran") {
          if (restoredIds.length > 0) {
            if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, id: restoredIds[0], restoredItem: restoredItems[0], message: `Berkas ${restoredIds[0]} berhasil dipulihkan.` });
          } else {
            if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: false, isLocalFallback: true, message: (failedItems[0] && failedItems[0].message) || 'Gagal memulihkan berkas.' });
          }
        } else {
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess({
            success: restoredIds.length > 0,
            isLocalFallback: true,
            restoredIds,
            restoredItems,
            failedItems,
            message: restoredIds.length > 0
              ? `Berhasil memulihkan ${restoredIds.length} berkas.${failedItems.length ? ` (${failedItems.length} dilewati)` : ''}`
              : ((failedItems[0] && failedItems[0].message) || 'Tidak ada berkas yang dipulihkan.')
          });
        }
        return;
      }

      // 16c. Hapus Permanen & Kosongkan Tong Sampah (Eksklusif Master Admin)
      if (action === "permanentDeletePendaftaran") {
        const id = args && args[0];
        const actName = args && args[1];
        const actRole = (args && args[2]) || (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '';
        const roleLower = String(actRole).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!['master admin', 'master_admin'].includes(roleLower)) {
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: false, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Akses ditolak: Hanya Master Admin yang berhak menghapus berkas secara permanen.' });
          return;
        }
        appData.sampahPendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];
        const beforeLen = appData.sampahPendaftaran.length;
        appData.sampahPendaftaran = appData.sampahPendaftaran.filter(d => String(d.ID || d.id).trim() !== String(id).trim());
        if (appData.sampahPendaftaran.length === beforeLen) {
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: false, isLocalFallback: true, message: `Berkas ${id} tidak ditemukan di Tong Sampah.` });
          return;
        }
        appendLocalActivityLog(actName, 'Hapus Permanen Pendaftaran', String(id || ''), 'Berkas dihapus permanen dari Tong Sampah (lokal)', actRole);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: `Berkas ${id} berhasil dihapus permanen.` });
        return;
      }

      if (action === "emptySampahPendaftaran") {
        const actName = args && args[0];
        const actRole = (args && args[1]) || (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '';
        const roleLower = String(actRole).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!['master admin', 'master_admin'].includes(roleLower)) {
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: false, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Akses ditolak: Hanya Master Admin yang berhak mengosongkan Tong Sampah.' });
          return;
        }
        appData.sampahPendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];
        const count = appData.sampahPendaftaran.length;
        appData.sampahPendaftaran = [];
        if (count > 0) {
          appendLocalActivityLog(actName, 'Kosongkan Tong Sampah', 'Sampah_Pendaftaran', `Menghapus permanen ${count} berkas di Tong Sampah (lokal)`, actRole);
        }
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, count, message: count > 0 ? `Tong Sampah dikosongkan (${count} berkas dihapus permanen).` : 'Tong Sampah sudah kosong.' });
        return;
      }

      if (action === "repairDuplicatePendaftaranIds") {
        const actName = args && args[0];
        const actRole = (args && args[1]) || (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '';
        const localRes = repairDuplicatePendaftaranIdsLocal(actName, actRole);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess(Object.assign({}, localRes, { isLocalFallback: true }));
        return;
      }

      // 17. Tahun Akademik & Ruangan & Ubah Password
      if (action === "addTahunAkademik" || action === "updateTahunAkademik") {
        const payload = (args && args[0]) || {};
        appData.master = appData.master || {};
        appData.master.tahunAkademik = Array.isArray(appData.master.tahunAkademik) ? appData.master.tahunAkademik : [];
        const targetId = String(payload.id || ('TA-' + String(appData.master.tahunAkademik.length + 1).padStart(3, '0'))).trim();
        const taObj = {
          ID: targetId,
          'Tahun Akademik': payload.tahunAkademik || '2026/2027',
          Semester: payload.semester || 'Ganjil',
          Status: payload.status || 'Aktif',
          Keterangan: payload.keterangan || ''
        };
        const idx = appData.master.tahunAkademik.findIndex(t => String(t.ID || t.id).trim() === targetId);
        if (idx >= 0) appData.master.tahunAkademik[idx] = Object.assign({}, appData.master.tahunAkademik[idx], taObj);
        else appData.master.tahunAkademik.unshift(taObj);
        appendLocalActivityLog(payload.actor, action === 'updateTahunAkademik' ? 'Edit Tahun Akademik' : 'Tambah Tahun Akademik', `${taObj.ID} (${taObj['Tahun Akademik']})`, 'Pembaruan tahun akademik (lokal)', payload.role);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Data tahun akademik berhasil disimpan (lokal).' });
        return;
      }

      if (action === "deleteTahunAkademik") {
        const id = args && args[0];
        const actName = args && args[1];
        const actRole = args && args[2];
        if (appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.tahunAkademik)) {
          appData.master.tahunAkademik = appData.master.tahunAkademik.filter(t => String(t.ID || t.id).trim() !== String(id).trim());
        }
        appendLocalActivityLog(actName, 'Hapus Tahun Akademik', String(id || ''), 'Menghapus tahun akademik dari sistem (lokal)', actRole);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Tahun akademik berhasil dihapus (lokal).' });
        return;
      }

      if (action === "addRuangan") {
        const payload = (args && args[0]) || {};
        appData.master = appData.master || {};
        appData.master.ruangan = Array.isArray(appData.master.ruangan) ? appData.master.ruangan : (Array.isArray(appData.ruangan) ? appData.ruangan : []);
        const rId = payload.id || ('RNG-' + String(appData.master.ruangan.length + 1).padStart(3, '0'));
        const rObj = {
          ID: rId,
          'Kode Ruangan': payload.kodeRuangan || '',
          'Nama Ruangan': payload.namaRuangan || '',
          Kapasitas: payload.kapasitas || 30,
          Gedung: payload.gedung || '',
          Keterangan: payload.keterangan || ''
        };
        appData.master.ruangan.unshift(rObj);
        appData.ruangan = appData.master.ruangan;
        appendLocalActivityLog(payload.actor, 'Tambah Ruangan', `${rObj['Kode Ruangan']} (${rObj['Nama Ruangan']})`, 'Penambahan master ruangan (lokal)', payload.role);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Ruangan berhasil disimpan (lokal).' });
        return;
      }

      if (action === "deleteRuangan") {
        const id = args && args[0];
        const actName = args && args[1];
        const actRole = args && args[2];
        const filterFn = r => String(r.ID || r.id || r['Kode Ruangan'] || '').trim() !== String(id).trim();
        if (appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.ruangan)) appData.master.ruangan = appData.master.ruangan.filter(filterFn);
        if (Array.isArray(appData.ruangan)) appData.ruangan = appData.ruangan.filter(filterFn);
        appendLocalActivityLog(actName, 'Hapus Ruangan', String(id || ''), 'Menghapus ruangan dari sistem (lokal)', actRole);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Ruangan berhasil dihapus (lokal).' });
        return;
      }

      if (action === "changePassword") {
        const uname = args && args[0];
        const actName = args && args[3];
        const actRole = args && args[4];
        appendLocalActivityLog(actName || uname, 'Ubah Password', String(uname || ''), 'Pembaruan kata sandi akun (lokal)', actRole);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, message: 'Password berhasil diperbarui (tersimpan di sesi aktif).' });
        return;
      }

      if (action === "saveSuratPengantarRecord" || action === "verifySuratPengantarStep" || action === "deleteSuratPengantarRecord" || action === "saveDigitalSpecimen") {
        if (typeof handleLocalSuratGasFallback === 'function') {
          handleLocalSuratGasFallback(action, args, onSuccess);
          return;
        }
      }

      // Default fallback
      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess({ success: true, message: "Aksi [" + action + "] berhasil diproses di memori lokal." });
      }
    }

    async function callGasApi(action, args, onSuccess, onFailure) {
      const targetUrl = (getGasApiUrl() || GAS_API_URL || '').trim();
      if (!targetUrl) {
        handleLocalGasFallback(action, args, onSuccess, onFailure);
        return;
      }

      try {
        const resp = await fetch(targetUrl, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=utf-8" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ action: action, args: args })
        });
        if (!resp.ok) {
          throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status + ': ' + resp.statusText);
        }
        const res = await resp.json();
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess(res);
      } catch (err) {
        // Jangan panggil console.error agar tidak memicu unhandled runtime error di iframe dev environment
        console.warn("GAS API offline/CORS fallback untuk [" + action + "]:", err?.message || err);
        handleLocalGasFallback(action, args, onSuccess, onFailure, err);
      }
    }

    function hydrateUikaLogos() {
      try {
        if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !LOGO_UIKA_BASE64) return;
        const logos = document.querySelectorAll('img[data-uika-logo="true"]');
        for (let i = 0; i < logos.length; i++) {
          if (logos[i].getAttribute('src') !== LOGO_UIKA_BASE64) {
            logos[i].setAttribute('src', LOGO_UIKA_BASE64);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    // Hidrasi logo UIKA di kartu login seketika tanpa menunggu akhir dokumen
    if (typeof hydrateUikaLogos === 'function') hydrateUikaLogos();

    window.__sipBootErrors = window.__sipBootErrors || [];
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') {
      window.addEventListener('error', function(ev) {
        try {
          const msg = (ev && ev.message) ? String(ev.message) : 'Script error';
          const loc = (ev && ev.lineno) ? ('baris ' + ev.lineno) : '';
          window.__sipBootErrors.push(msg + (loc ? ' (' + loc + ')' : ''));
        } catch (eCap) {}
      });
    }

    function sipResetLoginLog() {
      // Log proses login disembunyikan dari UI dan dicatat di Console (F12) saja
    }

    function sipAppendLoginLog(stage, message, level) {
      const lvl = level || 'info';
      try {
        const logFn = lvl === 'error' ? console.error : (lvl === 'warning' ? console.warn : console.info);
        logFn('[SIP-LOGIN][' + stage + ']', message);
      } catch (eLog) {}
    }

    function sipHandleEarlyLoginClick(e) {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      sipResetLoginLog();
      sipAppendLoginLog('BOOT', 'Tombol Masuk Sistem diklik, memeriksa kesiapan skrip...', 'info');
      if (typeof handleLogin === 'function') {
        handleLogin(e);
        return;
      }
      const bootErrDetail = (Array.isArray(window.__sipBootErrors) && window.__sipBootErrors.length > 0)
        ? (' Detail: ' + window.__sipBootErrors[0])
        : '';
      const errMsg = 'Skrip utama login (handleLogin) gagal termuat atau terpotong saat disalin ke Apps Script.' + bootErrDetail + ' Buka Console (F12) dan salin ulang Index.html versi terbaru dari menu Source Code & Skrip.';
      sipAppendLoginLog('ERROR', errMsg, 'error');
      const alertBox = document.getElementById('loginErrorAlert');
      if (alertBox) {
        alertBox.className = 'rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2.5';
        alertBox.textContent = errMsg;
      }
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    let currentUser = null;
    function getCurrentActorName(preferredFallback, defaultFallback) {
      const roleLikeSet = new Set([
        'admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'master admin', 'master_admin',
        'mahasiswa', 'dosen', 'kaprodi', 'dekanat', 'dekan', 'wakil dekan',
        'sekprodi', 'staff', 'petugas', 'user', 'sistem', 'system', 'pengguna', 'pengguna sistem'
      ]);
      const isRoleOnly = (val) => {
        const v = String(val || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        return !v || roleLikeSet.has(v);
      };

      const lookupFullNameByKey = (keyStr) => {
        const k = String(keyStr || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!k || isRoleOnly(k) || typeof appData !== 'object' || !appData) return '';
        const staffList = [].concat(
          Array.isArray(appData.users_staff) ? appData.users_staff : [],
          (appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.user_staff)) ? appData.master.user_staff : []
        );
        const mhsList = [].concat(
          Array.isArray(appData.users_mahasiswa) ? appData.users_mahasiswa : [],
          (appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.user_mahasiswa)) ? appData.master.user_mahasiswa : []
        );
        const staffHit = staffList.find(s => [s.Username, s.username, s.NIK, s.nik, s.NIP, s.nip, s.Email, s.email].some(f => String(f || '').trim().toLowerCase() === k));
        if (staffHit) {
          const nm = String(staffHit['Nama Lengkap'] || staffHit.Nama || staffHit.nama || '').trim();
          if (nm && !isRoleOnly(nm)) return nm;
        }
        const mhsHit = mhsList.find(m => [m.NPM, m.NIM, m.npm, m.nim, m.Username, m.username, m.Email, m.email].some(f => String(f || '').trim().toLowerCase() === k));
        if (mhsHit) {
          const nm = String(mhsHit['Nama Lengkap'] || mhsHit['Nama Mahasiswa'] || mhsHit.Nama || mhsHit.nama || '').trim();
          if (nm && !isRoleOnly(nm)) return nm;
        }
        return '';
      };

      let activeUser = (typeof currentUser === 'object' && currentUser) ? currentUser : null;
      if (!activeUser) {
        try {
          const rawSaved = sipSafeStorageGet('sip_user');
          if (rawSaved) activeUser = JSON.parse(rawSaved);
        } catch (eSess) {}
      }

      if (activeUser && typeof activeUser === 'object') {
        const directName = String(
          activeUser.nama ||
          activeUser.namaLengkap ||
          activeUser['Nama Lengkap'] ||
          activeUser['Nama Mahasiswa'] ||
          activeUser.fullName ||
          ''
        ).trim();
        if (directName && !isRoleOnly(directName)) return directName;

        const userIdKey = String(activeUser.username || activeUser.npm || activeUser.nim || activeUser.nik || activeUser.email || '').trim();
        const resolvedFromMaster = lookupFullNameByKey(userIdKey);
        if (resolvedFromMaster) return resolvedFromMaster;

        if (userIdKey && !isRoleOnly(userIdKey)) return userIdKey;
      }

      const pref = String(preferredFallback || '').trim();
      if (pref && !isRoleOnly(pref)) {
        const lookedUpPref = lookupFullNameByKey(pref);
        return lookedUpPref || pref;
      }

      const def = String(defaultFallback || '').trim();
      if (def && !isRoleOnly(def)) return def;

      return 'Pengguna Sistem';
    }
    function getCurrentActorRole(fallbackRole) {
      let activeUser = (typeof currentUser === 'object' && currentUser) ? currentUser : null;
      if (!activeUser) {
        try {
          const rawSaved = sipSafeStorageGet('sip_user');
          if (rawSaved) activeUser = JSON.parse(rawSaved);
        } catch (eSess) {}
      }
      if (activeUser && activeUser.role) {
        return String(activeUser.role).trim();
      }
      return String(fallbackRole || 'User').trim();
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [PERBAIKAN BAGIAN WAKTU & FORMAT JAM/TANGGAL]

    function isHubungiDosenSchedule(item) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return false;
      const mode = String(item.mode || item.scheduleMode || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (mode === 'contact_lecturer' || mode === 'hubungi_dosen') return true;
      const tgl = String(item['Tanggal Ujian'] || item.tanggalUjian || item.tanggal || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const ruang = String(item.Ruangan || item.ruangan || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const jm = String(item['Jam Mulai'] || item.jamMulai || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const hasKeyword = (s) => s.includes('hubungi dosen') || s.includes('konfirmasi dosen') || s.includes('konfirmasi ke dosen') || s === 'hubungi_dosen';
      return hasKeyword(tgl) || hasKeyword(ruang) || hasKeyword(jm);
    }
    window.isHubungiDosenSchedule = isHubungiDosenSchedule;

    function extractCleanJadwalNote(rawKet) {
      let s = String(rawKet || '').trim();
      if (!s || s === '-') return '';
      s = s.replace(/\s*\[ID:\s*REG-\d+\]/gi, '');
      s = s.replace(/\s*\|\s*Peserta\s*:\s*[^|\[\n]+/gi, '');
      s = s.replace(/^Peserta\s*:\s*[^|\[\n]+/gi, '');
      return s.replace(/^[\s|]+|[\s|]+$/g, '').trim();
    }
    window.extractCleanJadwalNote = extractCleanJadwalNote;

    function formatJamClean(t) {
      if (!t) return '08:00';
      const s = String(t).trim();
      if (!s || s === '-' || s.toLowerCase().includes('hubungi') || s.toLowerCase().includes('konfirmasi')) return '-';
      if (s.indexOf('1899') !== -1 || s.indexOf('1900') !== -1) {
        const dt = new Date(s);
        if (!isNaN(dt.getTime())) {
          return String(dt.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(dt.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
        }
      }
      const match = s.match(/(\d{1,2})[:.](\d{2})/);
      if (match) return match[1].padStart(2, '0') + ':' + match[2];
      return s;
    }

    function hitungDurasiMenit(mulai, selesai) {
      try {
        const cleanM = formatJamClean(mulai);
        const cleanS = formatJamClean(selesai);
        if (!cleanM || !cleanS || cleanM === '-' || cleanS === '-') return '';
        const [h1, m1] = cleanM.split(':').map(Number);
        const [h2, m2] = cleanS.split(':').map(Number);
        const diff = (h2 * 60 + m2) - (h1 * 60 + m1);
        if (diff > 0) return diff + ' Menit';
      } catch (e) {}
      return '90 Menit';
    }

    function formatTanggalIndo(tglStr) {
      if (!tglStr) return '-';
      const rawLower = String(tglStr).trim().toLowerCase();
      if (rawLower.includes('hubungi dosen') || rawLower.includes('konfirmasi dosen') || rawLower === 'hubungi_dosen') {
        return 'Hubungi / Konfirmasi Dosen';
      }
      try {
        let dt = null;
        if (tglStr instanceof Date) {
          dt = tglStr;
        } else {
          const s = String(tglStr).trim().split('T')[0].split(' ')[0];
          if (s.indexOf('-') !== -1) {
            const parts = s.split('-');
            if (parts[0].length === 4) dt = new Date(parts[0], parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1, parts[2]);
          } else if (s.indexOf('/') !== -1) {
            const parts = s.split('/');
            dt = new Date(parts[2], parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1, parts[0]);
          }
        }
        if (dt && !isNaN(dt.getTime())) {
          const hari = ['Minggu', 'Senin', 'Selasa', 'Rabu', 'Kamis', 'Jumat', 'Sabtu'][dt.getDay()];
          const bulan = ['Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni', 'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember'][dt.getMonth()];
          return `${hari}, ${dt.getDate()} ${bulan} ${dt.getFullYear()}`;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return String(tglStr);
    }

    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      try { if (typeof hydrateUikaLogos === 'function') hydrateUikaLogos(); } catch (e) {}
      try { initSidebarShellControls(); } catch (e) {}
      try { populateMasterDropdowns(); } catch (e) {}
