      if (loginFormEl) {
        loginFormEl.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
          if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
          handleLogin(e);
          return false;
        });
      }

      // Listener tombol Enter pada input login
      ['loginUsername', 'loginPassword'].forEach(id => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) {
          el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
              e.preventDefault();
              handleLogin(e);
            }
          });
          el.addEventListener('input', () => {
            if (typeof clearLoginErrorAlert === 'function') clearLoginErrorAlert();
          });
        }
      });

      // Polling sinkronisasi real-time (juga cek otomatis saat kembali dari tab Google Sheets)
      let isRealtimeSyncRunning = false;
      let lastRealtimeSyncAt = 0;
      function runRealtimeSyncCheck(force = false) {
        if (!currentUser || typeof google === 'undefined' || !google.script || !google.script.run) return;
        const nowTs = Date.now();
        if (isRealtimeSyncRunning) return;
        if (!force && nowTs - lastRealtimeSyncAt < 2000) return;

        isRealtimeSyncRunning = true;
        lastRealtimeSyncAt = nowTs;
        const queryUser = currentUser.npm || currentUser.username || '';
        const queryProdi = currentUser.kodeProdi || currentUser.prodi || '';

        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(res => {
            isRealtimeSyncRunning = false;
            if (res && res.changed && res.success) {
              appData = res;
              if (!appData.master) appData.master = {};
              if (!Array.isArray(appData.master.periode)) appData.master.periode = [];
              if (!Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) appData.pendaftaran = [];
              if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
              refreshAllViews();
              const pendModal = document.getElementById('modalPendaftaran');
              if (pendModal && !pendModal.classList.contains('hidden') && typeof syncPeriodeToPendaftaran === 'function') {
                syncPeriodeToPendaftaran();
              }
            }
          })
          .withFailureHandler(() => {
            isRealtimeSyncRunning = false;
          })
          .checkRealtimeSync(appData.version, currentUser.role, queryUser, queryProdi);
      }

      setInterval(() => runRealtimeSyncCheck(true), 7000);
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
        if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') runRealtimeSyncCheck(false);
      });
      window.addEventListener('focus', () => runRealtimeSyncCheck(false));
    });

    function checkStoredSession() {
      try {
        const savedUser = sipSafeStorageGet('sip_user');
        if (savedUser) {
          currentUser = JSON.parse(savedUser);
          if (currentUser && currentUser.username) {
            if ((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa' && !currentUser.npm) {
              currentUser.npm = currentUser.username;
            }
            initUserUI();
          }
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [LOGIN & LOGOUT FLOW RESILIENCE]
    // ==========================================
    function setLoginErrorAlert(type, message) {
      const box = document.getElementById('loginErrorAlert');
      if (!box) return;
      const isWarn = type === 'warning';
      box.className = isWarn
        ? 'rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2.5'
        : 'rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2.5';
      const iconCls = isWarn ? 'fas fa-exclamation-triangle text-amber-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0' : 'fas fa-circle-exclamation text-rose-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0';
      box.innerHTML = `<i class="${iconCls}"></i><span>${String(message || '').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')}</span>`;
    }

    function clearLoginErrorAlert() {
      const box = document.getElementById('loginErrorAlert');
      if (box) {
        box.className = 'hidden rounded-xl border px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold flex items-start gap-2.5';
        box.innerHTML = '';
      }
    }

    function showLoginSwalSafe(opts) {
      try {
        if (typeof Swal !== 'undefined' && Swal && typeof Swal.fire === 'function') {
          Swal.fire(opts);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    function fillQuickLogin(user, pass) {
      const uInput = document.getElementById('loginUsername');
      const pInput = document.getElementById('loginPassword');
      if (uInput) uInput.value = user;
      if (pInput) pInput.value = pass;
      handleLogin();
    }

    function handleLogin(e) {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      if (e && e.stopPropagation) e.stopPropagation();

      const logStep = (stage, msg, lvl) => {
        if (typeof sipAppendLoginLog === 'function') {
          sipAppendLoginLog(stage, msg, lvl);
        }
      };

      const uInput = document.getElementById('loginUsername');
      const pInput = document.getElementById('loginPassword');
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnLoginSubmit');

      if (btn && btn.disabled) {
        logStep('INFO', 'Permintaan login sebelumnya masih diproses, harap tunggu...', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      if (typeof sipResetLoginLog === 'function') sipResetLoginLog();
      logStep('KLIK', 'Tombol Masuk Sistem ditekan.', 'info');

      clearLoginErrorAlert();
      let username = (uInput?.value || '').trim();
      let password = (pInput?.value || '').trim();

      // VALIDASI KETAT: Wajib isi, tolak submit kosong!
      if (!username || !password) {
        const msg = 'Harap masukkan Username / NPM / NIK dan Password Anda.';
        logStep('VALIDASI', 'Gagal: Username atau Password masih kosong.', 'warning');
        setLoginErrorAlert('warning', msg);
        showLoginSwalSafe({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Input Belum Lengkap',
          text: msg,
          confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
        });
        return;
      }

      logStep('VALIDASI', 'Input terisi untuk akun "' + username + '".', 'info');

      const hasGoogleObj = (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google && google.script && google.script.run);
      const isProxyEnv = Boolean(typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.google && window.google.__isProxy);
      const isNativeGas = Boolean(
        hasGoogleObj &&
        !isProxyEnv &&
        typeof google.script.run.loginUser === 'function'
      );

      logStep(
        'ENV',
        isNativeGas
          ? 'Terdeteksi runtime Native Google Apps Script (google.script.run.loginUser).'
          : 'Terdeteksi runtime Web Standalone / REST API GAS.',
        'info'
      );

      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = isNativeGas
          ? '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-2"></i> <span>Memverifikasi Akun di Server GAS...</span>'
          : '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-2"></i> <span>Memverifikasi Akun...</span>';
      }

      const resetBtn = () => {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = '<span>Masuk Sistem</span> <i class="fas fa-arrow-right text-xs"></i>';
        }
      };

      const showLoginFailed = (msg, title = 'Login Gagal') => {
        resetBtn();
        const finalMsg = msg || 'Username atau kata sandi yang Anda masukkan tidak sesuai. Coba lagi atau hubungi admin jika belum memiliki akun.';
        logStep('GAGAL', finalMsg, 'warning');
        if (pInput) pInput.value = '';
        setLoginErrorAlert('error', finalMsg);
        showLoginSwalSafe({
          icon: 'error',
          title: title,
          text: finalMsg,
          confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48'
        });
      };

      const handleAuthSuccess = (user) => {
        resetBtn();
        clearLoginErrorAlert();
        logStep('SUKSES', 'Login berhasil sebagai ' + (user.nama || user.username) + ' (' + (user.role || 'User') + '). Membuka dashboard...', 'success');
        currentUser = user;
        sipSafeStorageSet('sip_user', JSON.stringify(user));
        if (pInput) pInput.value = '';
        initUserUI();
        showLoginSwalSafe({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'Berhasil Masuk!',
          text: `Selamat datang, ${user.nama} (${user.role})`,
          timer: 1600,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
      };

      // 1. Lingkungan Google Apps Script Runtime (native google.script.run):
      //    Gunakan validasi server GAS penuh dengan timeout cold-start 30 detik (tanpa fallback mock client)
      if (isNativeGas) {
        let isResolved = false;
        const GAS_LOGIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000;
        logStep('GAS-RPC', 'Memanggil google.script.run.loginUser(...) dengan batas waktu 30 detik...', 'loading');
        const timeoutFallback = setTimeout(() => {
          if (!isResolved) {
            isResolved = true;
            logStep('TIMEOUT', 'Tidak ada respons dari server GAS setelah 30 detik.', 'error');
            showLoginFailed(
              'Server Google Apps Script tidak merespons dalam 30 detik (cold start / gangguan koneksi). Silakan klik Masuk Sistem kembali.',
              'Koneksi Server GAS Timeout'
            );
          }
        }, GAS_LOGIN_TIMEOUT_MS);

        try {
          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(res => {
              if (isResolved) return;
              isResolved = true;
              clearTimeout(timeoutFallback);
              logStep('RESPON', 'Respons diterima dari server GAS.', 'info');
              if (res && res.success && res.user) {
                handleAuthSuccess(res.user);
              } else if (!res) {
                showLoginFailed(
                  'Server GAS mengembalikan respons kosong. Pastikan Code.gs terbaru telah disimpan dan di-deploy sebagai versi baru.',
                  'Respons Server Tidak Valid'
                );
              } else {
                showLoginFailed(
                  res.message || 'Username atau kata sandi yang Anda masukkan tidak sesuai. Coba lagi atau hubungi admin jika belum memiliki akun.',
                  'Akun Tidak Ditemukan'
                );
              }
            })
            .withFailureHandler(err => {
              if (isResolved) return;
              isResolved = true;
              clearTimeout(timeoutFallback);
              const errMsg = (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err || 'Terjadi gangguan komunikasi dengan server GAS.');
              logStep('RPC-ERR', 'Server GAS mengembalikan error: ' + errMsg, 'error');
              showLoginFailed('Gagal memverifikasi akun di server GAS: ' + errMsg, 'Kesalahan Server GAS');
            })
            .loginUser(username, password);
        } catch (rpcErr) {
          if (!isResolved) {
            isResolved = true;
            clearTimeout(timeoutFallback);
            const rpcMsg = rpcErr?.message || String(rpcErr);
            logStep('RPC-CATCH', 'Eksekusi panggilan GAS gagal: ' + rpcMsg, 'error');
            showLoginFailed('Gagal memanggil server GAS: ' + rpcMsg, 'Kesalahan Sistem GAS');
          }
        }
      } else {
        // 2. Lingkungan Hostinger / GitHub Pages / Standalone:
        const apiUrl = typeof getGasApiUrl === 'function' ? getGasApiUrl() : (sipSafeStorageGet('SIP_GAS_API_URL') || '');
        if (apiUrl) {
          logStep('FETCH', 'Mengirim permintaan login ke endpoint Web App GAS...', 'loading');
          fetch(apiUrl, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'loginUser', args: [username, password] })
          })
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(res => {
              if (res && res.success && res.user) {
                handleAuthSuccess(res.user);
              } else {
                showLoginFailed(res?.message || 'Username atau kata sandi yang Anda masukkan tidak sesuai. Coba lagi atau hubungi admin jika belum memiliki akun.', 'Akun Tidak Ditemukan');
              }
            })
            .catch(() => {
              logStep('FALLBACK', 'Endpoint REST tidak terjangkau, mencocokkan dengan cache data lokal...', 'warning');
              verifyClientSideLogin(username, password, handleAuthSuccess, (m) => showLoginFailed(m, 'Akun Tidak Ditemukan'));
            });
        } else {
          logStep('LOKAL', 'Memverifikasi akun menggunakan data sheet di memori lokal...', 'loading');
          verifyClientSideLogin(username, password, handleAuthSuccess, (m) => showLoginFailed(m, 'Akun Tidak Ditemukan'));
        }
      }
    }

    // Verifikasi kredensial terhadap data resmi spreadsheet di memori aman (User_Staff & User_Mahasiswa)
    function verifyClientSideLogin(username, password, onSuccess, onFailed) {
      const cleanUser = String(username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const cleanPass = String(password || '').trim();

      if (!cleanUser || !cleanPass) {
        onFailed('Harap masukkan Username dan Password.');
        return;
      }

      const emailPrefix = cleanUser.indexOf('@') !== -1 ? cleanUser.split('@')[0] : cleanUser;
      const simplePrefix = emailPrefix.indexOf('.') !== -1 ? emailPrefix.split('.')[0] : emailPrefix;

      // 1. Cek di daftar User_Staff (Master Admin, Admin TU, Dekan, Wakil Dekan, KaProdi, SekProdi)
      const staffList = appData.users_staff || [];
      const foundStaff = staffList.find(u => {
        const uName = String(u.Username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const uNik = String(u.NIK || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const uEmail = String(u.Email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const uPass = String(u.Password || '').trim();

        const isUserMatch = (
          uName === cleanUser ||
          uNik === cleanUser ||
          uEmail === cleanUser ||
          uName === emailPrefix ||
          uName === simplePrefix
        );
        return isUserMatch && uPass === cleanPass;
      });

      if (foundStaff) {
        onSuccess({
          username: String(foundStaff.Username).trim(),
          role: foundStaff.Role || 'Staff',
          nama: foundStaff['Nama Lengkap'] || foundStaff.Username,
          kodeProdi: foundStaff['Kode Prodi'] || 'ALL',
          prodi: foundStaff['Kode Prodi'] || 'ALL',
          nik: String(foundStaff.NIK || '').trim()
        });
        return;
      }

      // 2. Cek di daftar User_Mahasiswa
      const mhsList = appData.users_mahasiswa || [];
      const foundMhs = mhsList.find(u => {
        const uName = String(u.Username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const uNpm = String(u.NPM || u.NIM || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const uPass = String(u.Password || '').trim();

        const isUserMatch = (
          uName === cleanUser ||
          uNpm === cleanUser ||
          uName === emailPrefix ||
          uNpm === emailPrefix
        );
        return isUserMatch && uPass === cleanPass;
      });

      if (foundMhs) {
        const rawKelas = foundMhs.Kelas || foundMhs.kelas || 'Reguler A';
        const cleanKls = typeof normalizeClassNameClient === 'function' ? normalizeClassNameClient(rawKelas) : rawKelas;
        const katKelas = typeof detectCategoryFromClassClient === 'function' ? detectCategoryFromClassClient(cleanKls) : (foundMhs.KategoriKelas || 'Reguler');
        const angkatanVal = parseInt(foundMhs.Angkatan || foundMhs.angkatan || '2023', 10);
        const semVal = foundMhs.Semester || (typeof calculateSemesterFromAngkatan === 'function' ? calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(angkatanVal) : 'Semester 5');

        onSuccess({
          username: String(foundMhs.Username || foundMhs.NPM).trim(),
          role: 'Mahasiswa',
          nama: foundMhs['Nama Lengkap'] || foundMhs.Username,
          kodeProdi: foundMhs['Kode Prodi'] || 'MNJ',
          prodi: foundMhs['Kode Prodi'] || 'MNJ',
          npm: String(foundMhs.NPM || foundMhs.Username).trim(),
          kelas: cleanKls,
          kategoriKelas: katKelas,
          angkatan: angkatanVal,
          semester: semVal
        });
        return;
      }

      // Tolak akses jika kredensial tidak cocok
      onFailed('Username atau kata sandi yang Anda masukkan tidak sesuai. Coba lagi atau hubungi admin jika belum memiliki akun.');
    }

    function handleLogout() {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Keluar Sistem?',
        text: 'Anda akan keluar dari sesi akun aktif.',
        icon: 'question',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Keluar',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48'
      }).then((result) => {
        if (result.isConfirmed) {
          sipSafeStorageRemove('sip_user');
          currentUser = null;
          const loginSec = document.getElementById('loginSection');
          const mainSec = document.getElementById('mainAppSection');
          if (loginSec) loginSec.classList.remove('hidden');
          if (mainSec) {
            mainSec.classList.add('hidden');
            mainSec.classList.remove('flex');
          }
          const pInput = document.getElementById('loginPassword');
          if (pInput) pInput.value = '';
          if (typeof clearLoginErrorAlert === 'function') clearLoginErrorAlert();
          showLoginSwalSafe({
            icon: 'info',
            title: 'Sesi Selesai',
            text: 'Anda telah berhasil logout.',
            timer: 1200,
            showConfirmButton: false
          });
        }
      });
    }

    let isSidebarCollapsed = false;

    function applySidebarCollapsedState() {
      const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebarNav');
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnCollapseSidebar');
      if (!sidebar) return;
      sidebar.classList.toggle('sidebar-collapsed', isSidebarCollapsed);
      if (btn) {
        btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', isSidebarCollapsed ? 'true' : 'false');
        btn.setAttribute('title', isSidebarCollapsed ? 'Perluas Sidebar' : 'Lipat Sidebar');
      }
    }

    function toggleSidebarCollapsed() {
      isSidebarCollapsed = !isSidebarCollapsed;
      sipSafeStorageSet('sipusar_sidebar_collapsed', isSidebarCollapsed ? '1' : '0');
      applySidebarCollapsedState();
      if (typeof fitSuratPreviewSheets === 'function') {
        setTimeout(fitSuratPreviewSheets, 220);
      }
    }

    function initSidebarShellControls() {
      isSidebarCollapsed = sipSafeStorageGet('sipusar_sidebar_collapsed') === '1';
      applySidebarCollapsedState();

      if (!window._sipSidebarShellBound) {
        window._sipSidebarShellBound = true;
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && window.innerWidth < 768) {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebarNav');
            if (sidebar && !sidebar.classList.contains('-translate-x-full')) {
              toggleSidebar(false);
            }
          }
        });
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
            const backdrop = document.getElementById('sidebarBackdrop');
            if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.add('hidden');
            document.body.classList.remove('overflow-hidden');
          }
        });
      }
    }

    function toggleSidebar(show) {
      const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebarNav');
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('sidebarBackdrop');
      if (!sidebar) return;
      let isOpen = false;
      if (show === undefined) {
        isOpen = !sidebar.classList.contains('-translate-x-full');
        isOpen = !isOpen;
      } else {
        isOpen = Boolean(show);
      }
      if (isOpen) {
        sidebar.classList.remove('-translate-x-full');
        if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (window.innerWidth < 768) document.body.classList.add('overflow-hidden');
      } else {
        sidebar.classList.add('-translate-x-full');
        if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.add('hidden');
        document.body.classList.remove('overflow-hidden');
      }
    }

    function isInvoiceAllowed() {
      if (!currentUser || !currentUser.role) return false;
      const role = currentUser.role.toString().trim().toLowerCase();
      // Khusus: Master Admin, Admin TU, Dekan, dan Wakil Dekan
      return ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin', 'dekan', 'wakil dekan', 'wadek'].includes(role);
    }

    function isMasterAdmin() {
      if (!currentUser || !currentUser.role) return false;
      const role = currentUser.role.toString().trim().toLowerCase();
      return role === 'master admin' || role === 'master_admin';
    }

    function isSuratDosenAllowed() {
      if (!currentUser || !currentUser.role) return false;
      const role = currentUser.role.toString().trim().toLowerCase();
      return ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin', 'ketua program studi', 'kaprodi', 'sekretaris program studi', 'sekprodi'].includes(role);
    }

    function hideElem(id) {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) {
        el.classList.add('hidden');
        el.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
      }
    }

    function showElem(id, displayStyle = '') {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) {
        el.classList.remove('hidden');
        if (displayStyle) {
          el.style.setProperty('display', displayStyle, 'important');
        } else {
          el.style.removeProperty('display');
        }
      }
    }

        hideElem('btnEndpointApiGas');

        hideElem('btnTambahPendaftaran');
        hideElem('btnTongSampahPendaftaran');
        hideElem('btnTambahJadwal');
        hideElem('btnBulkDeleteNotif');
        hideElem('btnDeleteAllNotif');
        hideElem('containerSelectAllNotif');
        hideElem('btnTambahNotifikasi');
        hideElem('btnTambahPeriode');

        const subKaprodi = document.getElementById('notifSubtitleText');

    function initUserUI() {
      if (!currentUser) return;
      if (typeof hydrateUikaLogos === 'function') hydrateUikaLogos();
      document.getElementById('loginSection').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('mainAppSection').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('mainAppSection').classList.add('flex');

      const nameStr = currentUser.nama || currentUser.username || '-';
      const roleStr = currentUser.role || '-';
      const roleLower = roleStr.toLowerCase().trim();

      document.getElementById('userDisplayName').innerText = nameStr;
      document.getElementById('userRoleBadge').innerText = roleStr;
      const initElem = document.getElementById('sidebarUserInitial');
      if (initElem) initElem.innerText = nameStr.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

      updateSidebarVisibility();

      const roleNotice = document.getElementById('pendaftaranRoleNotice');
      if (roleLower === 'mahasiswa') {
        if (!currentUser.npm && currentUser.username) {
          currentUser.npm = currentUser.username;
        }
        const selProdi = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranProdi') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterProdi');
        if (selProdi) selProdi.value = '';
        const selStatus = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranStatus') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterStatus');
        if (selStatus) selStatus.value = '';
        const selLayanan = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranLayanan') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterLayanan');
        if (selLayanan) selLayanan.value = '';
        const selSort = document.getElementById('sortPendaftaran');
        if (selSort) selSort.value = 'tanggal-desc';
        const selSearch = document.getElementById('searchPendaftaran');
        if (selSearch) selSearch.value = '';
        if (typeof syncPendaftaranSearchClearButton === 'function') syncPendaftaranSearchClearButton();

        if (roleNotice) roleNotice.innerText = 'Pendaftaran & Cek Riwayat Pendaftaran Mahasiswa (NPM: ' + (currentUser.npm || currentUser.username) + ')';
        switchTab('pendaftaran');
      } else {
        if (roleNotice) roleNotice.innerText = 'Mode ' + currentUser.role + ': Pemantauan dan pengelolaan pendaftaran FEB UIKA.';
        switchTab('executive');
      }

      // [CACHE PINTAR 0 DETIK]: Muat seketika dari cache browser jika tersedia
      const cached = loadCachedAppData();
      if (cached) {
        appData = cached;
        refreshAllViews();
        updateSyncStatusIndicator('cache');
      }

      // Jalankan sinkronisasi background secara senyap
      loadAppData(true);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [MODUL CACHE PINTAR & INDIKATOR STATUS REALTIME]
    // ==========================================
    function saveAppDataCache(data) {
      try {
        if (data && data.success) {
          sipSafeStorageSet('SIP_APP_DATA_CACHE_V2', JSON.stringify({
            data: data,
            savedAt: Date.now()
          }));
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Gagal menyimpan cache lokal:', err);
      }
    }

    function loadCachedAppData() {
      try {
        const raw = sipSafeStorageGet('SIP_APP_DATA_CACHE_V2');
        if (!raw) return null;
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed && parsed.data && parsed.data.success) {
          return parsed.data;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Gagal memuat cache lokal:', err);
      }
      return null;
    }

    function updateSyncStatusIndicator(state) {
      const badge = document.getElementById('badgeRealtimeSync');
      const dot = document.getElementById('dotRealtimeSync');
      const text = document.getElementById('textRealtimeSync');
      if (!badge || !text) return;

      if (state === 'cache') {
        badge.className = 'hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 transition-all duration-300';
        if (dot) dot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500 animate-pulse';
        text.innerText = 'Cache Lokal (0 Detik)';
      } else if (state === 'syncing') {
        badge.className = 'hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200 transition-all duration-300';
        if (dot) dot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-pulse';
        text.innerText = 'Sinkronisasi...';
      } else {
        badge.className = 'hidden sm:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 transition-all duration-300';
        if (dot) dot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse';
        text.innerText = 'Realtime Sync Aktif';
      }
    }

    function refreshAllViews() {
      try {
        if (typeof populateMasterDropdowns === 'function') populateMasterDropdowns();
        if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
        if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable();
        if (typeof renderJadwalUjianTable === 'function') renderJadwalUjianTable();
        if (typeof renderKartuUjianDigital === 'function') renderKartuUjianDigital();
        if (typeof renderSuratDosenWorkspace === 'function') renderSuratDosenWorkspace();
        if (typeof renderNotifikasiList === 'function') renderNotifikasiList();
        if (typeof renderPeriodeTable === 'function') renderPeriodeTable();
        if (typeof renderInvoiceTable === 'function') renderInvoiceTable();
        if (typeof renderMasterDataTable === 'function') renderMasterDataTable();
        if (typeof renderRuanganTable === 'function') renderRuanganTable();
        if (typeof renderSpreadsheetWorkbook === 'function') renderSpreadsheetWorkbook();
        if (typeof syncActivePeriodBanner === 'function') syncActivePeriodBanner();
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Error refreshing views:', err);
      }
    }

    function loadAppData(isSilent = false) {
      const btn = document.querySelector('button[onclick="loadAppData()"]');
      if (btn && !isSilent) {
        btn.classList.add('opacity-75');
        const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
        if (icon) icon.classList.add('fa-spin');
      }
      if (!isSilent) updateSyncStatusIndicator('syncing');

      const finishRefresh = (res) => {
        if (btn) {
          btn.classList.remove('opacity-75');
          const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
          if (icon) icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
        }
        if (res && res.success) {
          const localPendaftaran = appData.pendaftaran || [];
          const localSampah = appData.sampahPendaftaran || [];
          const localSurat = Array.isArray(appData.suratPengantar) ? appData.suratPengantar : [];
          const localSpesimen = Array.isArray(appData.spesimenTtd) ? appData.spesimenTtd : [];
          const isFallback = Boolean(res.isLocalFallback);
          appData = res;
          if (!appData.master) appData.master = {};
          if (!Array.isArray(appData.master.periode)) appData.master.periode = [];
          if (!Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) appData.pendaftaran = [];
          if (!Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran)) appData.sampahPendaftaran = [];
          if (!Array.isArray(appData.suratPengantar)) appData.suratPengantar = [];
          if (!Array.isArray(appData.spesimenTtd)) appData.spesimenTtd = [];

          if (isFallback) {
            const trashedIdSet = new Set(localSampah.map(s => String(s.ID || s.id || '').trim()).filter(Boolean));
            localPendaftaran.forEach(loc => {
              const locId = String(loc.ID || loc.id || '').trim();
              if (trashedIdSet.has(locId)) return;
              const exists = appData.pendaftaran.some(s => String(s.ID || s.id || '').trim() === locId);
              if (!exists) {
                appData.pendaftaran.unshift(loc);
              }
            });
            if (localSampah.length > 0 && appData.sampahPendaftaran.length === 0) {
              appData.sampahPendaftaran = localSampah;
            }
            if (localSurat.length > 0 && appData.suratPengantar.length === 0) {
              appData.suratPengantar = localSurat;
            }
            if (localSpesimen.length > 0 && appData.spesimenTtd.length === 0) {
              appData.spesimenTtd = localSpesimen;
            }
          }

          if (!isFallback) {
            updateGasVersionBadgeFromInitialData(res);
          }

          saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        refreshAllViews();
        if (typeof syncSampahPendaftaranBadge === 'function') syncSampahPendaftaranBadge();
        const modalSampah = document.getElementById('modalSampahPendaftaran');
        if (modalSampah && !modalSampah.classList.contains('hidden') && typeof renderSampahPendaftaranTable === 'function') {
          renderSampahPendaftaranTable();
        }
        updateSyncStatusIndicator('online');

        if (!isSilent) {
          try {
            const Toast = Swal.mixin({
              toast: true,
              position: 'top-end',
              showConfirmButton: false,
              timer: 1500,
              timerProgressBar: true
            });
            Toast.fire({
              icon: 'success',
              title: 'Data Berhasil Diperbarui'
            });
          } catch (e) {}
        }
      };

      const queryRole = currentUser ? currentUser.role : '';
      const queryUser = currentUser ? (currentUser.npm || currentUser.username || '') : '';
      const queryProdi = currentUser ? (currentUser.kodeProdi || currentUser.prodi || '') : '';

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(finishRefresh)
          .withFailureHandler(function(err) {
            if (btn) {
              btn.classList.remove('opacity-75');
              const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
              if (icon) icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
            }
            console.warn('Gagal memuat data live dari server, menggunakan data memori:', err);
            refreshAllViews();
          })
          .getInitialData(queryRole, queryUser, queryProdi);
      } else {
        // Standalone Hostinger / GitHub Pages: panggil via REST API (callGasApi)
        callGasApi(
          'getInitialData',
          [queryRole, queryUser, queryProdi],
          finishRefresh,
          function(err) {
            if (btn) {
              btn.classList.remove('opacity-75');
              const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
              if (icon) icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
            }
            console.warn('Gagal memuat data via REST API GAS, menggunakan data memori:', err);
            refreshAllViews();
          }
        );
      }
    }

    function switchTab(tab) {
      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      if (isMhs && ['executive', 'invoice', 'spreadsheet', 'periode', 'master', 'sourcecode', 'suratdosen'].includes(tab)) tab = 'pendaftaran';
      if (tab === 'sourcecode' && !isMasterAdmin()) tab = isMhs ? 'pendaftaran' : 'executive';
      if (tab === 'suratdosen' && !isSuratDosenAllowed()) tab = isMhs ? 'pendaftaran' : 'executive';

      const tabTitles = {
        executive: 'Dashboard Executive',
        pendaftaran: 'Riwayat Pendaftaran',
        jadwal: 'Jadwal Ujian',
        kartu: 'Kartu Ujian Digital',
        suratdosen: 'Surat Pengantar Dosen & Daftar Hadir',
        notifikasi: 'Notifikasi',
        periode: 'Jadwal Periode',
        invoice: 'Invoice & Kwitansi',
        master: 'Master Data & Log Sistem',
        spreadsheet: 'Database Website',
        sourcecode: 'Source Code & Skrip Sistem',
      };

      const titleElem = document.getElementById('pageHeaderTitle');
      if (titleElem && tabTitles[tab]) titleElem.innerText = tabTitles[tab];

      ['executive', 'pendaftaran', 'jadwal', 'kartu', 'suratdosen', 'notifikasi', 'periode', 'invoice', 'master', 'spreadsheet', 'sourcecode'].forEach(t => {
        const btn = document.getElementById('tabBtn' + t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1));
        const cnt = document.getElementById('tabContent' + t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1));
        if (btn && cnt) {
          if (t === tab) {
            btn.classList.add('bg-blue-600', 'text-white', 'font-bold', 'shadow-md', 'shadow-blue-900/40');
            btn.classList.remove('text-slate-300', 'hover:bg-slate-800', 'font-semibold');
            cnt.classList.remove('hidden');
          } else {
            btn.classList.remove('bg-blue-600', 'text-white', 'font-bold', 'shadow-md', 'shadow-blue-900/40');
            btn.classList.add('text-slate-300', 'hover:bg-slate-800', 'font-semibold');
            cnt.classList.add('hidden');
          }
        }
      });

      updateSidebarVisibility();
      toggleSidebar(false);

      if (tab === 'executive') renderExecutiveDashboard();
      if (tab === 'jadwal') renderJadwalUjianTable();
      if (tab === 'kartu') renderKartuUjianDigital();
      if (tab === 'suratdosen') renderSuratDosenWorkspace();
      if (tab === 'notifikasi') renderNotifikasiList();
      if (tab === 'pendaftaran') renderPendaftaranTable();
      if (tab === 'periode') renderPeriodeTable();
      if (tab === 'invoice') renderInvoiceTable();
      if (tab === 'master') renderMasterDataTable();
      if (tab === 'spreadsheet') renderSpreadsheetWorkbook();
      if (tab === 'sourcecode') renderSourceCodeView();
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    // ==========================================
    // [MODUL SOURCE CODE & SKRIP SISTEM]
    // Menampilkan Code.gs, Setup.gs, Index.html, dan Hostinger index.html
    // ==========================================
    let currentSourceFileName = 'Code.gs';
    const sourceFileCache = {};

    const sourceFileMeta = {
      'Code.gs': {
        path: '/gas/Code.gs',
        altPath: '/public/gas/Code.gs',
        target: 'Google Apps Script (Backend Engine + REST API)',
        badge: 'Backend GAS'
      },
      'Setup.gs': {
        path: '/gas/Setup.gs',
        altPath: '/public/gas/Setup.gs',
        target: 'Google Apps Script (Inisialisasi Database 14 Sheet)',
        badge: 'Setup Database'
      },
      'Index.html': {
        path: '/gas/Index.html.txt',
        altPath: '/gas/Index.html',
        extraPaths: ['/public/gas/Index.html.txt', '/public/gas/Index.html'],
        target: 'Google Apps Script (Frontend Web App Native)',
        badge: 'Frontend GAS'
      },
      'index.html': {
        path: '/hostinger/index.html.txt',
        altPath: '/hostinger/index.html',
        extraPaths: ['/public/hostinger/index.html.txt', '/public/hostinger/index.html'],
        target: 'Hostinger / cPanel Standalone (REST API Web Fetch)',
        badge: 'Frontend Hostinger'
      }
    };

    function sanitizeFetchedSourceText(fileName, txt) {
      if (!txt || fileName.endsWith('.gs')) return txt;
      const viteMarker = '/@vite/' + 'client';
      if (txt.includes(viteMarker)) return txt;
      const scOpen = '<scr' + 'ipt';
      const scClose = '<\\/scr' + 'ipt>';
      const iframeRegex = new RegExp(scOpen + '[^>]*src=["\\x27][^"\\x27]*\\/_aistudio-' + 'iframe\\.js[^"\\x27]*["\\x27][^>]*>\\s*' + scClose, 'gi');
      return txt.replace(iframeRegex, '');
    }

    function isValidSourcePayload(fileName, txt) {
      if (!txt || txt.length < 100) return false;
      const trimmed = txt.trim();
      if (fileName.endsWith('.gs')) {
        const docMark = '<' + '!DOCTYPE';
        const htmlOpenMark = '<' + 'html';
        if (trimmed.startsWith(docMark) || trimmed.startsWith(htmlOpenMark)) return false;
        return true;
      }
      // Untuk Index.html (GAS) & index.html (Hostinger), TOLAK mentah-mentah HTML SPA fallback Vite dev
      const viteMarker = '/@vite/' + 'client';
      const iframeMarker = '/_aistudio-' + 'iframe';
      if (txt.includes(viteMarker) || txt.includes(iframeMarker)) {
        return false;
      }
      const htmlCloseMark = '</' + 'html>';
      if (!trimmed.toLowerCase().endsWith(htmlCloseMark)) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    }

    async function loadSourceContent(fileName) {
      if (sourceFileCache[fileName]) return sourceFileCache[fileName];
      const meta = sourceFileMeta[fileName];
      if (!meta) return '// File tidak ditemukan';

      const candidatePaths = [
        meta.path,
        (meta.path.startsWith('/') ? meta.path.slice(1) : meta.path),
        './' + (meta.path.startsWith('/') ? meta.path.slice(1) : meta.path),
        meta.altPath,
        (meta.altPath.startsWith('/') ? meta.altPath.slice(1) : meta.altPath),
        ...(Array.isArray(meta.extraPaths) ? meta.extraPaths : []),
        fileName
      ];

      for (const p of candidatePaths) {
        try {
          const resp = await fetch(p, { cache: 'no-store' });
          if (resp && resp.ok) {
            const rawTxt = await resp.text();
            const txt = sanitizeFetchedSourceText(fileName, rawTxt);
            if (!isValidSourcePayload(fileName, txt)) {
              continue;
            }
            sourceFileCache[fileName] = txt;
            return txt;
          }
        } catch (err) {
          // continue candidate
        }
      }
      return '// Gagal memuat file bersih secara asinkron. Pastikan folder public/gas dan public/hostinger tersedia.';
    }

    async function renderSourceCodeView() {
      switchSourceTab(currentSourceFileName);
    }

    async function switchSourceTab(fileName) {
      currentSourceFileName = fileName;

      // Update styling tombol tab
      ['Code.gs', 'Setup.gs', 'Index.html', 'index.html'].forEach(f => {
        let btnId = 'btnSrcTabCodeGs';
        if (f === 'Setup.gs') btnId = 'btnSrcTabSetupGs';
        if (f === 'Index.html') btnId = 'btnSrcTabIndexHtml';
        if (f === 'index.html') btnId = 'btnSrcTabHostingerHtml';

        const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
        if (btn) {
          if (f === fileName) {
            btn.className = 'px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition font-bold text-xs bg-blue-900 text-white shadow-xs';
          } else {
            btn.className = 'px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition font-bold text-xs text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200';
          }
        }
      });

      const meta = sourceFileMeta[fileName] || { target: fileName, badge: 'Script' };
      const nameEl = document.getElementById('activeSourceFileName');
      const badgeEl = document.getElementById('activeSourceTargetBadge');
      const preEl = document.getElementById('sourceCodePreBlock');
      const linesEl = document.getElementById('activeSourceLinesCount');
      const sizeEl = document.getElementById('activeSourceSize');
      const readyEl = document.getElementById('activeSourceReadinessBadge');

      if (nameEl) nameEl.innerText = fileName;
      if (badgeEl) badgeEl.innerText = meta.badge;
      if (preEl) preEl.innerText = 'Memuat kode ' + fileName + '...';
      if (readyEl) {
        readyEl.className = 'text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-sans font-semibold';
        readyEl.innerText = 'Memeriksa integritas berkas...';
      }

      const content = await loadSourceContent(fileName);
      if (preEl) preEl.innerText = content;

      const lines = content.split('\n').length;
      const bytes = new Blob([content]).size;
      const kb = (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1);

      if (linesEl) linesEl.innerText = `${lines.toLocaleString('id-ID')} baris`;
      if (sizeEl) sizeEl.innerText = `${kb} KB`;
      if (readyEl) {
        const ok = isValidSourcePayload(fileName, content);
        if (ok) {
          readyEl.className = 'text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-sans font-semibold';
          readyEl.innerText = fileName === 'Index.html'
            ? `UTF-8 · Bebas Tag Dev/Vite · Siap Tempel ke GAS (${kb} KB)`
            : 'UTF-8 · Terverifikasi Utuh & Siap Salin';
        } else {
          readyEl.className = 'text-[10px] text-rose-400 font-sans font-semibold';
          readyEl.innerText = 'Peringatan: Berkas gagal terverifikasi utuh';
        }
      }
    }

    async function copyActiveSourceCode() {
      const content = sourceFileCache[currentSourceFileName] || document.getElementById('sourceCodePreBlock')?.innerText;
      if (!content) {
        Swal.fire('Gagal', 'Konten kode belum siap disalin.', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
        const Toast = Swal.mixin({
          toast: true,
          position: 'top-end',
          showConfirmButton: false,
          timer: 2000,
          timerProgressBar: true
        });
        Toast.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: `Kode ${currentSourceFileName} Berhasil Disalin ke Clipboard!`
        });
      } catch (e) {
        // Fallback textarea copy
        const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
        ta.value = content;
        document.body.appendChild(ta);
        ta.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(ta);
        Swal.fire('Tersalin', `Kode ${currentSourceFileName} berhasil disalin!`, 'success');
      }
    }

    function downloadActiveSourceFile() {
      const content = sourceFileCache[currentSourceFileName] || document.getElementById('sourceCodePreBlock')?.innerText;
      if (!content) {
        Swal.fire('Gagal', 'Konten file belum siap diunduh.', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      const mime = currentSourceFileName.endsWith('.gs') ? 'text/plain' : 'text/html';
      const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime + ';charset=utf-8' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = currentSourceFileName;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

      const Toast = Swal.mixin({
        toast: true,
        position: 'top-end',
        showConfirmButton: false,
        timer: 2500,
        timerProgressBar: true
      });
      Toast.fire({
        icon: 'success',
        title: `File ${currentSourceFileName} berhasil diunduh!`
      });
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [AUTOCOMPLETE ENGINE KOMPONEN: MATA KULIAH & DOSEN]
    // Fitur: Substring search, text highlighter, keyboard navigation (Up, Down, Enter, Esc, Tab),
    // deteksi click-outside, visual feedback, clear button, dan validasi ketat Master Data.
    // ==========================================
    function escapeHtml(str) {
      if (!str) return '';
      return String(str)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function highlightSearchMatch(text, query) {
      const rawText = String(text || '');
      if (!rawText) return '';
      const tokens = Array.from(new Set(
        String(query || '').trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
      )).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length);
      if (tokens.length === 0) return escapeHtml(rawText);
      const pattern = tokens.map(t => t.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')).join('|');
      const regex = new RegExp(`(${pattern})`, 'gi');
      const parts = rawText.split(regex);
      return parts.map((part, idx) =>
        idx % 2 === 1
          ? `<mark class="bg-amber-200 text-blue-950 font-extrabold px-0.5 rounded shadow-2xs">${escapeHtml(part)}</mark>`
          : escapeHtml(part)
      ).join('');
    }

    function getMasterMatkulDosenCatalog(options = {}) {
      const preferredProdi = String(options.preferredProdi || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const preferredMatkul = String(options.preferredMatkul || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const master = (typeof appData !== 'undefined' && appData && appData.master) ? appData.master : {};
      const allMatkul = Array.isArray(master.matkul) ? master.matkul : [];

      const dosenMap = new Map();
      allMatkul.forEach(m => {
        if (!m || typeof m !== 'object') return;
        const nama = String(m['Dosen Pengampu'] || m.dosen || m.dosenPengampu || '').trim();
        if (!nama || nama === '-') return;
        const key = nama.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
        const kodeProdi = String(m['Kode Prodi'] || m.Kode_Prodi || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        const namaMatkul = String(m['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || m.nama || m.mataKuliah || '').trim();
        const kelasStr = String(m.Kelas || m.kelas || '').trim();

        if (!dosenMap.has(key)) {
          dosenMap.set(key, {
            nama,
            prodiSet: new Set(),
            matkulSet: new Set(),
            kelasSet: new Set()
          });
        }
        const entry = dosenMap.get(key);
        if (kodeProdi) entry.prodiSet.add(kodeProdi);
        if (namaMatkul) entry.matkulSet.add(namaMatkul);
        if (kelasStr) entry.kelasSet.add(kelasStr);
      });

      const list = Array.from(dosenMap.values()).map(entry => {
        const prodiList = Array.from(entry.prodiSet);
        const matkulList = Array.from(entry.matkulSet);
        const kelasList = Array.from(entry.kelasSet);
        const matchesPreferredProdi = preferredProdi ? prodiList.includes(preferredProdi) : false;
        const teachesPreferredMatkul = preferredMatkul
          ? matkulList.some(mk => mk.toLowerCase() === preferredMatkul || mk.toLowerCase().includes(preferredMatkul))
          : false;
        const primaryProdi = matchesPreferredProdi ? preferredProdi : (prodiList[0] || 'FEB');

        return {
          nama: entry.nama,
          prodiList,
          primaryProdi,
          matkulList,
          kelasList,
          matchesPreferredProdi,
          teachesPreferredMatkul
        };
      });

      list.sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.teachesPreferredMatkul !== b.teachesPreferredMatkul) {
          return a.teachesPreferredMatkul ? -1 : 1;
        }
        if (a.matchesPreferredProdi !== b.matchesPreferredProdi) {
          return a.matchesPreferredProdi ? -1 : 1;
        }
        return a.nama.localeCompare(b.nama, 'id');
      });

      return list;
    }

    function filterMasterMatkulDosenCatalog(catalog, query) {
      if (!Array.isArray(catalog) || catalog.length === 0) return [];
      const tokens = String(query || '').toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      if (tokens.length === 0) return catalog;
      return catalog.filter(item => {
        const haystack = `${item.nama} ${item.matkulList.join(' ')} ${item.prodiList.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase();
        return tokens.every(tok => haystack.includes(tok));
      });
    }

    function renderMasterMatkulDosenDropdownItem(item, query) {
      const highNama = highlightSearchMatch(item.nama || '', query);
      const prodiLabel = (item.prodiList && item.prodiList.length > 0)
        ? item.prodiList.join(', ')
        : (item.primaryProdi || 'FEB');
      const matkulPreviewList = (item.matkulList || []).slice(0, 2);
      const extraCount = Math.max(0, (item.matkulList || []).length - 2);
      const matkulSummary = matkulPreviewList.length > 0
        ? matkulPreviewList.map(mk => highlightSearchMatch(mk, query)).join(' · ') + (extraCount > 0 ? ` (+${extraCount} lainnya)` : '')
        : '';

      return `
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 pr-2">
          <div class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm group-hover:text-blue-900 break-words">${highNama}</div>
          ${matkulSummary ? `<div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 leading-snug break-words"><i class="fas fa-book-open mr-1"></i>${matkulSummary}</div>` : ''}
        </div>
        <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-800 bg-purple-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-purple-200 shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap">${escapeHtml(prodiLabel)}</span>
      `;
    }

    function setupAutocomplete({
      inputElem,
      dropdownElem,
      clearBtnElem,
      containerElem,
      getItems,
      renderItem,
      getItemValue,
      onSelect,
      onClear,
      strictValidation = true,
      placeholderEmpty = 'Tidak ada data master yang cocok'
    }) {
      if (!inputElem || !dropdownElem) return null;
      let activeIndex = -1;
      let currentItems = [];
      let isSelecting = false;

      function updateClearBtn() {
        if (clearBtnElem) {
          if (inputElem.value && inputElem.value.trim().length > 0) {
            clearBtnElem.classList.remove('hidden');
          } else {
            clearBtnElem.classList.add('hidden');
          }
        }
      }

      function openDropdown() {
        const query = inputElem.value || '';
        currentItems = getItems(query);
        activeIndex = -1;
        renderList(query);
        dropdownElem.classList.remove('hidden');
      }

      function closeDropdown() {
        dropdownElem.classList.add('hidden');
        activeIndex = -1;
      }

      function renderList(query) {
        dropdownElem.innerHTML = '';
        if (!currentItems || currentItems.length === 0) {
          const emptyDiv = document.createElement('div');
          emptyDiv.className = 'p-3 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5';
          emptyDiv.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-info-circle text-slate-400"></i> ${escapeHtml(placeholderEmpty)}`;
          dropdownElem.appendChild(emptyDiv);
          return;
        }

        currentItems.forEach((item, index) => {
          const itemEl = document.createElement('div');
          itemEl.className = 'px-3 py-2 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-150 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-700 hover:bg-blue-50/90 hover:text-blue-900 border-b border-slate-50 last:border-0 flex items-center justify-between group';
          itemEl.setAttribute('data-index', index);
          itemEl.innerHTML = renderItem(item, query, index === activeIndex);

          itemEl.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
            e.preventDefault(); // Mencegah input kehilangan fokus sebelum klik tercatat
          });

          itemEl.addEventListener('click', () => {
            selectItem(item);
          });

          dropdownElem.appendChild(itemEl);
        });
      }

      function highlightActiveItem() {
        const itemEls = dropdownElem.querySelectorAll('[data-index]');
        itemEls.forEach((el, idx) => {
          if (idx === activeIndex) {
            el.classList.add('bg-blue-100', 'text-blue-950', 'font-bold');
            el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
          } else {
            el.classList.remove('bg-blue-100', 'text-blue-950', 'font-bold');
          }
        });
      }

      function selectItem(item) {
        if (!item) return;
        isSelecting = true;
        const val = getItemValue(item);
        inputElem.value = val;
        updateClearBtn();
        closeDropdown();
        if (typeof onSelect === 'function') {
          onSelect(item);
        }
        setTimeout(() => { isSelecting = false; }, 100);
      }

      inputElem.addEventListener('input', () => {
        updateClearBtn();
        openDropdown();
      });

      inputElem.addEventListener('focus', () => {
        openDropdown();
      });

      inputElem.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if (dropdownElem.classList.contains('hidden')) {
          if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
            openDropdown();
            e.preventDefault();
            return;
          }
        }

        if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (currentItems.length > 0) {
            activeIndex = (activeIndex + 1) % currentItems.length;
            highlightActiveItem();
          }
        } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (currentItems.length > 0) {
            activeIndex = (activeIndex - 1 + currentItems.length) % currentItems.length;
            highlightActiveItem();
          }
        } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
          if (!dropdownElem.classList.contains('hidden') && activeIndex >= 0 && currentItems[activeIndex]) {
            e.preventDefault();
            selectItem(currentItems[activeIndex]);
          }
        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          closeDropdown();
        } else if (e.key === 'Tab') {
          if (!dropdownElem.classList.contains('hidden') && activeIndex >= 0 && currentItems[activeIndex]) {
            selectItem(currentItems[activeIndex]);
          } else {
            closeDropdown();
          }
        }
      });

      inputElem.addEventListener('blur', () => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (!isSelecting) {
            closeDropdown();
            if (strictValidation) {
              validateStrict();
            }
          }
        }, 180);
      });

      function validateStrict() {
        const val = (inputElem.value || '').trim();
        if (!val) {
          if (typeof onClear === 'function') onClear();
          return;
        }
        const allValid = getItems('');
        const exactMatch = allValid.find(it => (getItemValue(it) || '').toLowerCase() === val.toLowerCase());
        if (exactMatch) {
          inputElem.value = getItemValue(exactMatch);
          if (typeof onSelect === 'function') onSelect(exactMatch);
        } else {
          // Reset input jika bukan merupakan item valid dari master data
          inputElem.value = '';
          updateClearBtn();
          if (typeof onClear === 'function') onClear();
          const Toast = Swal.mixin({
            toast: true,
            position: 'top-end',
            showConfirmButton: false,
            timer: 3000,
            timerProgressBar: true
          });
          Toast.fire({
            icon: 'warning',
            title: 'Wajib memilih dari daftar Master Data yang valid!'
          });
        }
      }

      if (clearBtnElem) {
        clearBtnElem.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();
          inputElem.value = '';
          updateClearBtn();
          if (typeof onClear === 'function') {
            onClear();
          }
          inputElem.focus();
          openDropdown();
        });
      }

      // Deteksi klik di luar elemen untuk menutup dropdown
      document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const cont = containerElem || inputElem.parentElement;
        if (cont && !cont.contains(e.target) && !dropdownElem.contains(e.target)) {
          closeDropdown();
        }
      });

      return {
        open: openDropdown,
        close: closeDropdown,
        refresh: () => {
          updateClearBtn();
          if (!dropdownElem.classList.contains('hidden')) {
            renderList(inputElem.value || '');
          }
        },
        setValue: (val, item = null) => {
          inputElem.value = val || '';
          updateClearBtn();
          if (item && typeof onSelect === 'function') {
            onSelect(item);
          }
        },
        clear: () => {
          inputElem.value = '';
          updateClearBtn();
          if (typeof onClear === 'function') onClear();
        }
      };
    }

    // Variabel Instans Autocomplete Global
    let dynamicMatkulAutocompletes = [];
    let autoMatkulJadwal = null;
    let autoDosenJadwal = null;

    // Helper: Mengisi datalist dosen terdahulu dari Master Mata Kuliah FEB UIKA
    function populateDatalistDosenTerdahulu() {
      const datalist = document.getElementById('datalistDosenTerdahulu');
      if (!datalist) return;
      const allDosen = getMasterMatkulDosenCatalog();
      datalist.innerHTML = allDosen.map(d => {
        const nama = d.nama || '';
        const prodi = d.primaryProdi || 'FEB';
        return `<option value="${escapeHtml(nama)}">${escapeHtml(nama)} (${escapeHtml(prodi)})</option>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    // Handler: Perubahan jenis layanan (UTS Susulan / UAS Susulan / Remedial Teaching)
    function onLayananChange(newVal) {
      const existing = collectCurrentMatkulFormData();
      const selJumlah = document.getElementById('pendaftaranJumlahMatkul');
      const count = parseInt(selJumlah?.value || '1', 10);
      renderDynamicMatkulInputs(count, existing);
      updateRegistrationSummary();
    }

    // Helper: Salin nama dosen pengampu baru ke dosen masa lalu untuk baris rowIdx
    function copyCurrentDosenToLalu(rowIdx) {
      const currentDosenInput = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranDosen_${rowIdx}`);
      const laluDosenInput = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranDosenLalu_${rowIdx}`);
      if (currentDosenInput && laluDosenInput) {
        const entry = Array.isArray(dynamicMatkulAutocompletes)
          ? dynamicMatkulAutocompletes.find(e => e.rowIdx === rowIdx)
          : null;
        if (entry && entry.autoDosenLalu) {
          entry.autoDosenLalu.setValue(currentDosenInput.value);
        } else {
          laluDosenInput.value = currentDosenInput.value;
        }
        syncMatkulLegacyFields();
      }
    }

    // Helper: Mengumpulkan data form mata kuliah dinamis yang sedang terisi di browser
    function collectCurrentMatkulFormData() {
      const container = document.getElementById('dynamicMatkulContainer');
      if (!container) return [];
      const cards = container.querySelectorAll('[id^="matkulRowCard_"]');
      const data = [];
      cards.forEach((card, idx) => {
        const matkulInput = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranMatkul_${idx}`);
        const dosenInput = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranDosen_${idx}`);
        const nilaiHurufSelect = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranNilaiHuruf_${idx}`);
        const dosenLaluInput = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranDosenLalu_${idx}`);
        const matkulVal = (matkulInput ? matkulInput.value : '').trim();
        const dosenVal = (dosenInput ? dosenInput.value : '').trim();
        const sksVal = parseInt(matkulInput?.dataset?.sks || '0', 10) || 0;
        const kodeVal = matkulInput?.dataset?.kode || '';
        const nilaiHurufVal = (nilaiHurufSelect ? nilaiHurufSelect.value : '').trim();
        const dosenLaluVal = (dosenLaluInput ? dosenLaluInput.value : '').trim();
        data.push({
          mataKuliah: matkulVal,
          dosenPengampu: dosenVal,
          sks: sksVal,
          kode: kodeVal,
          nilaiHuruf: nilaiHurufVal,
          dosenLalu: dosenLaluVal
        });
      });
      return data;
    }

    // Helper: Mengubah jumlah mata kuliah dari dropdown (1 sampai 7)
    function onJumlahMatkulChange(countVal) {
      let count = parseInt(countVal, 10) || 1;
      if (count < 1) count = 1;
      if (count > 7) count = 7;
      const existing = collectCurrentMatkulFormData();
      renderDynamicMatkulInputs(count, existing);
    }

    // Helper: Hapus satu baris mata kuliah tertentu
    function removeSingleMatkulRow(rowIdx) {
      const sel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranJumlahMatkul');
      const currentCount = parseInt(sel?.value || '1', 10);
      if (currentCount <= 1) {
        Swal.fire('Info', 'Minimal 1 mata kuliah harus didaftarkan.', 'info');
        return;
      }
      const existing = collectCurrentMatkulFormData();
      if (rowIdx >= 0 && rowIdx < existing.length) {
        existing.splice(rowIdx, 1);
      }
      const newCount = existing.length;
      if (sel) sel.value = String(newCount);
      renderDynamicMatkulInputs(newCount, existing);
    }

    // Generator Dinamis: Render Baris Form Sesuai Jumlah yang Dipilih (1 sampai 7)
    function renderDynamicMatkulInputs(count = 1, existingData = []) {
      const container = document.getElementById('dynamicMatkulContainer');
      if (!container) return;

      count = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, parseInt(count, 10) || 1));
      const sel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranJumlahMatkul');
      if (sel && sel.value !== String(count)) {
        sel.value = String(count);
      }

      container.innerHTML = '';
      dynamicMatkulAutocompletes = [];

      const activeProdi = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi')?.value || 'MNJ').toUpperCase();
      const layananVal = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranLayanan')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
      const isRemedial = layananVal.includes('remedial');

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const rowData = existingData[i] || {};
        const rowNum = i + 1;

        const rowCard = document.createElement('div');
        rowCard.id = `matkulRowCard_${i}`;
        rowCard.className = 'p-3.5 sm:p-4 bg-slate-50/90 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 transition-all space-y-3 relative focus-within:z-30 shadow-2xs';

        rowCard.innerHTML = `
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-200/70">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-blue-900 text-white font-mono font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">${rowNum}</span>
              <span class="font-extrabold text-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm">Mata Kuliah #${rowNum}</span>
              <span id="badgeMatkulProdi_${i}" class="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-900 bg-blue-100/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">Prodi: ${activeProdi}</span>
              ${isRemedial ? `<span class="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-100/90 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-indigo-200"><i class="fas fa-graduation-cap mr-1"></i>Remedial Teaching</span>` : ''}
            </div>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span id="badgeRowSks_${i}" class="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-600 bg-white border border-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md shadow-2xs">0 SKS</span>
              ${count > 1 ? `
                <button type="button" onclick="removeSingleMatkulRow(${i})" title="Hapus baris mata kuliah ini" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 w-6 h-6 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition">
                  <i class="fas fa-trash-alt text-[10px]"></i>
                </button>
              ` : ''}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div class="relative" id="autocompleteMatkulContainer_${i}">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                <label for="pendaftaranMatkul_${i}" class="block font-bold text-slate-700 text-xs">
                  Nama Mata Kuliah <span class="text-rose-500">*</span>
                </label>
              </div>
              <div class="relative">
                <div class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-400">
                  <i class="fas fa-book-open text-xs"></i>
                </div>
                <input type="text" id="pendaftaranMatkul_${i}" required autocomplete="off"
                  placeholder="Ketik untuk mencari mata kuliah..."
                  class="w-full pl-8 pr-16 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-semibold text-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 placeholder:font-normal focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:border-blue-900 transition-all shadow-2xs">
                <div class="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button type="button" id="btnClearMatkul_${i}" title="Bersihkan input"
                    class="hidden w-5 h-5 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors">
                    <i class="fas fa-times text-[10px]"></i>
                  </button>
                  <div class="text-slate-400 pointer-events-none px-1">
                    <i class="fas fa-chevron-down text-[10px]"></i>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div id="feedbackMatkulSelected_${i}" class="hidden mt-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-1">
                <i class="fas fa-check-circle text-emerald-700"></i>
                <span id="feedbackMatkulText_${i}"></span>
              </div>
              <div id="dropdownListMatkul_${i}" class="hidden absolute left-0 right-0 z-[60] mt-1 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-slate-200 divide-y divide-slate-100"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="relative" id="autocompleteDosenContainer_${i}">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                <label for="pendaftaranDosen_${i}" class="block font-bold text-slate-700 text-xs">
                  Dosen Pengampu ${isRemedial ? '(Saat Ini / Penguji)' : ''} <span class="text-rose-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <span id="badgeDosenSuggest_${i}" class="hidden text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-100/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md flex items-center gap-1">
                  <i class="fas fa-magic text-[9px]"></i> Disarankan
                </span>
              </div>
              <div class="relative">
                <div class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-400">
                  <i class="fas fa-user-tie text-xs"></i>
                </div>
                <input type="text" id="pendaftaranDosen_${i}" required autocomplete="off"
                  placeholder="Ketik untuk mencari dosen pengampu..."
                  class="w-full pl-8 pr-16 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-semibold text-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 placeholder:font-normal focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:border-blue-900 transition-all shadow-2xs">
                <div class="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <button type="button" id="btnClearDosen_${i}" title="Bersihkan input"
                    class="hidden w-5 h-5 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors">
                    <i class="fas fa-times text-[10px]"></i>
                  </button>
                  <div class="text-slate-400 pointer-events-none px-1">
                    <i class="fas fa-chevron-down text-[10px]"></i>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div id="feedbackDosenSelected_${i}" class="hidden mt-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-1">
                <i class="fas fa-check-circle text-emerald-700"></i>
                <span id="feedbackDosenText_${i}"></span>
              </div>
              <div id="dropdownListDosen_${i}" class="hidden absolute left-0 right-0 z-[60] mt-1 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-slate-200 divide-y divide-slate-100"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          ${isRemedial ? `
          <div id="remedialBlock_${i}" class="p-3 sm:p-3.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50/90 via-purple-50/60 to-blue-50/80 rounded-xl border border-indigo-200/90 space-y-2.5 shadow-2xs">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between pb-1.5 border-b border-indigo-200/60">
              <span class="text-[11px] font-black text-indigo-950 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <i class="fas fa-award text-indigo-700"></i> Riwayat Nilai & Dosen Terdahulu
              </span>
              <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-800 bg-indigo-100/90 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-indigo-200">
                Nilai Syarat: D, CD, C, BC
              </span>
            </div>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label for="pendaftaranNilaiHuruf_${i}" class="block font-bold text-indigo-950 text-xs mb-1">
                  Nilai Huruf Sebelumnya <span class="text-rose-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <select id="pendaftaranNilaiHuruf_${i}" required onchange="syncMatkulLegacyFields()" class="w-full py-2 px-3 bg-white border border-indigo-300 rounded-xl font-bold text-indigo-950 text-xs sm:text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-700 focus:border-indigo-700 shadow-2xs">
                  <option value="" disabled ${!rowData.nilaiHuruf ? 'selected' : ''}>-- Pilih Nilai Huruf --</option>
                  <option value="BC" ${rowData.nilaiHuruf === 'BC' ? 'selected' : ''}>BC (Cukup Baik)</option>
                  <option value="C" ${rowData.nilaiHuruf === 'C' ? 'selected' : ''}>C (Cukup)</option>
                  <option value="CD" ${rowData.nilaiHuruf === 'CD' ? 'selected' : ''}>CD (Kurang Cukup)</option>
                  <option value="D" ${rowData.nilaiHuruf === 'D' ? 'selected' : ''}>D (Kurang)</option>
                </select>
                <p class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">Nilai huruf yang didapat pada semester sebelumnya.</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <label for="pendaftaranDosenLalu_${i}" class="block font-bold text-indigo-950 text-xs">
                    Dosen Mata Kuliah Pada Saat Itu <span class="text-rose-500">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <button type="button" onclick="copyCurrentDosenToLalu(${i})" title="Salin dari dosen pengampu baru di atas" class="text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-700 hover:text-indigo-900 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1">
                    <i class="fas fa-copy text-[9px]"></i> Sama Dgn Dosen Baru
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div class="relative" id="autocompleteDosenLaluContainer_${i}">
                  <div class="relative">
                    <div class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-indigo-400">
                      <i class="fas fa-user-clock text-xs"></i>
                    </div>
                    <input type="text" id="pendaftaranDosenLalu_${i}" required autocomplete="off"
                      value="${escapeHtml(rowData.dosenLalu || '')}"
                      placeholder="Ketik kata kunci nama dosen terdahulu..."
                      class="w-full pl-8 pr-16 py-2 bg-white border border-indigo-300 rounded-xl font-semibold text-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm placeholder:text-slate-400 placeholder:font-normal focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-700 focus:border-indigo-700 transition-all shadow-2xs">
                    <div class="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <button type="button" id="btnClearDosenLalu_${i}" title="Bersihkan input"
                        class="hidden w-5 h-5 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors">
                        <i class="fas fa-times text-[10px]"></i>
                      </button>
                      <div class="text-indigo-400 pointer-events-none px-1">
                        <i class="fas fa-chevron-down text-[10px]"></i>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div id="dropdownListDosenLalu_${i}" class="hidden absolute left-0 right-0 z-[60] mt-1 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-indigo-200 divide-y divide-slate-100"></div>
                </div>
                <p class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">Dosen yang mengajar saat Anda memperoleh nilai tersebut.</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          ` : ''}
          <div id="dupWarningRow_${i}" class="hidden text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 flex items-start gap-2"></div>
        `;

        container.appendChild(rowCard);

        // Bind Autocomplete Mata Kuliah untuk Row i
        const inputM = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranMatkul_${i}`);
        const dropM = document.getElementById(`dropdownListMatkul_${i}`);
        const btnClearM = document.getElementById(`btnClearMatkul_${i}`);
        const contM = document.getElementById(`autocompleteMatkulContainer_${i}`);

        // Bind Autocomplete Dosen Pengampu untuk Row i
        const inputD = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranDosen_${i}`);
        const dropD = document.getElementById(`dropdownListDosen_${i}`);
        const btnClearD = document.getElementById(`btnClearDosen_${i}`);
        const contD = document.getElementById(`autocompleteDosenContainer_${i}`);

        const autoMatkulInstance = setupAutocomplete({
          inputElem: inputM,
          dropdownElem: dropM,
          clearBtnElem: btnClearM,
          containerElem: contM,
          placeholderEmpty: 'Mata kuliah tidak ditemukan untuk Prodi dan Kelas ini',
          getItems: (query) => {
            const master = appData.master || {};
            const allMatkul = master.matkul || [];
            const currProdi = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi')?.value || 'MNJ').toUpperCase();

            // Filter otomatis sesuai kelas mahasiswa yang login (atau pilihan kelas pada form jika staf)
            const activeUserKelas = (
              (typeof currentUser !== 'undefined' && currentUser && (currentUser.kelas || currentUser.Kelas)) ||
              document.getElementById('pendaftaranKelas')?.value ||
              ''
            ).toString().trim().toLowerCase();

            let filtered = allMatkul.filter(m => {
              const p = String(m['Kode Prodi'] || m.Kode_Prodi || '').toUpperCase();
              const matchProdi = !currProdi || p === currProdi;

              const mKelas = (m.Kelas || m.kelas || m['Kelas'] || '').toString().trim().toLowerCase();
              const matchKelas = !activeUserKelas || !mKelas || mKelas === 'semua' || mKelas === 'semua kelas' || mKelas === 'all' || mKelas === activeUserKelas;

              return matchProdi && matchKelas;
            });

            // Fallback jika tidak ada matkul dengan spesifikasi kelas tertentu, tampilkan prodi aktif
            if (filtered.length === 0) {
              filtered = allMatkul.filter(m => String(m['Kode Prodi'] || m.Kode_Prodi || '').toUpperCase() === currProdi);
            }
            if (filtered.length === 0) filtered = allMatkul;

            const tokens = String(query || '').toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
            if (tokens.length === 0) return filtered;
            return filtered.filter(m => {
              const nama = String(m['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || m.nama || '').toLowerCase();
              const kode = String(m['Kode Matkul'] || m.kode || '').toLowerCase();
              const kls = String(m.Kelas || m.kelas || m['Kelas'] || '').toLowerCase();
              const dosen = String(m['Dosen Pengampu'] || m.dosen || '').toLowerCase();
              const haystack = `${nama} ${kode} ${kls} ${dosen}`;
              return tokens.every(tok => haystack.includes(tok));
            });
          },
          getItemValue: (item) => item['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || '',
          renderItem: (item, query) => {
            const highName = highlightSearchMatch(item['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || '', query);
            const highKode = highlightSearchMatch(item['Kode Matkul'] || '', query);
            const sks = item.SKS ? `${item.SKS} SKS` : '3 SKS';
            const kls = item.Kelas || item.kelas || item['Kelas'] || 'Semua Kelas';
            const dosen = item['Dosen Pengampu'] ? `<div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5"><i class="fas fa-chalkboard-user mr-1"></i>${escapeHtml(item['Dosen Pengampu'])}</div>` : '';
            return `
              <div class="flex-1 pr-2">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                  <span class="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200">${escapeHtml(kls)}</span>
                  <span class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm group-hover:text-blue-900">${highName}</span>
                </div>
                ${dosen}
              </div>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                <span class="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">${highKode}</span>
                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-800 bg-blue-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-200">${sks}</span>
              </div>
            `;
          },
          onSelect: (item) => {
            // Anti-duplikasi real-time: cek apakah mata kuliah sudah dipilih di baris lain
            const selectedName = (item['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            let isDuplicate = false;
            let dupIndex = -1;

            const allCards = container.querySelectorAll('[id^="matkulRowCard_"]');
            allCards.forEach((c, idx) => {
              if (idx !== i) {
                const otherVal = (document.getElementById(`pendaftaranMatkul_${idx}`)?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                if (otherVal && otherVal === selectedName) {
                  isDuplicate = true;
                  dupIndex = idx + 1;
                }
              }
            });

            if (isDuplicate) {
              Swal.fire({
                icon: 'warning',
                title: 'Mata Kuliah Sudah Dipilih',
