                text: `Mata kuliah "${item['Nama Mata Kuliah']}" sudah dipilih pada Mata Kuliah #${dupIndex}. Setiap mata kuliah dalam satu formulir harus berbeda.`,
                confirmButtonText: 'Pilih Lainnya'
              });
              if (autoMatkulInstance) autoMatkulInstance.clear();
              return;
            }

            // Simpan metadata SKS & Kode di dataset input
            inputM.dataset.sks = item.SKS || '3';
            inputM.dataset.kode = item['Kode Matkul'] || '';

            // Tampilkan feedback visual
            const fb = document.getElementById(`feedbackMatkulSelected_${i}`);
            const fbText = document.getElementById(`feedbackMatkulText_${i}`);
            if (fb && fbText) {
              fb.classList.remove('hidden');
              fbText.innerText = `${item['Nama Mata Kuliah']} (${item.SKS || 3} SKS · ${item['Kode Matkul'] || 'FEB'})`;
            }

            // Update badge SKS per row
            const badgeSks = document.getElementById(`badgeRowSks_${i}`);
            if (badgeSks) {
              badgeSks.innerText = `${item.SKS || 3} SKS`;
              badgeSks.className = 'text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-blue-800 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md shadow-2xs';
            }

            // Otomatis sarankan dan isi dosen pengampu sesuai matkul
            suggestDosenForMatkulRow(i, item);

            // Sinkronkan data ringkasan & legacy fields
            syncMatkulLegacyFields();
            updateRegistrationSummary();
          },
          onClear: () => {
            inputM.dataset.sks = '0';
            inputM.dataset.kode = '';
            const fb = document.getElementById(`feedbackMatkulSelected_${i}`);
            if (fb) fb.classList.add('hidden');
            const badgeSuggest = document.getElementById(`badgeDosenSuggest_${i}`);
            if (badgeSuggest) badgeSuggest.classList.add('hidden');
            const badgeSks = document.getElementById(`badgeRowSks_${i}`);
            if (badgeSks) {
              badgeSks.innerText = '0 SKS';
              badgeSks.className = 'text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 bg-white border border-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md shadow-2xs';
            }
            syncMatkulLegacyFields();
            updateRegistrationSummary();
          }
        });

        const autoDosenInstance = setupAutocomplete({
          inputElem: inputD,
          dropdownElem: dropD,
          clearBtnElem: btnClearD,
          containerElem: contD,
          placeholderEmpty: 'Dosen pengampu tidak ditemukan di Master Mata Kuliah',
          getItems: (query) => {
            const currProdi = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi')?.value || 'MNJ').toUpperCase();
            const currMatkul = (inputM?.value || '').trim();
            const catalog = getMasterMatkulDosenCatalog({
              preferredProdi: currProdi,
              preferredMatkul: currMatkul
            });
            return filterMasterMatkulDosenCatalog(catalog, query);
          },
          getItemValue: (item) => item.nama || '',
          renderItem: (item, query) => renderMasterMatkulDosenDropdownItem(item, query),
          onSelect: (item) => {
            const fb = document.getElementById(`feedbackDosenSelected_${i}`);
            const fbText = document.getElementById(`feedbackDosenText_${i}`);
            if (fb && fbText) {
              fb.classList.remove('hidden');
              fbText.innerText = `${item.nama} [${item.primaryProdi || 'FEB'}]`;
            }
            syncMatkulLegacyFields();
          },
          onClear: () => {
            const fb = document.getElementById(`feedbackDosenSelected_${i}`);
            if (fb) fb.classList.add('hidden');
            const badgeSuggest = document.getElementById(`badgeDosenSuggest_${i}`);
            if (badgeSuggest) badgeSuggest.classList.add('hidden');
            syncMatkulLegacyFields();
          }
        });

        const inputDLalu = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranDosenLalu_${i}`);
        const dropDLalu = document.getElementById(`dropdownListDosenLalu_${i}`);
        const btnClearDLalu = document.getElementById(`btnClearDosenLalu_${i}`);
        const contDLalu = document.getElementById(`autocompleteDosenLaluContainer_${i}`);
        let autoDosenLaluInstance = null;
        if (inputDLalu && dropDLalu) {
          autoDosenLaluInstance = setupAutocomplete({
            inputElem: inputDLalu,
            dropdownElem: dropDLalu,
            clearBtnElem: btnClearDLalu,
            containerElem: contDLalu,
            strictValidation: false,
            placeholderEmpty: 'Dosen tidak ditemukan di Master Mata Kuliah (tetap bisa diketik manual)',
            getItems: (query) => {
              const currProdi = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi')?.value || 'MNJ').toUpperCase();
              const currMatkul = (inputM?.value || '').trim();
              const catalog = getMasterMatkulDosenCatalog({
                preferredProdi: currProdi,
                preferredMatkul: currMatkul
              });
              return filterMasterMatkulDosenCatalog(catalog, query);
            },
            getItemValue: (item) => item.nama || '',
            renderItem: (item, query) => renderMasterMatkulDosenDropdownItem(item, query),
            onSelect: () => {
              syncMatkulLegacyFields();
            },
            onClear: () => {
              syncMatkulLegacyFields();
            }
          });
          inputDLalu.addEventListener('input', () => {
            syncMatkulLegacyFields();
          });
          if (rowData.dosenLalu) {
            autoDosenLaluInstance.setValue(rowData.dosenLalu);
          }
        }

        dynamicMatkulAutocompletes.push({
          rowIdx: i,
          autoMatkul: autoMatkulInstance,
          autoDosen: autoDosenInstance,
          autoDosenLalu: autoDosenLaluInstance
        });

        // Set data awal jika diberikan (misal saat mode edit pendaftaran atau perubahan dropdown)
        if (rowData.mataKuliah) {
          autoMatkulInstance.setValue(rowData.mataKuliah);
          inputM.dataset.sks = String(rowData.sks || '3');
          inputM.dataset.kode = rowData.kode || '';

          const fbM = document.getElementById(`feedbackMatkulSelected_${i}`);
          const fbMText = document.getElementById(`feedbackMatkulText_${i}`);
          if (fbM && fbMText) {
            fbM.classList.remove('hidden');
            fbMText.innerText = `${rowData.mataKuliah} (${rowData.sks || 3} SKS)`;
          }

          const badgeSks = document.getElementById(`badgeRowSks_${i}`);
          if (badgeSks) {
            badgeSks.innerText = `${rowData.sks || 3} SKS`;
            badgeSks.className = 'text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-blue-800 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md shadow-2xs';
          }
        }

        if (rowData.dosenPengampu) {
          autoDosenInstance.setValue(rowData.dosenPengampu);
          const fbD = document.getElementById(`feedbackDosenSelected_${i}`);
          const fbDText = document.getElementById(`feedbackDosenText_${i}`);
          if (fbD && fbDText) {
            fbD.classList.remove('hidden');
            fbDText.innerText = rowData.dosenPengampu;
          }
        }
        if (inputM) {
          inputM.addEventListener('input', () => {
            if (typeof refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings === 'function') refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings();
          });
        }
        if (inputD) {
          inputD.addEventListener('input', () => {
            if (typeof refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings === 'function') refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings();
          });
        }
      }

      syncMatkulLegacyFields();
      updateRegistrationSummary();
    }

    // Helper: Otomatis sarankan dosen pengampu untuk baris mata kuliah tertentu
    function suggestDosenForMatkulRow(rowIdx, matkulItem) {
      if (!matkulItem) return;
      let lecturerName = String(matkulItem['Dosen Pengampu'] || matkulItem.dosen || '').trim();

      if (!lecturerName) {
        const activeProdi = String(matkulItem['Kode Prodi'] || document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi')?.value || 'MNJ').toUpperCase();
        const catalog = getMasterMatkulDosenCatalog({
          preferredProdi: activeProdi,
          preferredMatkul: matkulItem['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || ''
        });
        if (catalog.length > 0) {
          lecturerName = catalog[0].nama;
        }
      }

      const rowEntry = dynamicMatkulAutocompletes.find(entry => entry.rowIdx === rowIdx);
      if (lecturerName && rowEntry && rowEntry.autoDosen) {
        rowEntry.autoDosen.setValue(lecturerName);

        const badgeSuggest = document.getElementById(`badgeDosenSuggest_${rowIdx}`);
        if (badgeSuggest) badgeSuggest.classList.remove('hidden');

        const fb = document.getElementById(`feedbackDosenSelected_${rowIdx}`);
        const fbText = document.getElementById(`feedbackDosenText_${rowIdx}`);
        if (fb && fbText) {
          fb.classList.remove('hidden');
          fbText.innerText = `${lecturerName} (Saran Otomatis)`;
        }

        // Jika form dalam mode Remedial Teaching dan dosen terdahulu masih kosong, sarankan nama yang sama
        const inputLalu = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranDosenLalu_${rowIdx}`);
        if (inputLalu && !inputLalu.value) {
          if (rowEntry.autoDosenLalu) {
            rowEntry.autoDosenLalu.setValue(lecturerName);
          } else {
            inputLalu.value = lecturerName;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Helper: Sinkronisasi field legacy (#pendaftaranMatkul & #pendaftaranDosen) agar kompatibel ke semua modul
    function syncMatkulLegacyFields() {
      const data = collectCurrentMatkulFormData().filter(d => d.mataKuliah && d.mataKuliah.trim().length > 0);
      const hiddenMatkul = document.getElementById('pendaftaranMatkul');
      const hiddenDosen = document.getElementById('pendaftaranDosen');

      if (!hiddenMatkul || !hiddenDosen) return;

      const layananVal = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranLayanan')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
      const isRemedial = layananVal.includes('remedial');

      if (data.length === 0) {
        hiddenMatkul.value = '';
        hiddenDosen.value = '';
      } else if (data.length === 1) {
        const d = data[0];
        const nilaiStr = isRemedial && d.nilaiHuruf ? ` [Nilai: ${d.nilaiHuruf}]` : '';
        const laluStr = isRemedial && d.dosenLalu ? ` (Dosen Lalu: ${d.dosenLalu})` : '';
        hiddenMatkul.value = `${d.mataKuliah}${nilaiStr}`;
        hiddenDosen.value = `${d.dosenPengampu || '-'}${laluStr}`;
      } else {
        hiddenMatkul.value = data.map((d, i) => {
          const nilaiStr = isRemedial && d.nilaiHuruf ? ` [Nilai: ${d.nilaiHuruf}]` : '';
          return `${i + 1}. ${d.mataKuliah}${nilaiStr} (${d.sks || 3} SKS)`;
        }).join('\n');
        hiddenDosen.value = data.map((d, i) => {
          const laluStr = isRemedial && d.dosenLalu ? ` (Dosen Lalu: ${d.dosenLalu})` : '';
          return `${i + 1}. ${d.dosenPengampu || '-'}${laluStr}`;
        }).join('\n');
      }
      if (typeof refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings === 'function') {
        refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings();
      }
    }

    let pendaftaranEditBillingState = null;

    function normalizePaymentStatusLabel(rawStatus, nominal = 0) {
      const raw = String(rawStatus || '').trim();
      const nomVal = Number(nominal || 0);
      if (!raw) {
        return nomVal > 0 ? 'Belum Bayar' : 'Gratis (Tepat Waktu)';
      }
      if (raw.toLowerCase().startsWith('belum bayar')) {
        return 'Belum Bayar';
      }
      return raw;
    }

    function ensureSelectOptionExists(selectEl, val) {
      if (!selectEl || val === undefined || val === null) return;
      const strVal = String(val).trim();
      if (!strVal) return;
      const opts = Array.from(selectEl.options || []);
      const matched = opts.find(o => String(o.value).trim().toLowerCase() === strVal.toLowerCase());
      if (matched) {
        selectEl.value = matched.value;
      } else {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = strVal;
        opt.textContent = strVal;
        selectEl.appendChild(opt);
        selectEl.value = strVal;
      }
    }

    function syncEditBillingAdminControls(jadwalVal, paymentVal, totalNominal) {
      const state = pendaftaranEditBillingState;
      const wrapper = document.getElementById('wrapperEditBillingAdmin');
      const isMhsUser = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      if (!wrapper || !state || isMhsUser) {
        if (wrapper) wrapper.classList.add('hidden');
        return;
      }
      wrapper.classList.remove('hidden');

      const modeSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditBillingMode');
      const jadwalSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditStatusJadwalSelect');
      const paymentSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditStatusPembayaranSelect');
      const nominalInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditNominalInput');
      const metaEl = document.getElementById('editBillingOriginalMetaText');
      const modeBadgeEl = document.getElementById('editBillingActiveModeText');

      if (modeSel) modeSel.value = state.billingMode || 'preserve';
      if (jadwalSel) ensureSelectOptionExists(jadwalSel, jadwalVal);
      if (paymentSel) ensureSelectOptionExists(paymentSel, paymentVal);
      if (nominalInput) {
        const isManual = state.billingMode === 'manual';
        nominalInput.readOnly = !isManual;
        nominalInput.className = isManual
          ? 'w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 font-mono tabular-nums font-bold text-slate-900 bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900'
          : 'w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 font-mono tabular-nums font-bold text-slate-700 bg-slate-100 cursor-not-allowed select-none';
        if (document.activeElement !== nominalInput) {
          nominalInput.value = String(Math.max(0, Number(totalNominal) || 0));
        }
      }
      if (metaEl) {
        metaEl.innerText = `Tercatat ${state.originalTanggal || '-'} · ${state.originalStatusJadwal || '-'} · ${state.originalStatusPembayaran || '-'} · Rp ${Number(state.originalNominal || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}`;
      }
      if (modeBadgeEl) {
        if (state.billingMode === 'manual') {
          modeBadgeEl.innerText = 'Penyesuaian Manual Admin';
          modeBadgeEl.className = 'text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-800 whitespace-nowrap';
        } else if (state.billingMode === 'recalculate') {
          modeBadgeEl.innerText = 'Hitung Ulang Periode Berjalan';
          modeBadgeEl.className = 'text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-800 whitespace-nowrap';
        } else {
          modeBadgeEl.innerText = 'Mengikuti Data Asli';
          modeBadgeEl.className = 'text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-800 whitespace-nowrap';
        }
      }
    }

    function onPendaftaranEditBillingModeChange(mode) {
      if (!pendaftaranEditBillingState) return;
      pendaftaranEditBillingState.billingMode = mode || 'preserve';
      if (pendaftaranEditBillingState.billingMode === 'preserve') {
        const jadwalSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditStatusJadwalSelect');
        const paymentSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditStatusPembayaranSelect');
        const nominalInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditNominalInput');
        if (jadwalSel) ensureSelectOptionExists(jadwalSel, pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalStatusJadwal);
        if (paymentSel) ensureSelectOptionExists(paymentSel, pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalStatusPembayaran);
        if (nominalInput) nominalInput.value = String(pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalNominal || 0);
      }
      updateRegistrationSummary();
    }

    function onPendaftaranEditManualBillingChange(source) {
      if (!pendaftaranEditBillingState) return;
      pendaftaranEditBillingState.billingMode = 'manual';
      const modeSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditBillingMode');
      if (modeSel) modeSel.value = 'manual';

      const paymentSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditStatusPembayaranSelect');
      const nominalInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditNominalInput');
      if (source === 'payment' && paymentSel && nominalInput) {
        const payLower = String(paymentSel.value || '').toLowerCase();
        if (payLower.startsWith('gratis')) {
          nominalInput.value = '0';
        } else if ((payLower.includes('denda') || payLower.includes('belum bayar')) && Number(nominalInput.value || 0) === 0) {
          const selectedLayanan = document.getElementById('pendaftaranLayanan')?.value || '';
          const selectedKategori = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas')?.value || '';
          const matchedPrd = findMatchingActivePeriod(selectedLayanan, selectedKategori);
          const lateFeePerItem = matchedPrd ? Number(evaluatePeriodWindow(matchedPrd, new Date()).biayaDenda || 0) : 0;
          const filledCount = collectCurrentMatkulFormData().filter(d => d.mataKuliah && d.mataKuliah.trim().length > 0).length;
          if (lateFeePerItem > 0) {
            nominalInput.value = String(lateFeePerItem * Math.max(1, filledCount));
          }
        }
      }
      updateRegistrationSummary();
    }

    // Helper: Hitung live total matkul, total SKS, dan estimasi biaya denda / retribusi
    function updateRegistrationSummary() {
      const data = collectCurrentMatkulFormData();
      const filledItems = data.filter(d => d.mataKuliah && d.mataKuliah.trim().length > 0);
      const filledCount = filledItems.length;

      const masterMatkul = (appData.master && appData.master.matkul) || [];
      let totalSks = 0;
      filledItems.forEach(item => {
        let sks = parseInt(item.sks, 10);
        if (!sks || isNaN(sks) || sks <= 0) {
          const matchMaster = masterMatkul.find(m => (m['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || '').toLowerCase() === item.mataKuliah.toLowerCase());
          sks = matchMaster && matchMaster.SKS ? parseInt(matchMaster.SKS, 10) : 3;
        }
        totalSks += (sks || 3);
      });

      const editId = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranId')?.value || '').trim();
      const hasEditState = Boolean(editId && pendaftaranEditBillingState && pendaftaranEditBillingState.recordId === editId);
      const editBillingMode = hasEditState ? (pendaftaranEditBillingState.billingMode || 'preserve') : '';

      // Pengecekan Periode & Jadwal Denda (Sinkron Jenis Layanan + Kategori Kelas)
      const selectedLayanan = document.getElementById('pendaftaranLayanan')?.value || '';
      const selectedKategori = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas')?.value || '';
      const matchedPrd = findMatchingActivePeriod(selectedLayanan, selectedKategori);

      if (matchedPrd && (!hasEditState || editBillingMode === 'recalculate')) {
        const taEl = document.getElementById('pendaftaranTahunAkademik');
        const semEl = document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemester');
        const badgeEl = document.getElementById('activePeriodBadgeId');
        if (taEl && matchedPrd['Tahun Akademik']) taEl.value = matchedPrd['Tahun Akademik'];
        if (semEl && matchedPrd.Semester) semEl.value = matchedPrd.Semester;
        if (badgeEl && matchedPrd.ID) badgeEl.innerText = matchedPrd.ID;
      }

      const now = new Date();
      const windowEval = matchedPrd
        ? evaluatePeriodWindow(matchedPrd, now)
        : { state: 'NO_ACTIVE_PERIOD', canRegister: false, isLate: false, biayaDenda: 0, normalStart: null, normalEnd: null, lateStart: null, lateEnd: null };

      const isLate = windowEval.state === 'LATE';
      const lateFeePerItem = windowEval.biayaDenda || 0;
      let totalNominal = isLate ? (lateFeePerItem * Math.max(1, filledCount)) : 0;

      // Update Live Summary Strip
      const badgeCount = document.getElementById('summaryMatkulCountBadge');
      if (badgeCount) {
        badgeCount.innerText = `${filledCount || 1} Mata Kuliah Diajukan`;
      }

      const textSks = document.getElementById('summaryTotalSksText');
      if (textSks) {
        textSks.innerText = `${totalSks} SKS Terakumulasi`;
      }

      // Update Box Ketentuan Jadwal & Biaya Denda
      const statusBadge = document.getElementById('notifStatusCurrent');
      const detailBox = document.getElementById('notifPeriodeRangeDetail');
      const isMhsUser = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';

      let jadwalVal = isLate ? 'Terlambat' : 'Tepat Waktu';
      let paymentVal = (isLate && totalNominal > 0) ? 'Belum Bayar' : 'Gratis (Tepat Waktu)';

      if (hasEditState && editBillingMode === 'preserve') {
        jadwalVal = pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalStatusJadwal || 'Tepat Waktu';
        paymentVal = pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalStatusPembayaran || 'Gratis (Tepat Waktu)';
        totalNominal = Math.max(0, Number(pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalNominal) || 0);

        if (statusBadge) {
          const payLower = paymentVal.toLowerCase();
          const jadwalLower = jadwalVal.toLowerCase();
          if (totalNominal <= 0 && (payLower.includes('gratis') || jadwalLower.includes('tepat waktu'))) {
            statusBadge.innerText = `${jadwalVal} · Gratis (Data Asli)`;
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-100/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-300';
          } else if (payLower === 'lunas') {
            statusBadge.innerText = `Lunas · Rp ${Number(totalNominal).toLocaleString('id-ID')} (Data Asli)`;
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-100/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-300';
          } else {
            statusBadge.innerText = `${jadwalVal} · Rp ${Number(totalNominal).toLocaleString('id-ID')} (Data Asli)`;
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-amber-800 bg-amber-100/90 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-amber-300';
          }
        }
      } else if (hasEditState && editBillingMode === 'manual') {
        const jadwalSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditStatusJadwalSelect');
        const paymentSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditStatusPembayaranSelect');
        const nominalInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranEditNominalInput');
        jadwalVal = (jadwalSel && jadwalSel.value) ? jadwalSel.value : 'Tepat Waktu';
        paymentVal = (paymentSel && paymentSel.value) ? paymentSel.value : 'Gratis (Tepat Waktu)';
        totalNominal = Math.max(0, Number(nominalInput ? nominalInput.value : 0) || 0);

        if (statusBadge) {
          const payLower = paymentVal.toLowerCase();
          if (totalNominal <= 0 || payLower === 'lunas' || payLower.includes('gratis')) {
            statusBadge.innerText = `${jadwalVal} · ${paymentVal} (Manual Admin)`;
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-100/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-300';
          } else {
            statusBadge.innerText = `${jadwalVal} · Rp ${Number(totalNominal).toLocaleString('id-ID')} (Manual Admin)`;
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-amber-800 bg-amber-100/90 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-amber-300';
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (statusBadge) {
          if (windowEval.state === 'LATE') {
            if (totalNominal > 0) {
              statusBadge.innerText = `Terlambat (Denda Rp ${Number(totalNominal).toLocaleString('id-ID')})`;
            } else {
              statusBadge.innerText = 'Masa Terlambat (Tanpa Denda)';
            }
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-amber-800 bg-amber-100/90 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-amber-300';
            if (totalNominal <= 0) paymentVal = 'Gratis (Masa Terlambat)';
          } else if (windowEval.state === 'NORMAL') {
            statusBadge.innerText = 'Tepat Waktu (Gratis)';
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-100/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-300';
          } else if (windowEval.state === 'BEFORE_START') {
            statusBadge.innerText = isMhsUser ? 'Belum Dibuka' : 'Di Luar Jadwal — Belum Buka (Admin)';
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-blue-800 bg-blue-100/90 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-blue-300';
            jadwalVal = 'Di Luar Jadwal (Belum Buka)';
            paymentVal = isMhsUser ? 'Belum Dibuka' : 'Gratis (Input Admin)';
          } else if (windowEval.state === 'CLOSED' || windowEval.state === 'BETWEEN_NORMAL_AND_LATE') {
            statusBadge.innerText = isMhsUser ? 'Masa Pendaftaran Ditutup' : 'Di Luar Jadwal — Tutup (Admin)';
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-rose-800 bg-rose-100/90 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-rose-300';
            jadwalVal = windowEval.state === 'CLOSED' ? 'Di Luar Jadwal (Sudah Tutup)' : 'Di Luar Jadwal (Jeda Periode)';
            paymentVal = isMhsUser ? 'Ditutup' : 'Gratis (Input Admin)';
          } else {
            statusBadge.innerText = isMhsUser ? 'Tidak Ada Periode Aktif' : 'Periode Non-Aktif (Input Admin)';
            statusBadge.className = 'font-mono font-bold text-[11px] text-slate-700 bg-slate-200/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-slate-300';
            jadwalVal = 'Periode Non-Aktif';
            paymentVal = isMhsUser ? 'Periode Non-Aktif' : 'Gratis (Input Admin)';
          }
        }
      }

      const textNominal = document.getElementById('summaryTotalNominalText');
      if (textNominal) {
        textNominal.innerText = `Rp ${Number(totalNominal).toLocaleString('id-ID')}`;
      }

      if (detailBox) {
        const origPrefix = hasEditState
          ? `<b>Data Daftar Asli:</b> Tanggal ${escapeHtml(pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalTanggal || '-')} · Status ${escapeHtml(pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalStatusJadwal || '-')} (${escapeHtml(pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalStatusPembayaran || '-')})<br>`
          : '';
        if (matchedPrd) {
          const normalTxt = formatPeriodeWaktuLengkap(
            matchedPrd['Tanggal & Jam Mulai'] || matchedPrd['Tanggal Mulai'],
            matchedPrd['Tanggal & Jam Selesai'] || matchedPrd['Tanggal Selesai']
          );
          const hasLate = Boolean(matchedPrd['Mulai Terlambat'] || matchedPrd['Selesai Terlambat']);
          const lateTxt = hasLate ? formatPeriodeWaktuLengkap(matchedPrd['Mulai Terlambat'], matchedPrd['Selesai Terlambat']) : 'Tidak ada masa terlambat';
          detailBox.innerHTML = `${origPrefix}<b>Jadwal Normal:</b> ${escapeHtml(normalTxt)}<br><b>Jadwal Terlambat:</b> ${escapeHtml(lateTxt)} · <b>Denda:</b> Rp ${Number(lateFeePerItem).toLocaleString('id-ID')}/mata kuliah`;
        } else {
          detailBox.innerHTML = `${origPrefix}<span class="text-rose-700 font-semibold">Tidak ditemukan periode berstatus Aktif yang cocok untuk kombinasi layanan &amp; kategori kelas ini.</span>`;
        }
      }

      const hiddenStatusJadwal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranStatusJadwal');
      if (hiddenStatusJadwal) hiddenStatusJadwal.value = jadwalVal;

      const hiddenStatusPembayaran = document.getElementById('pendaftaranStatusPembayaran');
      if (hiddenStatusPembayaran) hiddenStatusPembayaran.value = paymentVal;

      const hiddenNominal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranNominal');
      if (hiddenNominal) hiddenNominal.value = totalNominal;

      const hiddenTotalSks = document.getElementById('pendaftaranTotalSks');
      if (hiddenTotalSks) hiddenTotalSks.value = totalSks;

      if (hasEditState) {
        syncEditBillingAdminControls(jadwalVal, paymentVal, totalNominal);
      }
    }

    function initAllAutocompletes() {
      // 1. AUTOCOMPLETE MATA KULIAH PADA FORM INPUT JADWAL UJIAN
      const inputJadwalMatkul = document.getElementById('jadwalMataKuliah');
      const dropJadwalMatkul = document.getElementById('dropdownListJadwalMatkul');
      const btnClearJadwalMatkul = document.getElementById('btnClearJadwalMatkul');
      const contJadwalMatkul = document.getElementById('autocompleteJadwalMatkulContainer');

      if (inputJadwalMatkul && dropJadwalMatkul && !autoMatkulJadwal) {
        autoMatkulJadwal = setupAutocomplete({
          inputElem: inputJadwalMatkul,
          dropdownElem: dropJadwalMatkul,
          clearBtnElem: btnClearJadwalMatkul,
          containerElem: contJadwalMatkul,
          placeholderEmpty: 'Mata kuliah tidak ditemukan',
          getItems: (query) => {
            const master = appData.master || {};
            const allMatkul = master.matkul || [];
            const prodiCode = (document.getElementById('jadwalKodeProdi')?.value || '').toUpperCase();
            let filtered = prodiCode ? allMatkul.filter(m => String(m['Kode Prodi'] || '').toUpperCase() === prodiCode) : allMatkul;
            if (filtered.length === 0) filtered = allMatkul;

            const tokens = String(query || '').toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
            if (tokens.length === 0) return filtered;
            return filtered.filter(m => {
              const nama = String(m['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || m.nama || '').toLowerCase();
              const kode = String(m['Kode Matkul'] || m.kode || '').toLowerCase();
              const dosen = String(m['Dosen Pengampu'] || m.dosen || '').toLowerCase();
              const haystack = `${nama} ${kode} ${dosen}`;
              return tokens.every(tok => haystack.includes(tok));
            });
          },
          getItemValue: (item) => item['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || '',
          renderItem: (item, query) => {
            const highName = highlightSearchMatch(item['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || '', query);
            const highKode = highlightSearchMatch(item['Kode Matkul'] || '', query);
            const kls = item.Kelas || item.kelas || item['Kelas'] || '';
            const klsBadge = kls ? `<span class="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200 mr-1">${escapeHtml(kls)}</span>` : '';
            return `
              <div class="flex-1 pr-2">
                <div class="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-1 font-bold text-slate-800 text-xs">
                  ${klsBadge}<span>${highName}</span>
                </div>
                ${item['Dosen Pengampu'] ? `<div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">${escapeHtml(item['Dosen Pengampu'])}</div>` : ''}
              </div>
              <span class="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-1 py-0.5 rounded">${highKode}</span>
            `;
          },
          onSelect: (item) => {
            if (item['Dosen Pengampu'] && autoDosenJadwal) {
              autoDosenJadwal.setValue(item['Dosen Pengampu']);
            }
          }
        });
      }

      // 2. AUTOCOMPLETE DOSEN PENGAMPU PADA FORM INPUT JADWAL UJIAN (DARI MASTER_MATKUL)
      const inputJadwalDosen = document.getElementById('jadwalDosenPengampu');
      const dropJadwalDosen = document.getElementById('dropdownListJadwalDosen');
      const btnClearJadwalDosen = document.getElementById('btnClearJadwalDosen');
      const contJadwalDosen = document.getElementById('autocompleteJadwalDosenContainer');

      if (inputJadwalDosen && dropJadwalDosen && !autoDosenJadwal) {
        autoDosenJadwal = setupAutocomplete({
          inputElem: inputJadwalDosen,
          dropdownElem: dropJadwalDosen,
          clearBtnElem: btnClearJadwalDosen,
          containerElem: contJadwalDosen,
          placeholderEmpty: 'Dosen pengampu tidak ditemukan di Master Mata Kuliah',
          getItems: (query) => {
            const prodiCode = (document.getElementById('jadwalKodeProdi')?.value || '').toUpperCase();
            const matkulVal = (document.getElementById('jadwalMataKuliah')?.value || '').trim();
            const catalog = getMasterMatkulDosenCatalog({
              preferredProdi: prodiCode,
              preferredMatkul: matkulVal
            });
            return filterMasterMatkulDosenCatalog(catalog, query);
          },
          getItemValue: (item) => item.nama || '',
          renderItem: (item, query) => renderMasterMatkulDosenDropdownItem(item, query)
        });
      }
    }

    // Toggle edit input jadwal ujian
    function toggleEditJadwalMatkul() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('jadwalMataKuliah');
      if (inp) {
        inp.readOnly = false;
        inp.classList.remove('bg-slate-100');
        inp.classList.add('bg-white');
        inp.focus();
        if (autoMatkulJadwal) autoMatkulJadwal.open();
      }
    }

    function toggleEditJadwalDosen() {
      const inp = document.getElementById('jadwalDosenPengampu');
      if (inp) {
        inp.readOnly = false;
        inp.classList.remove('bg-slate-100');
        inp.classList.add('bg-white');
        inp.focus();
        if (autoDosenJadwal) autoDosenJadwal.open();
      }
    }

    function populateMasterDropdowns() {
      const master = appData.master || {};
      const prodiList = master.prodi || [];
      const prodiSelect = document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi');
      if (prodiSelect && prodiList.length > 0) {
        // [BUGFIX PRODI RESET]: Pertahankan nilai prodi yang sedang aktif
        const isMhs = typeof currentUser !== 'undefined' && currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
        let targetProdi = prodiSelect.value;
        if (isMhs && currentUser.kodeProdi && currentUser.kodeProdi !== 'ALL') {
          targetProdi = currentUser.kodeProdi;
        }

        prodiSelect.innerHTML = prodiList.map(p => {
          const code = p['Kode Prodi'] || 'MNJ';
          const name = p['Nama Prodi'] || 'Manajemen';
          return `<option value="${code}" data-nama="${name}">${code} - ${name}</option>`;
        }).join('');

        if (targetProdi) {
          prodiSelect.value = targetProdi;
        }
      }

      // Inisialisasi seluruh komponen Autocomplete
      initAllAutocompletes();

      const modalPendaftaran = document.getElementById('modalPendaftaran');
      const isModalOpen = modalPendaftaran && !modalPendaftaran.classList.contains('hidden');
      if (!isModalOpen) {
        onProdiSelectionChange();
      } else {
        // Jika modal sedang terbuka untuk mahasiswa, pastikan nilai prodi tetap konsisten
        const isMhs = typeof currentUser !== 'undefined' && currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
        if (isMhs && currentUser.kodeProdi && currentUser.kodeProdi !== 'ALL' && prodiSelect) {
          prodiSelect.value = currentUser.kodeProdi;
        }
      }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [HELPER NORMALISASI KELAS & KATEGORI CLIENT-SIDE]
    // ==========================================
    function normalizeClassNameClient(cls) {
      if (!cls) return 'Reguler A';
      var s = String(cls).trim();
      var regMatch = s.match(/^(Reguler|Karyawan)\s*\d+([A-Za-z]+)/i);
      if (regMatch) {
        var prefix = regMatch[1].charAt(0).toUpperCase() + regMatch[1].slice(1).toLowerCase();
        return prefix + ' ' + regMatch[2].toUpperCase();
      }
      var numPrefixMatch = s.match(/^\d+([A-Za-z]+)$/);
      if (numPrefixMatch) {
        return 'Reguler ' + numPrefixMatch[1].toUpperCase();
      }
      return s;
    }

    function detectCategoryFromClassClient(cls) {
      if (!cls) return 'Reguler';
      var s = String(cls).toLowerCase();
      if (s.indexOf('karyawan') !== -1) return 'Karyawan';
      return 'Reguler';
    }

    function populateKelasDropdown(prodiCode, filterCategory, targetValue) {
      const kSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKelas');
      if (!kSel) return;
      const master = appData.master || {};
      let allKelas = master.kelas || [];
      if (!allKelas || allKelas.length === 0) {
        allKelas = [
          { 'Nama Kelas': 'Reguler A', Kategori: 'Reguler', 'Kode Prodi': 'MNJ' },
          { 'Nama Kelas': 'Reguler B', Kategori: 'Reguler', 'Kode Prodi': 'MNJ' },
          { 'Nama Kelas': 'Reguler C', Kategori: 'Reguler', 'Kode Prodi': 'MNJ' },
          { 'Nama Kelas': 'Karyawan A', Kategori: 'Karyawan', 'Kode Prodi': 'MNJ' },
          { 'Nama Kelas': 'Karyawan B', Kategori: 'Karyawan', 'Kode Prodi': 'MNJ' }
        ];
      }

      // Filter berdasarkan prodi (jika item master kelas menyertakan kode prodi spesifik)
      let list = allKelas.filter(k => {
        const kp = String(k['Kode Prodi'] || '').toUpperCase();
        return !kp || kp === 'ALL' || kp === String(prodiCode || '').toUpperCase();
      });
      if (list.length === 0) list = allKelas;

      // Filter berdasarkan Kategori Kelas (Reguler vs Karyawan)
      if (filterCategory) {
        const catTarget = String(filterCategory).toLowerCase();
        const filteredByCat = list.filter(k => {
          const cat = String(k.Kategori || detectCategoryFromClassClient(k['Nama Kelas'] || k.Kelas)).toLowerCase();
          return cat === catTarget;
        });
        if (filteredByCat.length > 0) list = filteredByCat;
      }

      // Hilangkan duplikasi penamaan kelas
      const uniqueMap = {};
      const uniqueList = [];
      list.forEach(k => {
        const rawName = k['Nama Kelas'] || k.Kelas || '';
        const cleanName = normalizeClassNameClient(rawName);
        if (cleanName && !uniqueMap[cleanName]) {
          uniqueMap[cleanName] = true;
          uniqueList.push({
            name: cleanName,
            kategori: k.Kategori || detectCategoryFromClassClient(cleanName)
          });
        }
      });

      kSel.innerHTML = uniqueList.map(k => `<option value="${k.name}" data-kategori="${k.kategori}">${k.name}</option>`).join('');

      if (targetValue) {
        const cleanTarget = normalizeClassNameClient(targetValue);
        let foundOption = Array.from(kSel.options).find(o => o.value === cleanTarget);
        if (foundOption) {
          kSel.value = cleanTarget;
        } else {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = cleanTarget;
          opt.text = cleanTarget;
          opt.setAttribute('data-kategori', detectCategoryFromClassClient(cleanTarget));
          kSel.appendChild(opt);
          kSel.value = cleanTarget;
        }
      }
    }

    function onProdiSelectionChange() {
      const prodiCode = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi')?.value || 'MNJ').toUpperCase();
      const master = appData.master || {};
      const allMatkul = master.matkul || [];

      // Perbarui badge Prodi di setiap baris dinamis
      const allBadgeProdis = document.querySelectorAll('[id^="badgeMatkulProdi_"]');
      allBadgeProdis.forEach(b => {
        b.innerText = `Prodi: ${prodiCode}`;
      });

      // Verifikasi setiap input mata kuliah apakah masih sesuai prodi
      const prodiMatkul = allMatkul.filter(m => String(m['Kode Prodi'] || '').toUpperCase() === prodiCode);
      if (Array.isArray(dynamicMatkulAutocompletes)) {
        dynamicMatkulAutocompletes.forEach(entry => {
          const inp = document.getElementById(`pendaftaranMatkul_${entry.rowIdx}`);
          if (inp && inp.value) {
            const curVal = inp.value.trim().toLowerCase();
            const isValid = prodiMatkul.some(m => (m['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || '').toLowerCase() === curVal);
            if (!isValid && prodiMatkul.length > 0) {
              if (entry.autoMatkul) entry.autoMatkul.clear();
            }
          }
          if (entry.autoMatkul) entry.autoMatkul.refresh();
          if (entry.autoDosen) entry.autoDosen.refresh();
          if (entry.autoDosenLalu) entry.autoDosenLalu.refresh();
        });
      }

      syncMatkulLegacyFields();
      updateRegistrationSummary();

      // Sinkronkan dropdown kelas dengan kategori kelas yang aktif
      const katSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas');
      const currKat = katSel ? katSel.value : 'Reguler';
      const kSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKelas');
      const currKelas = kSel ? kSel.value : '';
      populateKelasDropdown(prodiCode, currKat, currKelas);

      syncPeriodeToPendaftaran();
    }

    function onKategoriKelasChange() {
      const prodiCode = document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi')?.value || 'MNJ';
      const katSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas');
      const selectedKat = katSel ? katSel.value : 'Reguler';
      const kSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKelas');
      const currentKelas = kSel ? kSel.value : '';

      // Muat ulang dropdown kelas sesuai kategori yang dipilih
      populateKelasDropdown(prodiCode, selectedKat, currentKelas);

      // Verifikasi apakah kelas saat ini sesuai kategori, jika tidak sesuaikan ke opsi pertama
      if (kSel && kSel.options.length > 0) {
        const detectedOfCurrent = detectCategoryFromClassClient(kSel.value);
        if (detectedOfCurrent !== selectedKat) {
          kSel.selectedIndex = 0;
        }
      }
      syncPeriodeToPendaftaran();
    }

    function onKelasSelectionChange() {
      const kSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKelas');
      const katSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas');
      if (kSel && katSel && kSel.value) {
        const chosenClass = kSel.value;
        const autoCat = detectCategoryFromClassClient(chosenClass);
        if (katSel.value !== autoCat) {
          katSel.value = autoCat;
        }
      }
      syncPeriodeToPendaftaran();
    }

    function syncPeriodeToPendaftaran(preferredLayanan = null, allowHistorical = false) {
      const layananEl = document.getElementById('pendaftaranLayanan');
      const taEl = document.getElementById('pendaftaranTahunAkademik');
      const semEl = document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemester');
      const badgeEl = document.getElementById('activePeriodBadgeId');
      const badgeLayananLock = document.getElementById('badgeLayananLock');

      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      const katSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas');
      const studentClassCat = isMhs
        ? detectCategoryFromClassClient(normalizeClassNameClient(currentUser.kelas || 'Reguler A'))
        : (katSel ? katSel.value : 'Reguler');
      const targetKategori = studentClassCat || 'Reguler';

      const activePeriods = getActivePeriodsForCategory(targetKategori);
      const now = new Date();
      let candidatePeriods = activePeriods;
      if (isMhs && !allowHistorical) {
        const openOnes = activePeriods.filter(p => evaluatePeriodWindow(p, now).canRegister);
        if (openOnes.length > 0) candidatePeriods = openOnes;
      }

      const prevSelected = normalizeJenisLayananName(
        preferredLayanan || (layananEl ? layananEl.value : '')
      );

      const serviceList = [];
      candidatePeriods.forEach(p => {
        const norm = normalizeJenisLayananName(p['Jenis Layanan']);
        if (norm && !serviceList.some(s => s.toLowerCase() === norm.toLowerCase())) {
          serviceList.push(norm);
        }
      });

      if (layananEl) {
        layananEl.innerHTML = '';
        if (serviceList.length === 0) {
          if (allowHistorical && prevSelected) {
            const histOpt = document.createElement('option');
            histOpt.value = prevSelected;
            histOpt.textContent = `${prevSelected} (Periode Arsip / Non-Aktif)`;
            layananEl.appendChild(histOpt);
            layananEl.value = prevSelected;
          } else {
            const emptyOpt = document.createElement('option');
            emptyOpt.value = '';
            emptyOpt.textContent = '-- Tidak Ada Layanan Aktif --';
            layananEl.appendChild(emptyOpt);
            layananEl.value = '';
          }
          if (badgeLayananLock) badgeLayananLock.innerText = '(Tidak Ada Periode Aktif)';
        } else {
          serviceList.forEach(srv => {
            const opt = document.createElement('option');
            opt.value = srv;
            opt.textContent = srv;
            layananEl.appendChild(opt);
          });
          const hasPrev = prevSelected && serviceList.some(s => s.toLowerCase() === prevSelected.toLowerCase());
          if (hasPrev) {
            const exactPrev = serviceList.find(s => s.toLowerCase() === prevSelected.toLowerCase());
            layananEl.value = exactPrev;
          } else if (allowHistorical && prevSelected) {
            const histOpt = document.createElement('option');
            histOpt.value = prevSelected;
            histOpt.textContent = `${prevSelected} (Periode Arsip / Non-Aktif)`;
            layananEl.appendChild(histOpt);
            layananEl.value = prevSelected;
          } else {
            layananEl.value = serviceList[0];
          }
          if (badgeLayananLock) {
            badgeLayananLock.innerText = serviceList.length === 1
              ? '(Sesuai Periode Aktif)'
              : `(${serviceList.length} Layanan Aktif)`;
          }
        }
      }

      const currentLayananVal = layananEl ? layananEl.value : '';
      const matched = findMatchingActivePeriod(currentLayananVal, targetKategori) || candidatePeriods[0] || activePeriods[0] || null;
      const keepOriginalPeriod = Boolean(
        allowHistorical ||
        (pendaftaranEditBillingState && pendaftaranEditBillingState.billingMode !== 'recalculate')
      );
      if (keepOriginalPeriod && pendaftaranEditBillingState && pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalTahunAkademik) {
        if (taEl) taEl.value = pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalTahunAkademik;
        if (semEl) semEl.value = pendaftaranEditBillingState.originalSemester || (matched && matched.Semester) || 'Ganjil';
        if (badgeEl) badgeEl.innerText = (matched && matched.ID) || 'DATA-ASLI';
      } else if (matched) {
        if (taEl) taEl.value = matched['Tahun Akademik'] || '2026/2027';
        if (semEl) semEl.value = matched.Semester || 'Ganjil';
        if (badgeEl) badgeEl.innerText = matched.ID || 'PRD-AKTIF';
      } else {
        const listTa = (appData && appData.master && appData.master.tahunAkademik) || [];
        const activeTa = listTa.find(t => String(t.Status || t.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'aktif') || listTa[0];
        if (taEl && activeTa) taEl.value = activeTa['Tahun Akademik'] || '2026/2027';
        if (semEl && activeTa) semEl.value = activeTa.Semester || 'Ganjil';
        if (badgeEl) badgeEl.innerText = 'TIDAK ADA PERIODE';
      }

      if (typeof updateRegistrationSummary === 'function') {
        updateRegistrationSummary();
      }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [KALKULASI SEMESTER OTOMATIS]: Berdasarkan Angkatan & Tahun Akademik Aktif
    // ==========================================
    function calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(angkatanInput, customTaYear, customTaSem) {
      if (!angkatanInput) return 'Semester 1';
      let angkatan = parseInt(angkatanInput, 10);
      if (isNaN(angkatan) || angkatan <= 0) return 'Semester 1';
      if (angkatan < 100) angkatan = 2000 + angkatan;

      let taYear = customTaYear;
      let taSem = customTaSem;

      if (!taYear || !taSem) {
        const listTa = (appData && appData.master && appData.master.tahunAkademik) || [];
        const activeTa = listTa.find(t => String(t.Status || t.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'aktif') || listTa[0];
        if (activeTa) {
          taYear = activeTa['Tahun Akademik'] || activeTa.Tahun || '2026/2027';
          taSem = activeTa.Semester || (String(activeTa['Tahun Akademik'] || activeTa.Tahun || '').toLowerCase().includes('genap') ? 'Genap' : 'Ganjil');
        } else {
          const periodes = (appData && appData.master && appData.master.periode) || [];
          const activePrd = periodes.find(p => String(p.Status || '').toLowerCase() === 'aktif') || periodes[0];
          if (activePrd) {
            taYear = activePrd['Tahun Akademik'] || '2026/2027';
            taSem = activePrd.Semester || (String(activePrd['Tahun Akademik'] || '').toLowerCase().includes('genap') ? 'Genap' : 'Ganjil');
          }
        }
      }

      if (!taYear) taYear = '2026/2027';
      if (!taSem) taSem = 'Ganjil';

      let startYear = 2026;
      const match = String(taYear).match(/\d{4}/);
      if (match) startYear = parseInt(match[0], 10);
      const isGanjil = !String(taSem).toLowerCase().includes('genap');

      const diffYears = startYear - angkatan;
      let semNum = 1;
      if (diffYears >= 0) {
        semNum = isGanjil ? (diffYears * 2 + 1) : (diffYears * 2 + 2);
      } else {
        semNum = 1;
      }
      return 'Semester ' + semNum;
    }

    function onAngkatanInputChange() {
      const angkatanVal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranAngkatan')?.value;
      const semInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemesterKalkulasi');
      if (semInput) {
        semInput.value = calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(angkatanVal);
      }
    }

    function onPendaftaranNimInput(val) {
      if (!val) {
        if (typeof refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings === 'function') refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings();
        return;
      }
      const clean = String(val).trim();
      const mhsList = (appData && appData.users_mahasiswa) || [];
      const found = mhsList.find(m => String(m.NPM || m.Username || m.ID || '').toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase());
      
      const namaInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranNama');
      const prodiSelect = document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi');
      const angkatanInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranAngkatan');
      const semInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemesterKalkulasi');
      const katSelect = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas');

      if (found) {
        if (namaInput && (!namaInput.value || namaInput.dataset.autoFilled === 'true')) {
          namaInput.value = found['Nama Lengkap'] || found.Nama || '';
          namaInput.dataset.autoFilled = 'true';
        }
        if (prodiSelect && found['Kode Prodi']) {
          prodiSelect.value = found['Kode Prodi'];
        }

        const cleanKelas = normalizeClassNameClient(found.Kelas || 'Reguler A');
        const autoKat = detectCategoryFromClassClient(cleanKelas);
        if (katSelect) katSelect.value = autoKat;
        populateKelasDropdown(prodiSelect ? prodiSelect.value : 'MNJ', autoKat, cleanKelas);
        syncPeriodeToPendaftaran();

        let angkatan = found.Angkatan;
        if (!angkatan) {
          const match = clean.match(/^(\d{2})/);
          if (match) angkatan = 2000 + parseInt(match[1], 10);
        }
        if (angkatan && angkatanInput) {
          angkatanInput.value = angkatan;
          if (semInput) {
            semInput.value = found.Semester || calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(angkatan);
          }
        }
      } else {
        const match = clean.match(/^(\d{2})/);
        if (match && angkatanInput && (!angkatanInput.value || angkatanInput.dataset.autoFilled === 'true')) {
          const yr = 2000 + parseInt(match[1], 10);
          if (yr >= 2015 && yr <= 2035) {
            angkatanInput.value = yr;
            angkatanInput.dataset.autoFilled = 'true';
            if (semInput) {
              semInput.value = calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(yr);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (typeof refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings === 'function') {
        refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings();
      }
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    // ==========================================
    // [FORM PENDAFTARAN MAHASISWA & AUTOFILL KUNCI]
    // ==========================================
    function openPendaftaranModal(id = null) {
      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      if (isMhs && !id) {
        const studentClass = normalizeClassNameClient(currentUser.kelas || 'Reguler A');
        const studentCategory = detectCategoryFromClassClient(studentClass);
        const accessCheck = checkMahasiswaRegistrationAccess(studentCategory, new Date());
        if (!accessCheck.allowed) {
          Swal.fire({
            icon: accessCheck.icon || 'warning',
            title: accessCheck.title || 'Tidak Dapat Mendaftar',
            html: accessCheck.html || accessCheck.message,
            confirmButtonText: 'Saya Mengerti',
            confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
          });
          return;
        }
      }

      const modal = document.getElementById('modalPendaftaran');
      const form = document.getElementById('formPendaftaran');
      form.reset();
      clearBuktiFoto();
      document.getElementById('pendaftaranId').value = id || '';
      const nimInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranNim');
      const namaInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranNama');
      const prodiSelect = document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi');
      const angkatanInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranAngkatan');
      const semKalkulasiInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemesterKalkulasi');
      const kelasSelect = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKelas');
      const kategoriSelect = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas');

      const badgeNpm = document.getElementById('badgeNpmLock');
      const badgeNama = document.getElementById('badgeNamaLock');
      const badgeProdi = document.getElementById('badgeProdiLock');
      const badgeAngkatan = document.getElementById('badgeAngkatanLock');
      const badgeKelas = document.getElementById('badgeKelasLock');
      const badgeKategori = document.getElementById('badgeKategoriLock');

      if (isMhs) {
        // [POIN 3 & POIN 7]: Kunci input Nama, NPM, Program Studi, Angkatan, Kelas, dan Kategori Kelas
        nimInput.value = currentUser.npm || currentUser.username || '';
        nimInput.readOnly = true;
        nimInput.className = 'w-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold font-mono border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 cursor-not-allowed select-none';
        if (badgeNpm) badgeNpm.innerText = '(Terkunci Akun Aktif)';

        namaInput.value = currentUser.nama || currentUser.username || '';
        namaInput.readOnly = true;
        namaInput.className = 'w-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 cursor-not-allowed select-none';
        if (badgeNama) badgeNama.innerText = '(Terkunci Akun Aktif)';

        if (currentUser.kodeProdi && currentUser.kodeProdi !== 'ALL') {
          prodiSelect.value = currentUser.kodeProdi;
        }
        prodiSelect.disabled = true;
        prodiSelect.className = 'w-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 cursor-not-allowed select-none';
        if (badgeProdi) badgeProdi.innerText = '(Terkunci)';

        let userAngkatan = currentUser.angkatan;
        if (!userAngkatan) {
          const matchAngkatan = String(nimInput.value).match(/^(\d{2})/);
          if (matchAngkatan) userAngkatan = 2000 + parseInt(matchAngkatan[1], 10);
          else userAngkatan = 2024;
        }
        if (angkatanInput) {
          angkatanInput.value = userAngkatan;
          angkatanInput.readOnly = true;
          angkatanInput.className = 'w-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold font-mono border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 cursor-not-allowed select-none text-xs';
          if (badgeAngkatan) badgeAngkatan.innerText = '(Terkunci Akun)';
        }

        const calculatedSemester = calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(userAngkatan);
        if (semKalkulasiInput) {
          semKalkulasiInput.value = currentUser.semester || calculatedSemester;
        }

        // Kunci Kelas dan Kategori Kelas untuk Mahasiswa
        const studentCleanClass = normalizeClassNameClient(currentUser.kelas || 'Reguler A');
        const studentCategory = detectCategoryFromClassClient(studentCleanClass);

        if (kategoriSelect) {
          kategoriSelect.value = studentCategory;
          kategoriSelect.disabled = true;
          kategoriSelect.className = 'w-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 cursor-not-allowed select-none';
        }
        if (badgeKategori) badgeKategori.innerText = '(Terkunci Akun Aktif)';

        populateKelasDropdown(currentUser.kodeProdi || 'MNJ', studentCategory, studentCleanClass);

        if (kelasSelect) {
          kelasSelect.value = studentCleanClass;
          kelasSelect.disabled = true;
          kelasSelect.className = 'w-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 cursor-not-allowed select-none';
        }
        if (badgeKelas) badgeKelas.innerText = '(Terkunci Akun Aktif)';
      } else {
        // Mode Admin: Buka kunci seluruh field
        nimInput.readOnly = false;
        nimInput.className = 'w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 font-mono focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900';
        if (badgeNpm) badgeNpm.innerText = '';

        namaInput.readOnly = false;
        namaInput.className = 'w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900';
        if (badgeNama) badgeNama.innerText = '';

        prodiSelect.disabled = false;
        prodiSelect.className = 'w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 bg-white font-semibold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900';
        if (badgeProdi) badgeProdi.innerText = '';

        if (angkatanInput) {
          angkatanInput.readOnly = false;
          angkatanInput.className = 'w-full border border-blue-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 font-mono font-bold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 bg-white text-xs';
          angkatanInput.value = 2024;
          if (badgeAngkatan) badgeAngkatan.innerText = '(Otomatis Terhitung)';
        }
        if (semKalkulasiInput) {
          semKalkulasiInput.value = calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(2024);
        }

        if (kategoriSelect) {
          kategoriSelect.disabled = false;
          kategoriSelect.className = 'w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 bg-white font-semibold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900';
          kategoriSelect.value = 'Reguler';
        }
        if (badgeKategori) badgeKategori.innerText = '';

        populateKelasDropdown(prodiSelect ? prodiSelect.value : 'MNJ', 'Reguler', 'Reguler A');

        if (kelasSelect) {
          kelasSelect.disabled = false;
          kelasSelect.className = 'w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 bg-white font-semibold focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900';
        }
        if (badgeKelas) badgeKelas.innerText = '';
      }

      onProdiSelectionChange();

      populateDatalistDosenTerdahulu();

      pendaftaranEditBillingState = null;

      if (id) {
        const item = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(d => String(d.ID) === String(id));
        if (item) {
          nimInput.value = item.NPM || item.NIM || '';
          namaInput.value = item['Nama Mahasiswa'] || '';
          prodiSelect.value = item['Kode Prodi'] || 'MNJ';
          const itemCleanClass = normalizeClassNameClient(item.Kelas || 'Reguler A');
          const itemCategory = item['Kategori Kelas'] || detectCategoryFromClassClient(itemCleanClass);
          if (kategoriSelect) kategoriSelect.value = itemCategory;
          populateKelasDropdown(prodiSelect.value, itemCategory, itemCleanClass);
          if (kelasSelect) kelasSelect.value = itemCleanClass;

          const rawNominal = Math.max(0, Number(item.Nominal || 0) || 0);
          const origPayRaw = String(item['Status Pembayaran'] || '').trim();
          let rawStatusJadwal = String(item['Status Jadwal'] || '').trim();
          if (!rawStatusJadwal || (rawStatusJadwal.toLowerCase() === 'belum terjadwal' && origPayRaw.toLowerCase().includes('tepat waktu'))) {
            const payLower = origPayRaw.toLowerCase();
            rawStatusJadwal = (rawNominal > 0 && (payLower.includes('denda') || payLower.includes('terlambat')))
              ? 'Terlambat'
              : 'Tepat Waktu';
          }
          const rawStatusBayar = normalizePaymentStatusLabel(origPayRaw, rawNominal);
          pendaftaranEditBillingState = {
            recordId: String(item.ID || id).trim(),
            originalTanggal: String(item.Tanggal || item.tanggal || '').trim(),
            originalTahunAkademik: String(item['Tahun Akademik'] || '').trim(),
            originalSemester: String(item['Semester Type'] || item.Semester || '').trim(),
            originalStatusJadwal: rawStatusJadwal,
            originalStatusPembayaran: rawStatusBayar,
            originalNominal: rawNominal,
            billingMode: 'preserve'
          };

          syncPeriodeToPendaftaran(item['Jenis Layanan'] || '', true);
          const taElEdit = document.getElementById('pendaftaranTahunAkademik');
          const semElEdit = document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemester');
          if (taElEdit && item['Tahun Akademik']) taElEdit.value = item['Tahun Akademik'];
          if (semElEdit && (item['Semester Type'] || item.Semester)) {
            semElEdit.value = item['Semester Type'] || item.Semester;
          }
          
          // Parsing data multi-matkul dari item
          let parsedRows = [];
          if (Array.isArray(item.mataKuliahList) && item.mataKuliahList.length > 0) {
            parsedRows = item.mataKuliahList.map(m => ({
              mataKuliah: m.nama || m.mataKuliah || '',
              dosenPengampu: m.dosen || m.dosenPengampu || '',
              sks: m.sks || 3,
              kode: m.kode || '',
              nilaiHuruf: m.nilaiHuruf || '',
              dosenLalu: m.dosenLalu || ''
            }));
          } else {
            const rawMatkul = String(item['Mata Kuliah'] || '').trim();
            const rawDosen = String(item['Dosen Pengampu'] || '').trim();
            const matkulLines = rawMatkul.split('\n').map(l => l.replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '').replace(/\s*\(\d+\s*SKS\)/i, '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
            const dosenLines = rawDosen.split('\n').map(l => l.replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '').trim()).filter(Boolean);

            if (matkulLines.length > 0) {
              parsedRows = matkulLines.map((mk, idx) => {
                let nilaiHuruf = '';
                const mNilai = mk.match(/\[(?:Nilai|Nilai Asal)\s*:\s*([A-Za-z]+)\]/i);
                if (mNilai) {
                  nilaiHuruf = mNilai[1].toUpperCase();
                  mk = mk.replace(/\[(?:Nilai|Nilai Asal)\s*:\s*[A-Za-z]+\]/i, '').trim();
                }
                let dosenP = dosenLines[idx] || (dosenLines.length === 1 ? dosenLines[0] : '');
                let dosenLalu = '';
                const mDosenLalu = dosenP.match(/\((?:Dosen Lalu|Dosen Kelas Lalu|Dosen Saat Mengambil)\s*:\s*([^)]+)\)/i);
                if (mDosenLalu) {
                  dosenLalu = mDosenLalu[1].trim();
                  dosenP = dosenP.replace(/\((?:Dosen Lalu|Dosen Kelas Lalu|Dosen Saat Mengambil)\s*:\s*[^)]+\)/i, '').trim();
                }
                return {
                  mataKuliah: mk,
                  dosenPengampu: dosenP,
                  sks: 3,
                  kode: '',
                  nilaiHuruf: nilaiHuruf,
                  dosenLalu: dosenLalu
                };
              });
            } else {
              parsedRows = [{ mataKuliah: rawMatkul, dosenPengampu: rawDosen, sks: 3, kode: '', nilaiHuruf: '', dosenLalu: '' }];
            }
          }

          const parsedCount = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, parsedRows.length));
          const selJumlah = document.getElementById('pendaftaranJumlahMatkul');
          if (selJumlah) selJumlah.value = String(parsedCount);

          renderDynamicMatkulInputs(parsedCount, parsedRows);

          document.getElementById('pendaftaranAlasan').value = item.Alasan || '';

          // Inisialisasi preview berkas bukti yang sudah tersimpan
          clearBuktiFoto();
          const existingBukti = item['Bukti Foto'] || '';
          const buktiInputElem = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiFile');
          if (buktiInputElem) buktiInputElem.dataset.existingUrl = existingBukti;
          if (existingBukti) {
            const box = document.getElementById('previewBuktiContainer');
            const img = document.getElementById('previewBuktiImg');
            const iconPdf = document.getElementById('previewBuktiIcon');
            const nameP = document.getElementById('previewBuktiName');
            const infoP = document.getElementById('previewBuktiInfo');
            if (nameP) nameP.innerText = 'Berkas Bukti Terlampir';
            if (infoP) infoP.innerHTML = `<span class="text-emerald-700 font-semibold"><i class="fas fa-cloud-check mr-1"></i>Tersimpan di Google Drive / Cloud</span>`;
            if (existingBukti.toLowerCase().includes('.pdf') || existingBukti.includes('application/pdf')) {
              if (img) img.classList.add('hidden');
              if (iconPdf) {
                iconPdf.classList.remove('hidden');
                iconPdf.className = 'w-14 h-12 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-rose-600 font-bold text-xs shrink-0';
                iconPdf.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-file-pdf text-lg text-rose-600 mb-0.5"></i><span class="text-[9px] font-mono">PDF</span>';
              }
            } else {
              if (iconPdf) iconPdf.classList.add('hidden');
              if (img) {
                img.classList.remove('hidden');
                img.src = existingBukti;
              }
            }
            if (box) {
              box.classList.remove('hidden');
              box.classList.add('flex');
            }
          }

          let itemAngkatan = item.Angkatan;
          if (!itemAngkatan) {
            const m = String(nimInput.value).match(/^(\d{2})/);
            if (m) itemAngkatan = 2000 + parseInt(m[1], 10);
          }
          if (itemAngkatan && angkatanInput) angkatanInput.value = itemAngkatan;
          if (semKalkulasiInput) {
            semKalkulasiInput.value = item.Semester || calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(itemAngkatan || 2024);
          }

          const wrapperStatus = document.getElementById('wrapperStatusPersetujuan');
          const selStatus = document.getElementById('pendaftaranStatusPersetujuan');
          const wrapperBillingAdmin = document.getElementById('wrapperEditBillingAdmin');
          if (!isMhs && wrapperStatus && selStatus) {
            wrapperStatus.classList.remove('hidden');
            selStatus.value = item['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending';
            if (wrapperBillingAdmin) wrapperBillingAdmin.classList.remove('hidden');
          } else {
            if (wrapperStatus) wrapperStatus.classList.add('hidden');
            if (wrapperBillingAdmin) wrapperBillingAdmin.classList.add('hidden');
          }
        }
      } else {
        const wrapperStatus = document.getElementById('wrapperStatusPersetujuan');
        if (wrapperStatus) wrapperStatus.classList.add('hidden');
        const wrapperBillingAdmin = document.getElementById('wrapperEditBillingAdmin');
        if (wrapperBillingAdmin) wrapperBillingAdmin.classList.add('hidden');

        // Reset form pendaftaran baru
        clearBuktiFoto();
        const buktiInputElem = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiFile');
        if (buktiInputElem) buktiInputElem.dataset.existingUrl = '';
        const alasanInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranAlasan');
        if (alasanInput) alasanInput.value = '';

        syncPeriodeToPendaftaran();

        const selJumlah = document.getElementById('pendaftaranJumlahMatkul');
        if (selJumlah) selJumlah.value = '1';
        renderDynamicMatkulInputs(1, []);
      }

      if (typeof updateRegistrationSummary === 'function') {
        updateRegistrationSummary();
      }
      if (typeof refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings === 'function') {
        refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings();
      }
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closePendaftaranModal() {
      pendaftaranEditBillingState = null;
      document.getElementById('modalPendaftaran').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalPendaftaran').classList.remove('flex');
    }

    function normalizeTahunAkademikKeyClient(val) {
      const raw = String(val || '').trim();
      const m = raw.match(/(\d{4}\s*\/\s*\d{4})/);
      if (m) return m[1].replace(/\s+/g, '').toLowerCase();
      return raw.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase();
    }

    function normalizeSemesterParityClient(val, fallbackTa) {
      const combined = `${String(val || '')} ${String(fallbackTa || '')}`.toLowerCase();
      if (combined.includes('genap')) return 'genap';
      if (combined.includes('ganjil')) return 'ganjil';
      const numMatch = String(val || '').match(/\d+/);
      if (numMatch) {
        const num = parseInt(numMatch[0], 10);
        if (!isNaN(num) && num > 0) return (num % 2 === 0) ? 'genap' : 'ganjil';
      }
      return 'ganjil';
    }

    function cleanCourseLabelForDedup(raw) {
      return String(raw || '')
        .replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '')
        .replace(/\[(?:Nilai|Nilai Asal)\s*:\s*[^\]]+\]/gi, '')
        .replace(/\(\s*\d+\s*SKS\s*\)/gi, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    }

    function cleanDosenLabelForDedup(raw) {
      const cleaned = String(raw || '')
        .replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '')
        .replace(/\((?:Dosen Lalu|Dosen Kelas Lalu|Dosen Saat Mengambil)\s*:[^)]+\)/gi, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
      return cleaned === '-' ? '' : cleaned;
    }

    function parsePendaftaranCoursePairsClient(rawMatkul, rawDosen, matkulList) {
      const pairs = [];
      if (Array.isArray(matkulList) && matkulList.length > 0) {
        matkulList.forEach(item => {
          const mk = cleanCourseLabelForDedup(item && typeof item === 'object' ? (item.nama || item.mataKuliah) : item);
          const dsn = cleanDosenLabelForDedup(item && typeof item === 'object' ? (item.dosenPengampu || item.dosen) : '');
          if (mk || dsn) pairs.push({ mataKuliah: mk, dosenPengampu: dsn });
        });
        if (pairs.length > 0) return pairs;
      }

      const mkLines = String(rawMatkul || '').split(/\n|\|/).map(cleanCourseLabelForDedup).filter(Boolean);
      const dsnLines = String(rawDosen || '').split(/\n|\|/).map(cleanDosenLabelForDedup).filter(Boolean);
      const maxLen = Math.max(mkLines.length, dsnLines.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) {
        const mkName = mkLines[i] || '';
        const dsnName = dsnLines[i] || (dsnLines.length === 1 ? dsnLines[0] : '');
        if (mkName || dsnName) pairs.push({ mataKuliah: mkName, dosenPengampu: dsnName });
      }
      return pairs;
    }

    function findCrossFormPendaftaranDuplicatesClient(candidatePayload, existingList, excludeId = '') {
      if (!candidatePayload || !Array.isArray(existingList) || existingList.length === 0) return [];
      const incomingPairs = parsePendaftaranCoursePairsClient(
        candidatePayload.mataKuliah,
        candidatePayload.dosenPengampu,
        candidatePayload.mataKuliahList
      );
      if (incomingPairs.length === 0) return [];

      const targetId = String(excludeId || candidatePayload.id || '').trim();
      const targetNpm = String(candidatePayload.npm || candidatePayload.nim || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const targetNama = String(candidatePayload.namaMahasiswa || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const targetTa = normalizeTahunAkademikKeyClient(candidatePayload.tahunAkademik || '2026/2027');
      const targetSemParity = normalizeSemesterParityClient(
        candidatePayload.semesterPeriode || candidatePayload.semester || 'Ganjil',
        candidatePayload.tahunAkademik
      );
      const targetLayanan = normalizeJenisLayananName(candidatePayload.jenisLayanan || '').toLowerCase();
      if ((!targetNpm && !targetNama) || !targetLayanan) return [];

      const conflicts = [];
      existingList.forEach(rec => {
        if (!rec || typeof rec !== 'object') return;
        const recId = String(rec.ID || rec.id || '').trim();
        if (targetId && recId === targetId) return;

        const recStatus = String(rec['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending').trim();
        if (recStatus.toLowerCase() === 'ditolak') return;

        const recNpm = String(rec.NPM || rec.NIM || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const recNama = String(rec['Nama Mahasiswa'] || rec.namaMahasiswa || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const sameStudent = (targetNpm && recNpm)
          ? (targetNpm === recNpm)
          : (targetNama && recNama && targetNama === recNama);
        if (!sameStudent) return;

        const recTaRaw = rec['Tahun Akademik'] || '2026/2027';
        const recSemRaw = rec['Semester Type'] || rec.semesterPeriode || rec.Semester || 'Ganjil';
        const recLayananRaw = rec['Jenis Layanan'] || rec.jenisLayanan || '';

        if (normalizeTahunAkademikKeyClient(recTaRaw) !== targetTa) return;
        if (normalizeSemesterParityClient(recSemRaw, recTaRaw) !== targetSemParity) return;
        if (normalizeJenisLayananName(recLayananRaw).toLowerCase() !== targetLayanan) return;

        const existingPairs = parsePendaftaranCoursePairsClient(
          rec['Mata Kuliah'] || rec.mataKuliah,
          rec['Dosen Pengampu'] || rec.dosenPengampu,
          rec.mataKuliahList
        );

        incomingPairs.forEach((inPair, rowIdx) => {
          const inMk = inPair.mataKuliah.toLowerCase();
          const inDsn = inPair.dosenPengampu.toLowerCase();
          if (!inMk || !inDsn) return;
          const matchedExisting = existingPairs.find(ex =>
            ex.mataKuliah.toLowerCase() === inMk && ex.dosenPengampu.toLowerCase() === inDsn
          );
          if (matchedExisting) {
            conflicts.push({
              rowIdx,
              mataKuliah: inPair.mataKuliah,
              dosenPengampu: inPair.dosenPengampu,
              existingId: recId || '-',
              existingStatus: recStatus || 'Pending'
            });
          }
        });
      });

      return conflicts;
    }

    function refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings() {
      const container = document.getElementById('dynamicMatkulContainer');
      if (!container) return;
      const rows = collectCurrentMatkulFormData();
      const editId = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranId')?.value || '').trim();
      const npmVal = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranNim')?.value || '').trim();
      const namaVal = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranNama')?.value || '').trim();
      const taVal = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranTahunAkademik')?.value || '2026/2027').trim();
      const semPeriodeVal = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemester')?.value || 'Ganjil').trim();
      const layananVal = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranLayanan')?.value || '').trim();

      const candidate = {
        id: editId,
        npm: npmVal,
        namaMahasiswa: namaVal,
        tahunAkademik: taVal,
        semesterPeriode: semPeriodeVal,
        semester: semPeriodeVal,
        jenisLayanan: layananVal,
        mataKuliahList: rows
      };

      const conflicts = findCrossFormPendaftaranDuplicatesClient(candidate, (appData && appData.pendaftaran) || [], editId);
      const conflictByRow = new Map();
      conflicts.forEach(c => {
        if (!conflictByRow.has(c.rowIdx)) conflictByRow.set(c.rowIdx, c);
      });

      rows.forEach((row, idx) => {
        const warnEl = document.getElementById(`dupWarningRow_${idx}`);
        if (!warnEl) return;
        const hit = conflictByRow.get(idx);
        if (hit) {
          warnEl.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-triangle-exclamation mt-0.5 shrink-0"></i><span>Sudah terdaftar pada pengajuan <b>${escapeHtml(hit.existingId)}</b> (Status: <b>${escapeHtml(hit.existingStatus)}</b>) untuk periode &amp; layanan ini. Hanya bisa daftar ulang jika status sebelumnya <b>Ditolak</b>.</span>`;
          warnEl.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          warnEl.innerHTML = '';
          warnEl.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      });
    }

    function handleSavePendaftaran(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const isMhsGuard = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      const editRecordId = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranId')?.value || '').trim();
      const layananValPre = document.getElementById('pendaftaranLayanan')?.value || '';
      const rawKelasPre = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKelas')?.value || 'Reguler A';
      const cleanKategoriPre = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas')?.value || detectCategoryFromClassClient(normalizeClassNameClient(rawKelasPre));

      if (isMhsGuard && !editRecordId) {
        const saveAccessCheck = checkMahasiswaRegistrationAccess(cleanKategoriPre, new Date(), layananValPre);
        if (!saveAccessCheck.allowed) {
          Swal.fire({
            icon: saveAccessCheck.icon || 'warning',
            title: saveAccessCheck.title || 'Tidak Dapat Mendaftar',
            html: saveAccessCheck.html || saveAccessCheck.message,
            confirmButtonText: 'Saya Mengerti',
            confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
          });
          return;
        }
      }

      if (!layananValPre) {
        Swal.fire('Periode Layanan Tidak Tersedia', 'Jenis Layanan belum tersedia karena belum ada Jadwal Periode berstatus Aktif untuk Kategori Kelas ini.', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      if (typeof updateRegistrationSummary === 'function') {
        updateRegistrationSummary();
      }

      const prodiSel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranProdi');
      const kodeProdi = prodiSel.value;
      const namaProdi = prodiSel.options[prodiSel.selectedIndex]?.getAttribute('data-nama') || kodeProdi;
      const semCalculated = document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemesterKalkulasi')?.value || document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemester')?.value || 'Semester 1';
      const semPeriodeVal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranSemester')?.value || 'Ganjil';
      const angkatanVal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranAngkatan')?.value || '';
      const rawKelas = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKelas')?.value || 'Reguler A';
      const cleanKelas = normalizeClassNameClient(rawKelas);
      const rawKategori = document.getElementById('pendaftaranKategoriKelas')?.value;
      const cleanKategori = rawKategori || detectCategoryFromClassClient(cleanKelas);

      // Verifikasi seluruh baris mata kuliah dinamis
      const matkulRows = collectCurrentMatkulFormData();
      if (matkulRows.length === 0) {
        Swal.fire('Validasi Gagal', 'Mohon pilih minimal 1 mata kuliah yang akan didaftarkan.', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      const layananVal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranLayanan')?.value || '';
      const isRemedial = layananVal.toLowerCase().includes('remedial');

      for (let i = 0; i < matkulRows.length; i++) {
        const row = matkulRows[i];
        if (!row.mataKuliah || row.mataKuliah.trim().length === 0) {
          Swal.fire('Validasi Gagal', `Nama Mata Kuliah #${i + 1} belum dipilih. Silakan pilih dari daftar Master Data!`, 'warning');
          document.getElementById(`pendaftaranMatkul_${i}`)?.focus();
          return;
        }
        if (!row.dosenPengampu || row.dosenPengampu.trim().length === 0) {
