          Swal.fire('Validasi Gagal', `Dosen Pengampu untuk Mata Kuliah #${i + 1} belum dipilih. Silakan pilih dari daftar Dosen!`, 'warning');
          document.getElementById(`pendaftaranDosen_${i}`)?.focus();
          return;
        }
        if (isRemedial) {
          if (!row.nilaiHuruf || !['D', 'CD', 'C', 'BC'].includes(row.nilaiHuruf)) {
            Swal.fire('Validasi Nilai Remedial', `Nilai huruf sebelumnya untuk Mata Kuliah #${i + 1} wajib dipilih (syarat perbaikan: D, CD, C, atau BC).`, 'warning');
            document.getElementById(`pendaftaranNilaiHuruf_${i}`)?.focus();
            return;
          }
          if (!row.dosenLalu || row.dosenLalu.trim().length === 0) {
            Swal.fire('Validasi Dosen Remedial', `Nama dosen mata kuliah pada saat mengambil Mata Kuliah #${i + 1} wajib diisi!`, 'warning');
            document.getElementById(`pendaftaranDosenLalu_${i}`)?.focus();
            return;
          }
        }
      }

      // Validasi duplikasi antar baris dalam 1 formulir
      const seenNames = new Set();
      for (let i = 0; i < matkulRows.length; i++) {
        const nameLower = matkulRows[i].mataKuliah.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (seenNames.has(nameLower)) {
          Swal.fire('Duplikasi Terdeteksi', `Mata kuliah "${matkulRows[i].mataKuliah}" terdaftar lebih dari satu kali pada formulir ini. Mohon perbaiki sebelum menyimpan!`, 'warning');
          return;
        }
        seenNames.add(nameLower);
      }

      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      const statusPersetujuan = !isMhs && document.getElementById('pendaftaranStatusPersetujuan') 
        ? document.getElementById('pendaftaranStatusPersetujuan').value 
        : 'Pending';

      // Validasi duplikasi antar formulir (Mata Kuliah & Dosen Pengampu sama untuk 1 mahasiswa di periode/layanan sama; kecuali pengajuan lama Ditolak)
      if (String(statusPersetujuan || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== 'ditolak') {
        const dupCandidate = {
          id: editRecordId,
          npm: document.getElementById('pendaftaranNim')?.value || '',
          namaMahasiswa: document.getElementById('pendaftaranNama')?.value || '',
          tahunAkademik: document.getElementById('pendaftaranTahunAkademik')?.value || '2026/2027',
          semester: semCalculated,
          semesterPeriode: semPeriodeVal,
          jenisLayanan: layananVal,
          mataKuliahList: matkulRows
        };
        const crossConflicts = findCrossFormPendaftaranDuplicatesClient(dupCandidate, (appData && appData.pendaftaran) || [], editRecordId);
        if (crossConflicts.length > 0) {
          refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings();
          const listHtml = crossConflicts.map(c =>
            `<li class="text-left"><b>${escapeHtml(c.mataKuliah)}</b> — Dosen: <b>${escapeHtml(c.dosenPengampu)}</b> (Kode: <code>${escapeHtml(c.existingId)}</code>, Status: <b>${escapeHtml(c.existingStatus)}</b>)</li>`
          ).join('');
          Swal.fire({
            icon: 'warning',
            title: 'Pendaftaran Ganda Terdeteksi',
            html: `<div class="text-left text-xs space-y-2 leading-relaxed">
              <p>Mahasiswa ini sudah memiliki pengajuan aktif untuk kombinasi <b>Mata Kuliah &amp; Dosen</b> yang sama pada periode dan layanan <b>${escapeHtml(layananVal)}</b>:</p>
              <ul class="list-disc pl-4 space-y-1 text-rose-800">${listHtml}</ul>
              <p class="text-slate-600">Mahasiswa hanya dapat mendaftar ulang mata kuliah &amp; dosen yang sama apabila pengajuan sebelumnya berstatus <b>Ditolak</b>.</p>
            </div>`,
            confirmButtonText: 'Saya Mengerti',
            confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
          });
          document.getElementById(`pendaftaranMatkul_${crossConflicts[0].rowIdx}`)?.focus();
          return;
        }
      }

      // Validasi wajib isi: Alasan / Keterangan
      const alasanVal = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranAlasan')?.value || '').trim();
      if (!alasanVal) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Alasan Wajib Diisi',
          text: 'Kolom Alasan / Keterangan pengajuan layanan wajib diisi secara lengkap.'
        });
        document.getElementById('pendaftaranAlasan')?.focus();
        return;
      }

      // Validasi wajib isi: Upload Bukti Foto / Dokumen Pendukung (JPG, PNG, atau PDF)
      const buktiBase64 = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiBase64')?.value || '').trim();
      const existingBukti = (document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiFile')?.dataset?.existingUrl || '').trim();
      if (!buktiBase64 && !existingBukti) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Berkas Bukti Wajib Diunggah',
          text: 'Upload Bukti Foto atau Dokumen Pendukung (format JPG, PNG, atau PDF maks 5 MB) wajib dilampirkan sebelum menyimpan formulir!'
        });
        document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiFile')?.focus();
        return;
      }

      // Format string multi-matkul dan dosen untuk backwards compatibility dan spreadsheet
      let formattedMatkul = '';
      let formattedDosen = '';
      if (matkulRows.length === 1) {
        const m = matkulRows[0];
        const nilaiStr = isRemedial && m.nilaiHuruf ? ` [Nilai: ${m.nilaiHuruf}]` : '';
        const laluStr = isRemedial && m.dosenLalu ? ` (Dosen Lalu: ${m.dosenLalu})` : '';
        formattedMatkul = `${m.mataKuliah}${nilaiStr}`;
        formattedDosen = `${m.dosenPengampu}${laluStr}`;
      } else {
        formattedMatkul = matkulRows.map((m, idx) => {
          const nilaiStr = isRemedial && m.nilaiHuruf ? ` [Nilai: ${m.nilaiHuruf}]` : '';
          return `${idx + 1}. ${m.mataKuliah}${nilaiStr} (${m.sks || 3} SKS)`;
        }).join('\n');
        formattedDosen = matkulRows.map((m, idx) => {
          const laluStr = isRemedial && m.dosenLalu ? ` (Dosen Lalu: ${m.dosenLalu})` : '';
          return `${idx + 1}. ${m.dosenPengampu}${laluStr}`;
        }).join('\n');
      }

      const totalNominal = Number(document.getElementById('pendaftaranNominal')?.value || 0);
      const statusJadwal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranStatusJadwal')?.value || 'Tepat Waktu';
      const statusPembayaran = document.getElementById('pendaftaranStatusPembayaran')?.value || (totalNominal > 0 ? 'Belum Bayar' : 'Gratis (Tepat Waktu)');
      const totalSksVal = Number(document.getElementById('pendaftaranTotalSks')?.value || 0);

      const fileNameVal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiFileName')?.value || '';
      const mimeTypeVal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiMimeType')?.value || '';

      const payload = {
        id: document.getElementById('pendaftaranId').value,
        nim: document.getElementById('pendaftaranNim').value,
        namaMahasiswa: document.getElementById('pendaftaranNama').value,
        kodeProdi: kodeProdi,
        prodi: namaProdi,
        kelas: cleanKelas,
        kategoriKelas: cleanKategori,
        tahunAkademik: document.getElementById('pendaftaranTahunAkademik').value,
        semester: semCalculated,
        semesterPeriode: semPeriodeVal,
        angkatan: angkatanVal,
        mataKuliah: formattedMatkul,
        dosenPengampu: formattedDosen,
        mataKuliahList: matkulRows,
        jumlahMatkul: matkulRows.length,
        totalSks: totalSksVal,
        jenisLayanan: document.getElementById('pendaftaranLayanan').value,
        alasan: alasanVal,
        buktiFoto: buktiBase64 || existingBukti,
        buktiFileName: fileNameVal,
        buktiMimeType: mimeTypeVal,
        statusJadwal: statusJadwal,
        statusPembayaran: statusPembayaran,
        nominal: totalNominal,
        statusPersetujuan: statusPersetujuan,
        actor: getCurrentActorName(document.getElementById('pendaftaranNama')?.value, 'Mahasiswa'),
        role: getCurrentActorRole('Mahasiswa')
      };

      const btnSave = document.getElementById('btnSavePendaftaran');
      if (btnSave) {
        btnSave.disabled = true;
        btnSave.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-cloud-arrow-up fa-bounce mr-1.5"></i> Mengunggah & Menyimpan...';
      }

      const fn = payload.id ? 'updatePendaftaran' : 'addPendaftaran';

      // [OPTIMISTIC UI UPDATE]: Simpan snapshot untuk rollback aman bila ditolak server
      let optimisticRecord = null;
      let prevEditSnapshot = null;
      if (!payload.id) {
        const newId = getNextLocalRegId();
        optimisticRecord = {
          ID: newId,
          Tanggal: new Date().toLocaleDateString('id-ID'),
          'Tahun Akademik': payload.tahunAkademik,
          Semester: payload.semester,
          'Semester Type': payload.semesterPeriode || 'Ganjil',
          NPM: payload.nim || (currentUser && currentUser.npm) || '',
          NIM: payload.nim || (currentUser && currentUser.npm) || '',
          'Nama Mahasiswa': payload.namaMahasiswa || (currentUser && currentUser.nama) || '',
          'Kode Prodi': payload.kodeProdi,
          'Program Studi': payload.prodi,
          Kelas: payload.kelas,
          'Kategori Kelas': payload.kategoriKelas,
          'Mata Kuliah': payload.mataKuliah,
          'Dosen Pengampu': payload.dosenPengampu,
          mataKuliahList: payload.mataKuliahList,
          'Jenis Layanan': payload.jenisLayanan,
          Alasan: payload.alasan,
          'Bukti Foto': payload.buktiFoto,
          'Status Jadwal': payload.statusJadwal || 'Belum Terjadwal',
          Nominal: payload.nominal,
          'Status Pembayaran': payload.statusPembayaran || 'Lunas',
          'Status Persetujuan': payload.statusPersetujuan || 'Pending'
        };
        appData.pendaftaran = appData.pendaftaran || [];
        appData.pendaftaran.unshift(optimisticRecord);
        saveAppDataCache(appData);
        renderPendaftaranTable();
      } else {
        const item = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(d => String(d.ID) === String(payload.id));
        if (item) {
          prevEditSnapshot = { ...item };
          item.NPM = payload.nim;
          item.NIM = payload.nim;
          item['Nama Mahasiswa'] = payload.namaMahasiswa;
          item['Kode Prodi'] = payload.kodeProdi;
          item['Program Studi'] = payload.prodi;
          item.Kelas = payload.kelas;
          item['Kategori Kelas'] = payload.kategoriKelas;
          item['Tahun Akademik'] = payload.tahunAkademik;
          item.Semester = payload.semester;
          item['Semester Type'] = payload.semesterPeriode || item['Semester Type'] || 'Ganjil';
          item.Angkatan = payload.angkatan;
          item['Jenis Layanan'] = payload.jenisLayanan;
          item['Mata Kuliah'] = payload.mataKuliah;
          item['Dosen Pengampu'] = payload.dosenPengampu;
          item.mataKuliahList = payload.mataKuliahList;
          item['Status Jadwal'] = payload.statusJadwal;
          item['Status Pembayaran'] = payload.statusPembayaran;
          item.Nominal = payload.nominal;
          item['Status Persetujuan'] = payload.statusPersetujuan;
          item.Alasan = payload.alasan;
        }
        saveAppDataCache(appData);
        renderPendaftaranTable();
      }

      const onSaveSuccess = function(res) {
        if (btnSave) {
          btnSave.disabled = false;
          btnSave.innerHTML = 'Simpan Data';
        }
        if (res && res.success) {
          closePendaftaranModal();
          Swal.fire({
            icon: 'success',
            title: 'Berhasil Disimpan!',
            text: res.message || 'Data formulir pendaftaran berhasil disimpan ke sistem.',
            timer: 2000,
            showConfirmButton: false
          });
          if (optimisticRecord && (res.id || res.ID)) {
            optimisticRecord.ID = res.id || res.ID;
          }
          saveAppDataCache(appData);
          renderPendaftaranTable();
          loadAppData(true);
        } else {
          if (optimisticRecord) {
            appData.pendaftaran = (appData.pendaftaran || []).filter(r => r !== optimisticRecord);
          } else if (prevEditSnapshot) {
            const idx = (appData.pendaftaran || []).findIndex(d => String(d.ID) === String(payload.id));
            if (idx !== -1) appData.pendaftaran[idx] = prevEditSnapshot;
          }
          saveAppDataCache(appData);
          renderPendaftaranTable();
          refreshDynamicMatkulDuplicateWarnings();
          Swal.fire('Gagal', (res && res.message) || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem saat menyimpan pendaftaran.', 'error');
        }
      };
      const onSaveError = function(err) {
        if (btnSave) {
          btnSave.disabled = false;
          btnSave.innerHTML = 'Simpan Data';
        }
        closePendaftaranModal();
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Tersimpan di Lokal',
          text: 'Pendaftaran berhasil disimpan ke memori lokal dan akan disinkronkan ke server.',
          confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
        });
        saveAppDataCache(appData);
        renderPendaftaranTable();
      };
      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(onSaveSuccess)
          .withFailureHandler(onSaveError)[fn](payload);
      } else {
        callGasApi(fn, [payload], onSaveSuccess, onSaveError);
      }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [MANAJEMEN MASTER USER MAHASISWA]

    function openAddMahasiswaModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalAddMahasiswa');
      const form = document.getElementById('formAddMahasiswa');
      if (form) form.reset();

      const prodiSelect = document.getElementById('addMhsProdi');
      if (prodiSelect) {
        const prodis = (appData.master && appData.master.prodi) || [];
        prodiSelect.innerHTML = prodis.map(p => `<option value="${p['Kode Prodi']}" data-nama="${p['Nama Prodi'] || p['Kode Prodi']}">${p['Kode Prodi']} - ${p['Nama Prodi'] || p['Kode Prodi']}</option>`).join('');
      }

      const kelasSelect = document.getElementById('addMhsKelas');
      if (kelasSelect) {
        const rawKelasList = (appData.master && appData.master.kelas) || [];
        const uniqueKelasMap = {};
        const cleanKelasList = [];
        rawKelasList.forEach(k => {
          const cName = normalizeClassNameClient(k['Nama Kelas'] || k.Kelas || '');
          if (cName && !uniqueKelasMap[cName]) {
            uniqueKelasMap[cName] = true;
            cleanKelasList.push({ name: cName, prodi: k['Kode Prodi'] || '' });
          }
        });

        if (cleanKelasList.length > 0) {
          kelasSelect.innerHTML = cleanKelasList.map(k => `<option value="${k.name}">${k.name}${k.prodi ? ` (${k.prodi})` : ''}</option>`).join('');
        } else {
          kelasSelect.innerHTML = `
            <option value="Reguler A">Reguler A</option>
            <option value="Reguler B">Reguler B</option>
            <option value="Reguler C">Reguler C</option>
            <option value="Karyawan A">Karyawan A</option>
            <option value="Karyawan B">Karyawan B</option>
          `;
        }
      }

      const angkatanInput = document.getElementById('addMhsAngkatan');
      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      if (angkatanInput) {
        angkatanInput.value = currentYear;
      }

      const badgeTa = document.getElementById('badgeActiveTaName');
      const listTa = (appData.master && appData.master.tahunAkademik) || [];
      const activeTa = listTa.find(t => String(t.Status || '').toLowerCase() === 'aktif') || listTa[0] || { 'Tahun Akademik': '2026/2027', Semester: 'Ganjil' };
      if (badgeTa) {
        badgeTa.innerText = `TA Aktif: ${activeTa['Tahun Akademik'] || activeTa.Tahun || '2026/2027'} ${activeTa.Semester || 'Ganjil'}`;
      }

      onAddMhsAngkatanInput(currentYear);

      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        modal.classList.add('flex');
      }
    }

    function closeAddMahasiswaModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalAddMahasiswa');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
        modal.classList.remove('flex');
      }
    }

    function onAddMhsNpmInput(val) {
      if (!val) return;
      const clean = String(val).trim();
      const angkatanInput = document.getElementById('addMhsAngkatan');
      const match = clean.match(/^(\d{2})/);
      if (match && angkatanInput && (!angkatanInput.value || angkatanInput.dataset.autoFilled === 'true')) {
        const yr = 2000 + parseInt(match[1], 10);
        if (yr >= 2015 && yr <= 2035) {
          angkatanInput.value = yr;
          angkatanInput.dataset.autoFilled = 'true';
          onAddMhsAngkatanInput(yr);
        }
      }
    }

    function onAddMhsAngkatanInput(val) {
      const semInput = document.getElementById('addMhsSemester');
      if (semInput) {
        semInput.value = calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(val);
      }
    }

    function handleSaveMahasiswa(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnSaveAddMhs');
      const nama = document.getElementById('addMhsNama')?.value?.trim();
      const npm = document.getElementById('addMhsNpm')?.value?.trim();
      const prodiSel = document.getElementById('addMhsProdi');
      const kodeProdi = prodiSel?.value || 'MNJ';
      const prodi = prodiSel?.options[prodiSel.selectedIndex]?.getAttribute('data-nama') || kodeProdi;
      const rawKelas = document.getElementById('addMhsKelas')?.value?.trim() || 'Reguler A';
      const kelas = normalizeClassNameClient(rawKelas);
      const angkatan = parseInt(document.getElementById('addMhsAngkatan')?.value || '2024', 10);
      const semester = document.getElementById('addMhsSemester')?.value || calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(angkatan);
      const password = document.getElementById('addMhsPassword')?.value?.trim() || '123456';

      if (!nama || !npm) {
        Swal.fire('Data Tidak Lengkap', 'Nama Lengkap dan NPM mahasiswa wajib diisi.', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-1"></i> Menyimpan...';
      }

      const actorName = getCurrentActorName();
      const actorRole = getCurrentActorRole();
      const payload = {
        nama: nama,
        npm: npm,
        kodeProdi: kodeProdi,
        prodi: prodi,
        kelas: kelas,
        angkatan: angkatan,
        semester: semester,
        password: password,
        actor: actorName,
        role: actorRole
      };

      const onSaveSuccess = function(res) {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-save"></i> <span>Simpan Mahasiswa</span>';
        }
        if (res && res.success) {
          closeAddMahasiswaModal();
          Swal.fire({
            icon: 'success',
            title: 'Mahasiswa Berhasil Ditambahkan!',
            text: res.message || `Mahasiswa ${nama} (NPM: ${npm}) berhasil didaftarkan ke sistem dengan ${semester}.`,
            confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
          });
          loadAppData();
        } else {
          Swal.fire('Gagal Menyimpan', (res && res.message) || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem saat menyimpan data mahasiswa.', 'error');
        }
      };

      const onSaveError = function(err) {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-save"></i> <span>Simpan Mahasiswa</span>';
        }
        Swal.fire('Error Sistem', err?.message || String(err), 'error');
      };

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(onSaveSuccess)
          .withFailureHandler(onSaveError)
          .addUserMahasiswa(payload, actorName, actorRole);
      } else {
        callGasApi('addUserMahasiswa', [payload, actorName, actorRole], onSaveSuccess, onSaveError);
      }
    }

    function openExcelSyncModalWithTarget(targetSheet) {
      const select = document.getElementById('excelTargetSheet');
      if (select && targetSheet) {
        select.value = targetSheet;
      }
      openExcelSyncModal();
    }

  <script>
    // ==========================================
    // [REVISI POIN 4]: ALUR INPUT JADWAL UJIAN
    // Admin memilih data dari mahasiswa yang mendaftar dahulu
    // Setelah dipilih, kunci otomatis: Prodi, Sem, Kelas, Matkul, Dosen, Jenis
    // Admin hanya mengisi: Tgl, Jam Mulai, Jam Selesai, Ruangan, Catatan
    // ==========================================
    function openJadwalModal(id = null) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalJadwalUjian');
      const form = document.getElementById('formJadwalUjian');
      if (form) form.reset();
      
      const realId = (typeof id === 'string' && id.indexOf('JDW-') === 0) ? id.trim() : '';
      document.getElementById('jadwalId').value = realId;
      document.getElementById('modalJadwalTitle').innerText = realId ? ('Edit Data Jadwal Ujian (' + realId + ')') : 'Input Data Jadwal Ujian Baru';

      // Populate Ruangan dari Master_Ruangan
      const ruanganSel = document.getElementById('jadwalRuangan');
      if (ruanganSel) {
        const masterRuangan = (appData.master && appData.master.ruangan) || appData.ruangan || [];
        ruanganSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Pilih Ruangan (Master_Ruangan) --</option>' +
          masterRuangan.map(r => {
            const kode = r['Kode Ruangan'] || r.Kode || 'R.101';
            const nama = r['Nama Ruangan'] || r.Nama || kode;
            return `<option value="${kode}">${kode} - ${nama}</option>`;
          }).join('');
      }

      // Populate pilihan mahasiswa yang mendaftar (Hanya yang BELUM terjadwalkan)
      const selectPendaftar = document.getElementById('jadwalSelectPendaftar');
      const badgeCount = document.getElementById('jadwalPendaftarCountBadge');
      const hintText = document.getElementById('jadwalPendaftarHint');
      const pendaftaranList = appData.pendaftaran || [];
      const jadwalList = appData.jadwal || [];

      // Cari jadwal yang sedang diedit jika realId ada
      const currentEditingJadwal = realId ? jadwalList.find(j => String(j.ID).trim() === realId) : null;

      // Fungsi deteksi apakah SELURUH mata kuliah dalam berkas pendaftaran p sudah memiliki jadwal ujian aktif
      function isPendaftaranAlreadyScheduled(p) {
        const allCourses = extractMataKuliahList(p);
        if (allCourses.length === 0) return false;
        const unscheduled = getUnscheduledCoursesForPendaftaran(p, jadwalList, realId);
        return unscheduled.length === 0;
      }

      // Saring hanya pendaftar berstatus Disetujui / Pending yang masih memiliki mata kuliah belum terjadwal
      let availablePendaftar = pendaftaranList.filter(p => {
        const st = String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (st === 'ditolak') return false;
        return !isPendaftaranAlreadyScheduled(p);
      });

      // Jika sedang mengedit jadwal yang sudah ada, pastikan pendaftar jadwal ini tetap disertakan (pencocokan bertingkat bebas tabrakan NPM)
      let matchedPendaftarForEdit = null;
      if (currentEditingJadwal) {
        const jKetEdit = String(currentEditingJadwal.Keterangan || '');
        const jPIdEdit = String(currentEditingJadwal.pendaftarId || currentEditingJadwal.pendaftaranId || '').trim();
        const editRegTags = [...jKetEdit.matchAll(/\[id:\s*(reg-\d+)\]/gi)].map(m => m[1].toUpperCase());
        if (jPIdEdit && !editRegTags.includes(jPIdEdit.toUpperCase())) editRegTags.unshift(jPIdEdit.toUpperCase());

        const isEditPendaftarValid = (p) => {
          if (typeof isPendaftarValidForJadwal === 'function') return isPendaftarValidForJadwal(p, currentEditingJadwal);
          const sameProdi = String(p['Kode Prodi'] || '').toUpperCase() === String(currentEditingJadwal['Kode Prodi'] || '').toUpperCase();
          return sameProdi;
        };

        // Pass 1: Tag [ID: REG-...] tervalidasi Prodi/Kelas/Matkul
        if (editRegTags.length > 0) {
          matchedPendaftarForEdit = pendaftaranList.find(p => {
            const pIdUpper = String(p.ID || p.id || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            return editRegTags.includes(pIdUpper) && isEditPendaftarValid(p);
          }) || null;
        }
        // Pass 2: Pola "Peserta: Nama (NPM)" tervalidasi Prodi/Kelas/Matkul
        if (!matchedPendaftarForEdit) {
          const pesertaM = jKetEdit.match(/Peserta\s*:\s*([^\(\n\[]+?)\s*\(\s*(?:NPM|NIM)\s*:\s*([^)\n\]]+)\s*\)/i);
          if (pesertaM) {
            const targetNama = pesertaM[1].trim().toLowerCase();
            const targetNpm = pesertaM[2].trim().toLowerCase();
            matchedPendaftarForEdit = pendaftaranList.find(p => {
              const pNpm = String(p.NPM || p.NIM || '').trim().toLowerCase();
              const pNama = String(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
              return pNpm === targetNpm && pNama === targetNama && isEditPendaftarValid(p);
            }) || null;
          }
        }
        // Pass 3: Fallback Prodi + Semester + Kelas + Mata Kuliah
        if (!matchedPendaftarForEdit) {
          matchedPendaftarForEdit = pendaftaranList.find(p => isEditPendaftarValid(p)) || null;
        }
        // Pass 4: Fallback tag REG-ID pertama bila data master berubah
        if (!matchedPendaftarForEdit && editRegTags.length > 0) {
          matchedPendaftarForEdit = pendaftaranList.find(p => editRegTags.includes(String(p.ID || p.id || '').trim().toUpperCase())) || null;
        }

        if (matchedPendaftarForEdit && !availablePendaftar.some(p => String(p.ID) === String(matchedPendaftarForEdit.ID))) {
          availablePendaftar.unshift(matchedPendaftarForEdit);
        }
      }

      if (availablePendaftar.length > 0) {
        selectPendaftar.disabled = false;
        if (badgeCount) {
          badgeCount.innerText = `${availablePendaftar.length} Mahasiswa Menunggu`;
          badgeCount.className = 'text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-900 bg-blue-100 border border-blue-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full';
        }
        if (hintText) {
          hintText.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-filter text-emerald-600"></i><span>Mahasiswa yang seluruh mata kuliahnya sudah terjadwal otomatis disembunyikan agar tidak terjadi duplikasi.</span>';
        }
        selectPendaftar.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Pilih Mahasiswa Terdaftar (Disetujui / Pending) --</option>' +
          availablePendaftar.map(p => {
            const allCourses = extractMataKuliahList(p);
            const unscheduled = getUnscheduledCoursesForPendaftaran(p, jadwalList, realId);
            const partialInfo = (allCourses.length > 1 && unscheduled.length < allCourses.length)
              ? ` (Sisa ${unscheduled.length}/${allCourses.length} Matkul)`
              : '';
            const cleanMatkul = String(p['Mata Kuliah'] || '').replace(/\n/g, ', ');
            const isCurrentEdit = matchedPendaftarForEdit && String(p.ID) === String(matchedPendaftarForEdit.ID);
            const editLabel = isCurrentEdit ? ' [Jadwal Aktif Ini]' : '';
            return `<option value="${p.ID}" data-json='${JSON.stringify(p).replace(/'/g, "&#39;")}' ${isCurrentEdit ? 'selected' : ''}>${p['Nama Mahasiswa']} (NPM: ${p.NPM || p.NIM}) - ${cleanMatkul} [${p['Jenis Layanan']}]${partialInfo}${editLabel}</option>`;
          }).join('');
      } else {
        if (badgeCount) {
          badgeCount.innerText = 'Semua Sudah Terjadwalkan';
          badgeCount.className = 'text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full';
        }
        if (hintText) {
          hintText.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-check-circle text-emerald-600"></i><span class="text-emerald-700 font-semibold">Seluruh mahasiswa pendaftar telah berhasil dijadwalkan ke ruangan ujian.</span>';
        }
        selectPendaftar.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Semua Mahasiswa Terdaftar Sudah Terjadwalkan (0 Menunggu) --</option>';
      }

      // Jika edit jadwal yang sudah ada:
      if (realId) {
        const item = (appData.jadwal || []).find(j => String(j.ID).trim() === realId);
        if (item) {
          document.getElementById('jadwalRuangan').value = item.Ruangan || '';
          document.getElementById('jadwalKodeProdi').value = item['Kode Prodi'] || 'MNJ';
          document.getElementById('jadwalProgramStudi').value = item['Program Studi'] || '';
          document.getElementById('jadwalSemester').value = item.Semester || '';
          document.getElementById('jadwalKelas').value = item.Kelas || '';
          document.getElementById('jadwalSemesterKelas').value = `${item.Semester || ''} · ${item.Kelas || ''}`;
          document.getElementById('jadwalJenisUjian').value = item['Jenis Ujian'] || 'UTS Susulan';
          document.getElementById('jadwalKeterangan').value = item.Keterangan || '';

          const singleCourse = [{
            nama: item['Mata Kuliah'] || '',
            mataKuliah: item['Mata Kuliah'] || '',
            dosen: item['Dosen Pengampu'] || '',
            dosenPengampu: item['Dosen Pengampu'] || '',
            sks: 3
          }];
          renderSlotJadwalMatkul(singleCourse, item);
        }
      } else {
        renderSlotJadwalMatkul([]);
      }

      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [HELPER MULTI-MATA KULIAH JADWAL UJIAN (GLOBAL SCOPE)]
    // ==========================================
    function extractMataKuliahList(data) {
      if (!data) return [];
      if (Array.isArray(data.mataKuliahList) && data.mataKuliahList.length > 0) {
        return data.mataKuliahList.map(m => ({
          nama: m.nama || m.mataKuliah || '',
          mataKuliah: m.mataKuliah || m.nama || '',
          dosen: m.dosen || m.dosenPengampu || '',
          dosenPengampu: m.dosenPengampu || m.dosen || '',
          sks: m.sks || 3
        }));
      }

      const rawMatkul = String(data['Mata Kuliah'] || data.mataKuliah || '').trim();
      const rawDosen = String(data['Dosen Pengampu'] || data.dosenPengampu || data.dosen || '').trim();
      if (!rawMatkul) return [];

      // Format bernomor: "1. Matematika Bisnis (3 SKS), 2. Pengantar Manajemen Bisnis (3 SKS), 3. Bahasa Inggris Bisnis (3 SKS)"
      if (/(?:^|\s*)(?:\d+[\.\)]|\-)\s+/.test(rawMatkul)) {
        const numRegex = /(?:^|\s+|(?<=[a-zA-Z\.\,]))(?:\s*\d+[\.\)]|\-)\s+/;
        const matkulParts = rawMatkul.split(numRegex).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const dosenParts = rawDosen ? rawDosen.split(numRegex).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];

        if (matkulParts.length > 0) {
          return matkulParts.map((mk, i) => {
            let sks = 3;
            const sksMatch = mk.match(/\((\d+)\s*SKS\)/i);
            if (sksMatch) sks = parseInt(sksMatch[1], 10);
            const cleanName = mk.replace(/\s*\(\d+\s*SKS\)/i, '').replace(/,\s*$/, '').trim();
            const ds = (dosenParts[i] || dosenParts[0] || '').replace(/,\s*$/, '').trim();
            return {
              nama: cleanName,
              mataKuliah: cleanName,
              dosen: ds,
              dosenPengampu: ds,
              sks: sks
            };
          });
        }
      }

      // Format baris baru (newline)
      if (rawMatkul.includes('\n')) {
        const matkulParts = rawMatkul.split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const dosenParts = rawDosen.split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        return matkulParts.map((mk, i) => {
          let sks = 3;
          const sksMatch = mk.match(/\((\d+)\s*SKS\)/i);
          if (sksMatch) sks = parseInt(sksMatch[1], 10);
          const cleanName = mk.replace(/\s*\(\d+\s*SKS\)/i, '').replace(/,\s*$/, '').trim();
          const ds = (dosenParts[i] || dosenParts[0] || '').replace(/,\s*$/, '').trim();
          return {
            nama: cleanName,
            mataKuliah: cleanName,
            dosen: ds,
            dosenPengampu: ds,
            sks: sks
          };
        });
      }

      // Default single course
      let sks = 3;
      const sksMatch = rawMatkul.match(/\((\d+)\s*SKS\)/i);
      if (sksMatch) sks = parseInt(sksMatch[1], 10);
      const cleanSingle = rawMatkul.replace(/\s*\(\d+\s*SKS\)/i, '').replace(/,\s*$/, '').trim();
      return [{
        nama: cleanSingle || rawMatkul,
        mataKuliah: cleanSingle || rawMatkul,
        dosen: rawDosen,
        dosenPengampu: rawDosen,
        sks: sks
      }];
    }

    function renderSlotJadwalMatkul(courses, existingScheduleItem = null) {
      const container = document.getElementById('containerSlotJadwalMatkul');
      const toolbar = document.getElementById('toolbarSlotMultiMatkul');
      if (!container) return;

      container.innerHTML = '';
      if (!courses || courses.length === 0) {
        if (toolbar) toolbar.classList.add('hidden');
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="bg-amber-50 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 text-xs text-center font-medium">
            <i class="fas fa-info-circle text-amber-600 mr-1.5"></i>
            Silakan pilih data mahasiswa yang mendaftar di atas untuk memuat mata kuliah yang akan dijadwalkan.
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      if (courses.length > 1) {
        if (toolbar) toolbar.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        if (toolbar) toolbar.classList.add('hidden');
      }

      const masterRuangan = (appData && appData.master && appData.master.ruangan) || (appData && appData.ruangan) || [];
      const existingIsDirect = existingScheduleItem ? isHubungiDosenSchedule(existingScheduleItem) : false;
      const fallbackToday = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
      const defaultDate = (existingScheduleItem && !existingIsDirect) ? (existingScheduleItem['Tanggal Ujian'] || fallbackToday) : fallbackToday;
      const defaultMulai = (existingScheduleItem && !existingIsDirect) ? (formatJamClean(existingScheduleItem['Jam Mulai']) || '08:00') : '08:00';
      const defaultSelesai = (existingScheduleItem && !existingIsDirect) ? (formatJamClean(existingScheduleItem['Jam Selesai']) || '10:00') : '10:00';
      const defaultRuang = (existingScheduleItem && !existingIsDirect) ? (existingScheduleItem.Ruangan || '') : '';
      const defaultKet = existingScheduleItem ? (existingScheduleItem.Keterangan || '') : '';

      courses.forEach((c, idx) => {
        const isDirect = existingScheduleItem ? existingIsDirect : isHubungiDosenSchedule(c);
        const mode = isDirect ? 'contact_lecturer' : 'fixed';

        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'slot-jadwal-card relative focus-within:z-30 bg-white p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs space-y-2.5 transition hover:border-indigo-300';
        card.setAttribute('data-slot-idx', String(idx));
        card.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
        card.setAttribute('data-matkul', c.mataKuliah || c.nama || '');
        card.setAttribute('data-dosen', c.dosenPengampu || c.dosen || '');
        card.setAttribute('data-sks', c.sks || 3);

        const ruanganOptions = '<option value="">-- Pilih Ruangan --</option>' +
          masterRuangan.map(r => {
            const kode = typeof r === 'string' ? r : (r['Kode Ruangan'] || r.Kode || r.kode || 'R.101');
            const nama = typeof r === 'string' ? r : (r['Nama Ruangan'] || r.Nama || r.nama || kode);
            const sel = (defaultRuang && defaultRuang === kode) ? 'selected' : '';
            return `<option value="${kode}" ${sel}>${kode} - ${nama}</option>`;
          }).join('');

        const initialDosen = c.dosenPengampu || c.dosen || '';
        const activeBtnCls = 'bg-white text-blue-950 font-bold shadow-xs border border-slate-200/80';
        const inactiveBtnCls = 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 font-semibold border border-transparent';

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-2 gap-2">
            <div>
              <div class="font-extrabold text-blue-950 text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                <span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-blue-900 text-white font-mono text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center font-bold">${idx + 1}</span>
                <span class="text-slate-900">${escapeHtml(c.mataKuliah || c.nama)}</span>
                <span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200">${c.sks || 3} SKS</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            ${courses.length > 1 ? `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold shrink-0">Slot #${idx + 1}</span>` : ''}
          </div>
          <div class="relative" id="autocompleteSlotDosenContainer_${idx}">
            <label for="slotDosenInput_${idx}" class="block font-bold text-slate-700 text-[11px] mb-1">Dosen Pengampu <span class="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
            <div class="relative">
              <div class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-2.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-slate-400">
                <i class="fas fa-user-tie text-[11px]"></i>
              </div>
              <input type="text" id="slotDosenInput_${idx}" required autocomplete="off"
                value="${escapeHtml(initialDosen)}"
                placeholder="Ketik kata kunci nama dosen pengampu..."
                class="slot-dosen-input w-full pl-7 pr-14 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-xl font-semibold text-slate-800 text-xs placeholder:text-slate-400 placeholder:font-normal focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 focus:border-blue-900 transition-all shadow-2xs">
              <div class="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                <button type="button" id="btnClearSlotDosen_${idx}" title="Bersihkan input"
                  class="hidden w-5 h-5 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors">
                  <i class="fas fa-times text-[10px]"></i>
                </button>
                <div class="text-slate-400 pointer-events-none px-1">
                  <i class="fas fa-chevron-down text-[10px]"></i>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div id="dropdownListSlotDosen_${idx}" class="hidden absolute left-0 right-0 z-[60] mt-1 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto bg-white rounded-xl shadow-xl border border-slate-200 divide-y divide-slate-100"></div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <span class="block font-bold text-slate-700 text-[11px] mb-1">Metode Penjadwalan Ujian</span>
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80">
              <button type="button" onclick="setSlotJadwalMode(${idx}, 'fixed')"
                class="slot-mode-btn-fixed px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${!isDirect ? activeBtnCls : inactiveBtnCls}">
                <i class="fas fa-calendar-check text-[10px]"></i>
                <span>Tanggal, Jam &amp; Ruangan</span>
              </button>
              <button type="button" onclick="setSlotJadwalMode(${idx}, 'contact_lecturer')"
                class="slot-mode-btn-direct px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${isDirect ? activeBtnCls : inactiveBtnCls}">
                <i class="fas fa-comments text-[10px]"></i>
                <span>Hubungi Dosen</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="slot-fixed-fields space-y-2.5 ${isDirect ? 'hidden' : ''}">
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
              <div>
                <label class="block font-bold text-slate-700 text-[11px] mb-1">Tanggal Ujian <span class="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
                <input type="date" class="slot-tanggal w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white font-semibold text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900" ${!isDirect ? 'required' : ''} value="${defaultDate}">
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="block font-bold text-slate-700 text-[11px] mb-1">Jam Mulai <span class="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
                <input type="time" class="slot-jam-mulai w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white font-mono font-bold text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900" ${!isDirect ? 'required' : ''} value="${defaultMulai}">
              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="block font-bold text-slate-700 text-[11px] mb-1">Jam Selesai <span class="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
                <input type="time" class="slot-jam-selesai w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white font-mono font-bold text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900" ${!isDirect ? 'required' : ''} value="${defaultSelesai}">
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="block font-bold text-slate-700 text-[11px] mb-1">Ruangan Ujian <span class="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
              <select class="slot-ruangan w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white font-bold text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900" ${!isDirect ? 'required' : ''}>
                ${ruanganOptions}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="slot-direct-info p-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/70 space-y-1 ${isDirect ? '' : 'hidden'}">
            <div class="text-[11px] font-extrabold text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <i class="fas fa-user-check text-amber-700"></i>
              <span>Hubungi / Konfirmasi Langsung ke Dosen</span>
            </div>
            <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-700 leading-relaxed">
              Mahasiswa akan melihat instruksi untuk menghubungi dan mengonfirmasi jadwal pelaksanaan ujian secara langsung kepada <b class="slot-direct-dosen-name text-slate-900">${escapeHtml(initialDosen || 'dosen pengampu')}</b>. Kartu Ujian Digital tetap aktif.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label class="block font-bold text-slate-700 text-[11px] mb-1">Catatan / Instruksi Tambahan</label>
            <input type="text" class="slot-keterangan w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white text-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900" placeholder="Contoh: Membawa Kartu Ujian atau hubungi WA dosen terkait..." value="${escapeHtml(defaultKet)}">
          </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);

        const inputSlotDosen = card.querySelector(`#slotDosenInput_${idx}`);
        const dropSlotDosen = card.querySelector(`#dropdownListSlotDosen_${idx}`);
        const btnClearSlotDosen = card.querySelector(`#btnClearSlotDosen_${idx}`);
        const contSlotDosen = card.querySelector(`#autocompleteSlotDosenContainer_${idx}`);
        const directDosenLabel = card.querySelector('.slot-direct-dosen-name');
        const syncDirectDosenLabel = (nm) => {
          if (directDosenLabel) directDosenLabel.textContent = (nm && nm.trim()) ? nm.trim() : 'dosen pengampu';
        };
        if (inputSlotDosen && dropSlotDosen && typeof setupAutocomplete === 'function') {
          const autoSlotDosen = setupAutocomplete({
            inputElem: inputSlotDosen,
            dropdownElem: dropSlotDosen,
            clearBtnElem: btnClearSlotDosen,
            containerElem: contSlotDosen,
            strictValidation: false,
            placeholderEmpty: 'Dosen pengampu tidak ditemukan di Master Mata Kuliah',
            getItems: (query) => {
              const prodiCode = (document.getElementById('jadwalKodeProdi')?.value || '').toUpperCase();
              const matkulVal = (c.mataKuliah || c.nama || '').trim();
              const catalog = getMasterMatkulDosenCatalog({
                preferredProdi: prodiCode,
                preferredMatkul: matkulVal
              });
              return filterMasterMatkulDosenCatalog(catalog, query);
            },
            getItemValue: (item) => item.nama || '',
            renderItem: (item, query) => renderMasterMatkulDosenDropdownItem(item, query),
            onSelect: (item) => {
              card.setAttribute('data-dosen', item.nama || '');
              syncDirectDosenLabel(item.nama || '');
            },
            onClear: () => {
              card.setAttribute('data-dosen', '');
              syncDirectDosenLabel('');
            }
          });
          inputSlotDosen.addEventListener('input', () => {
            const v = (inputSlotDosen.value || '').trim();
            card.setAttribute('data-dosen', v);
            syncDirectDosenLabel(v);
          });
          if (autoSlotDosen && initialDosen) {
            autoSlotDosen.setValue(initialDosen);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function setSlotJadwalMode(idx, mode) {
      const card = document.querySelector(`.slot-jadwal-card[data-slot-idx="${idx}"]`);
      if (!card) return;
      const isDirect = mode === 'contact_lecturer';
      card.setAttribute('data-mode', isDirect ? 'contact_lecturer' : 'fixed');

      const fixedBox = card.querySelector('.slot-fixed-fields');
      const directBox = card.querySelector('.slot-direct-info');
      const btnFixed = card.querySelector('.slot-mode-btn-fixed');
      const btnDirect = card.querySelector('.slot-mode-btn-direct');

      if (fixedBox) fixedBox.classList.toggle('hidden', isDirect);
      if (directBox) directBox.classList.toggle('hidden', !isDirect);

      const activeCls = ['bg-white', 'text-blue-950', 'font-bold', 'shadow-xs', 'border-slate-200/80'];
      const inactiveCls = ['text-slate-600', 'hover:text-slate-900', 'font-semibold', 'border-transparent'];

      if (btnFixed && btnDirect) {
        activeCls.forEach(cls => {
          btnFixed.classList.toggle(cls, !isDirect);
          btnDirect.classList.toggle(cls, isDirect);
        });
        inactiveCls.forEach(cls => {
          btnFixed.classList.toggle(cls, isDirect);
          btnDirect.classList.toggle(cls, !isDirect);
        });
      }

      ['.slot-tanggal', '.slot-jam-mulai', '.slot-jam-selesai', '.slot-ruangan'].forEach(sel => {
        const el = card.querySelector(sel);
        if (el) el.required = !isDirect;
      });
    }

    function applyFirstSlotToAll() {
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.slot-jadwal-card');
      if (cards.length <= 1) return;
      const first = cards[0];
      const firstMode = first.getAttribute('data-mode') || 'fixed';
      const tgl = first.querySelector('.slot-tanggal')?.value;
      const jmMulai = first.querySelector('.slot-jam-mulai')?.value;
      const jmSelesai = first.querySelector('.slot-jam-selesai')?.value;
      const ruangan = first.querySelector('.slot-ruangan')?.value;
      const ket = first.querySelector('.slot-keterangan')?.value;

      for (let i = 1; i < cards.length; i++) {
        const c = cards[i];
        const slotIdx = parseInt(c.getAttribute('data-slot-idx') || String(i), 10);
        setSlotJadwalMode(slotIdx, firstMode);
        if (firstMode === 'fixed') {
          if (tgl && c.querySelector('.slot-tanggal')) c.querySelector('.slot-tanggal').value = tgl;
          if (jmMulai && c.querySelector('.slot-jam-mulai')) c.querySelector('.slot-jam-mulai').value = jmMulai;
          if (jmSelesai && c.querySelector('.slot-jam-selesai')) c.querySelector('.slot-jam-selesai').value = jmSelesai;
          if (ruangan && c.querySelector('.slot-ruangan')) c.querySelector('.slot-ruangan').value = ruangan;
        }
        if (ket !== undefined && c.querySelector('.slot-keterangan')) c.querySelector('.slot-keterangan').value = ket;
      }

      Swal.fire({
        toast: true,
        position: 'top-end',
        icon: 'success',
        title: 'Pengaturan jadwal berhasil disamakan ke semua mata kuliah!',
        showConfirmButton: false,
        timer: 2000
      });
    }

    function closeJadwalModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalJadwalUjian');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
        modal.classList.remove('flex');
      }
    }

    function normalizeMatkulNameForMatch(name) {
      return String(name || '')
        .replace(/^\d+[\.\)]\s*/, '')
        .replace(/\s*\(\d+\s*SKS\)/gi, '')
        .replace(/,\s*$/, '')
        .trim()
        .toLowerCase();
    }

    function isCourseNameMatched(jMatkulRaw, cMatkulRaw) {
      const cleanJ = normalizeMatkulNameForMatch(jMatkulRaw);
      const cleanC = normalizeMatkulNameForMatch(cMatkulRaw);
      if (!cleanJ || !cleanC) return false;
      if (cleanJ === cleanC) return true;
      // Jika entri jadwal lama menyimpan gabungan banyak mata kuliah bernomor
      const rawJLower = String(jMatkulRaw || '').toLowerCase();
      if (/(?:^|\s)2[\.\)]\s+/.test(rawJLower) || rawJLower.includes('\n')) {
        return rawJLower.includes(cleanC);
      }
      return false;
    }

    function findScheduleForRegistrationCourse(p, course, jadwalList, excludeJadwalId = '') {
      if (!p || !Array.isArray(jadwalList) || jadwalList.length === 0) return null;
      const pId = String(p.ID || p.id || '').trim();
      const pNpm = String(p.NPM || p.NIM || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const pProdi = String(p['Kode Prodi'] || p.prodi || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const pSem = String(p.Semester || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const pKelas = String(p.Kelas || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const cMatkul = course ? (course.mataKuliah || course.nama || '') : '';
      const allCourses = extractMataKuliahList(p);

      // PASS 1: Pencocokan prioritas berdasarkan kepemilikan eksplisit (pendaftarId, [ID: REG-...], atau NPM) + validasi Prodi & Kelas
      const normKelas = (v) => (typeof normalizeClassNameClient === 'function' ? normalizeClassNameClient(v).toLowerCase() : String(v || '').trim().toLowerCase());
      const explicitMatch = jadwalList.find(j => {
        if (excludeJadwalId && String(j.ID || j.id || '').trim() === String(excludeJadwalId).trim()) return false;
        const jProdi = String(j['Kode Prodi'] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        const jKelas = normKelas(j.Kelas || '');
        if (pProdi && jProdi && pProdi !== jProdi) return false;
        if (pKelas && jKelas && normKelas(pKelas) !== jKelas) return false;

        const jPId = String(j.pendaftarId || j.pendaftaranId || '').trim();
        const jKet = String(j.Keterangan || '').toLowerCase();
        const allRegTags = [...jKet.matchAll(/\[id:\s*(reg-\d+)\]/gi)].map(m => m[1].toUpperCase());

        if (allRegTags.length > 0 && pId && !allRegTags.includes(pId.toUpperCase())) return false;
        if (jPId && pId && jPId.toUpperCase() !== pId.toUpperCase()) return false;

        const idMatched = (jPId && pId && jPId.toUpperCase() === pId.toUpperCase()) ||
                          (pId && allRegTags.includes(pId.toUpperCase())) ||
                          (pNpm && (jKet.includes(pNpm) || String(j.npm || '').toLowerCase() === pNpm));

        if (!idMatched) return false;
        if (isCourseNameMatched(j['Mata Kuliah'], cMatkul)) return true;
        if (allCourses.length === 1 && normalizeMatkulNameForMatch(j['Mata Kuliah']) === normalizeMatkulNameForMatch(cMatkul)) return true;
        return false;
      });
      if (explicitMatch) return explicitMatch;

      // PASS 2: Fallback jadwal legacy (tanpa tag REG-ID milik mahasiswa lain), HARUS cocok Prodi + Semester + Kelas + Matkul
      return jadwalList.find(j => {
        if (excludeJadwalId && String(j.ID || j.id || '').trim() === String(excludeJadwalId).trim()) return false;
        const jPId = String(j.pendaftarId || j.pendaftaranId || '').trim();
        const jKet = String(j.Keterangan || '').toLowerCase();
        if (jPId && pId && jPId.toUpperCase() !== pId.toUpperCase()) return false;
        const regTagMatch = jKet.match(/\[id:\s*(reg-\d+)\]/i);
        if (regTagMatch && pId && regTagMatch[1].toUpperCase() !== pId.toUpperCase()) return false;

        if (!isCourseNameMatched(j['Mata Kuliah'], cMatkul)) return false;

        const jProdi = String(j['Kode Prodi'] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        const jSem = String(j.Semester || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const jKelas = String(j.Kelas || '').trim().toLowerCase();

        const sameProdi = !pProdi || !jProdi || pProdi === jProdi;
        const sameSem = !pSem || !jSem || pSem === jSem;
        const sameKelas = !pKelas || !jKelas || pKelas === jKelas;
        return sameProdi && sameSem && sameKelas;
      }) || null;
    }

    function getUnscheduledCoursesForPendaftaran(p, jadwalList, excludeJadwalId = '') {
      const allCourses = extractMataKuliahList(p);
      return allCourses.filter(c => !findScheduleForRegistrationCourse(p, c, jadwalList || [], excludeJadwalId));
    }

    function onSelectMahasiswaPendaftar(pendaftarId, forceShowAll = false) {
      if (!pendaftarId) {
        renderSlotJadwalMatkul([]);
        return;
      }
      const select = document.getElementById('jadwalSelectPendaftar');
      const opt = select ? select.options[select.selectedIndex] : null;

      // 1. Prioritas baca dari atribut data-json pada opsi yang dipilih agar tepat baris meski ada ID lama kembar
      let data = null;
      if (opt && String(opt.value || '').trim() === String(pendaftarId).trim() && opt.getAttribute('data-json')) {
        try {
          data = JSON.parse(opt.getAttribute('data-json'));
        } catch(e) {}
      }

      // 2. Fallback cari langsung dari objek appData.pendaftaran
      if (!data) {
        data = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID || p.id).trim() === String(pendaftarId).trim());
      }

      if (!data) {
        console.warn('Data mahasiswa pendaftar tidak ditemukan untuk ID:', pendaftarId);
        renderSlotJadwalMatkul([]);
        return;
      }

      try {
        // Kunci otomatis data akademik sesuai pendaftar
        if (document.getElementById('jadwalKodeProdi')) document.getElementById('jadwalKodeProdi').value = data['Kode Prodi'] || 'MNJ';
        if (document.getElementById('jadwalProgramStudi')) document.getElementById('jadwalProgramStudi').value = `[${data['Kode Prodi'] || 'MNJ'}] ${data['Program Studi'] || 'Manajemen'}`;
        if (document.getElementById('jadwalSemester')) document.getElementById('jadwalSemester').value = data.Semester || 'Semester 3';
        if (document.getElementById('jadwalKelas')) document.getElementById('jadwalKelas').value = data.Kelas || 'Reguler';
        if (document.getElementById('jadwalSemesterKelas')) document.getElementById('jadwalSemesterKelas').value = `${data.Semester || 'Semester 3'} · ${data.Kelas || 'Reguler'}`;
        if (document.getElementById('jadwalJenisUjian')) document.getElementById('jadwalJenisUjian').value = data['Jenis Layanan'] || 'UTS Susulan';

        const allCourses = extractMataKuliahList(data);
        const unscheduledCourses = getUnscheduledCoursesForPendaftaran(data, appData.jadwal || []);
        const coursesToRender = (!forceShowAll && unscheduledCourses.length > 0) ? unscheduledCourses : allCourses;

        renderSlotJadwalMatkul(coursesToRender);

        if (!forceShowAll && unscheduledCourses.length > 0 && unscheduledCourses.length < allCourses.length) {
          const container = document.getElementById('containerSlotJadwalMatkul');
          if (container) {
            const doneCount = allCourses.length - unscheduledCourses.length;
            const infoBanner = document.createElement('div');
            infoBanner.className = 'bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-[11px] text-blue-900 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2';
            infoBanner.innerHTML = `
              <span><i class="fas fa-info-circle text-blue-700 mr-1"></i> <b>${doneCount} dari ${allCourses.length}</b> mata kuliah sudah memiliki jadwal. Menampilkan <b>${unscheduledCourses.length} mata kuliah</b> yang belum terjadwal.</span>
              <button type="button" onclick="onSelectMahasiswaPendaftar('${String(pendaftarId).replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', true)" class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-white border border-blue-300 rounded-lg font-bold text-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-100 cursor-pointer">Tampilkan Semua (${allCourses.length})</button>
            `;
            container.prepend(infoBanner);
          }
        }
      } catch(e) {
        console.error('Error onSelectMahasiswaPendaftar:', e);
      }
    }

    // Expose secara eksplisit ke window agar dapat dipanggil dari atribut onclick/onchange HTML
    window.extractMataKuliahList = extractMataKuliahList;
    window.findScheduleForRegistrationCourse = findScheduleForRegistrationCourse;
    window.getUnscheduledCoursesForPendaftaran = getUnscheduledCoursesForPendaftaran;
    window.renderSlotJadwalMatkul = renderSlotJadwalMatkul;
    window.setSlotJadwalMode = setSlotJadwalMode;
    window.applyFirstSlotToAll = applyFirstSlotToAll;
    window.openJadwalModal = openJadwalModal;
    window.closeJadwalModal = closeJadwalModal;
    window.onSelectMahasiswaPendaftar = onSelectMahasiswaPendaftar;
    window.handleSaveJadwal = handleSaveJadwal;

  function sendJadwalRpcPromise(fnName, fnArgs) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy && google.script.run[fnName]) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(res => resolve(res))
          .withFailureHandler(err => reject(err))
          [fnName](...fnArgs);
      } else {
        callGasApi(fnName, fnArgs, res => resolve(res), err => reject(err));
      }
    });
  }

  async function handleSaveJadwal(e) {
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    const pId = document.getElementById('jadwalSelectPendaftar')?.value || '';
    const editId = (document.getElementById('jadwalId')?.value || '').trim();

    if (!pId && !editId) {
      Swal.fire('Perhatian', 'Pilih data mahasiswa yang mendaftar terlebih dahulu!', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    const slotCards = document.querySelectorAll('.slot-jadwal-card');
    if (slotCards.length === 0) {
      Swal.fire('Perhatian', 'Pilih mahasiswa yang mendaftar terlebih dahulu untuk memuat slot mata kuliah.', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    const pData = pId ? (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID || p.id).trim() === String(pId).trim()) : null;
    const pNpm = pData ? String(pData.NPM || pData.NIM || '').trim() : '';
    const pNama = pData ? String(pData['Nama Mahasiswa'] || '').trim() : '';
    const studentIdentityTag = (pNama || pNpm)
      ? `Peserta: ${pNama || '-'}${pNpm ? ` (NPM: ${pNpm})` : ''}`
      : '';

    // Validasi semua slot
    let isValid = true;
    let missingField = '';
    const items = [];

    slotCards.forEach((card, idx) => {
      const mode = card.getAttribute('data-mode') || 'fixed';
      const isDirect = mode === 'contact_lecturer';
      const matkul = card.getAttribute('data-matkul') || '';
      const dosen = (card.querySelector('.slot-dosen-input')?.value || card.getAttribute('data-dosen') || '').trim();
      const rawTgl = card.querySelector('.slot-tanggal')?.value || '';
      const rawJmMulai = card.querySelector('.slot-jam-mulai')?.value || '';
      const rawJmSelesai = card.querySelector('.slot-jam-selesai')?.value || '';
      const rawRuangan = card.querySelector('.slot-ruangan')?.value || '';
      const rawKet = (card.querySelector('.slot-keterangan')?.value || '').trim();

      const tgl = isDirect ? 'Hubungi Dosen' : rawTgl;
      const jmMulai = isDirect ? '-' : rawJmMulai;
      const jmSelesai = isDirect ? '-' : rawJmSelesai;
      const ruangan = isDirect ? 'Hubungi Dosen' : rawRuangan;

      if (isDirect) {
        if (!dosen) {
          isValid = false;
          missingField = `Mata kuliah "${matkul || 'Slot #' + (idx + 1)}" wajib mencantumkan nama Dosen Pengampu.`;
        }
      } else if (!dosen || !tgl || !jmMulai || !jmSelesai || !ruangan) {
        isValid = false;
        missingField = `Mata kuliah "${matkul || 'Slot #' + (idx + 1)}" belum lengkap (Dosen Pengampu, Tanggal, Jam, dan Ruangan wajib diisi).`;
      }

      let fullKet = rawKet;
      // Bersihkan tag [ID: REG-...] nyasar milik pendaftar lain yang tidak cocok dengan slot mata kuliah ini
      if (pId) {
        fullKet = fullKet.replace(/\s*\[ID:\s*(REG-\d+)\]/gi, (fullMatch, tagId) => {
          if (tagId.toUpperCase() === pId.toUpperCase()) return fullMatch;
          const otherP = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID || p.id || '').trim().toUpperCase() === tagId.toUpperCase());
          if (!otherP) return '';
          const dummyJadwal = {
            'Kode Prodi': document.getElementById('jadwalKodeProdi')?.value || '',
            Semester: document.getElementById('jadwalSemester')?.value || '',
            Kelas: document.getElementById('jadwalKelas')?.value || '',
            'Mata Kuliah': matkul
          };
          return (typeof isPendaftarValidForJadwal === 'function' && isPendaftarValidForJadwal(otherP, dummyJadwal)) ? fullMatch : '';
        }).replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim();
      }
      if (studentIdentityTag && !fullKet.includes('Peserta:') && (!pNpm || !fullKet.includes(pNpm))) {
        fullKet = fullKet ? `${fullKet} | ${studentIdentityTag}` : studentIdentityTag;
      }
      if (pId && !new RegExp(`\\[ID:\\s*${pId.replace(/[-/\\^$*+?.()|[\]{}]/g, '\\$&')}\\]`, 'i').test(fullKet)) {
        fullKet = fullKet ? `${fullKet} [ID: ${pId}]` : `[ID: ${pId}]`;
      }

      items.push({
        mode: mode,
        mataKuliah: matkul,
        dosenPengampu: dosen,
        tanggalUjian: tgl,
        jamMulai: jmMulai,
        jamSelesai: jmSelesai,
        ruangan: ruangan,
        keterangan: fullKet
      });
    });

    if (!isValid) {
      Swal.fire('Data Belum Lengkap', missingField, 'warning');
      return;
    }

    const btn = document.getElementById('btnSaveJadwal');
    if (btn) {
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Menyimpan...';
    }

    const kdProdi = document.getElementById('jadwalKodeProdi').value;
    const nmProdi = document.getElementById('jadwalProgramStudi').value;
    const sem = document.getElementById('jadwalSemester').value;
    const kls = document.getElementById('jadwalKelas').value;
    const jnsUjian = document.getElementById('jadwalJenisUjian').value;

    const payload = {
      id: editId,
      pendaftarId: pId,
      npm: pNpm,
      namaMahasiswa: pNama,
      kodeProdi: kdProdi,
      programStudi: nmProdi,
      semester: sem,
      kelas: kls,
      jenisUjian: jnsUjian,
      actor: getCurrentActorName(),
      role: getCurrentActorRole(),
      items: items,
      // Fallback backward-compatible properties
      mataKuliah: items[0].mataKuliah,
      dosenPengampu: items[0].dosenPengampu,
      tanggalUjian: items[0].tanggalUjian,
      jamMulai: items[0].jamMulai,
      jamSelesai: items[0].jamSelesai,
      ruangan: items[0].ruangan,
      keterangan: items[0].keterangan
    };

    // Optimistic update lokal
    appData.jadwal = appData.jadwal || [];
    const baseNum = getNextLocalJadwalBaseNum();
    const baseId = editId || ('JDW-' + baseNum);

    if (items.length > 1 && !editId) {
      items.forEach((it, i) => {
        const subId = `${baseId}-${i + 1}`;
        appData.jadwal.unshift({
          ID: subId,
          id: subId,
          pendaftarId: pId,
          pendaftaranId: pId,
          npm: pNpm,
          'Tanggal Ujian': it.tanggalUjian,
          'Jam Mulai': it.jamMulai,
          'Jam Selesai': it.jamSelesai,
          Ruangan: it.ruangan,
          'Kode Prodi': kdProdi,
          'Program Studi': nmProdi,
          Semester: sem,
          Kelas: kls,
          'Mata Kuliah': it.mataKuliah,
          'Dosen Pengampu': it.dosenPengampu,
          'Jenis Ujian': jnsUjian,
          Keterangan: it.keterangan
        });
      });
    } else {
      const itemObj = {
        ID: baseId,
        id: baseId,
        pendaftarId: pId,
        pendaftaranId: pId,
        npm: pNpm,
        'Tanggal Ujian': items[0].tanggalUjian,
        'Jam Mulai': items[0].jamMulai,
        'Jam Selesai': items[0].jamSelesai,
        Ruangan: items[0].ruangan,
        'Kode Prodi': kdProdi,
        'Program Studi': nmProdi,
        Semester: sem,
        Kelas: kls,
        'Mata Kuliah': items[0].mataKuliah,
        'Dosen Pengampu': items[0].dosenPengampu,
        'Jenis Ujian': jnsUjian,
        Keterangan: items[0].keterangan
      };
      const existIdx = appData.jadwal.findIndex(j => String(j.ID || j.id) === baseId);
      if (existIdx !== -1) {
        appData.jadwal[existIdx] = Object.assign({}, appData.jadwal[existIdx], itemObj);
      } else {
        appData.jadwal.unshift(itemObj);
      }
    }

    if (pId) {
      const pMatch = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID || p.id) === String(pId));
      if (pMatch) {
        pMatch['Status Jadwal'] = 'Terjadwal';
      }
    }
    saveAppDataCache(appData);
    renderJadwalUjianTable();
    renderPendaftaranTable();
    if (typeof renderKartuUjianDigital === 'function') renderKartuUjianDigital();
    if (typeof renderSpreadsheetWorkbook === 'function') renderSpreadsheetWorkbook();

    const isEdit = Boolean(editId && editId.indexOf('JDW-') === 0);

    try {
      const fnName = isEdit ? 'updateJadwal' : 'addJadwal';
      const fnArgs = isEdit ? [editId, payload] : [payload];
      const res = await sendJadwalRpcPromise(fnName, fnArgs);

      // JIKA backend GAS masih versi lama (hanya menyimpan 1 baris pertama & tidak mengembalikan array res.items lengkap),
      // kirim sisa mata kuliah (indeks 1 s.d. akhir) secara berurutan agar SEMUA mata kuliah masuk ke Google Spreadsheet!
      if (!isEdit && res && res.success && !res.isLocalFallback && items.length > 1) {
        const savedCount = Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items.length : 1;
        if (savedCount < items.length) {
          for (let k = savedCount; k < items.length; k++) {
            const singleIt = items[k];
            const singlePayload = {
              id: '',
              pendaftarId: pId,
              npm: pNpm,
              namaMahasiswa: pNama,
              kodeProdi: kdProdi,
              programStudi: nmProdi,
              semester: sem,
              kelas: kls,
              jenisUjian: jnsUjian,
              actor: getCurrentActorName(),
              role: getCurrentActorRole(),
              mataKuliah: singleIt.mataKuliah,
              dosenPengampu: singleIt.dosenPengampu,
              tanggalUjian: singleIt.tanggalUjian,
              jamMulai: singleIt.jamMulai,
              jamSelesai: singleIt.jamSelesai,
              ruangan: singleIt.ruangan,
              keterangan: singleIt.keterangan
            };
            await sendJadwalRpcPromise('addJadwal', [singlePayload]);
          }
        }
      }

      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = 'Simpan & Terbitkan Jadwal';
      }

      if (res && res.success) {
        closeJadwalModal();
        if (res.isLocalFallback) {
          Swal.fire('Tersimpan Lokal', `${items.length} jadwal mata kuliah tersimpan di cache browser (GAS sedang offline).`, 'info');
        } else {
          Swal.fire('Berhasil', res.message || `Berhasil menerbitkan ${items.length} jadwal ujian ke Spreadsheet!`, 'success');
          loadAppData();
        }
      } else {
        Swal.fire('Gagal', (res && res.message) || 'Gagal menyimpan jadwal.', 'error');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = 'Simpan & Terbitkan Jadwal';
      }
      Swal.fire('Tersimpan Lokal', 'Jadwal telah tersimpan di sistem lokal.', 'info');
      closeJadwalModal();
    }
  }

    // ==========================================
    // [REVISI POIN 5]: TAMPILAN JADWAL UJIAN RAPI
    // Format tanggal dan jam tersusun rapi seperti Jadwal Periode
    // ==========================================
  </script>

  <script>
    // ==========================================
    // [JADWAL UJIAN MODERN]: KPI DINAMIS, TOOLBAR PINTAR, STICKY HEADER & INFINITE SCROLL
    // ==========================================
    const JADWAL_BATCH_SIZE = 25;
    const jadwalToolbarState = {
      search: '',
      prodi: '',
      jenis: '',
      sort: 'tanggal-asc',
      visibleCount: JADWAL_BATCH_SIZE
    };
    let jadwalFilteredCache = [];
    let jadwalInfiniteObserver = null;

    function readJadwalToolbarControls() {
      const elSearch = document.getElementById('searchJadwal');
      const elProdi = document.getElementById('jadwalFilterProdi');
      const elJenis = document.getElementById('jadwalFilterJenis');
      const elSort = document.getElementById('sortJadwal');

      if (elSearch) jadwalToolbarState.search = String(elSearch.value || '').trim();
      if (elProdi) jadwalToolbarState.prodi = String(elProdi.value || '').trim();
      if (elJenis) jadwalToolbarState.jenis = String(elJenis.value || '').trim();
      if (elSort) jadwalToolbarState.sort = String(elSort.value || 'tanggal-asc').trim() || 'tanggal-asc';
    }

    function syncJadwalToolbarVisualControls() {
      const btnClear = document.getElementById('btnClearSearchJadwal');
      if (btnClear) {
        btnClear.classList.toggle('hidden', !jadwalToolbarState.search);
      }

      const isDirty = Boolean(
        jadwalToolbarState.search ||
        jadwalToolbarState.prodi ||
        jadwalToolbarState.jenis ||
        (jadwalToolbarState.sort && jadwalToolbarState.sort !== 'tanggal-asc')
      );
      const btnReset = document.getElementById('btnResetJadwalToolbar');
      if (btnReset) {
        btnReset.classList.toggle('hidden', !isDirty);
        btnReset.classList.toggle('inline-flex', isDirty);
      }

      const s = jadwalToolbarState.sort;
      const setIcon = (id, ascKey, descKey) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el) return;
        if (s === ascKey) {
          el.className = 'fas fa-sort-up text-[10px] text-blue-900';
        } else if (s === descKey) {
          el.className = 'fas fa-sort-down text-[10px] text-blue-900';
        } else {
          el.className = 'fas fa-sort text-[10px] text-slate-400';
        }
      };
      setIcon('sortIconJdwId', 'id-asc', 'id-desc');
      setIcon('sortIconJdwTanggal', 'tanggal-asc', 'tanggal-desc');
      setIcon('sortIconJdwRuangan', 'ruangan-asc', 'ruangan-desc');
      setIcon('sortIconJdwMatkul', 'matkul-asc', 'matkul-desc');
    }

    function getMahasiswaOwnJadwalList(jadwalList, userObj) {
      if (!Array.isArray(jadwalList) || jadwalList.length === 0 || !userObj) return [];
      const myNpm = String(userObj.npm || userObj.username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const myNama = String(userObj.nama || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const pendaftaranList = Array.isArray(appData && appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];

      const isMyRegistration = (p) => {
        if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') return false;
        const pNpm = String(p.NPM || p.NIM || p.npm || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const pNama = String(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.nama || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (myNpm && pNpm) return pNpm === myNpm;
        if (!pNpm && myNama && pNama) return pNama === myNama;
        return false;
      };

      const myRegs = pendaftaranList.filter(isMyRegistration);
      const myNonRejectedRegs = myRegs.filter(p => String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').trim().toLowerCase() !== 'ditolak');
      if (myNonRejectedRegs.length === 0) return [];

      const myNonRejectedIds = new Set(myNonRejectedRegs.map(p => String(p.ID || p.id || '').trim().toUpperCase()).filter(Boolean));
      const myRejectedIds = new Set(
        myRegs
          .filter(p => String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'ditolak')
          .map(p => String(p.ID || p.id || '').trim().toUpperCase())
          .filter(Boolean)
      );

      return jadwalList.filter(j => {
        if (!j || typeof j !== 'object') return false;

        // 1. Cek kecocokan langsung dari pendaftaran non-Ditolak milik akun mahasiswa
        const matchedViaReg = myNonRejectedRegs.some(p => {
          const courses = typeof extractMataKuliahList === 'function' ? extractMataKuliahList(p) : [];
          if (courses.length > 0) {
            return courses.some(c => typeof findScheduleForRegistrationCourse === 'function' && findScheduleForRegistrationCourse(p, c, [j]) !== null);
          }
          return typeof findScheduleForRegistrationCourse === 'function' && findScheduleForRegistrationCourse(p, { mataKuliah: p['Mata Kuliah'] || '' }, [j]) !== null;
        });
        if (matchedViaReg) return true;

        // 2. Cek peserta teresolusi (untuk jadwal gabungan/multi-peserta) & pastikan bukan semata tag registrasi Ditolak
        const ketStr = String(j.Keterangan || j.keterangan || '');
        const tagIds = [...ketStr.matchAll(/\[id:\s*(reg-\d+)\]/gi)].map(m => m[1].trim().toUpperCase());
        const directPId = String(j.pendaftarId || j.pendaftaranId || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        if (directPId && !tagIds.includes(directPId)) tagIds.push(directPId);

        const hasRejectedOnlyTag = tagIds.length > 0 && tagIds.some(id => myRejectedIds.has(id)) && !tagIds.some(id => myNonRejectedIds.has(id));
        if (hasRejectedOnlyTag) return false;

        if (typeof resolveJadwalPeserta === 'function') {
          const resolved = resolveJadwalPeserta(j);
          const participants = (resolved && Array.isArray(resolved.participants)) ? resolved.participants : [];
          return participants.some(pt => {
            const ptNpm = String(pt.npm || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            if (myNpm && ptNpm && ptNpm !== '-') return ptNpm === myNpm;
            const ptNama = String(pt.nama || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            return (!ptNpm || ptNpm === '-') && myNama && ptNama === myNama;
          });
        }
        return false;
      });
    }

    function getJadwalScopedList() {
      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      const allJadwal = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.jadwal)) ? appData.jadwal : [];
      return isMhs ? getMahasiswaOwnJadwalList(allJadwal, currentUser) : allJadwal.slice();
    }

    function parseJadwalDateTimeMs(item) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return 0;
      if (typeof isHubungiDosenSchedule === 'function' && isHubungiDosenSchedule(item)) return 0;
      const dateMs = typeof parseInvoiceDateMs === 'function'
        ? parseInvoiceDateMs(item['Tanggal Ujian'] || item.tanggal || '')
        : 0;
      const cleanJam = typeof formatJamClean === 'function'
        ? formatJamClean(item['Jam Mulai'] || '')
        : String(item['Jam Mulai'] || '');
      const timeMatch = String(cleanJam).match(/(\d{1,2})[:.](\d{2})/);
      const minsOffset = timeMatch
        ? ((parseInt(timeMatch[1], 10) || 0) * 60 + (parseInt(timeMatch[2], 10) || 0)) * 60000
        : 0;
      return dateMs + minsOffset;
    }

    function getFilteredSortedJadwalList(scopedInput) {
      readJadwalToolbarControls();
      let list = Array.isArray(scopedInput) ? scopedInput.slice() : getJadwalScopedList();

      if (jadwalToolbarState.prodi) {
        const targetProdi = jadwalToolbarState.prodi.toUpperCase();
        list = list.filter(j => {
          const code = typeof resolveInvoiceProdiCode === 'function'
            ? resolveInvoiceProdiCode(j)
            : String(j['Kode Prodi'] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
          return code === targetProdi;
        });
      }

      if (jadwalToolbarState.jenis) {
        const targetJenis = (typeof normalizeJenisLayananName === 'function'
          ? normalizeJenisLayananName(jadwalToolbarState.jenis)
          : jadwalToolbarState.jenis
        ).toLowerCase();
        list = list.filter(j => {
          const rawJenis = j['Jenis Ujian'] || j['Jenis Layanan'] || '';
          const normJenis = (typeof normalizeJenisLayananName === 'function'
            ? normalizeJenisLayananName(rawJenis)
            : String(rawJenis)
          ).trim().toLowerCase();
          return normJenis === targetJenis;
        });
      }

      if (jadwalToolbarState.search) {
        const tokens = jadwalToolbarState.search.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        if (tokens.length > 0) {
          list = list.filter(j => {
            const haystack = [
              j.ID,
              j['Tanggal Ujian'],
              j['Jam Mulai'],
              j['Jam Selesai'],
              j.Ruangan,
              j['Kode Prodi'],
              j['Program Studi'],
              j.Semester,
              j.Kelas,
              j['Mata Kuliah'],
              j['Dosen Pengampu'],
              j['Jenis Ujian'],
              j.Keterangan
            ]
              .filter(v => v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim() !== '')
              .map(v => String(v).toLowerCase())
              .join(' ');
            return tokens.every(token => haystack.includes(token));
          });
        }
      }

      const sortKey = jadwalToolbarState.sort || 'tanggal-asc';
      list.sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortKey === 'tanggal-asc' || sortKey === 'tanggal-desc') {
          const diff = parseJadwalDateTimeMs(a) - parseJadwalDateTimeMs(b);
          if (diff !== 0) return sortKey === 'tanggal-asc' ? diff : -diff;
          const idDiff = (typeof extractNumericIdTail === 'function' ? extractNumericIdTail(a.ID) - extractNumericIdTail(b.ID) : 0);
          return sortKey === 'tanggal-asc' ? idDiff : -idDiff;
        }
        if (sortKey === 'matkul-asc' || sortKey === 'matkul-desc') {
          const cmp = String(a['Mata Kuliah'] || '').localeCompare(String(b['Mata Kuliah'] || ''), 'id');
          return sortKey === 'matkul-asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
        }
        if (sortKey === 'ruangan-asc' || sortKey === 'ruangan-desc') {
          const cmp = String(a.Ruangan || '').localeCompare(String(b.Ruangan || ''), 'id', { numeric: true });
          return sortKey === 'ruangan-asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
        }
        if (sortKey === 'id-asc' || sortKey === 'id-desc') {
          const cmp = String(a.ID || '').localeCompare(String(b.ID || ''), 'id', { numeric: true });
          return sortKey === 'id-asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
        }
        return 0;
      });

      return list;
    }

    function updateJadwalSummaryCards(filteredList) {
      const list = Array.isArray(filteredList) ? filteredList : [];
      const elTotal = document.getElementById('statTotalJadwal');
      const elProdi = document.getElementById('statProdiJadwal');
      const elRuang = document.getElementById('statRuanganJadwal');

      if (elTotal) elTotal.innerText = list.length;
      if (elProdi) {
        const prodiCount = new Set(
          list
            .map(j => (typeof resolveInvoiceProdiCode === 'function' ? resolveInvoiceProdiCode(j) : String(j['Kode Prodi'] || '').trim().toUpperCase()))
            .filter(Boolean)
        ).size;
        elProdi.innerText = `${prodiCount} Prodi`;
      }
      if (elRuang) {
        const ruangCount = new Set(
          list
            .filter(j => !(typeof isHubungiDosenSchedule === 'function' && isHubungiDosenSchedule(j)))
            .map(j => String(j.Ruangan || '').trim())
            .filter(r => r && r !== '-')
        ).size;
        elRuang.innerText = `${ruangCount} Ruangan`;
      }
    }
