    function buildJadwalTableRow(item, canManageJadwal) {
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.className = 'hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition align-top';

      const idRaw = String(item.ID || '-').trim();
      const idAttr = escapeHtml(idRaw).replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
      const isDirect = typeof isHubungiDosenSchedule === 'function' && isHubungiDosenSchedule(item);
      const cleanMulai = formatJamClean(item['Jam Mulai']);
      const cleanSelesai = formatJamClean(item['Jam Selesai']);
      const durasi = (!isDirect && cleanMulai !== '-' && cleanSelesai !== '-') ? hitungDurasiMenit(cleanMulai, cleanSelesai) : '';
      const jamDisplay = (!isDirect && cleanMulai !== '-' && cleanSelesai !== '-') ? `${cleanMulai} - ${cleanSelesai} WIB` : '';
      const tglIndo = formatTanggalIndo(item['Tanggal Ujian']);
      const kodeProdi = String(item['Kode Prodi'] || (typeof resolveInvoiceProdiCode === 'function' ? resolveInvoiceProdiCode(item) : '') || '-').trim() || '-';
      const namaProdi = String(item['Program Studi'] || '-').trim() || '-';
      const ruangan = String(item.Ruangan || '-').trim() || '-';
      const jenisUjian = String(item['Jenis Ujian'] || '-').trim() || '-';
      const keterangan = String(item.Keterangan || '-').trim() || '-';
      const dosen = String(item['Dosen Pengampu'] || '-').trim() || '-';

      const aksiTd = canManageJadwal ? `
        <td class="px-2 py-2.5 text-center">
          <div class="flex flex-col gap-1 items-stretch max-w-[74px] mx-auto">
            <button type="button" onclick="openJadwalModal('${idAttr}')" class="bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer">
              <i class="fas fa-edit text-[9px]" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span>Edit</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="deleteJadwalItem('${idAttr}')" class="bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer">
              <i class="fas fa-trash text-[9px]" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span>Hapus</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </td>
      ` : '';

      const jadwalSlotHtml = isDirect ? `
        <div class="bg-amber-50/85 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl px-2 py-1.5 space-y-0.5 text-[11px]">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
            <i class="fas fa-comments text-amber-700 text-[10px] shrink-0" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span class="font-bold text-amber-950 leading-snug break-words">Hubungi / Konfirmasi Dosen</span>
          </div>
          <div class="text-[10px] text-amber-900/90 leading-snug break-words">
            Konfirmasi langsung ke dosen pengampu
          </div>
        </div>
      ` : `
        <div class="bg-indigo-50/75 border border-indigo-200/80 rounded-xl px-2 py-1.5 space-y-1 text-[11px]">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
            <i class="fas fa-calendar-day text-indigo-700 text-[10px] shrink-0" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            <span class="font-bold text-slate-900 leading-snug break-words">${escapeHtml(tglIndo)}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
            <span class="font-bold font-mono text-indigo-950 text-[10.5px] tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">${escapeHtml(jamDisplay || '-')}</span>
            ${durasi ? `<span class="text-[9.5px] bg-white px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200 text-slate-600 font-semibold whitespace-nowrap">${escapeHtml(durasi)}</span>` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      const ruangBadgeHtml = isDirect
        ? `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 font-black border border-amber-300 text-[11px] max-w-full truncate" title="Konfirmasi Langsung ke Dosen"><i class="fas fa-user-check text-[9px] text-amber-700" aria-hidden="true"></i> Hubungi Dosen</span>`
        : `<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-900 font-black border border-emerald-300 text-[11px] max-w-full truncate" title="${escapeHtml(ruangan)}">${escapeHtml(ruangan)}</span>`;

      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td class="px-2.5 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-1.5 mb-1">
            <span class="font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 text-[11px] tabular-nums truncate">${escapeHtml(idRaw)}</span>
            <span class="sm:hidden inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-50 text-blue-900 border border-blue-200 text-[9px] font-bold shrink-0">${escapeHtml(jenisUjian)}</span>
          </div>
          ${jadwalSlotHtml}
        </td>
        <td class="px-2.5 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          ${ruangBadgeHtml}
          <div class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-[11px] leading-snug mt-1 break-words">
            <span class="text-blue-900">[${escapeHtml(kodeProdi)}]</span> ${escapeHtml(namaProdi)}
          </div>
          <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 leading-snug mt-0.5">${escapeHtml(item.Semester || '-')} · ${escapeHtml(item.Kelas || '-')}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="px-2.5 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <b class="text-blue-950 text-xs leading-snug block break-words">${escapeHtml(item['Mata Kuliah'] || '-')}</b>
          <div class="lg:hidden text-[10px] text-slate-500 leading-snug mt-1 break-words">
            <i class="fas fa-user-tie text-[9px] text-slate-400 mr-1" aria-hidden="true"></i>${escapeHtml(dosen)}
          </div>
        </td>
        <td class="hidden lg:table-cell px-2.5 py-2.5 text-slate-700 font-medium text-[11px] leading-snug break-words min-w-0">
          ${escapeHtml(dosen)}
        </td>
        <td class="hidden sm:table-cell px-2.5 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <span class="inline-block font-bold text-blue-900 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200/80 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] leading-snug">${escapeHtml(jenisUjian)}</span>
          <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 leading-snug mt-1 break-words line-clamp-3" title="${escapeHtml(keterangan)}">${escapeHtml(keterangan)}</div>
        </td>
        ${aksiTd}
      `;
      return tr;
    }

    function updateJadwalSentinelAndCounts(renderedCount, totalFilteredCount, totalScopedCount, isMhs) {
      const infoEl = document.getElementById('jadwalToolbarCountInfo');
      if (infoEl) {
        if (totalFilteredCount === 0) {
          infoEl.innerText = isMhs && totalScopedCount === 0
            ? 'Belum ada jadwal ujian untuk akun Anda'
            : `Menampilkan 0 dari ${totalScopedCount} jadwal`;
        } else {
          const suffix = totalFilteredCount !== totalScopedCount ? ` (tersaring dari ${totalScopedCount} total)` : '';
          infoEl.innerText = `Menampilkan ${renderedCount} dari ${totalFilteredCount} jadwal${suffix}`;
        }
      }

      const sentinel = document.getElementById('jadwalInfiniteSentinel');
      if (!sentinel) return;

      if (totalFilteredCount === 0) {
        sentinel.classList.add('hidden');
        sentinel.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }

      sentinel.classList.remove('hidden');
      const remaining = totalFilteredCount - renderedCount;
      if (remaining > 0) {
        sentinel.innerHTML = `
          <span class="text-slate-500">Menampilkan <b class="text-slate-700 tabular-nums">${renderedCount}</b> dari <b class="text-slate-700 tabular-nums">${totalFilteredCount}</b> jadwal · Gulir ke bawah untuk memuat berikutnya</span>
          <button type="button" onclick="loadMoreJadwalRows()" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-blue-900 font-bold text-[11px] transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">Muat +${Math.min(JADWAL_BATCH_SIZE, remaining)}</button>
        `;
      } else {
        sentinel.innerHTML = `<span class="text-slate-400">Seluruh <b class="text-slate-600 tabular-nums">${totalFilteredCount}</b> jadwal telah ditampilkan</span>`;
      }
    }

    function setupJadwalInfiniteScroll() {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('jadwalTableScrollWrap');
      const sentinel = document.getElementById('jadwalInfiniteSentinel');
      if (!wrap || !sentinel || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;

      if (jadwalInfiniteObserver) {
        jadwalInfiniteObserver.disconnect();
      }
      jadwalInfiniteObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        if (entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting)) {
          loadMoreJadwalRows();
        }
      }, {
        root: wrap,
        rootMargin: '120px'
      });
      jadwalInfiniteObserver.observe(sentinel);
    }

    function handleJadwalScrollCheck() {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('jadwalTableScrollWrap');
      if (!wrap) return;
      const distanceFromBottom = wrap.scrollHeight - wrap.scrollTop - wrap.clientHeight;
      if (distanceFromBottom <= 120) {
        loadMoreJadwalRows();
      }
    }

    function loadMoreJadwalRows() {
      const total = jadwalFilteredCache.length;
      if (jadwalToolbarState.visibleCount >= total) return;

      const tbody = document.getElementById('tableJadwalBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      const canManageJadwal = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
      const startIdx = jadwalToolbarState.visibleCount;
      const nextCount = Math.min(total, startIdx + JADWAL_BATCH_SIZE);
      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = startIdx; i < nextCount; i++) {
        frag.appendChild(buildJadwalTableRow(jadwalFilteredCache[i], canManageJadwal));
      }
      tbody.appendChild(frag);
      jadwalToolbarState.visibleCount = nextCount;
      updateJadwalSentinelAndCounts(nextCount, total, getJadwalScopedList().length, isMhs);
    }

    function handleJadwalToolbarChange(resetScroll = true) {
      readJadwalToolbarControls();
      jadwalToolbarState.visibleCount = JADWAL_BATCH_SIZE;
      renderJadwalUjianTable({ preserveScroll: !resetScroll });
    }

    function clearJadwalSearch() {
      const input = document.getElementById('searchJadwal');
      if (input) {
        input.value = '';
        input.focus();
      }
      handleJadwalToolbarChange(true);
    }

    function resetJadwalToolbar() {
      const elSearch = document.getElementById('searchJadwal');
      if (elSearch) elSearch.value = '';
      const elProdi = document.getElementById('jadwalFilterProdi');
      if (elProdi) elProdi.value = '';
      const elJenis = document.getElementById('jadwalFilterJenis');
      if (elJenis) elJenis.value = '';
      const elSort = document.getElementById('sortJadwal');
      if (elSort) elSort.value = 'tanggal-asc';

      jadwalToolbarState.search = '';
      jadwalToolbarState.prodi = '';
      jadwalToolbarState.jenis = '';
      jadwalToolbarState.sort = 'tanggal-asc';
      jadwalToolbarState.visibleCount = JADWAL_BATCH_SIZE;

      renderJadwalUjianTable({ preserveScroll: false });
    }

    function toggleJadwalColumnSort(col) {
      readJadwalToolbarControls();
      const curr = jadwalToolbarState.sort;
      let next = 'tanggal-asc';
      if (col === 'tanggal') next = curr === 'tanggal-asc' ? 'tanggal-desc' : 'tanggal-asc';
      else if (col === 'matkul') next = curr === 'matkul-asc' ? 'matkul-desc' : 'matkul-asc';
      else if (col === 'ruangan') next = curr === 'ruangan-asc' ? 'ruangan-desc' : 'ruangan-asc';
      else if (col === 'id') next = curr === 'id-asc' ? 'id-desc' : 'id-asc';

      const elSort = document.getElementById('sortJadwal');
      if (elSort) {
        const descLabels = {
          'matkul-desc': 'Mata Kuliah Z–A',
          'ruangan-desc': 'Ruangan Z–A',
          'id-desc': 'No. Jadwal Z–A'
        };
        if (descLabels[next] && !elSort.querySelector(`option[value="${next}"]`)) {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = next;
          opt.text = descLabels[next];
          elSort.appendChild(opt);
        }
        elSort.value = next;
      }
      jadwalToolbarState.sort = next;
      handleJadwalToolbarChange(true);
    }

    function renderJadwalUjianTable(opts = {}) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('tableJadwalBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      const wrap = document.getElementById('jadwalTableScrollWrap');
      const prevScrollTop = (opts && opts.preserveScroll && wrap) ? wrap.scrollTop : 0;

      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      const canManageJadwal = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
      const thAksi = document.getElementById('thAksiJadwal');
      if (thAksi) thAksi.classList.toggle('hidden', !canManageJadwal);

      const scopedList = getJadwalScopedList();
      const list = getFilteredSortedJadwalList(scopedList);
      jadwalFilteredCache = list;

      syncJadwalToolbarVisualControls();
      updateJadwalSummaryCards(list);

      const hasActiveFilter = Boolean(
        jadwalToolbarState.search ||
        jadwalToolbarState.prodi ||
        jadwalToolbarState.jenis
      );

      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      if (list.length === 0) {
        updateJadwalSentinelAndCounts(0, 0, scopedList.length, isMhs);
        const colCount = canManageJadwal ? 6 : 5;
        const emptyMsg = (isMhs && scopedList.length === 0)
          ? 'Belum ada jadwal ujian untuk akun Anda.'
          : 'Tidak ada jadwal ujian yang cocok dengan pencarian atau filter.';
        const resetActionHtml = hasActiveFilter
          ? `<div class="mt-2"><button type="button" onclick="resetJadwalToolbar()" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-rotate-left text-[11px]"></i><span>Reset Filter</span></button></div>`
          : '';
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="${colCount}" class="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 font-medium"><div>${emptyMsg}</div>${resetActionHtml}</td></tr>`;
        return;
      }

      const targetVisible = Math.min(
        list.length,
        Math.max(JADWAL_BATCH_SIZE, jadwalToolbarState.visibleCount || JADWAL_BATCH_SIZE)
      );
      jadwalToolbarState.visibleCount = targetVisible;

      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < targetVisible; i++) {
        frag.appendChild(buildJadwalTableRow(list[i], canManageJadwal));
      }
      tbody.appendChild(frag);
      updateJadwalSentinelAndCounts(targetVisible, list.length, scopedList.length, isMhs);
      setupJadwalInfiniteScroll();

      if (wrap) {
        wrap.scrollTop = opts && opts.preserveScroll ? prevScrollTop : 0;
      }
    }

    function deleteJadwalItem(id) {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Hapus Jadwal ' + id + '?',
        text: 'Mahasiswa terkait jadwal ini akan dikembalikan ke status menunggu jadwal.',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Hapus Jadwal',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          // Revert Status Jadwal lokal optimis
          const jTarget = (appData.jadwal || []).find(j => String(j.ID).trim() === String(id).trim());
          if (jTarget) {
            const jKet = String(jTarget.Keterangan || '').toLowerCase();
            const jMatkul = String(jTarget['Mata Kuliah'] || '').toLowerCase();
            (appData.pendaftaran || []).forEach(p => {
              const pId = String(p.ID || '').toLowerCase();
              const pNpm = String(p.NPM || p.NIM || '').toLowerCase();
              if ((pId && jKet.includes(pId)) || (pNpm && jKet.includes(pNpm)) || (jMatkul && String(p['Mata Kuliah'] || '').toLowerCase().includes(jMatkul))) {
                p['Status Jadwal'] = 'Tepat Waktu';
              }
            });
            if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
          }

          const onDeleteSuccess = res => {
            Swal.fire('Terhapus', (res && res.message) || 'Jadwal berhasil dihapus.', 'success');
            loadAppData();
          };

          const onDeleteError = err => {
            Swal.fire('Error', err?.message || String(err), 'error');
          };

          const delActor = getCurrentActorName();
          const delRole = getCurrentActorRole();
          if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy && google.script.run.deleteJadwal) {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(onDeleteSuccess)
              .withFailureHandler(onDeleteError)
              .deleteJadwal(id, delActor, delRole);
          } else {
            callGasApi('deleteJadwal', [id, delActor, delRole], onDeleteSuccess, onDeleteError);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [REVISI POIN 6]: KARTU UJIAN DIGITAL MAHASISWA
    // HANYA MUNCUL JIKA ADMIN TU SUDAH SELESAI MEMASUKKAN JADWAL UJIAN
    // Jika belum: Tampilkan pesan status pending!
    // ==========================================
    function renderKartuUjianDigital() {
      const container = document.getElementById('kartuDigitalCardsContainer');
      if (!container) return;

      const pendaftaranList = appData.pendaftaran || [];
      const jadwalList = appData.jadwal || [];
      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';

      let target = pendaftaranList;
      if (isMhs) {
        const myNpm = String(currentUser.npm || currentUser.username || '').toLowerCase();
        target = pendaftaranList.filter(d => String(d.NPM || d.NIM || '').toLowerCase() === myNpm);
      }

      container.innerHTML = '';
      if (target.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="col-span-2 bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 text-center text-slate-400">Belum ada berkas pendaftaran Anda yang terdaftar di sistem.</div>';
        return;
      }

      target.forEach(p => {
        const statusApp = p['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending';
        const isApproved = statusApp.toLowerCase() === 'disetujui';
        const pId = String(p.ID || p.id || '').trim();
        const pNpm = String(p.NPM || p.NIM || '').trim().toLowerCase();

        const courses = extractMataKuliahList(p);

        // Cari jadwal untuk masing-masing mata kuliah menggunakan pencocokan dua tahap yang presisi
        const scheduledCourses = courses.map(c => ({
          course: c,
          schedule: typeof findScheduleForRegistrationCourse === 'function'
            ? findScheduleForRegistrationCourse(p, c, jadwalList)
            : null
        }));

        const hasAnySchedule = scheduledCourses.some(sc => sc.schedule && (isHubungiDosenSchedule(sc.schedule) || (sc.schedule['Tanggal Ujian'] && sc.schedule.Ruangan)));

        // KONDISI KHUSUS: Jika Belum Disetujui atau Jadwal Belum Diinput oleh Admin TU -> Tampilkan Status Pending!
        if (!isApproved || !hasAnySchedule) {
          const pendingNotice = !isApproved
            ? `Berkas pendaftaran Anda masih berstatus "${statusApp}" (Menunggu Verifikasi Persetujuan Admin TU).`
            : `Pendaftaran telah disetujui, namun Admin Master/TU belum selesai memasukkan jadwal ujian untuk mata kuliah ini.`;

          const pendingCard = document.createElement('div');
          pendingCard.className = 'bg-white rounded-3xl border-2 border-amber-200 shadow-sm p-6 space-y-3';
          pendingCard.innerHTML = `
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-xl shrink-0"><i class="fas fa-hourglass-half animate-pulse"></i></div>
              <div>
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 uppercase border border-amber-300">STATUS: MENUNGGU JADWAL RESMI</span>
                <h4 class="font-black text-slate-800 text-sm mt-0.5">${escapeHtml(p['Mata Kuliah'] || '')}</h4>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="bg-amber-50/60 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 text-xs text-slate-700 space-y-1.5">
              <p><b>Mahasiswa:</b> ${escapeHtml(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || '')} (NPM: ${escapeHtml(p.NPM || p.NIM || '')})</p>
              <p><b>Program Studi:</b> ${escapeHtml(p['Program Studi'] || '')}</p>
              <p><b>Jenis Layanan:</b> ${escapeHtml(p['Jenis Layanan'] || '')}</p>
              <p class="text-amber-900 font-bold mt-2 pt-1 border-t border-amber-200"><i class="fas fa-circle-info"></i> ${escapeHtml(pendingNotice)}</p>
            </div>
            <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 italic">Kartu Tanda Peserta Ujian Digital otomatis muncul dan dapat dicetak segera setelah Admin TU memasukkan jadwal ujian.</p>
          `;
          container.appendChild(pendingCard);
          return;
        }

        // KONDISI JADWAL SUDAH SELESAI DIMASUKKAN OLEH ADMIN TU -> TAMPILKAN KARTU DIGITAL RESMI DENGAN QR CODE!
        const qrUrl = 'https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=110x110&data=' + encodeURIComponent('FEB-UIKA-RESMI|ID:' + p.ID + '|NPM:' + (p.NPM || p.NIM) + '|NAMA:' + p['Nama Mahasiswa'] + '|STATUS:TERVERIFIKASI_SAH');

        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'bg-white rounded-3xl border-2 border-slate-300 shadow-xl p-6 space-y-4 printable-active';
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="flex items-center space-x-3.5 border-b-2 border-slate-900 pb-3" style="display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid #0f172a; padding-bottom: 12px; gap: 14px;">
            <div style="width: 58px; height: 58px; min-width: 58px; max-width: 58px; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;">
              <img src="${LOGO_UIKA_BASE64}" alt="Logo Resmi UIKA Bogor" style="width: 52px; height: 52px; max-width: 52px; max-height: 52px; object-fit: contain; display: block;" />
            </div>
            <div style="flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: block; text-align: left;">
              <div style="display: block; width: 100%; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.3; color: #0f172a; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 2px 0;">UNIVERSITAS IBN KHALDUN BOGOR</div>
              <div style="display: block; width: 100%; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.3; color: #1e3a8a; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 2px 0;">FAKULTAS EKONOMI DAN BISNIS (FEB)</div>
              <div style="display: block; width: 100%; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; color: #64748b; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0;">KARTU TANDA PESERTA UJIAN DIGITAL</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
            <div>
              <span class="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-200">NO: ${escapeHtml(p.ID)}</span>
              <h4 class="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 mt-1 uppercase">${escapeHtml(p['Jenis Layanan'])}</h4>
            </div>
            <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300">DISETUJUI</span>
          </div>

          <div class="bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 text-xs space-y-1">
            <p><b>Nama:</b> ${escapeHtml(p['Nama Mahasiswa'])}</p>
            <p><b>NPM:</b> ${escapeHtml(p.NPM || p.NIM)}</p>
            <p><b>Prodi:</b> ${escapeHtml(p['Program Studi'])} (${escapeHtml(p['Kode Prodi'])})</p>
            <p><b>Semester &amp; Kelas:</b> ${escapeHtml(p.Semester || 'Semester 3')} · ${escapeHtml(p.Kelas || 'Reguler')}</p>
          </div>

          <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-2xs">
            <div class="bg-indigo-900 text-white px-3 py-2 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-between">
              <span><i class="fas fa-calendar-alt mr-1.5 text-indigo-300"></i> Rincian Jadwal &amp; Ruangan Ujian</span>
              <span class="text-[10px] bg-indigo-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-mono">${scheduledCourses.length} Mata Kuliah</span>
            </div>
            <div class="overflow-x-auto">
              <table class="w-full text-left text-xs">
                <thead class="bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 font-bold border-b border-slate-200 text-[11px] uppercase">
                  <tr>
                    <th class="p-2.5 text-center w-8">#</th>
                    <th class="p-2.5">Mata Kuliah &amp; Dosen</th>
                    <th class="p-2.5">Jadwal Pelaksanaan</th>
                    <th class="p-2.5 text-center">Ruangan / Keterangan</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-xs">
                  ${scheduledCourses.map((sc, scIdx) => {
                    const c = sc.course;
                    const j = sc.schedule;
                    const isDirect = j && isHubungiDosenSchedule(j);
                    const dosenNama = (j && j['Dosen Pengampu']) || c.dosenPengampu || c.dosen || '-';
                    const cleanNote = j ? extractCleanJadwalNote(j.Keterangan) : '';

                    let jadwalCellHtml = '<span class="text-amber-600 font-bold italic">Menunggu Jadwal</span>';
                    let ruangCellHtml = '<span class="text-slate-400">-</span>';

                    if (j) {
                      if (isDirect) {
                        jadwalCellHtml = `
                          <div class="font-extrabold text-amber-900 leading-snug">Hubungi / Konfirmasi Langsung ke Dosen</div>
                          <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-600 mt-0.5 leading-snug">Silakan hubungi ${escapeHtml(dosenNama)} untuk penjadwalan teknis ujian</div>
                          ${cleanNote ? `<div class="text-[10.5px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5 italic">Catatan: ${escapeHtml(cleanNote)}</div>` : ''}
                        `;
                        ruangCellHtml = `<span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 font-bold border border-amber-300 text-xs whitespace-nowrap">Hubungi Dosen</span>`;
                      } else {
                        const tgl = formatTanggalIndo(j['Tanggal Ujian']);
                        const jamMulai = formatJamClean(j['Jam Mulai']);
                        const jamSelesai = formatJamClean(j['Jam Selesai']);
                        const jam = (jamMulai && jamSelesai && jamMulai !== '-' && jamSelesai !== '-') ? `${jamMulai} - ${jamSelesai} WIB` : '';
                        jadwalCellHtml = `
                          <div class="font-bold text-slate-900">${escapeHtml(tgl)}</div>
                          ${jam ? `<div class="font-mono font-bold text-indigo-950 text-[11px] tabular-nums">${escapeHtml(jam)}</div>` : ''}
                        `;
                        ruangCellHtml = `<span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 font-black border border-emerald-300 text-xs">${escapeHtml(j.Ruangan || '-')}</span>`;
                      }
                    }

                    return `
                      <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 transition align-top">
                        <td class="p-2.5 text-center font-mono font-bold text-blue-900">${scIdx + 1}</td>
                        <td class="p-2.5">
                          <div class="font-extrabold text-blue-950">${escapeHtml(c.mataKuliah || c.nama)} <span class="text-[10px] text-indigo-700 font-bold">(${c.sks || 3} SKS)</span></div>
                          <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5"><i class="fas fa-user-tie text-[10px] text-slate-400 mr-1"></i> Dosen: ${escapeHtml(dosenNama)}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td class="p-2.5 ${isDirect ? '' : 'whitespace-nowrap'}">
                          ${jadwalCellHtml}
                        </td>
                        <td class="p-2.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap">${ruangCellHtml}</td>
                      </tr>
                    `;
                  }).join('')}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
            <img src="${qrUrl}" alt="QR Validasi Dokumen Sah" class="w-16 h-16 shrink-0 bg-white p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 shadow-xs" />
            <div class="space-y-0.5 text-[10px]">
              <div class="font-bold text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-1">
                <i class="fas fa-qrcode text-emerald-700"></i>
                <span>QR CODE VALIDASI RESMI</span>
              </div>
              <p class="text-slate-600">Pindai QR Code untuk memeriksa keabsahan dokumen tanda peserta ujian resmi FEB UIKA.</p>
              <p class="font-mono text-slate-400">Kode Hash: FEB-${p.ID}-${String(p.NPM || p.NIM).slice(-4)}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="flex justify-between items-center pt-2 text-[11px] no-print">
            <span class="text-emerald-800 font-bold"><i class="fas fa-shield-halved"></i> Terverifikasi Sah Sistem</span>
            <button onclick="window.print()" class="bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-950 text-white font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center space-x-1 shadow-sm">
              <i class="fas fa-print"></i> <span>Cetak Kartu</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);
      });
    }


    // ==========================================
    // [ATURAN EKSKLUSIF NOTIFIKASI]: HAPUS HANYA UNTUK MASTER ADMIN
    // ==========================================
    function renderNotifikasiList() {
      const container = document.getElementById('notifikasiFeedList');
      if (!container) return;
      const list = appData.notifications || [];
      const isMaster = isMasterAdmin();

      container.innerHTML = '';
      if (list.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">Tidak ada notifikasi aktif.</div>';
        updateNotifSelectionUI();
        return;
      }

      list.forEach(n => {
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'p-4 rounded-2xl border bg-white flex items-start justify-between gap-3 text-xs shadow-xs';
        item.innerHTML = `
          <div class="flex items-start space-x-3">
            ${isMaster ? `<input type="checkbox" class="notif-row-cb mt-1 rounded text-blue-900 cursor-pointer" value="${n.ID}" onchange="updateNotifSelectionUI()">` : ''}
            <div>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class="font-bold text-[10px] uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-100 text-blue-900">${n.Tipe || 'Pengumuman'}</span>
                <span class="text-[10px] text-slate-400">${n.Waktu || '-'}</span>
              </div>
              <h4 class="font-black text-slate-800 text-sm mt-1">${n.Judul}</h4>
              <p class="text-slate-600 mt-0.5">${n.Pesan}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          ${isMaster ? `
          <div class="flex items-center space-x-1.5 shrink-0">
            <button onclick="handleDeleteSingleNotifikasi('${n.ID}')" title="Hapus Notifikasi (Khusus Master Admin)" class="text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 p-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 transition cursor-pointer">
              <i class="fas fa-trash-alt"></i>
            </button>
          </div>
          ` : ''}
        `;
        container.appendChild(item);
      });
      updateNotifSelectionUI();
    }

    function toggleSelectAllNotifikasi(masterCb) {
      if (!isMasterAdmin()) return;
      document.querySelectorAll('.notif-row-cb').forEach(cb => cb.checked = masterCb.checked);
      updateNotifSelectionUI();
    }

    function updateNotifSelectionUI() {
      const isMaster = isMasterAdmin();
      const selected = isMaster ? document.querySelectorAll('.notif-row-cb:checked').length : 0;
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnBulkDeleteNotif');
      const text = document.getElementById('bulkDeleteNotifText');
      if (btn && text) {
        if (isMaster && selected > 0) {
          btn.classList.remove('hidden');
          btn.classList.add('flex');
          text.innerText = `Hapus Terpilih (${selected})`;
        } else {
          btn.classList.add('hidden');
          btn.classList.remove('flex');
        }
      }
    }

    function handleDeleteSingleNotifikasi(id) {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Hapus Notifikasi Ini?',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Hapus',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(res => {
              Swal.fire('Terhapus', res.message, 'success');
              loadAppData();
            })
            .deleteNotification(id);
        }
      });
    }

    function handleBulkDeleteNotifikasi() {
      const selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.notif-row-cb:checked')).map(cb => cb.value);
      if (selected.length === 0) return;
      Swal.fire({
        title: `Hapus ${selected.length} Notifikasi Terpilih?`,
        text: 'Notifikasi yang dipilih akan dihapus permanen.',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Hapus Massal',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(res => {
              Swal.fire('Terhapus', res.message, 'success');
              loadAppData();
            })
            .bulkDeleteNotifications(selected);
        }
      });
    }

    function handleDeleteAllNotifikasi() {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Hapus Semua Notifikasi?',
        text: 'Seluruh notifikasi di sistem akan dibersihkan.',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Bersihkan Semua',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(res => {
              Swal.fire('Bersih', res.message, 'success');
              loadAppData();
            })
            .deleteAllNotifications();
        }
      });
    }

    function markAllNotificationsReadGAS() {
      (appData.notifications || []).forEach(n => {
        google.script.run.markNotificationRead(n.ID);
      });
      Swal.fire('Selesai', 'Semua notifikasi ditandai sudah dibaca.', 'success');
      loadAppData();
    }

    function openNotifikasiModal() {
      document.getElementById('formNotifikasi').reset();
      document.getElementById('modalNotifikasi').classList.remove('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalNotifikasi').classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closeNotifikasiModal() {
      document.getElementById('modalNotifikasi').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('modalNotifikasi').classList.remove('flex');
    }

    function handleSaveNotifikasi(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const payload = {
        judul: document.getElementById('notifJudulInput').value,
        pesan: document.getElementById('notifPesanInput').value,
        tipe: document.getElementById('notifTipeInput').value,
        targetRole: document.getElementById('notifTargetRoleInput').value,
        actor: getCurrentActorName(),
        role: getCurrentActorRole()
      };
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(res => {
          if (res && res.success) {
            closeNotifikasiModal();
            Swal.fire('Terkirim', res.message, 'success');
            loadAppData();
          }
        })
        .addNotification(payload);
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [REVISI POIN 1]: LOG AKTIVITAS (TIDAK HILANG)
    // ==========================================
    function getActivityLogsList() {
      if (appData && Array.isArray(appData.activityLogs)) return appData.activityLogs;
      if (appData && appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.logs)) return appData.master.logs;
      return [];
    }

    function renderMasterDataTable() {
      const container = document.getElementById('masterDataTablesContainer');
      const actLogContainer = document.getElementById('masterActivityLogContainer');

      if (actLogContainer) {
        const logs = getActivityLogsList();
        const isMaster = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
        const clearBtnHtml = isMaster ? `
          <button onclick="clearActivityLogsGAS()" class="bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition">
            <i class="fas fa-trash-can text-rose-600"></i>
            <span>Kosongkan Seluruh Log (Master Admin)</span>
          </button>
        ` : '';

        const getRoleBadgeHtml = (roleVal) => {
          const r = String(roleVal || 'Sistem').trim();
          const rl = r.toLowerCase();
          if (rl.includes('master')) {
            return `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200 whitespace-nowrap">${r}</span>`;
          }
          if (rl.includes('admin')) {
            return `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-800 border border-indigo-200 whitespace-nowrap">${r}</span>`;
          }
          if (rl.includes('kaprodi') || rl.includes('dekanat')) {
            return `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 whitespace-nowrap">${r}</span>`;
          }
          if (rl.includes('mahasiswa')) {
            return `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 whitespace-nowrap">${r}</span>`;
          }
          return `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 whitespace-nowrap">${r}</span>`;
        };

        const gasVersionBadgeHtml = gasVersionCheckState.checking
          ? `<span class="text-xs font-bold bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-blue-200"><i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-1"></i>Cek Versi GAS...</span>`
          : (gasVersionCheckState.checked
              ? (gasVersionCheckState.matches
                  ? `<span class="text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-emerald-200"><i class="fas fa-check-circle mr-1"></i>GAS Sinkron</span>`
                  : `<span class="text-xs font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-amber-200"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle mr-1"></i>GAS Versi Lama</span>`)
              : `<span class="text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-slate-200">GAS Belum Dicek</span>`);

        const gasMismatchBannerHtml = (gasVersionCheckState.checked && gasVersionCheckState.matches === false) ? `

    // ==========================================
    // [HAPUS LOG SISTEM]: KHUSUS MASTER ADMIN
    // ==========================================
    function clearActivityLogsGAS() {
      const isMaster = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
      if (!isMaster) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Ditolak', 'Hanya role Master Admin yang berhak menghapus riwayat log aktivitas sistem.', 'error');
        return;
      }

      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Kosongkan Seluruh Log?',
        text: 'Tindakan ini hanya dapat dilakukan oleh Master Admin. Seluruh riwayat log aktivitas di Google Sheets, persistent cache, dan tampilan website akan dibersihkan secara sinkron.',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Kosongkan Log',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          const execRole = getCurrentActorRole('Master Admin');
          const execActor = getCurrentActorName(null, 'Master Admin');
          const onClearSuccess = res => {
            if (res && res.success) {
              if (Array.isArray(res.logs)) {
                appData.activityLogs = res.logs;
                appData.master = appData.master || {};
                appData.master.logs = res.logs;
                if (res.version) appData.version = res.version;
                if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
                renderMasterDataTable();
              }
              Swal.fire('Berhasil', res.message, 'success');
              loadAppData(true);
            } else {
              Swal.fire('Gagal', (res && res.message) || 'Gagal menghapus log.', 'error');
            }
          };
          const onClearError = err => {
            Swal.fire('Error', err?.message || String(err), 'error');
          };
          if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(onClearSuccess)
              .withFailureHandler(onClearError)
              .clearActivityLogs(execRole, execActor);
          } else {
            callGasApi('clearActivityLogs', [execRole, execActor], onClearSuccess, onClearError);
          }
        }
      });
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    // ==========================================
    // [REVISI JADWAL PERIODE]: FORMAT WAKTU LENGKAP & FITUR EDIT BERFUNGSI
    // Format: [Hari], [Tanggal] [Bulan] [Tahun] [Jam] s/d [Jam]
    // ==========================================
    function formatPeriodeWaktuLengkap(mulaiStr, selesaiStr) {
      if (!mulaiStr) return '-';
      try {
        if (typeof formatIndonesianDateTimeRange === 'function' && typeof resolveDateTimeString === 'function') {
          const s = resolveDateTimeString(mulaiStr, '2026-11-15 00:00:00');
          const e = resolveDateTimeString(selesaiStr, '2026-11-20 23:59:00');
          return formatIndonesianDateTimeRange(s, e);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return `${mulaiStr} s/d ${selesaiStr || ''}`;
    }

    function renderPeriodeTable() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('tablePeriodeBody');
      if (!tbody) return;
      const list = (appData.master && appData.master.periode) ? appData.master.periode : [];
      tbody.innerHTML = '';

      if (list.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-400">Belum ada periode pendaftaran aktif.</td></tr>';
        renderTahunAkademikTable();
        return;
      }

      const canManage = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());

      list.forEach(p => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.className = 'hover:bg-slate-50 transition';

        const jadwalNormal = formatPeriodeWaktuLengkap(p['Tanggal & Jam Mulai'], p['Tanggal & Jam Selesai']);
        const jadwalTerlambat = p['Mulai Terlambat'] ? formatPeriodeWaktuLengkap(p['Mulai Terlambat'], p['Selesai Terlambat']) : '-';

        const aksiHtml = canManage ? `
          <td class="p-3.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap space-x-2">
            <button onclick="openPeriodeModal('${p.ID}')" class="text-blue-900 font-bold hover:underline">
              <i class="fas fa-edit mr-1"></i> Edit
            </button>
            <button onclick="deletePeriodeItem('${p.ID}')" class="text-rose-600 font-bold hover:underline">
              <i class="fas fa-trash mr-1"></i> Hapus
            </button>
          </td>
        ` : '<td class="p-3.5 text-center text-slate-400">-</td>';

        const katKelas = p['Kategori Kelas'] || 'Reguler';
        const katBadge = katKelas === 'Reguler & Karyawan'
          ? '<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-800 border border-indigo-200">Reguler & Karyawan</span>'
          : (katKelas === 'Karyawan'
            ? '<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-purple-50 text-purple-800 border border-purple-200">Karyawan</span>'
            : '<span class="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200">Reguler</span>');

        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td class="p-3.5 font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 whitespace-nowrap">${p.ID}</td>
          <td class="p-3.5">
            <b>${p['Jenis Layanan']}</b> (${p.Semester})<br>
            <span class="text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 font-bold">${p['Tahun Akademik'] || '2026/2027'}</span>
          </td>
          <td class="p-3.5 whitespace-nowrap">${katBadge}</td>
          <td class="p-3.5 font-medium text-slate-800">
            <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-950 border border-blue-200 text-xs font-semibold">
              <i class="fas fa-calendar-check text-blue-700"></i> ${jadwalNormal}
            </span>
          </td>
          <td class="p-3.5 font-medium text-amber-900">
            ${jadwalTerlambat !== '-' ? `
              <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-950 border border-amber-200 text-xs font-semibold">
                <i class="fas fa-clock text-amber-700"></i> ${jadwalTerlambat}
              </span>
            ` : '<span class="text-slate-400 italic">Tidak ada denda</span>'}
          </td>
          <td class="p-3.5 font-mono font-bold text-amber-950 whitespace-nowrap">Rp ${Number(p['Biaya Keterlambatan'] || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}</td>
          <td class="p-3.5">
            <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold text-xs ${String(p.Status).toLowerCase() === 'aktif' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700'}">
              ${p.Status}
            </span>
          </td>
          ${aksiHtml}
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });

      renderTahunAkademikTable();
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [MODAL PERIODE]: TAMBAH & EDIT PERIODE BERFUNGSI SEMPURNA
    // ==========================================
    function openPeriodeModal(id = null) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalPeriode');
      const form = document.getElementById('formPeriode');
      if (form) form.reset();

      const realId = (typeof id === 'string' && id.indexOf('PRD-') === 0) ? id.trim() : '';
      document.getElementById('periodeId').value = realId;
      document.getElementById('modalPeriodeTitle').innerText = realId ? (`Edit Jadwal Periode (${realId})`) : 'Tambah Periode Pendaftaran Baru';

      // Sinkronkan opsi dropdown Tahun Akademik dari Master
      const selectTa = document.getElementById('periodeTahunAkademik');
      if (selectTa) {
        const taList = (appData.master && appData.master.tahunAkademik) || [
          { 'Tahun Akademik': '2026/2027', Semester: 'Ganjil', Status: 'Aktif' },
          { 'Tahun Akademik': '2025/2026', Semester: 'Genap', Status: 'Arsip' },
          { 'Tahun Akademik': '2027/2028', Semester: 'Ganjil', Status: 'Mendatang' }
        ];
        selectTa.innerHTML = taList.map(t => {
          const val = t['Tahun Akademik'] || t.tahun || '2026/2027';
          const sem = t.Semester || t.semester || '';
          const semTxt = sem ? ` ${sem}` : '';
          const st = t.Status || t.status || 'Aktif';
          return `<option value="${val}">${val}${semTxt} (${st})</option>`;
        }).join('');
      }

      if (realId) {
        const list = (appData.master && appData.master.periode) || [];
        const item = list.find(p => String(p.ID).trim() === realId);
        if (item) {
          const toDatetimeLocal = (val) => {
            if (!val) return '';
            const pad2 = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
            if (val instanceof Date && !isNaN(val.getTime())) {
              return `${val.getFullYear()}-${pad2(val.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(val.getDate())}T${pad2(val.getHours())}:${pad2(val.getMinutes())}`;
            }
            const s = String(val).trim();
            if (/[Zz]|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2}$/.test(s)) {
              const dt = new Date(s);
              if (!isNaN(dt.getTime())) {
                return `${dt.getFullYear()}-${pad2(dt.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(dt.getDate())}T${pad2(dt.getHours())}:${pad2(dt.getMinutes())}`;
              }
            }
            const isoM = s.match(/^(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})(?:[T\s](\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?)?$/);
            if (isoM) {
              return `${isoM[1]}-${pad2(isoM[2])}-${pad2(isoM[3])}T${pad2(isoM[4] || '0')}:${pad2(isoM[5] || '0')}`;
            }
            const dmyM = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{4})(?:[T\s](\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?)?$/);
            if (dmyM) {
              return `${dmyM[3]}-${pad2(dmyM[2])}-${pad2(dmyM[1])}T${pad2(dmyM[4] || '0')}:${pad2(dmyM[5] || '0')}`;
            }
            const parsed = typeof parsePeriodeDateTime === 'function' ? parsePeriodeDateTime(s, false) : null;
            if (parsed && !isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
              return `${parsed.getFullYear()}-${pad2(parsed.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(parsed.getDate())}T${pad2(parsed.getHours())}:${pad2(parsed.getMinutes())}`;
            }
            const fallback = s.replace(' ', 'T');
            return fallback.length >= 16 ? fallback.slice(0, 16) : fallback;
          };
          if (selectTa && item['Tahun Akademik']) selectTa.value = item['Tahun Akademik'];
          document.getElementById('periodeSemester').value = item.Semester || 'Ganjil';
          document.getElementById('periodeJenisLayanan').value = item['Jenis Layanan'] || 'UTS Susulan';
          document.getElementById('periodeKategoriKelas').value = item['Kategori Kelas'] || 'Reguler';
          document.getElementById('periodeTglMulai').value = toDatetimeLocal(item['Tanggal & Jam Mulai'] || item['Tanggal Mulai']);
          document.getElementById('periodeTglSelesai').value = toDatetimeLocal(item['Tanggal & Jam Selesai'] || item['Tanggal Selesai']);
          document.getElementById('periodeTglTerlambatMulai').value = toDatetimeLocal(item['Mulai Terlambat']);
          document.getElementById('periodeTglTerlambatSelesai').value = toDatetimeLocal(item['Selesai Terlambat']);
          document.getElementById('periodeBiaya').value = item['Biaya Keterlambatan'] !== undefined ? item['Biaya Keterlambatan'] : (item['Biaya'] || 50000);
          const st = String(item.Status || 'Aktif').toLowerCase() === 'non-aktif' ? 'Ditutup' : (item.Status || 'Aktif');
          document.getElementById('periodeStatus').value = st;
        }
      } else {
        // Default tanggal: hari ini s/d 7 hari ke depan (waktu lokal WIB, bukan UTC)
        const fmtLocalInput = dt => {
          const pad2 = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
          return `${dt.getFullYear()}-${pad2(dt.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(dt.getDate())}T${pad2(dt.getHours())}:${pad2(dt.getMinutes())}`;
        };
        const now = new Date();
        const startStr = fmtLocalInput(now);
        const end = new Date(now.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);
        const endStr = fmtLocalInput(end);
        document.getElementById('periodeTglMulai').value = startStr;
        document.getElementById('periodeTglSelesai').value = endStr;
        document.getElementById('periodeBiaya').value = 50000;
        document.getElementById('periodeStatus').value = 'Aktif';
      }

      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closePeriodeModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalPeriode');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
        modal.classList.remove('flex');
      }
    }

    function handleSavePeriode(e) {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      const editId = (document.getElementById('periodeId')?.value || '').trim();
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnSavePeriode');
      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Menyimpan...';
      }

      const payload = {
        id: editId,
        tahunAkademik: document.getElementById('periodeTahunAkademik').value,
        semester: document.getElementById('periodeSemester').value,
        jenisLayanan: document.getElementById('periodeJenisLayanan').value,
        kategoriKelas: document.getElementById('periodeKategoriKelas').value,
        tglMulai: document.getElementById('periodeTglMulai').value,
        tglSelesai: document.getElementById('periodeTglSelesai').value,
        tglTerlambatMulai: document.getElementById('periodeTglTerlambatMulai').value,
        tglTerlambatSelesai: document.getElementById('periodeTglTerlambatSelesai').value,
        biayaKeterlambatan: Number(document.getElementById('periodeBiaya').value) || 0,
        biaya: Number(document.getElementById('periodeBiaya').value) || 0,
        status: document.getElementById('periodeStatus').value,
        actor: getCurrentActorName(),
        role: getCurrentActorRole()
      };

      const isEdit = (editId && editId.indexOf('PRD-') === 0);

      // [OPTIMISTIC UI UPDATE]: Perbarui langsung di memori lokal agar tabel dan banner segera sinkron
      appData.master = appData.master || {};
      appData.master.periode = appData.master.periode || [];
      if (isEdit) {
        const pIndex = appData.master.periode.findIndex(p => String(p.ID || p.id).trim() === editId);
        const updatedObj = {
          ID: editId,
          id: editId,
          'Tahun Akademik': payload.tahunAkademik,
          Semester: payload.semester,
          'Jenis Layanan': payload.jenisLayanan,
          'Kategori Kelas': payload.kategoriKelas,
          'Tanggal & Jam Mulai': String(payload.tglMulai || '').replace('T', ' '),
          'Tanggal & Jam Selesai': String(payload.tglSelesai || '').replace('T', ' '),
          'Mulai Terlambat': String(payload.tglTerlambatMulai || '').replace('T', ' '),
          'Selesai Terlambat': String(payload.tglTerlambatSelesai || '').replace('T', ' '),
          'Biaya Keterlambatan': payload.biayaKeterlambatan,
          Biaya: payload.biaya,
          Status: payload.status
        };
        if (pIndex !== -1) {
          appData.master.periode[pIndex] = Object.assign({}, appData.master.periode[pIndex], updatedObj);
        } else {
          appData.master.periode.push(updatedObj);
        }
      } else {
        const newId = 'PRD-REG-' + String(appData.master.periode.length + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        payload.id = newId;
        appData.master.periode.unshift({
          ID: newId,
          id: newId,
          'Tahun Akademik': payload.tahunAkademik,
          Semester: payload.semester,
          'Jenis Layanan': payload.jenisLayanan,
          'Kategori Kelas': payload.kategoriKelas,
          'Tanggal & Jam Mulai': String(payload.tglMulai || '').replace('T', ' '),
          'Tanggal & Jam Selesai': String(payload.tglSelesai || '').replace('T', ' '),
          'Mulai Terlambat': String(payload.tglTerlambatMulai || '').replace('T', ' '),
          'Selesai Terlambat': String(payload.tglTerlambatSelesai || '').replace('T', ' '),
          'Biaya Keterlambatan': payload.biayaKeterlambatan,
          Biaya: payload.biaya,
          Status: payload.status
        });
      }
      saveAppDataCache(appData);
      renderPeriodeTable();
      if (typeof syncActivePeriodBanner === 'function') syncActivePeriodBanner();

      const fn = isEdit ? 'updatePeriode' : 'addPeriode';

      const onResult = res => {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = 'Simpan Periode';
        }
        if (res && res.success) {
          closePeriodeModal();
          Swal.fire('Berhasil', res.message || 'Periode pendaftaran berhasil disimpan!', 'success');
          loadAppData(true);
        } else {
          Swal.fire('Gagal', (res && res.message) || 'Gagal menyimpan periode.', 'error');
        }
      };

      const onError = err => {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = 'Simpan Periode';
        }
        closePeriodeModal();
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Tersimpan di Lokal',
          text: 'Data periode tersimpan di sistem lokal dan akan disinkronkan ke server.',
          confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
        });
        loadAppData(true);
      };

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(onResult)
          .withFailureHandler(onError)[fn](payload);
      } else {
        callGasApi(fn, [payload], onResult, onError);
      }
    }

    function deletePeriodeItem(id) {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Hapus Periode ' + id + '?',
        text: 'Data periode ini akan dihapus dari database website.',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Hapus',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          if (appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.periode)) {
            appData.master.periode = appData.master.periode.filter(p => String(p.ID || p.id).trim() !== String(id).trim());
            saveAppDataCache(appData);
            renderPeriodeTable();
            if (typeof syncActivePeriodBanner === 'function') syncActivePeriodBanner();
          }
          const onDelSuccess = res => {
            Swal.fire('Terhapus', res?.message || 'Periode berhasil dihapus.', 'success');
            loadAppData(true);
          };
          const onDelError = () => {
            Swal.fire('Terhapus', 'Periode dihapus dari memori lokal.', 'success');
          };
          const delActor = getCurrentActorName();
          const delRole = getCurrentActorRole();
          if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(onDelSuccess)
              .withFailureHandler(onDelError)
              .deletePeriode(id, delActor, delRole);
          } else {
            callGasApi('deletePeriode', [id, delActor, delRole], onDelSuccess, onDelError);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [MODUL TAHUN AKADEMIK]: CRUD LENGKAP & TERINTEGRASI
    // ==========================================
    function renderTahunAkademikTable() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('tableTahunAkademikBody');
      if (!tbody) return;
      const list = (appData.master && appData.master.tahunAkademik) || [
        { ID: 'TA-001', 'Tahun Akademik': '2026/2027', Semester: 'Ganjil', Status: 'Aktif', Keterangan: 'Tahun Akademik Berjalan' },
        { ID: 'TA-002', 'Tahun Akademik': '2025/2026', Semester: 'Genap', Status: 'Arsip', Keterangan: 'Arsip Tahun Lalu' },
        { ID: 'TA-003', 'Tahun Akademik': '2027/2028', Semester: 'Ganjil', Status: 'Mendatang', Keterangan: 'Periode Mendatang' }
      ];

      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      const canManage = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());

      list.forEach(t => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.className = 'hover:bg-slate-50 transition';
        const namaTa = t['Tahun Akademik'] || t.tahun || '';
        const idTa = t.ID || t.id || 'TA-001';
        const semTa = t.Semester || t.semester || 'Ganjil';
        const statusTa = t.Status || t.status || 'Aktif';
        const ketTa = t.Keterangan || t.keterangan || '-';

        const aksiHtml = canManage ? `
          <td class="p-3.5 text-center whitespace-nowrap space-x-2">
            <button onclick="openTahunAkademikModal('${idTa}')" class="text-blue-900 font-bold hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1">
              <i class="fas fa-edit"></i> Edit
            </button>
            <button onclick="deleteTahunAkademikItem('${idTa}')" class="text-rose-600 font-bold hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1">
              <i class="fas fa-trash"></i> Hapus
            </button>
          </td>
        ` : '<td class="p-3.5 text-center text-slate-400">-</td>';

        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td class="p-3.5 font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 whitespace-nowrap">${idTa}</td>
          <td class="p-3.5 font-bold text-slate-800 whitespace-nowrap">${namaTa}</td>
          <td class="p-3.5 whitespace-nowrap">
            <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold ${semTa.toLowerCase() === 'ganjil' ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border border-amber-200' : 'bg-cyan-50 text-cyan-900 border border-cyan-200'}">
              <i class="fas ${semTa.toLowerCase() === 'ganjil' ? 'fa-sun text-amber-600' : 'fa-moon text-cyan-600'} text-[10px]"></i>
              ${semTa}
            </span>
          </td>
          <td class="p-3.5 whitespace-nowrap">
            <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold ${statusTa.toLowerCase() === 'aktif' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200'}">
              <i class="fas fa-circle text-[7px] ${statusTa.toLowerCase() === 'aktif' ? 'text-emerald-500 animate-pulse' : 'text-slate-400'}"></i>
              ${statusTa}
            </span>
          </td>
          <td class="p-3.5 text-slate-600 text-xs">${ketTa}</td>
          ${aksiHtml}
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });

      // Sinkronkan ke dropdown filter executive & pendaftaran
      syncTahunAkademikDropdowns(list);
    }

    function syncTahunAkademikDropdowns(explicitList = null) {
      const execSelect = document.getElementById('execFilterTahun');
      const periodeList = (appData.master && appData.master.periode) || appData.periode || [];
      const taMap = new Map();

      // Ekstraksi Tahun Akademik HANYA dari Jadwal Periode
      periodeList.forEach(per => {
        let rawTA = String(per['Tahun Akademik'] || per.tahunAkademik || per.Tahun || '').trim();
        let m = rawTA.match(/(\d{4}\s*\/\s*\d{4})/);
        let taClean = m ? m[1].replace(/\s+/g, '') : rawTA.replace(/ (Ganjil|Genap)/i, '').trim();
        if (taClean) {
          const isAktif = String(per.Status || per.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'aktif';
          if (!taMap.has(taClean) || isAktif) {
            taMap.set(taClean, {
              tahun: taClean,
              status: per.Status || 'Aktif'
            });
          }
        }
      });

      // Jika jadwal periode belum ada, gunakan 2026/2027 sebagai default aktif
      if (taMap.size === 0) {
        taMap.set('2026/2027', { tahun: '2026/2027', status: 'Aktif' });
      }

      if (execSelect) {
        const curVal = execSelect.value;
        const taArray = Array.from(taMap.values());
        execSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">Semua Tahun Akademik</option>' +
          taArray.map(t => `<option value="${t.tahun}" ${t.tahun === curVal ? 'selected' : ''}>TA ${t.tahun} (${t.status})</option>`).join('');
      }

      const pendaftarTa = document.getElementById('pendaftaranTahunAkademik');
      if (pendaftarTa) {
        const activeTa = Array.from(taMap.keys())[0] || '2026/2027';
        pendaftarTa.value = activeTa;
      }
    }

    function openTahunAkademikModal(id = null) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalTahunAkademik');
      const form = document.getElementById('formTahunAkademik');
      if (form) form.reset();

      const realId = (id && typeof id === 'string' && id.trim() !== '') ? id.trim() : (id ? String(id).trim() : '');
      document.getElementById('tahunAkademikId').value = realId;
      document.getElementById('modalTahunAkademikTitle').innerText = realId ? (`Edit Tahun Akademik (${realId})`) : 'Tambah Tahun Akademik Baru';

      if (realId) {
        const list = (appData.master && appData.master.tahunAkademik) || [];
        const item = list.find(t => String(t.ID || t.id).trim() === realId);
        if (item) {
          document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikNama').value = item['Tahun Akademik'] || item.tahun || '';
          const semVal = item.Semester || item.semester || 'Ganjil';
          const semEl = document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikSemester');
          if (semEl) semEl.value = semVal;
          document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikStatus').value = item.Status || item.status || 'Aktif';
          document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikKeterangan').value = item.Keterangan || item.keterangan || '';
        }
      } else {
        const semEl = document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikSemester');
        if (semEl) semEl.value = 'Ganjil';
      }

      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closeTahunAkademikModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalTahunAkademik');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
        modal.classList.remove('flex');
      }
    }

    function handleSaveTahunAkademik(e) {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      const editId = (document.getElementById('tahunAkademikId')?.value || '').trim();
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnSaveTahunAkademik');
      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Menyimpan...';
      }

      const payload = {
        id: editId,
        tahun: document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikNama').value.trim(),
        semester: document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikSemester') ? document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikSemester').value : 'Ganjil',
        status: document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikStatus').value,
        keterangan: document.getElementById('inputTahunAkademikKeterangan').value.trim(),
        actor: getCurrentActorName(),
        role: getCurrentActorRole()
      };

      const isEdit = Boolean(editId && editId.length > 0);
      if (isEdit && appData.master && appData.master.tahunAkademik) {
        const item = appData.master.tahunAkademik.find(t => String(t.ID || t.id).trim() === editId);
        if (item) {
          item['Tahun Akademik'] = payload.tahun;
          item.Semester = payload.semester;
          item.Status = payload.status;
          item.Keterangan = payload.keterangan;
        }
      }

      const onResult = res => {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = 'Simpan Tahun Akademik';
        }
        if (res && res.success) {
          closeTahunAkademikModal();
          Swal.fire('Berhasil', res.message || 'Tahun akademik berhasil disimpan!', 'success');
          loadAppData();
        } else {
          Swal.fire('Gagal', (res && res.message) || 'Gagal menyimpan tahun akademik.', 'error');
        }
      };

      const onError = err => {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = 'Simpan Tahun Akademik';
        }
        Swal.fire('Error Sistem', err.message || String(err), 'error');
      };

      const fnTa = isEdit ? 'updateTahunAkademik' : 'addTahunAkademik';
      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(onResult)
          .withFailureHandler(onError)[fnTa](payload);
      } else {
        callGasApi(fnTa, [payload], onResult, onError);
      }
    }

    function deleteTahunAkademikItem(id) {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Hapus Tahun Akademik ' + id + '?',
        text: 'Data ini akan dihapus dari database website.',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Hapus',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          const delActor = getCurrentActorName();
          const delRole = getCurrentActorRole();
          const onDelSuccess = res => {
            Swal.fire('Terhapus', (res && res.message) || 'Tahun akademik berhasil dihapus.', 'success');
            loadAppData();
          };
          const onDelError = err => {
            Swal.fire('Error', err?.message || String(err), 'error');
          };
          if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(onDelSuccess)
              .withFailureHandler(onDelError)
              .deleteTahunAkademik(id, delActor, delRole);
          } else {
            callGasApi('deleteTahunAkademik', [id, delActor, delRole], onDelSuccess, onDelError);
          }
        }
      });
    }
