    function handleInjectMockups() {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Suntik 10 Data Mockup?',
        text: 'Sistem akan memasukkan 10 data sampel mahasiswa FEB UIKA (UTS Susulan, UAS Susulan, & Remedial Teaching lengkap dengan multi-matkul dan riwayat nilai D, CD, C, BC).',
        icon: 'question',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Suntik 10 Data',
        confirmButtonColor: '#7e22ce'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          Swal.fire({
            title: 'Memproses Injeksi 10 Data Mockup...',
            allowOutsideClick: false,
            didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading()
          });

          const mockups = getTenMockupDataItems();

          const seedActor = getCurrentActorName(null, 'Master Admin');
          const seedRole = getCurrentActorRole('Master Admin');
          // Cek apakah Google Apps Script runtime tersedia
          const isGas = typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy && typeof google.script.run.seedMockupData === 'function';

          if (isGas) {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(res => {
                closeAiDiagnosticsModal();
                Swal.fire('Berhasil Disuntik', res.message || '10 Data Mockup berhasil masuk ke database spreadsheet!', 'success');
                loadAppData();
              })
              .withFailureHandler(err => {
                // Fallback client-side jika koneksi GAS offline
                injectMockupDataClientSide(mockups);
              })
              .seedMockupData(seedActor, seedRole);
          } else {
            // Mode Client / Hostinger / Standalone
            injectMockupDataClientSide(mockups);
            const apiUrl = typeof getGasApiUrl === 'function' ? getGasApiUrl() : (localStorage.getItem('SIP_GAS_API_URL') || DEFAULT_GAS_API_URL);
            if (apiUrl) {
              fetch(apiUrl, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'seedMockupData', args: [seedActor, seedRole] })
              }).catch(e => console.warn('Sync to GAS API failed:', e));
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function injectMockupDataClientSide(mockups) {
      if (!appData.pendaftaran) appData.pendaftaran = [];
      const testIds = new Set(['REG-1001', 'REG-1002', 'REG-1003', 'REG-1004', 'REG-1005', 'REG-1006', 'REG-1007', 'REG-1008', 'REG-1009', 'REG-1010']);
      // Hapus data uji lama dulu agar tidak ada duplikasi
      appData.pendaftaran = appData.pendaftaran.filter(p => !testIds.has(String(p.ID || p.id)));
      mockups.forEach(m => {
        appData.pendaftaran.push(m);
      });
      closeAiDiagnosticsModal();
      Swal.fire('Berhasil Disuntik', `10 Data Mockup sampel berhasil disuntikkan secara lengkap dan sinkron (UTS Susulan, UAS Susulan, & Remedial Teaching)!`, 'success');
      renderPendaftaranTable();
      renderExecutiveDashboard();
    }

    function handleClearTestData() {
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Bersihkan Data Uji?',
        text: 'Data sampel pengujian (REG-1001 s.d. REG-1010) akan dibersihkan dari database website.',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Bersihkan',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          const clrActor = getCurrentActorName(null, 'Master Admin');
          const clrRole = getCurrentActorRole('Master Admin');
          const isGas = typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy && typeof google.script.run.clearAITestData === 'function';

          if (isGas) {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(res => {
                closeAiDiagnosticsModal();
                Swal.fire('Bersih', res.message || 'Data uji berhasil dibersihkan dari database spreadsheet.', 'success');
                loadAppData();
              })
              .withFailureHandler(() => {
                clearTestDataClientSide();
              })
              .clearAITestData(clrActor, clrRole);
          } else {
            clearTestDataClientSide();
            const apiUrl = typeof getGasApiUrl === 'function' ? getGasApiUrl() : (localStorage.getItem('SIP_GAS_API_URL') || DEFAULT_GAS_API_URL);
            if (apiUrl) {
              fetch(apiUrl, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'clearAITestData', args: [clrActor, clrRole] })
              }).catch(e => console.warn('Clear on GAS API failed:', e));
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function clearTestDataClientSide() {
      if (appData.pendaftaran) {
        const testIds = new Set(['REG-1001', 'REG-1002', 'REG-1003', 'REG-1004', 'REG-1005', 'REG-1006', 'REG-1007', 'REG-1008', 'REG-1009', 'REG-1010']);
        appData.pendaftaran = appData.pendaftaran.filter(p => !testIds.has(String(p.ID || p.id)));
      }
      closeAiDiagnosticsModal();
      Swal.fire('Bersih', 'Data sampel pengujian berhasil dibersihkan dari memori.', 'success');
      renderPendaftaranTable();
      renderExecutiveDashboard();
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [DASHBOARD EXECUTIVE]: KALKULASI PRESISI & SINKRON
    // Sinkron 100% dengan Spreadsheet, Invoice, dan Kwitansi
    // ==========================================
    let currentTrendMode = 'hari';
    let execTrendChartInstance = null;

    // ==========================================
    // [DASHBOARD EXECUTIVE]: KALKULASI PRESISI, GRAFIK & SINKRON
    // Sinkron 100% dengan Spreadsheet, Invoice, dan Kwitansi
    // ==========================================
    function renderExecutiveDashboard() {
      syncTahunAkademikDropdowns();
      const pendaftaran = appData.pendaftaran || [];
      const filterTahun = document.getElementById('execFilterTahun')?.value || '';
      const filterSemester = document.getElementById('execFilterSemester')?.value || '';
      const filterLayanan = document.getElementById('execFilterLayanan')?.value || '';
      const filterProdi = document.getElementById('execFilterProdi')?.value || '';

      let filtered = pendaftaran;
      if (filterTahun) filtered = filtered.filter(p => String(p['Tahun Akademik'] || '').trim() === filterTahun.trim());
      if (filterSemester) filtered = filtered.filter(p => String(p.Semester || '').toLowerCase().includes(filterSemester.toLowerCase()));
      if (filterLayanan) filtered = filtered.filter(p => String(p['Jenis Layanan'] || '').toLowerCase() === filterLayanan.toLowerCase());
      if (filterProdi) filtered = filtered.filter(p => (p['Kode Prodi'] || '').toUpperCase() === filterProdi.toUpperCase());

      const total = filtered.length;
      const approved = filtered.filter(p => String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').toLowerCase() === 'disetujui').length;
      const pending = filtered.filter(p => String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').toLowerCase() === 'pending').length;
      const rejected = filtered.filter(p => String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').toLowerCase() === 'ditolak').length;

      // Presisi sinkron kalkulasi retribusi: sum of Nominal
      const totalRetribusi = filtered.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (Number(p.Nominal) || 0), 0);
      const totalLunas = filtered.filter(p => String(p['Status Pembayaran'] || '').toLowerCase() === 'lunas').reduce((acc, p) => acc + (Number(p.Nominal) || 0), 0);

      const approvalRate = total > 0 ? Math.round((approved / total) * 100) : 0;
      const pendingRate = total > 0 ? Math.round((pending / total) * 100) : 0;
      const rejectedRate = total > 0 ? Math.round((rejected / total) * 100) : 0;

      if (document.getElementById('statTotalPengajuan')) document.getElementById('statTotalPengajuan').innerText = total;
      if (document.getElementById('statApprovalRate')) document.getElementById('statApprovalRate').innerText = approvalRate + '%';
      if (document.getElementById('statDisetujuiCount')) document.getElementById('statDisetujuiCount').innerText = approved + ' disetujui dari ' + total;
      if (document.getElementById('statPendingCount')) document.getElementById('statPendingCount').innerText = pending;
      
      const cardRet = document.getElementById('cardTotalRetribusi');
      if (cardRet) cardRet.classList.toggle('hidden', !isInvoiceAllowed());
      if (document.getElementById('statTotalNominal')) {
        document.getElementById('statTotalNominal').innerText = 'Rp ' + totalRetribusi.toLocaleString('id-ID');
      }
      if (document.getElementById('statNominalLunas')) {
        document.getElementById('statNominalLunas').innerText = 'Lunas: Rp ' + totalLunas.toLocaleString('id-ID');
      }

      // Update Rasio Persetujuan Status Bar
      if (document.getElementById('barPctDisetujuiText')) {
        document.getElementById('barPctDisetujuiText').innerText = approvalRate + '% (' + approved + ')';
      }
      if (document.getElementById('barPctDisetujui')) {
        document.getElementById('barPctDisetujui').style.width = approvalRate + '%';
      }

      if (document.getElementById('barPctPendingText')) {
        document.getElementById('barPctPendingText').innerText = pendingRate + '% (' + pending + ')';
      }
      if (document.getElementById('barPctPending')) {
        document.getElementById('barPctPending').style.width = pendingRate + '%';
      }

      if (document.getElementById('barPctDitolakText')) {
        document.getElementById('barPctDitolakText').innerText = rejectedRate + '% (' + rejected + ')';
      }
      if (document.getElementById('barPctDitolak')) {
        document.getElementById('barPctDitolak').style.width = rejectedRate + '%';
      }

      // Render Grafik Tren Interaktif
      renderExecTrendChart(filtered, currentTrendMode);

      // Breakdown & Rekapitulasi per Prodi
      const prodiMap = {};
      (appData.master?.prodi || []).forEach(pr => {
        prodiMap[pr['Kode Prodi']] = { kode: pr['Kode Prodi'], nama: pr['Nama Prodi'], count: 0, approved: 0, pending: 0, rejected: 0, nominal: 0 };
      });

      filtered.forEach(p => {
        const k = (p['Kode Prodi'] || 'LAIN').toUpperCase();
        if (!prodiMap[k]) prodiMap[k] = { kode: k, nama: p['Program Studi'] || k, count: 0, approved: 0, pending: 0, rejected: 0, nominal: 0 };
        prodiMap[k].count++;
        prodiMap[k].nominal += (Number(p.Nominal) || 0);
        const st = String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').toLowerCase();
        if (st === 'disetujui') prodiMap[k].approved++;
        else if (st === 'ditolak') prodiMap[k].rejected++;
        else prodiMap[k].pending++;
      });

      const prodiList = Object.values(prodiMap);

      // 1. Kartu Distribusi Visual
      const prodiBreakdown = document.getElementById('execProdiBreakdownContainer');
      if (prodiBreakdown) {
        prodiBreakdown.innerHTML = prodiList.map(pr => {
          const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((pr.count / total) * 100) : 0;
          return `
            <div class="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl space-y-1.5 hover:shadow-xs transition">
              <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                <span class="font-bold text-slate-800">[${pr.kode}] ${pr.nama}</span>
                <span class="font-mono font-bold text-blue-900">${pr.count} Mhs (${pct}%)</span>
              </div>
              <div class="w-full bg-slate-200 h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                <div class="bg-blue-600 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" style="width: ${pct}%"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                <span>Retribusi Terkumpul:</span>
                <span class="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700">Rp ${pr.nominal.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
        }).join('');
      }

      // 2. Tabel Rekapitulasi Per Program Studi
      const tableBody = document.getElementById('execProdiTableBody');
      if (tableBody) {
        if (prodiList.length === 0) {
          tableBody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-400 italic">Belum ada data pendaftaran</td></tr>`;
        } else {
          tableBody.innerHTML = prodiList.map(pr => {
            const ratio = pr.count > 0 ? Math.round((pr.approved / pr.count) * 100) : 0;
            return `
              <tr class="hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition border-b border-slate-100 last:border-b-0">
                <td class="p-2.5 font-mono font-bold text-blue-900">${pr.kode}</td>
                <td class="p-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-800">${pr.nama}</td>
                <td class="p-2.5 text-center font-bold text-slate-900">${pr.count}</td>
                <td class="p-2.5 text-center font-semibold text-emerald-600">${pr.approved}</td>
                <td class="p-2.5 text-center font-semibold text-amber-600">${pr.pending}</td>
                <td class="p-2.5 text-center font-semibold text-rose-600">${pr.rejected}</td>
                <td class="p-2.5 text-center">
                  <span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                    ratio >= 80 ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800' :
                    ratio >= 50 ? 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800' :
                    'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                  }">
                    ${ratio}%
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            `;
          }).join('');
        }
      }
    }

    function setExecTrendMode(m) {
      currentTrendMode = m;
      ['Hari', 'Bulan', 'Semester'].forEach(mode => {
        const btn = document.getElementById('btnTrend' + mode);
        if (!btn) return;
        if (mode.toLowerCase() === m.toLowerCase()) {
          btn.className = 'btn-exec-trend px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md font-bold bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm transition';
        } else {
          btn.className = 'btn-exec-trend px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md font-bold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 transition';
        }
      });
      renderExecutiveDashboard();
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [GRAFIK TREN PENDAFTARAN & RETRIBUSI]
    // Mendukung Chart.js Canvas & Fallback SVG Dinamis
    // ==========================================
    function extractTahunSemesterKey(p) {
      if (!p) return '2026/2027 Ganjil';
      // Pembersihan spasi ganda dan karakter kosong
      const rawTA = String(p['Tahun Akademik'] || p.TahunAkademik || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      const rawSem = String(p.Semester || p['Semester/Kelas'] || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

      // Ekstraksi format tahun akademik (misal: 2025/2026, 2026/2027)
      let taMatch = rawTA.match(/(\d{4}\s*\/\s*\d{4})/);
      let tahunAkademik = '';
      if (taMatch) {
        tahunAkademik = taMatch[1].replace(/\s+/g, '');
      } else {
        const tgl = String(p.Tanggal || p['Tanggal Pengajuan'] || '').trim();
        const yr = tgl.match(/(\d{4})/);
        if (yr) {
          const y = parseInt(yr[1], 10);
          tahunAkademik = `${y}/${y + 1}`;
        } else {
          tahunAkademik = '2026/2027';
        }
      }

      // Tentukan Semester Ganjil vs Genap
      let semName = '';
      const combined = (rawTA + ' ' + rawSem).toLowerCase();
      if (combined.includes('genap')) {
        semName = 'Genap';
      } else if (combined.includes('ganjil')) {
        semName = 'Ganjil';
      } else {
        const semDigitMatch = rawSem.match(/(\d+)/);
        if (semDigitMatch) {
          const num = parseInt(semDigitMatch[1], 10);
          semName = (num % 2 === 0) ? 'Genap' : 'Ganjil';
        } else {
          semName = 'Ganjil';
        }
      }

      return `${tahunAkademik} ${semName}`;
    }

    function renderExecTrendChart(dataList, mode) {
      const container = document.getElementById('execTrendChartContainer');
      const summaryContainer = document.getElementById('execTrendSemesterSummary');
      if (!container) return;

      // 1. Data Cleaning: abaikan record kosong
      const cleanDataList = (dataList || []).filter(p => {
        if (!p) return false;
        const id = String(p.ID || '').trim();
        const nama = String(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.NPM || p.NIM || '').trim();
        return id !== '' || nama !== '';
      });

      // Siapkan Agregasi Data Berdasarkan Mode
      let labels = [];
      let totalData = [];
      let approvedData = [];
      let pendingData = [];
      let retribusiData = [];

      if (mode === 'hari') {
        const dateMap = {};
        cleanDataList.forEach(p => {
          const raw = String(p['Tanggal'] || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
          const d = raw ? raw.substring(0, 10) : '2026-10-15';
          if (!dateMap[d]) dateMap[d] = { total: 0, approved: 0, pending: 0, retribusi: 0 };
          dateMap[d].total++;
          dateMap[d].retribusi += (Number(p.Nominal || 0) || 0);
          const st = String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').toLowerCase();
          if (st === 'disetujui') dateMap[d].approved++;
          else dateMap[d].pending++;
        });

        const defaultDates = ['2026-10-12', '2026-10-13', '2026-10-14', '2026-10-15', '2026-10-16', '2026-10-17', '2026-10-18'];
        defaultDates.forEach(d => {
          if (!dateMap[d]) dateMap[d] = { total: 0, approved: 0, pending: 0, retribusi: 0 };
        });

        const sortedKeys = Object.keys(dateMap).sort();
        sortedKeys.forEach(k => {
          const parts = k.split('-');
          const label = parts.length === 3 ? `${parts[2]}/${parts[1]}` : k;
          labels.push(label);
          totalData.push(dateMap[k].total);
          approvedData.push(dateMap[k].approved);
          pendingData.push(dateMap[k].pending);
          retribusiData.push(dateMap[k].retribusi);
        });
      } else if (mode === 'bulan') {
        const monthNames = ['Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des', 'Jan'];
        const monthMap = {};
        monthNames.forEach(m => { monthMap[m] = { total: 0, approved: 0, pending: 0, retribusi: 0 }; });

        cleanDataList.forEach(p => {
          const raw = String(p['Tanggal'] || '').trim();
          let mKey = 'Okt';
          if (raw.includes('-08-')) mKey = 'Agu';
          else if (raw.includes('-09-')) mKey = 'Sep';
          else if (raw.includes('-10-')) mKey = 'Okt';
          else if (raw.includes('-11-')) mKey = 'Nov';
          else if (raw.includes('-12-')) mKey = 'Des';
          else if (raw.includes('-01-')) mKey = 'Jan';

          monthMap[mKey].total++;
          monthMap[mKey].retribusi += (Number(p.Nominal || 0) || 0);
          const st = String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').toLowerCase();
          if (st === 'disetujui') monthMap[mKey].approved++;
          else monthMap[mKey].pending++;
        });

        monthNames.forEach(m => {
          labels.push(m);
          totalData.push(monthMap[m].total);
          approvedData.push(monthMap[m].approved);
          pendingData.push(monthMap[m].pending);
          retribusiData.push(monthMap[m].retribusi);
        });
      } else {
        // [GRAFIK TREN PENDAFTARAN - MODE SEMESTER]
        // HANYA menampilkan Tahun Akademik & Semester yang terdaftar di Jadwal Periode
        const semMap = {};

        // 1. Ambil daftar semester valid HANYA dari Jadwal Periode (Periode Pendaftaran)
        const periodeList = (appData.master && appData.master.periode) || appData.periode || [];
        const periodeSemesters = [];

        periodeList.forEach(per => {
          let rawTA = String(per['Tahun Akademik'] || per.tahunAkademik || per.Tahun || '').trim();
          let rawSem = String(per.Semester || per['Semester/Kelas'] || per['Nama Periode'] || '').trim();
          
          let m = rawTA.match(/(\d{4}\s*\/\s*\d{4})/);
          let taClean = m ? m[1].replace(/\s+/g, '') : rawTA.replace(/ (Ganjil|Genap)/i, '').trim();
          
          let semName = 'Ganjil';
          const combined = (rawTA + ' ' + rawSem).toLowerCase();
          if (combined.includes('genap')) semName = 'Genap';
          else if (combined.includes('ganjil')) semName = 'Ganjil';

          if (taClean) {
            const key = `${taClean} ${semName}`;
            if (!periodeSemesters.includes(key)) {
              periodeSemesters.push(key);
            }
          }
        });

        // Fallback aman: jika belum ada periode di spreadsheet, gunakan semester aktif berjalan
        if (periodeSemesters.length === 0) {
          periodeSemesters.push('2026/2027 Ganjil');
        }

        // Inisialisasi wadah agregasi HANYA untuk semester yang ada di Jadwal Periode
        periodeSemesters.forEach(s => {
          semMap[s] = { label: s, total: 0, approved: 0, pending: 0, retribusi: 0 };
        });

        // Agregasikan pendaftaran HANYA jika masuk ke dalam semester yang ada di Jadwal Periode
        cleanDataList.forEach(p => {
          const key = extractTahunSemesterKey(p);
          if (semMap[key]) {
            semMap[key].total++;
            semMap[key].retribusi += (Number(p.Nominal || 0) || 0);

            const st = String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            if (st === 'disetujui') {
              semMap[key].approved++;
            } else {
              semMap[key].pending++;
            }
          }
        });

        // Urutkan semester secara kronologis
        const sortedSemKeys = periodeSemesters.sort((a, b) => {
          const parseOrder = (str) => {
            const yr = str.match(/(\d{4})/);
            const y = yr ? parseInt(yr[1], 10) : 0;
            const isGenap = str.toLowerCase().includes('genap') ? 1 : 0;
            return y * 10 + isGenap;
          };
          return parseOrder(a) - parseOrder(b);
        });

        sortedSemKeys.forEach(k => {
          labels.push(k);
          totalData.push(semMap[k].total);
          approvedData.push(semMap[k].approved);
          pendingData.push(semMap[k].pending);
          retribusiData.push(semMap[k].retribusi);
        });
      }

      // Render Ringkasan Card / Badge Per Semester di Bawah Chart
      if (summaryContainer) {
        if (mode === 'semester') {
          summaryContainer.classList.remove('hidden');
          summaryContainer.innerHTML = `
            <div class="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl space-y-2">
              <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <i class="fas fa-chart-pie text-blue-900"></i> Ringkasan Akurat Tren Per Semester
                </span>
                <span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-semibold font-mono">Agregasi Data Mentah Memori</span>
              </div>
              <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
                ${labels.map((lbl, idx) => `
                  <div class="p-2.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 shadow-2xs space-y-1">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span class="font-bold text-blue-950 text-xs">${lbl}</span>
                      <span class="text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-50 text-blue-900 border border-blue-200">${totalData[idx]} Pendaftar</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                      <span class="text-emerald-700 font-semibold">✔ Disetujui: <b>${approvedData[idx]}</b></span>
                      <span class="text-amber-700 font-semibold">⏳ Pending: <b>${pendingData[idx]}</b></span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">
                      <span class="text-slate-500 font-medium">Total Retribusi:</span>
                      <span class="font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700">Rp ${Number(retribusiData[idx] || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                `).join('')}
              </div>
            </div>
          `;
        } else {
          summaryContainer.classList.add('hidden');
          summaryContainer.innerHTML = '';
        }
      }

      // 1. Menggunakan Chart.js jika tersedia
      if (typeof Chart !== 'undefined') {
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="w-full h-full relative">
            <canvas id="execTrendChartCanvas" class="w-full h-full"></canvas>
          </div>
        `;
        const canvas = document.getElementById('execTrendChartCanvas');
        if (canvas) {
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          if (execTrendChartInstance) {
            try { execTrendChartInstance.destroy(); } catch (e) {}
          }

          // Gradient fills
          const gradTotal = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 240);
          gradTotal.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28)');
          gradTotal.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.01)');

          const gradApproved = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 240);
          gradApproved.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.24)');
          gradApproved.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.01)');

          execTrendChartInstance = new Chart(ctx, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
              labels: labels,
              datasets: [
                {
                  label: 'Total Pengajuan',
                  data: totalData,
                  borderColor: '#2563eb',
                  backgroundColor: gradTotal,
                  fill: true,
                  tension: 0.38,
                  borderWidth: 2.5,
                  pointBackgroundColor: '#2563eb',
                  pointBorderColor: '#ffffff',
                  pointBorderWidth: 2,
                  pointRadius: 4.5,
                  pointHoverRadius: 6.5
                },
                {
                  label: 'Disetujui / Terverifikasi',
                  data: approvedData,
                  borderColor: '#059669',
                  backgroundColor: gradApproved,
                  fill: true,
                  tension: 0.38,
                  borderWidth: 2,
                  pointBackgroundColor: '#059669',
                  pointBorderColor: '#ffffff',
                  pointBorderWidth: 2,
                  pointRadius: 4,
                  pointHoverRadius: 6
                },
                {
                  label: 'Pending / Menunggu',
                  data: pendingData,
                  borderColor: '#d97706',
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.05)',
                  fill: false,
                  borderDash: [4, 4],
                  tension: 0.38,
                  borderWidth: 2,
                  pointBackgroundColor: '#d97706',
                  pointBorderColor: '#ffffff',
                  pointBorderWidth: 2,
                  pointRadius: 3.5,
                  pointHoverRadius: 5.5
                }
              ]
            },
            options: {
              responsive: true,
              maintainAspectRatio: false,
              interaction: {
                mode: 'index',
                intersect: false
              },
              plugins: {
                legend: {
                  position: 'top',
                  align: 'end',
                  labels: {
                    boxWidth: 12,
                    boxHeight: 12,
                    usePointStyle: true,
                    font: { size: 11, weight: 'bold' }
                  }
                },
                tooltip: {
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95)',
                  titleFont: { size: 12, weight: 'bold' },
                  bodyFont: { size: 11 },
                  padding: 10,
                  cornerRadius: 10,
                  callbacks: {
                    afterBody: function(tooltipItems) {
                      const idx = tooltipItems[0]?.dataIndex;
                      if (mode === 'semester' && idx !== undefined && retribusiData[idx] !== undefined) {
                        return 'Total Retribusi: Rp ' + Number(retribusiData[idx]).toLocaleString('id-ID');
                      }
                      return '';
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              scales: {
                y: {
                  beginAtZero: true,
                  ticks: {
                    precision: 0,
                    font: { size: 10 }
                  },
                  grid: {
                    color: '#f1f5f9'
                  }
                },
                x: {
                  ticks: {
                    font: { size: 10, weight: 'bold' }
                  },
                  grid: {
                    display: false
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          });
          return;
        }
      }

      // 2. Fallback SVG Chart Interaktif
      const maxVal = Math.max(1, ...totalData);
      const svgHeight = 220;
      const svgWidth = 600;
      const padL = 40;
      const padR = 20;
      const padT = 20;
      const padB = 35;
      const plotW = svgWidth - padL - padR;
      const plotH = svgHeight - padT - padB;

      const getX = (idx) => padL + (idx / Math.max(1, labels.length - 1)) * plotW;
      const getY = (val) => padT + plotH - (val / maxVal) * plotH;

      const totalPoints = totalData.map((v, i) => `${getX(i)},${getY(v)}`).join(' ');
      const approvedPoints = approvedData.map((v, i) => `${getX(i)},${getY(v)}`).join(' ');

      const totalArea = `${getX(0)},${padT + plotH} ` + totalPoints + ` ${getX(totalData.length - 1)},${padT + plotH}`;

      let svgHtml = `
        <div class="w-full h-full flex flex-col justify-between">
          <div class="flex justify-end gap-3 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">
            <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-blue-600 inline-block"></span> Total</span>
            <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 inline-block"></span> Disetujui</span>
            <span class="flex items-center gap-1.5"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-500 inline-block"></span> Pending</span>
          </div>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 ${svgWidth} ${svgHeight}" class="w-full h-56 overflow-visible">
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id="gasChartGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2563eb" stop-opacity="0.25"/>
                <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2563eb" stop-opacity="0.0"/>
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            <line x1="${padL}" y1="${padT}" x2="${padL + plotW}" y2="${padT}" stroke="#f1f5f9" stroke-width="1"/>
            <line x1="${padL}" y1="${padT + plotH / 2}" x2="${padL + plotW}" y2="${padT + plotH / 2}" stroke="#f1f5f9" stroke-width="1"/>
            <line x1="${padL}" y1="${padT + plotH}" x2="${padL + plotW}" y2="${padT + plotH}" stroke="#e2e8f0" stroke-width="1.5"/>

            <text x="${padL - 8}" y="${padT + 4}" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="end">${maxVal}</text>
            <text x="${padL - 8}" y="${padT + plotH / 2 + 3}" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="end">${Math.round(maxVal / 2)}</text>
            <text x="${padL - 8}" y="${padT + plotH + 3}" font-size="9" font-weight="bold" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="end">0</text>

            <polygon points="${totalArea}" fill="url(#gasChartGrad)"/>
            <polyline points="${totalPoints}" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            <polyline points="${approvedPoints}" fill="none" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

            ${totalData.map((v, i) => `
              <circle cx="${getX(i)}" cy="${getY(v)}" r="4" fill="#2563eb" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"/>
              <circle cx="${getX(i)}" cy="${getY(approvedData[i])}" r="3" fill="#059669" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <text x="${getX(i)}" y="${padT + plotH + 18}" font-size="10" font-weight="bold" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">${labels[i]}</text>
            `).join('')}
          </svg>
        </div>
      `;
      container.innerHTML = svgHtml;
    }
  </script>

  <script>
    // ==========================================
    // [RIWAYAT PENDAFTARAN MODERN]: KPI DINAMIS, TOOLBAR PINTAR, STICKY HEADER, INFINITE SCROLL & EDIT INLINE
    // ==========================================
    const PENDAFTARAN_BATCH_SIZE = 25;
    const pendaftaranToolbarState = {
      search: '',
      prodi: '',
      layanan: '',
      status: '',
      sort: 'tanggal-desc',
      visibleCount: PENDAFTARAN_BATCH_SIZE
    };
    let pendaftaranFilteredCache = [];
    let pendaftaranInfiniteObserver = null;

    function changePendaftaranPageSize() {
      handlePendaftaranToolbarChange(true);
    }

    function getPendaftaranApprovalSelectStyle(status) {
      const lower = String(status || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (lower === 'disetujui') {
        return 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-100/70';
      }
      if (lower === 'ditolak') {
        return 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-100/70';
      }
      return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-100/70';
    }

    function getPendaftaranApprovalBadgeStyle(status) {
      const lower = String(status || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (lower === 'disetujui') {
        return 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300';
      }
      if (lower === 'ditolak') {
        return 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-300';
      }
      return 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-300';
    }

    function readPendaftaranToolbarControls() {
      const elSearch = document.getElementById('searchPendaftaran');
      const elProdi = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranProdi') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterProdi');
      const elLayanan = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranLayanan') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterLayanan');
      const elStatus = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranStatus') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterStatus');
      const elSort = document.getElementById('sortPendaftaran');

      if (elSearch) pendaftaranToolbarState.search = String(elSearch.value || '').trim();
      if (elProdi) pendaftaranToolbarState.prodi = String(elProdi.value || '').trim();
      if (elLayanan) pendaftaranToolbarState.layanan = String(elLayanan.value || '').trim();
      if (elStatus) pendaftaranToolbarState.status = String(elStatus.value || '').trim();
      if (elSort) pendaftaranToolbarState.sort = String(elSort.value || 'tanggal-desc').trim() || 'tanggal-desc';
    }

    function syncPendaftaranSearchClearButton() {
      const input = document.getElementById('searchPendaftaran');
      const clearBtn = document.getElementById('btnClearSearchPendaftaran');
      if (!clearBtn) return;
      const hasValue = Boolean(input && String(input.value || '').trim().length > 0);
      clearBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasValue);
    }

    function syncPendaftaranToolbarVisualControls() {
      syncPendaftaranSearchClearButton();

      const isDirty = Boolean(
        pendaftaranToolbarState.search ||
        pendaftaranToolbarState.prodi ||
        pendaftaranToolbarState.layanan ||
        pendaftaranToolbarState.status ||
        (pendaftaranToolbarState.sort && pendaftaranToolbarState.sort !== 'tanggal-desc')
      );
      const btnReset = document.getElementById('btnResetPendaftaranToolbar');
      if (btnReset) {
        btnReset.classList.toggle('hidden', !isDirty);
        btnReset.classList.toggle('inline-flex', isDirty);
      }

      const elStatusFilter = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranStatus') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterStatus');
      if (elStatusFilter) {
        const baseFilterClasses = 'w-full sm:col-span-2 lg:col-span-1 lg:w-auto min-w-0 border rounded-xl px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 cursor-pointer transition';
        if (pendaftaranToolbarState.status) {
          elStatusFilter.className = `${baseFilterClasses} ${getPendaftaranApprovalSelectStyle(pendaftaranToolbarState.status)}`;
        } else {
          elStatusFilter.className = `${baseFilterClasses} border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-700`;
        }
      }

      const s = pendaftaranToolbarState.sort;
      const setIcon = (id, ascKey, descKey) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el) return;
        if (s === ascKey) {
          el.className = 'fas fa-sort-up text-[10px] text-blue-900';
        } else if (s === descKey) {
          el.className = 'fas fa-sort-down text-[10px] text-blue-900';
        } else {
          el.className = 'fas fa-sort text-[10px] text-slate-400';
        }
      };
      setIcon('sortIconPenId', 'id-asc', 'id-desc');
      setIcon('sortIconPenTanggal', 'tanggal-asc', 'tanggal-desc');
      setIcon('sortIconPenNama', 'nama-asc', 'nama-desc');
      setIcon('sortIconPenNominal', 'nominal-asc', 'nominal-desc');
    }

    function handlePendaftaranSearchInput() {
      handlePendaftaranToolbarChange(true);
    }

    function clearPendaftaranSearch() {
      const input = document.getElementById('searchPendaftaran');
      if (input) {
        input.value = '';
        input.focus();
      }
      handlePendaftaranToolbarChange(true);
    }

    function resetAllPendaftaranFilters() {
      const input = document.getElementById('searchPendaftaran');
      if (input) input.value = '';
      const selProdi = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranProdi') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterProdi');
      if (selProdi) selProdi.value = '';
      const selLayanan = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranLayanan') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterLayanan');
      if (selLayanan) selLayanan.value = '';
      const selStatus = document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranStatus') || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterStatus');
      if (selStatus) selStatus.value = '';
      const selSort = document.getElementById('sortPendaftaran');
      if (selSort) selSort.value = 'tanggal-desc';

      pendaftaranToolbarState.search = '';
      pendaftaranToolbarState.prodi = '';
      pendaftaranToolbarState.layanan = '';
      pendaftaranToolbarState.status = '';
      pendaftaranToolbarState.sort = 'tanggal-desc';
      pendaftaranToolbarState.visibleCount = PENDAFTARAN_BATCH_SIZE;

      renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: false });
    }

    function buildPendaftaranSearchHaystack(p) {
      if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') return '';
      const parts = [
        p.ID, p.id,
        p.NPM, p.NIM, p.npm, p.nim,
        p['Nama Mahasiswa'], p.namaMahasiswa, p.nama,
        p.Username, p.username,
        p['Mata Kuliah'], p.mataKuliah,
        p['Dosen Pengampu'], p.dosenPengampu, p.Dosen, p.dosen,
        p['Dosen Lalu'], p.dosenLalu,
        p['Kode Prodi'], p.kodeProdi,
        p['Program Studi'], p.programStudi, p.prodi,
        p.Kelas, p.kelas,
        p['Kategori Kelas'], p.kategoriKelas,
        p.Semester, p.semester,
        p['Jenis Layanan'], p.jenisLayanan,
        p['Status Persetujuan'],
        p['Status Pembayaran'],
        p.Tanggal
      ];

      if (Array.isArray(p.mataKuliahList)) {
        p.mataKuliahList.forEach(item => {
          if (item && typeof item === 'object') {
            parts.push(item.nama, item.mataKuliah, item.kode, item.dosen, item.dosenPengampu, item.dosenLalu);
          } else if (item !== undefined && item !== null) {
            parts.push(item);
          }
        });
      }

      return parts
        .filter(v => v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim() !== '')
        .map(v => String(v).toLowerCase())
        .join(' ');
    }

    function matchesPendaftaranSearch(p, rawQuery) {
      const cleanQuery = String(rawQuery ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!cleanQuery) return true;
      const tokens = cleanQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      if (tokens.length === 0) return true;
      const haystack = buildPendaftaranSearchHaystack(p);
      return tokens.every(token => haystack.includes(token));
    }

    function getPendaftaranRoleScopedList() {
      const pendaftaran = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      if (!isMhs) return pendaftaran.slice();

      const myNpm = String(currentUser.npm || currentUser.username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const myName = String(currentUser.nama || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const myUser = String(currentUser.username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      return pendaftaran.filter(p => {
        const pNpm = String(p.NPM || p.NIM || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const pName = String(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.nama || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const pUser = String(p.Username || p.username || '').trim().toLowerCase();

        const npmMatch = myNpm && pNpm && (pNpm === myNpm || pNpm.includes(myNpm) || myNpm.includes(pNpm));
        const nameMatch = myName && pName && (pName === myName || pName.includes(myName) || myName.includes(pName));
        const userMatch = myUser && (pNpm === myUser || pUser === myUser || pName.includes(myUser));

        return Boolean(npmMatch || nameMatch || userMatch);
      });
    }

    function getFilteredPendaftaranList(scopedInput) {
      readPendaftaranToolbarControls();
      let list = Array.isArray(scopedInput) ? scopedInput.slice() : getPendaftaranRoleScopedList();

      if (pendaftaranToolbarState.prodi) {
        const targetProdi = pendaftaranToolbarState.prodi.toUpperCase();
        list = list.filter(p => {
          const code = typeof resolveInvoiceProdiCode === 'function'
            ? resolveInvoiceProdiCode(p)
            : String(p['Kode Prodi'] || p.kodeProdi || '').trim().toUpperCase();
          return code === targetProdi;
        });
      }
      if (pendaftaranToolbarState.status) {
        const targetStatus = pendaftaranToolbarState.status.toLowerCase();
        list = list.filter(p => String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending').trim().toLowerCase() === targetStatus);
      }
      if (pendaftaranToolbarState.layanan) {
        const targetLayanan = (typeof normalizeJenisLayananName === 'function'
          ? normalizeJenisLayananName(pendaftaranToolbarState.layanan)
          : pendaftaranToolbarState.layanan
        ).toLowerCase();
        list = list.filter(p => {
          const rawLyn = p['Jenis Layanan'] || p.Layanan || '';
          const normLyn = (typeof normalizeJenisLayananName === 'function'
            ? normalizeJenisLayananName(rawLyn)
            : String(rawLyn)
          ).trim().toLowerCase();
          return normLyn === targetLayanan;
        });
      }
      if (pendaftaranToolbarState.search) {
        list = list.filter(p => matchesPendaftaranSearch(p, pendaftaranToolbarState.search));
      }

      const sortKey = pendaftaranToolbarState.sort || 'tanggal-desc';
      list.sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortKey === 'tanggal-desc' || sortKey === 'tanggal-asc') {
          const diff = (typeof parseInvoiceDateMs === 'function' ? parseInvoiceDateMs(a.Tanggal) - parseInvoiceDateMs(b.Tanggal) : 0);
          if (diff !== 0) return sortKey === 'tanggal-desc' ? -diff : diff;
          const idDiff = (typeof extractNumericIdTail === 'function' ? extractNumericIdTail(a.ID) - extractNumericIdTail(b.ID) : 0);
          return sortKey === 'tanggal-desc' ? -idDiff : idDiff;
        }
        if (sortKey === 'nominal-desc' || sortKey === 'nominal-asc') {
          const diff = (Number(a.Nominal) || 0) - (Number(b.Nominal) || 0);
          return sortKey === 'nominal-desc' ? -diff : diff;
        }
        if (sortKey === 'nama-asc' || sortKey === 'nama-desc') {
          const cmp = String(a['Nama Mahasiswa'] || a.Nama || '').localeCompare(String(b['Nama Mahasiswa'] || b.Nama || ''), 'id');
          return sortKey === 'nama-asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
        }
        if (sortKey === 'id-asc' || sortKey === 'id-desc') {
          const cmp = String(a.ID || '').localeCompare(String(b.ID || ''), 'id', { numeric: true });
          return sortKey === 'id-asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
        }
        return 0;
      });

      return list;
    }

    function updatePendaftaranSummaryCards(filteredList) {
      const list = Array.isArray(filteredList) ? filteredList : [];
      const elTotal = document.getElementById('pendaftaranTotalCount');
      const elSetuju = document.getElementById('pendaftaranDisetujuiCount');
      const elPending = document.getElementById('pendaftaranPendingCount');
      const elTolak = document.getElementById('pendaftaranDitolakCount');

      if (elTotal) elTotal.innerText = list.length;
      if (elSetuju) elSetuju.innerText = list.filter(p => String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'disetujui').length;
      if (elPending) elPending.innerText = list.filter(p => String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending').trim().toLowerCase() === 'pending').length;
      if (elTolak) elTolak.innerText = list.filter(p => String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'ditolak').length;
    }

    function buildPendaftaranTableRow(p, roleFlags) {
      const { isMhs, isDekanOrWadek, isPimpinan, canManageFull } = roleFlags;
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.className = 'hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition align-top';

      const idRaw = String(p.ID || '').trim();
      const idAttr = escapeHtml(idRaw).replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
      const statusApp = String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending').trim() || 'Pending';
      const nominal = Number(p.Nominal || 0);
      const statusBayar = normalizePaymentStatusLabel(p['Status Pembayaran'], nominal);
      const bayarBadgeClass = typeof getInvoicePaymentBadgeStyle === 'function'
        ? getInvoicePaymentBadgeStyle(statusBayar)
        : (statusBayar.toLowerCase() === 'lunas' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300' : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border-rose-300');
      const kodeProdi = String(p['Kode Prodi'] || (typeof resolveInvoiceProdiCode === 'function' ? resolveInvoiceProdiCode(p) : '') || '-').trim() || '-';
      const namaProdi = String(p['Program Studi'] || '-').trim() || '-';
      const layananStr = String(p['Jenis Layanan'] || p.Layanan || '-').trim() || '-';

      const buktiFotoHtml = p['Bukti Foto'] ? `
        <button type="button" onclick="showBuktiPreviewModal('${escapeHtml(p['Bukti Foto']).replace(/'/g, '&#39;')}')" class="text-blue-700 hover:text-blue-900 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-[10px] mt-1 cursor-pointer">
          <i class="fas fa-image text-[9px]" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span>Bukti Foto</span>
        </button>
      ` : '<span class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 italic block mt-0.5">Tanpa bukti</span>';

      // Status Persetujuan cell: Inline Select untuk Master Admin & Admin TU, Badge statis untuk role lain
      const standardAppStatuses = ['Pending', 'Disetujui', 'Ditolak'];
      const hasAppMatch = standardAppStatuses.some(opt => opt.toLowerCase() === statusApp.toLowerCase());
      const appOptionsHtml = [
        ...(hasAppMatch ? [] : [statusApp]),
        ...standardAppStatuses
      ].map(opt => {
        const isSelected = opt.toLowerCase() === statusApp.toLowerCase();
        const optCls = getPendaftaranApprovalBadgeStyle(opt);
        return `<option value="${escapeHtml(opt)}" class="${optCls} font-semibold" ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(opt)}</option>`;
      }).join('');

      const statusAppHtml = canManageFull
        ? `<select aria-label="Status Persetujuan ${escapeHtml(idRaw)}" data-pendaftaran-id="${escapeHtml(idRaw)}" onchange="handleInlinePendaftaranStatusChange('${idAttr}', this.value, this)" class="w-full max-w-[116px] text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg px-1.5 py-1.5 border cursor-pointer focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 transition truncate ${getPendaftaranApprovalSelectStyle(statusApp)}">${appOptionsHtml}</select>`
        : `<span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] uppercase font-bold border break-words ${getPendaftaranApprovalBadgeStyle(statusApp)}">${escapeHtml(statusApp)}</span>`;

      let aksiButtons = '';
      if (canManageFull) {
        aksiButtons = `
          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 max-w-[110px] mx-auto">
            <button type="button" onclick="openSettingPembayaranModal('${idAttr}')" title="Setting Status Pembayaran" class="bg-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-800 text-white px-1.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-money-bill-transfer text-[9px]"></i><span class="hidden lg:inline">Bayar</span></button>
            <button type="button" onclick="openPendaftaranModal('${idAttr}')" title="Edit Data Pendaftaran" class="bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white px-1.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-edit text-[9px]"></i><span class="hidden lg:inline">Edit</span></button>
            <button type="button" onclick="renderKartuUjianDigital('${idAttr}'); switchTab('kartu');" title="Kartu Ujian Digital" class="bg-teal-700 hover:bg-teal-800 text-white px-1.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-id-card text-[9px]"></i><span class="hidden lg:inline">Kartu</span></button>
            <button type="button" onclick="openSuratDosenFromPendaftaran('${idAttr}')" title="Surat Pengantar Dosen &amp; Daftar Hadir" class="bg-sky-700 hover:bg-sky-800 text-white px-1.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-envelope-open-text text-[9px]"></i><span class="hidden lg:inline">Surat</span></button>
            <button type="button" onclick="openInvoiceModal('${idAttr}')" title="Cetak Kwitansi" class="bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white px-1.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 shadow-xs transition cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-receipt text-[9px]"></i><span class="hidden lg:inline">Kwit.</span></button>
            <button type="button" onclick="handleDeletePendaftaran('${idAttr}')" title="Hapus Berkas" class="bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 px-1.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold border border-rose-200 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 transition cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-trash text-[9px]"></i><span class="hidden lg:inline">Hapus</span></button>
          </div>
        `;
      } else if (isDekanOrWadek) {
        aksiButtons = `
          <div class="flex flex-col gap-1 items-stretch max-w-[82px] mx-auto">
            <button type="button" onclick="openInvoiceModal('${idAttr}')" class="bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-xs cursor-pointer">
              <i class="fas fa-receipt text-[9px]"></i> <span>Kwitansi</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        `;
      } else if (isPimpinan) {
        aksiButtons = `<span class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold">Pemantauan</span>`;
      } else if (isMhs) {
        aksiButtons = statusApp.toLowerCase() === 'disetujui'
          ? `<button type="button" onclick="renderKartuUjianDigital('${idAttr}'); switchTab('kartu');" class="bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-950 text-white px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-xs cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-print text-[9px]"></i> <span>Kartu</span></button>`
          : `<span class="text-[10px] text-amber-700 italic leading-tight block">Verifikasi TU</span>`;
      }

      const isApproved = statusApp.toLowerCase() === 'disetujui';
      const checkboxAttr = isApproved
        ? 'disabled style="opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed;" title="Berkas telah disetujui (tidak dapat dipilih massal)"'
        : 'class="pendaftaran-row-cb rounded text-blue-900 cursor-pointer"';

      const checkboxTd = canManageFull ? `
        <td class="px-1.5 py-2.5 text-center">
          <input type="checkbox" ${isApproved ? 'class="pendaftaran-row-cb rounded text-blue-900"' : ''} value="${escapeHtml(idRaw)}" ${checkboxAttr} onchange="updatePendaftaranSelectionUI()">
        </td>
      ` : '';

      let matkulTdContent = '';
      if (Array.isArray(p.mataKuliahList) && p.mataKuliahList.length > 0) {
        matkulTdContent = p.mataKuliahList.map((m, idx) => {
          const num = p.mataKuliahList.length > 1 ? `<span class="text-slate-400 font-mono text-[10px] mr-1">${idx + 1}.</span>` : '';
          const nilaiBadge = m.nilaiHuruf ? `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 ml-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-900 border border-indigo-200">Nilai ${escapeHtml(m.nilaiHuruf)}</span>` : '';
          const dosenLaluInfo = m.dosenLalu ? `<div class="text-[10px] text-indigo-700 italic mt-0.5 break-words">Dosen Lalu: ${escapeHtml(m.dosenLalu)}</div>` : '';
          return `
            <div class="${idx > 0 ? 'pt-1 mt-1 border-t border-slate-100' : ''}">
              <div class="font-bold text-blue-950 leading-snug text-[11px] break-words">
                ${num}${escapeHtml(m.nama || m.mataKuliah || '')}${nilaiBadge}
              </div>
              <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 leading-snug mt-0.5 break-words">
                <i class="fas fa-user-tie text-[9px] text-slate-400 mr-1" aria-hidden="true"></i>${escapeHtml(m.dosen || m.dosenPengampu || '-')}
              </div>
              ${dosenLaluInfo}
            </div>
          `;
        }).join('');
      } else {
        matkulTdContent = `
          <div class="space-y-0.5">
            <div class="font-bold text-blue-950 leading-snug text-[11px] break-words">
              ${escapeHtml(p['Mata Kuliah'] || '-').replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}
            </div>
            <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 leading-snug break-words">
              ${escapeHtml(p['Dosen Pengampu'] || '-').replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      tr.innerHTML = `
        ${checkboxTd}
        <td class="px-2 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <div class="font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 text-[11px] leading-snug break-all tabular-nums">${escapeHtml(idRaw)}</div>
          <div class="font-mono text-slate-400 text-[10px] leading-snug tabular-nums mt-0.5">${escapeHtml(p.Tanggal || '-')}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="px-2 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <b class="text-slate-800 block text-xs leading-snug break-words">${escapeHtml(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.nama || '-')}</b>
          <div class="font-mono text-slate-500 text-[10px] leading-snug tabular-nums mt-0.5 break-all">${escapeHtml(p.NPM || p.NIM || '-')}</div>
          <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-600 leading-snug mt-0.5 break-words">
            <span class="font-bold">[${escapeHtml(kodeProdi)}]</span> <span class="hidden xl:inline">${escapeHtml(namaProdi)} · </span>${escapeHtml(p.Semester || 'Sem 3')} · ${escapeHtml(p.Kelas || 'Reguler')}
          </div>
          <div class="sm:hidden text-[10px] font-semibold text-blue-900 leading-snug mt-0.5 truncate">${escapeHtml(layananStr)}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="hidden sm:table-cell px-2 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <div class="inline-block text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-900 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200/80 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 mb-1">${escapeHtml(layananStr)}</div>
          ${matkulTdContent}
        </td>
        <td class="hidden lg:table-cell px-2 py-2.5 text-right min-w-0">
          <div class="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 text-[11px] tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">Rp ${nominal.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</div>
          <span class="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[9.5px] font-bold border mt-1 max-w-full truncate ${bayarBadgeClass}" title="${escapeHtml(statusBayar)}">${escapeHtml(statusBayar)}</span>
          <div class="flex justify-end">${buktiFotoHtml}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="px-2 py-2.5 text-center min-w-0">
          <div class="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
            ${statusAppHtml}
            <span class="lg:hidden inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-bold border max-w-full truncate ${bayarBadgeClass}">${escapeHtml(statusBayar)}</span>
            <div class="lg:hidden">${buktiFotoHtml}</div>
          </div>
        </td>
        <td class="px-1.5 py-2.5 text-center">${aksiButtons}</td>
      `;
