    }

    function updatePendaftaranSentinelAndCounts(renderedCount, totalFilteredCount, totalScopedCount) {
      const countEl = document.getElementById('pendaftaranToolbarCountInfo');
      if (countEl) {
        if (totalFilteredCount === 0) {
          countEl.innerText = `Menampilkan 0 dari ${totalScopedCount} berkas`;
        } else {
          const suffix = totalFilteredCount !== totalScopedCount ? ` (tersaring dari ${totalScopedCount} total)` : '';
          countEl.innerText = `Menampilkan ${renderedCount} dari ${totalFilteredCount} berkas${suffix}`;
        }
      }

      const sentinel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranInfiniteSentinel');
      if (!sentinel) return;

      if (totalFilteredCount === 0) {
        sentinel.classList.add('hidden');
        sentinel.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }

      sentinel.classList.remove('hidden');
      const remaining = totalFilteredCount - renderedCount;
      if (remaining > 0) {
        sentinel.innerHTML = `
          <span class="text-slate-500">Menampilkan <b class="text-slate-700 tabular-nums">${renderedCount}</b> dari <b class="text-slate-700 tabular-nums">${totalFilteredCount}</b> berkas · Gulir ke bawah untuk memuat berikutnya</span>
          <button type="button" onclick="loadMorePendaftaranRows()" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-blue-900 font-bold text-[11px] transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">Muat +${Math.min(PENDAFTARAN_BATCH_SIZE, remaining)}</button>
        `;
      } else {
        sentinel.innerHTML = `<span class="text-slate-400">Seluruh <b class="text-slate-600 tabular-nums">${totalFilteredCount}</b> berkas telah ditampilkan</span>`;
      }
    }

    function setupPendaftaranInfiniteScroll() {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('pendaftaranTableScrollWrap');
      const sentinel = document.getElementById('pendaftaranInfiniteSentinel');
      if (!wrap || !sentinel || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;

      if (pendaftaranInfiniteObserver) {
        pendaftaranInfiniteObserver.disconnect();
      }
      pendaftaranInfiniteObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        if (entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting)) {
          loadMorePendaftaranRows();
        }
      }, {
        root: wrap,
        rootMargin: '120px'
      });
      pendaftaranInfiniteObserver.observe(sentinel);
    }

    function handlePendaftaranScrollCheck() {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('pendaftaranTableScrollWrap');
      if (!wrap) return;
      const distanceFromBottom = wrap.scrollHeight - wrap.scrollTop - wrap.clientHeight;
      if (distanceFromBottom <= 120) {
        loadMorePendaftaranRows();
      }
    }

    function loadMorePendaftaranRows() {
      const total = pendaftaranFilteredCache.length;
      if (pendaftaranToolbarState.visibleCount >= total) return;

      const tbody = document.getElementById('tablePendaftaranBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      const roleFlags = {
        isMhs: currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa',
        isDekanOrWadek: currentUser && ['dekan', 'wakil dekan', 'wadek'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase()),
        isPimpinan: currentUser && ['dekan', 'wakil dekan', 'wadek', 'ketua program studi', 'kaprodi', 'sekretaris program studi', 'sekprodi'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase()),
        canManageFull: currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase())
      };

      const startIdx = pendaftaranToolbarState.visibleCount;
      const nextCount = Math.min(total, startIdx + PENDAFTARAN_BATCH_SIZE);
      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = startIdx; i < nextCount; i++) {
        frag.appendChild(buildPendaftaranTableRow(pendaftaranFilteredCache[i], roleFlags));
      }
      tbody.appendChild(frag);
      pendaftaranToolbarState.visibleCount = nextCount;
      updatePendaftaranSentinelAndCounts(nextCount, total, getPendaftaranRoleScopedList().length);
      updatePendaftaranSelectionUI();
    }

    function handlePendaftaranToolbarChange(resetScroll = true) {
      readPendaftaranToolbarControls();
      pendaftaranToolbarState.visibleCount = PENDAFTARAN_BATCH_SIZE;
      renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: !resetScroll });
    }

    function togglePendaftaranColumnSort(col) {
      readPendaftaranToolbarControls();
      const curr = pendaftaranToolbarState.sort;
      let next = 'tanggal-desc';
      if (col === 'tanggal') next = curr === 'tanggal-desc' ? 'tanggal-asc' : 'tanggal-desc';
      else if (col === 'nominal') next = curr === 'nominal-desc' ? 'nominal-asc' : 'nominal-desc';
      else if (col === 'nama') next = curr === 'nama-asc' ? 'nama-desc' : 'nama-asc';
      else if (col === 'id') next = curr === 'id-asc' ? 'id-desc' : 'id-asc';

      const elSort = document.getElementById('sortPendaftaran');
      if (elSort) {
        if (next === 'id-desc' && !elSort.querySelector('option[value="id-desc"]')) {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = 'id-desc';
          opt.text = 'No. Berkas Z–A';
          elSort.appendChild(opt);
        }
        elSort.value = next;
      }
      pendaftaranToolbarState.sort = next;
      handlePendaftaranToolbarChange(true);
    }

    function handleInlinePendaftaranStatusChange(id, newStatus, selectEl) {
      const canManageFull = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
      if (!canManageFull) {
        if (selectEl) {
          const existing = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID).trim() === String(id).trim());
          if (existing) selectEl.value = existing['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending';
        }
        Swal.fire('Akses Ditolak', 'Hanya Master Admin atau Admin TU yang dapat mengubah status persetujuan.', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      const item = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID).trim() === String(id).trim());
      if (!item) return;

      const prevStatus = String(item['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending').trim() || 'Pending';
      if (prevStatus.toLowerCase() === String(newStatus || '').trim().toLowerCase()) return;

      const baseSelectClasses = 'w-full max-w-[116px] text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg px-1.5 py-1.5 border cursor-pointer focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 transition truncate';
      item['Status Persetujuan'] = newStatus;
      if (selectEl) {
        selectEl.disabled = true;
        selectEl.className = `${baseSelectClasses} opacity-75 cursor-wait ${getPendaftaranApprovalSelectStyle(newStatus)}`;
      }
      if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
      updatePendaftaranSummaryCards(getFilteredPendaftaranList());
      if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();

      const actorName = typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function' ? getCurrentActorName() : '';
      const actorRole = typeof getCurrentActorRole === 'function' ? getCurrentActorRole() : '';

      const rollbackInlineApproval = (errMsg) => {
        item['Status Persetujuan'] = prevStatus;
        if (selectEl) {
          selectEl.value = prevStatus;
          selectEl.disabled = false;
          selectEl.className = `${baseSelectClasses} ${getPendaftaranApprovalSelectStyle(prevStatus)}`;
        }
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        updatePendaftaranSummaryCards(getFilteredPendaftaranList());
        if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
        Swal.fire('Gagal Memperbarui Status', errMsg || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat menyimpan status persetujuan ke server.', 'error');
      };

      const onComplete = (res) => {
        if (res && res.success === false) {
          rollbackInlineApproval(res.message);
          return;
        }
        if (selectEl) {
          selectEl.disabled = false;
          selectEl.className = `${baseSelectClasses} ${getPendaftaranApprovalSelectStyle(newStatus)}`;
        }
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        updatePendaftaranSummaryCards(getFilteredPendaftaranList());
        if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
        if (typeof renderKartuUjianDigital === 'function') renderKartuUjianDigital();
        if (pendaftaranToolbarState.status) {
          renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: true });
        } else {
          // Sinkronkan status checkbox smart-approval baris tanpa reset scroll
          renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: true });
        }
        Swal.fire({
          toast: true,
          position: 'top-end',
          icon: 'success',
          title: `${id} diperbarui: ${newStatus}`,
          showConfirmButton: false,
          timer: 1800,
          timerProgressBar: true
        });
      };

      const onError = (err) => {
        rollbackInlineApproval((err && err.message) || String(err || 'Koneksi ke server gagal.'));
      };

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(onComplete)
          .withFailureHandler(onError)
          .updateStatusApproval(id, newStatus, actorName, actorRole);
      } else if (typeof callGasApi === 'function') {
        callGasApi('updateStatusApproval', [id, newStatus, actorName, actorRole], onComplete, onError);
      } else {
        onComplete({ success: true });
      }
    }

    function renderPendaftaranTable(opts = {}) {
      if (typeof syncActivePeriodBanner === 'function') syncActivePeriodBanner();
      const tbody = document.getElementById('tablePendaftaranBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      const wrap = document.getElementById('pendaftaranTableScrollWrap');
      const prevScrollTop = (opts && opts.preserveScroll && wrap) ? wrap.scrollTop : 0;

      const roleFlags = {
        isMhs: currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa',
        isDekanOrWadek: currentUser && ['dekan', 'wakil dekan', 'wadek'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase()),
        isPimpinan: currentUser && ['dekan', 'wakil dekan', 'wadek', 'ketua program studi', 'kaprodi', 'sekretaris program studi', 'sekprodi'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase()),
        canManageFull: currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase())
      };

      // RBAC Ketat Kolom Checkbox: Hanya untuk Master Admin & Admin TU
      const thSelectAll = document.getElementById('thSelectAll');
      if (thSelectAll) {
        thSelectAll.style.display = roleFlags.canManageFull ? '' : 'none';
      }
      const selectAllCb = document.getElementById('selectAllCb');
      if (selectAllCb) {
        selectAllCb.checked = false;
        selectAllCb.indeterminate = false;
      }
      updatePendaftaranSelectionUI();

      const scopedList = getPendaftaranRoleScopedList();
      const list = getFilteredPendaftaranList(scopedList);
      pendaftaranFilteredCache = list;

      syncPendaftaranToolbarVisualControls();
      updatePendaftaranSummaryCards(list);

      const hasActiveFilter = Boolean(
        pendaftaranToolbarState.search ||
        pendaftaranToolbarState.prodi ||
        pendaftaranToolbarState.layanan ||
        pendaftaranToolbarState.status
      );

      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      if (list.length === 0) {
        updatePendaftaranSentinelAndCounts(0, 0, scopedList.length);
        const colCount = roleFlags.canManageFull ? 7 : 6;
        const resetActionHtml = hasActiveFilter
          ? `<div class="mt-2"><button type="button" onclick="resetAllPendaftaranFilters()" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-rotate-left text-[11px]"></i><span>Reset Filter</span></button></div>`
          : '';
        tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="${colCount}" class="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 font-medium"><div>${scopedList.length === 0 ? 'Belum ada berkas pendaftaran yang tercatat.' : 'Tidak ada berkas pendaftaran yang cocok dengan pencarian atau filter.'}</div>${resetActionHtml}</td></tr>`;
        return;
      }

      const targetVisible = Math.min(
        list.length,
        Math.max(PENDAFTARAN_BATCH_SIZE, pendaftaranToolbarState.visibleCount || PENDAFTARAN_BATCH_SIZE)
      );
      pendaftaranToolbarState.visibleCount = targetVisible;

      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < targetVisible; i++) {
        frag.appendChild(buildPendaftaranTableRow(list[i], roleFlags));
      }
      tbody.appendChild(frag);
      updatePendaftaranSentinelAndCounts(targetVisible, list.length, scopedList.length);
      setupPendaftaranInfiniteScroll();
      updatePendaftaranSelectionUI();

      if (wrap) {
        wrap.scrollTop = opts && opts.preserveScroll ? prevScrollTop : 0;
      }
      syncSampahPendaftaranBadge();
      if (typeof syncPendaftaranDuplicateBanner === 'function') syncPendaftaranDuplicateBanner();
    }

    function syncPendaftaranDuplicateBanner() {
      const banner = document.getElementById('pendaftaranDuplicateIdBanner');
      const listEl = document.getElementById('pendaftaranDuplicateIdListText');
      if (!banner) return;
      const info = typeof findDuplicatePendaftaranIdsClient === 'function'
        ? findDuplicatePendaftaranIdsClient()
        : { affectedCount: 0, duplicateIds: [] };
      const roleLower = currentUser ? String(currentUser.role || '').trim().toLowerCase() : '';
      const canRepair = ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin'].includes(roleLower);
      const shouldShow = canRepair && info.affectedCount > 0;
      banner.classList.toggle('hidden', !shouldShow);
      if (shouldShow && listEl) {
        listEl.innerText = `${info.affectedCount} baris duplikat: ${info.duplicateIds.join(', ')}`;
      }
    }

    function repairDuplicatePendaftaranIdsAction() {
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnRepairDuplicatePendaftaranIds');
      const origHtml = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';
      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-1"></i> Memperbaiki...';
      }
      const actor = typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function' ? getCurrentActorName('', 'Admin') : 'Admin';
      const role = typeof getCurrentActorRole === 'function' ? getCurrentActorRole('Admin TU') : 'Admin TU';

      const handleDone = (res) => {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = origHtml || 'Perbaiki ID Duplikat';
        }
        if (res && res.success) {
          if (typeof repairDuplicatePendaftaranIdsLocal === 'function' && res.isLocalFallback) {
            // already fixed locally
          } else {
            repairDuplicatePendaftaranIdsLocal(actor, role);
          }
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
          renderPendaftaranTable();
          if (typeof loadAppData === 'function') loadAppData(true);
          Swal.fire({
            icon: 'success',
            title: 'ID Duplikat Diperbaiki',
            text: res.message || 'Seluruh ID pendaftaran kini sudah unik.',
            confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
          });
        } else {
          const errMsg = String((res && res.message) || 'Gagal memperbaiki ID pendaftaran duplikat.');
          const safeErrMsg = errMsg.replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
          if (/fungsi tidak ditemukan/i.test(errMsg)) {
            Swal.fire({
              icon: 'warning',
              title: 'Deployment GAS Perlu Diperbarui',
              html: `<div class="text-left text-sm text-slate-700 space-y-2">
                <p>Server GAS saat ini masih menjalankan versi deployment lama (<code>${safeErrMsg}</code>).</p>
                <p>Buka editor <strong>Google Apps Script</strong>, tempel <code>Code.gs</code> terbaru, lalu klik <strong>Terapkan → Kelola deployment → Edit → Versi baru → Terapkan</strong>.</p>
              </div>`,
              confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
            });
          } else {
            Swal.fire('Gagal', errMsg, 'error');
          }
        }
      };

      const handleFail = () => {
        const localRes = repairDuplicatePendaftaranIdsLocal(actor, role);
        handleDone(Object.assign({}, localRes, { isLocalFallback: true }));
      };

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google?.__isProxy && typeof google.script.run.repairDuplicatePendaftaranIds === 'function') {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(handleDone)
          .withFailureHandler(handleFail)
          .repairDuplicatePendaftaranIds(actor, role);
      } else {
        callGasApi('repairDuplicatePendaftaranIds', [actor, role], (res) => {
          if (res && res.isLocalFallback) {
            handleDone(Object.assign({}, repairDuplicatePendaftaranIdsLocal(actor, role), { isLocalFallback: true }));
          } else {
            handleDone(res);
          }
        }, handleFail);
      }
    }

    function canManagePendaftaranTrash() {
      const r = currentUser ? String(currentUser.role || '').trim().toLowerCase() : '';
      return ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu', 'admin'].includes(r);
    }

    function canPermanentDeletePendaftaranTrash() {
      const r = currentUser ? String(currentUser.role || '').trim().toLowerCase() : '';
      return ['master admin', 'master_admin'].includes(r);
    }

    function syncSampahPendaftaranBadge() {
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnTongSampahPendaftaran');
      const badge = document.getElementById('sampahPendaftaranBadgeCount');
      const allowed = canManagePendaftaranTrash();
      const count = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran)) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran.length : 0;
      if (btn) {
        btn.classList.toggle('hidden', !allowed);
        btn.classList.toggle('inline-flex', allowed);
      }
      if (badge) {
        badge.innerText = count;
        badge.className = count > 0
          ? 'px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-600 text-white text-[10px] font-mono tabular-nums'
          : 'px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-700 text-white text-[10px] font-mono tabular-nums';
      }
    }

    function handleSingleApproval(id, status) {
      const actorName = getCurrentActorName();
      const actorRole = getCurrentActorRole();
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(res => {
          Swal.fire('Berhasil', res.message, 'success');
          loadAppData();
        })
        .updateStatusApproval(id, status, actorName, actorRole);
    }

    function handleDeletePendaftaran(id) {
      if (!canManagePendaftaranTrash()) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Ditolak', 'Hanya Master Admin atau Admin TU yang dapat memindahkan berkas ke Tong Sampah.', 'warning');
        return;
      }
      Swal.fire({
        title: `Pindahkan ${id} ke Tong Sampah?`,
        text: 'Berkas akan dipindahkan ke Tong Sampah Pendaftaran dan masih dapat dipulihkan kapan saja.',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Pindah ke Sampah',
        confirmButtonColor: '#d97706',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal'
      }).then(r => {
        if (!r.isConfirmed) return;
        const actorName = typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function' ? getCurrentActorName() : '';
        const actorRole = typeof getCurrentActorRole === 'function' ? getCurrentActorRole() : '';
        appData.pendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
        appData.sampahPendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];

        const prevIdx = appData.pendaftaran.findIndex(p => String(p.ID || p.id).trim() === String(id).trim());
        const removedSnapshot = prevIdx !== -1 ? Object.assign({}, appData.pendaftaran[prevIdx]) : null;
        let optimisticTrashed = null;

        if (prevIdx !== -1 && removedSnapshot) {
          optimisticTrashed = Object.assign({}, removedSnapshot, {
            'Deleted At': new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace('T', ' '),
            'Deleted By': actorName || 'Admin TU',
            'Deleted Role': actorRole || 'Admin TU'
          });
          appData.pendaftaran.splice(prevIdx, 1);
          appData.sampahPendaftaran.unshift(optimisticTrashed);
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
          if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: true });
          if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
          if (typeof renderInvoiceTable === 'function') renderInvoiceTable({ preserveScroll: true });
        }

        const rollbackSoftDelete = (errMsg) => {
          if (optimisticTrashed) {
            appData.sampahPendaftaran = appData.sampahPendaftaran.filter(s => s !== optimisticTrashed);
          }
          if (removedSnapshot) {
            const restoreIdx = Math.min(prevIdx, appData.pendaftaran.length);
            appData.pendaftaran.splice(restoreIdx, 0, removedSnapshot);
          }
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
          if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: true });
          if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
          if (typeof renderInvoiceTable === 'function') renderInvoiceTable({ preserveScroll: true });
          Swal.fire('Gagal Menghapus', errMsg || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat memindahkan berkas ke Tong Sampah.', 'error');
        };

        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(res => {
            if (res && res.success === false) {
              rollbackSoftDelete(res.message);
              return;
            }
            if (res && res.trashedItem && optimisticTrashed) {
              const tIdx = appData.sampahPendaftaran.indexOf(optimisticTrashed);
              if (tIdx !== -1) appData.sampahPendaftaran[tIdx] = res.trashedItem;
              if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
            }
            syncSampahPendaftaranBadge();
            Swal.fire({
              title: 'Dipindahkan ke Tong Sampah',
              text: (res && res.message) || `Berkas ${id} dipindahkan ke Tong Sampah.`,
              icon: 'success',
              timer: 2000,
              showConfirmButton: false
            });
            if (res && !res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') {
              loadAppData(true);
            }
          })
          .withFailureHandler(err => {
            rollbackSoftDelete((err && err.message) || String(err || 'Koneksi ke server gagal.'));
          })
          .deletePendaftaran(id, actorName, actorRole);
      });
    }

    function openSampahPendaftaranModal() {
      if (!canManagePendaftaranTrash()) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Ditolak', 'Hanya Master Admin dan Admin TU yang dapat membuka Tong Sampah Pendaftaran.', 'warning');
        return;
      }
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalSampahPendaftaran');
      if (!modal) return;
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
      renderSampahPendaftaranTable();
    }

    function closeSampahPendaftaranModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalSampahPendaftaran');
      if (!modal) return;
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
      modal.classList.remove('flex');
    }

    function clearSampahPendaftaranSearch() {
      const input = document.getElementById('searchSampahPendaftaran');
      if (input) {
        input.value = '';
        input.focus();
      }
      renderSampahPendaftaranTable();
    }

    function resetSampahPendaftaranFilters() {
      const input = document.getElementById('searchSampahPendaftaran');
      if (input) input.value = '';
      const prodi = document.getElementById('filterSampahProdi');
      if (prodi) prodi.value = '';
      renderSampahPendaftaranTable();
    }

    function getFilteredSampahPendaftaranList() {
      const all = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran)) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];
      const rawSearch = String(document.getElementById('searchSampahPendaftaran')?.value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const filterProdi = String(document.getElementById('filterSampahProdi')?.value || '').trim().toUpperCase();

      const btnClear = document.getElementById('btnClearSearchSampah');
      if (btnClear) {
        btnClear.classList.toggle('hidden', !rawSearch);
        btnClear.classList.toggle('flex', Boolean(rawSearch));
      }
      const btnReset = document.getElementById('btnResetSampahFilter');
      if (btnReset) {
        const isDirty = Boolean(rawSearch || filterProdi);
        btnReset.classList.toggle('hidden', !isDirty);
        btnReset.classList.toggle('inline-flex', isDirty);
      }

      let list = all.slice();
      if (filterProdi) {
        list = list.filter(sp => {
          const code = typeof resolveInvoiceProdiCode === 'function'
            ? resolveInvoiceProdiCode(sp)
            : String(sp['Kode Prodi'] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
          return code === filterProdi;
        });
      }
      if (rawSearch) {
        const tokens = rawSearch.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        list = list.filter(sp => {
          const hay = [
            sp.ID, sp.NPM, sp.NIM, sp['Nama Mahasiswa'], sp['Kode Prodi'],
            sp['Program Studi'], sp['Mata Kuliah'], sp['Jenis Layanan'],
            sp['Deleted By'], sp['Deleted Role'], sp['Deleted At']
          ].filter(Boolean).map(v => String(v).toLowerCase()).join(' ');
          return tokens.every(t => hay.includes(t));
        });
      }

      list.sort((a, b) => String(b['Deleted At'] || '').localeCompare(String(a['Deleted At'] || '')));
      return list;
    }

    function renderSampahPendaftaranTable() {
      syncSampahPendaftaranBadge();
      const tbody = document.getElementById('tableSampahPendaftaranBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      const isMaster = canPermanentDeletePendaftaranTrash();
      const allTrash = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran)) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];
      const list = getFilteredSampahPendaftaranList();

      const btnEmpty = document.getElementById('btnEmptySampahPendaftaran');
      if (btnEmpty) {
        const showEmpty = isMaster && allTrash.length > 0;
        btnEmpty.classList.toggle('hidden', !showEmpty);
        btnEmpty.classList.toggle('inline-flex', showEmpty);
      }

      const rbacNotice = document.getElementById('sampahRbacNotice');
      if (rbacNotice) {
        rbacNotice.innerText = isMaster
          ? 'Hak akses Master Admin: Pulihkan & Hapus Permanen'
          : 'Hak akses Admin TU: Pulihkan berkas (Hapus Permanen hanya oleh Master Admin)';
      }

      const countInfo = document.getElementById('sampahToolbarCountInfo');
      if (countInfo) {
        countInfo.innerText = allTrash.length === list.length
          ? `Menampilkan ${list.length} berkas terhapus`
          : `Menampilkan ${list.length} dari ${allTrash.length} berkas terhapus`;
      }

      const selectAll = document.getElementById('sampahSelectAllCb');
      if (selectAll) {
        selectAll.checked = false;
        selectAll.indeterminate = false;
      }

      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      if (list.length === 0) {
        const isFiltered = allTrash.length > 0;
        tbody.innerHTML = `
          <tr>
            <td colspan="6" class="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">
              <div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-2 text-lg">
                <i class="fas fa-trash-restore" aria-hidden="true"></i>
              </div>
              <p class="font-bold text-slate-600 text-xs">${isFiltered ? 'Tidak ada berkas sampah yang cocok dengan pencarian/filter.' : 'Tong Sampah Pendaftaran kosong.'}</p>
              <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">${isFiltered ? 'Coba hapus kata kunci pencarian atau reset filter.' : 'Berkas yang dihapus oleh admin akan tersimpan sementara di sini dan dapat dipulihkan.'}</p>
              ${isFiltered ? '<button type="button" onclick="resetSampahPendaftaranFilters()" class="mt-3 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer">Reset Filter</button>' : ''}
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
        updateSampahSelectionUI();
        return;
      }

      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      list.forEach(sp => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.className = 'hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition align-top';

        const idRaw = String(sp.ID || '').trim();
        const idAttr = escapeHtml(idRaw).replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
        const kodeProdi = String(sp['Kode Prodi'] || (typeof resolveInvoiceProdiCode === 'function' ? resolveInvoiceProdiCode(sp) : '') || '-').trim() || '-';
        const layananStr = String(sp['Jenis Layanan'] || '-').trim() || '-';
        const matkulStr = String(sp['Mata Kuliah'] || '-').trim() || '-';
        const deletedBy = String(sp['Deleted By'] || 'Admin TU').trim();
        const deletedRole = String(sp['Deleted Role'] || 'Admin TU').trim();
        const deletedAt = String(sp['Deleted At'] || '-').trim();

        const permBtnHtml = isMaster ? `
          <button type="button" onclick="handlePermanentDeletePendaftaran('${idAttr}')" class="w-full bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer" title="Hapus Permanen (Tidak bisa dikembalikan)">
            <i class="fas fa-trash text-[9px]" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span>Hapus Perm.</span>
          </button>
        ` : '';

        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td class="px-2 py-2.5 text-center">
            <input type="checkbox" class="sampah-row-cb rounded text-emerald-700 cursor-pointer" value="${escapeHtml(idRaw)}" onchange="updateSampahSelectionUI()">
          </td>
          <td class="px-2 py-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div class="font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 text-[11px] tabular-nums break-all">${escapeHtml(idRaw)}</div>
            <div class="font-mono text-slate-400 text-[10px] tabular-nums mt-0.5">${escapeHtml(sp.Tanggal || '-')}</div>
          </td>
          <td class="px-2 py-2.5 min-w-0">
            <b class="text-slate-800 block text-xs leading-snug break-words">${escapeHtml(sp['Nama Mahasiswa'] || '-')}</b>
            <div class="font-mono text-slate-500 text-[10px] tabular-nums mt-0.5 break-all">${escapeHtml(sp.NPM || sp.NIM || '-')}</div>
            <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-600 mt-0.5"><span class="font-bold">[${escapeHtml(kodeProdi)}]</span> ${escapeHtml(sp.Semester || '-')}</div>
          </td>
          <td class="hidden sm:table-cell px-2 py-2.5 min-w-0">
            <span class="inline-block text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-900 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200/80 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 mb-1">${escapeHtml(layananStr)}</span>
            <div class="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-700 leading-snug break-words line-clamp-2">${escapeHtml(matkulStr)}</div>
          </td>
          <td class="px-2 py-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div class="font-bold text-slate-700 text-[11px] leading-snug break-words">${escapeHtml(deletedBy)}</div>
            <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">${escapeHtml(deletedRole)}</div>
            <div class="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-400 tabular-nums mt-0.5">${escapeHtml(deletedAt)}</div>
          </td>
          <td class="px-2 py-2.5 text-center">
            <div class="flex flex-col gap-1 items-stretch max-w-[96px] mx-auto">
              <button type="button" onclick="handleRestorePendaftaran('${idAttr}')" class="w-full bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-2xs transition cursor-pointer">
                <i class="fas fa-trash-restore text-[9px]" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span>Pulihkan</span>
              </button>
              ${permBtnHtml}
            </div>
          </td>
        `;
        frag.appendChild(tr);
      });
      tbody.appendChild(frag);
      updateSampahSelectionUI();
    }

    function toggleSampahSelectAll(masterCb) {
      if (!canManagePendaftaranTrash()) return;
      document.querySelectorAll('.sampah-row-cb').forEach(cb => { cb.checked = Boolean(masterCb && masterCb.checked); });
      updateSampahSelectionUI();
    }

    function updateSampahSelectionUI() {
      const cbs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.sampah-row-cb'));
      const checkedCbs = cbs.filter(cb => cb.checked);
      const btnBulk = document.getElementById('btnBulkRestoreSampah');
      const labelBulk = document.getElementById('btnBulkRestoreSampahLabel');
      const selectAll = document.getElementById('sampahSelectAllCb');

      if (btnBulk) {
        const show = checkedCbs.length > 0 && canManagePendaftaranTrash();
        btnBulk.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
        btnBulk.classList.toggle('inline-flex', show);
      }
      if (labelBulk) {
        labelBulk.innerText = `Pulihkan Terpilih (${checkedCbs.length})`;
      }
      if (selectAll) {
        selectAll.checked = cbs.length > 0 && checkedCbs.length === cbs.length;
        selectAll.indeterminate = checkedCbs.length > 0 && checkedCbs.length < cbs.length;
      }
    }

    function handleRestorePendaftaran(id) {
      if (!canManagePendaftaranTrash()) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Ditolak', 'Hanya Master Admin atau Admin TU yang dapat memulihkan berkas.', 'warning');
        return;
      }
      appData.sampahPendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran : [];
      appData.pendaftaran = Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
      const sIdx = appData.sampahPendaftaran.findIndex(s => String(s.ID || s.id).trim() === String(id).trim());
      if (sIdx === -1) return;

      const trashedSnapshot = Object.assign({}, appData.sampahPendaftaran[sIdx]);
      const restoredPreview = Object.assign({}, trashedSnapshot);
      delete restoredPreview['Deleted At'];
      delete restoredPreview['Deleted By'];
      delete restoredPreview['Deleted Role'];

      // Optimistic restore
      appData.sampahPendaftaran.splice(sIdx, 1);
      appData.pendaftaran.unshift(restoredPreview);
      if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
      renderSampahPendaftaranTable();
      if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: true });
      if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
      if (typeof renderInvoiceTable === 'function') renderInvoiceTable({ preserveScroll: true });

      const rollbackRestore = (errMsg) => {
        appData.pendaftaran = appData.pendaftaran.filter(p => p !== restoredPreview);
        appData.sampahPendaftaran.splice(Math.min(sIdx, appData.sampahPendaftaran.length), 0, trashedSnapshot);
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        renderSampahPendaftaranTable();
        if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: true });
        if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
        if (typeof renderInvoiceTable === 'function') renderInvoiceTable({ preserveScroll: true });
        Swal.fire('Gagal Memulihkan', errMsg || 'Berkas tidak dapat dipulihkan.', 'error');
      };

      const actorName = typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function' ? getCurrentActorName() : '';
      const actorRole = typeof getCurrentActorRole === 'function' ? getCurrentActorRole() : '';

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(res => {
          if (res && res.success === false) {
            rollbackRestore(res.message);
            return;
          }
          if (res && res.restoredItem) {
            const pIdx = appData.pendaftaran.indexOf(restoredPreview);
            if (pIdx !== -1) appData.pendaftaran[pIdx] = res.restoredItem;
            if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
            if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: true });
          }
          Swal.fire({
            title: 'Berkas Dipulihkan',
            text: (res && res.message) || `Berkas ${id} berhasil dikembalikan ke daftar aktif.`,
            icon: 'success',
            timer: 2000,
            showConfirmButton: false
          });
          if (res && !res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') {
            loadAppData(true);
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(err => {
          rollbackRestore((err && err.message) || String(err || 'Koneksi ke server gagal.'));
        })
        .restorePendaftaran(id, actorName, actorRole);
    }

    function handleBulkRestoreSampah() {
      if (!canManagePendaftaranTrash()) return;
      const selectedIds = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.sampah-row-cb:checked')).map(cb => String(cb.value || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;

      const actorName = typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function' ? getCurrentActorName() : '';
      const actorRole = typeof getCurrentActorRole === 'function' ? getCurrentActorRole() : '';

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(res => {
          if (!res || res.success === false) {
            Swal.fire('Gagal Memulihkan', (res && res.message) || 'Tidak ada berkas yang dapat dipulihkan.', 'warning');
            return;
          }
          if (!res.isLocalFallback) {
            const restoredSet = new Set((res.restoredIds || []).map(x => String(x).trim()));
            appData.sampahPendaftaran = (appData.sampahPendaftaran || []).filter(s => !restoredSet.has(String(s.ID || s.id).trim()));
            if (Array.isArray(res.restoredItems) && res.restoredItems.length > 0) {
              appData.pendaftaran = res.restoredItems.concat(appData.pendaftaran || []);
            }
          }
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
          renderSampahPendaftaranTable();
          if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable({ preserveScroll: true });
          if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
          if (typeof renderInvoiceTable === 'function') renderInvoiceTable({ preserveScroll: true });

          Swal.fire('Pemulihan Selesai', res.message || `Berhasil memulihkan ${(res.restoredIds || selectedIds).length} berkas.`, 'success');
          if (!res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') {
            loadAppData(true);
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(err => {
          Swal.fire('Gagal Memulihkan', (err && err.message) || String(err || 'Koneksi ke server gagal.'), 'error');
        })
        .bulkRestorePendaftaran(selectedIds, actorName, actorRole);
    }

    function handlePermanentDeletePendaftaran(id) {
      if (!canPermanentDeletePendaftaranTrash()) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Ditolak', 'Hanya Master Admin yang berhak menghapus berkas secara permanen.', 'error');
        return;
      }
      Swal.fire({
        title: `Hapus Permanen ${id}?`,
        text: 'Tindakan ini tidak dapat dibatalkan! Berkas akan dihapus selamanya dari sheet Sampah_Pendaftaran.',
        icon: 'error',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Hapus Permanen',
        confirmButtonColor: '#be123c',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal'
      }).then(r => {
        if (!r.isConfirmed) return;
        const actorName = typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function' ? getCurrentActorName() : '';
        const actorRole = typeof getCurrentActorRole === 'function' ? getCurrentActorRole() : '';
        const prevTrash = (appData.sampahPendaftaran || []).slice();
        appData.sampahPendaftaran = prevTrash.filter(s => String(s.ID || s.id).trim() !== String(id).trim());
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        renderSampahPendaftaranTable();

        const rollbackPerm = (msg) => {
          appData.sampahPendaftaran = prevTrash;
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
          renderSampahPendaftaranTable();
          Swal.fire('Gagal Hapus Permanen', msg || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat menghapus berkas.', 'error');
        };

        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(res => {
            if (res && res.success === false) {
              rollbackPerm(res.message);
              return;
            }
            Swal.fire({
              title: 'Dihapus Permanen',
              text: (res && res.message) || `Berkas ${id} telah dihapus permanen.`,
              icon: 'success',
              timer: 1800,
              showConfirmButton: false
            });
            if (res && !res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') {
              loadAppData(true);
            }
          })
          .withFailureHandler(err => {
            rollbackPerm((err && err.message) || String(err || 'Koneksi ke server gagal.'));
          })
          .permanentDeletePendaftaran(id, actorName, actorRole);
      });
    }

    function handleEmptySampahPendaftaran() {
      if (!canPermanentDeletePendaftaranTrash()) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Ditolak', 'Hanya Master Admin yang berhak mengosongkan Tong Sampah.', 'error');
        return;
      }
      const total = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.sampahPendaftaran)) ? appData.sampahPendaftaran.length : 0;
      if (total === 0) return;

      Swal.fire({
        title: `Kosongkan Tong Sampah (${total} Berkas)?`,
        text: 'Seluruh berkas di Tong Sampah akan dihapus permanen selamanya dan tidak bisa dipulihkan.',
        icon: 'error',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Kosongkan Permanen',
        confirmButtonColor: '#be123c',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal'
      }).then(r => {
        if (!r.isConfirmed) return;
        const actorName = typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function' ? getCurrentActorName() : '';
        const actorRole = typeof getCurrentActorRole === 'function' ? getCurrentActorRole() : '';
        const prevTrash = (appData.sampahPendaftaran || []).slice();
        appData.sampahPendaftaran = [];
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        renderSampahPendaftaranTable();

        const rollbackEmpty = (msg) => {
          appData.sampahPendaftaran = prevTrash;
          if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
          renderSampahPendaftaranTable();
          Swal.fire('Gagal Mengosongkan', msg || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat mengosongkan Tong Sampah.', 'error');
        };

        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(res => {
            if (res && res.success === false) {
              rollbackEmpty(res.message);
              return;
            }
            Swal.fire('Tong Sampah Kosong', (res && res.message) || 'Seluruh berkas sampah telah dihapus permanen.', 'success');
            if (res && !res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') {
              loadAppData(true);
            }
          })
          .withFailureHandler(err => {
            rollbackEmpty((err && err.message) || String(err || 'Koneksi ke server gagal.'));
          })
          .emptySampahPendaftaran(actorName, actorRole);
      });
    }

    // [SMART CHECKBOX]: Checkbox Header 'Pilih Semua' HANYA menyasar elemen :not(:disabled)
    function toggleSelectAll(masterCb) {
      const canManageFull = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
      if (!canManageFull) return;
      document.querySelectorAll('.pendaftaran-row-cb:not(:disabled)').forEach(cb => { cb.checked = masterCb.checked; });
      updatePendaftaranSelectionUI();
    }

    // [SMART CHECKBOX]: Lencana / Badge 'X Terpilih' HANYA menghitung elemen :checked:not(:disabled)
    function updatePendaftaranSelectionUI() {
      const canManageFull = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
      const bulkBar = document.getElementById('bulkActionBar');
      const badge = document.getElementById('selectedCountBadge');
      const selectAllCb = document.getElementById('selectAllCb');

      if (!canManageFull) {
        if (bulkBar) {
          bulkBar.classList.add('hidden');
          bulkBar.classList.remove('flex');
        }
        return;
      }

      const checkedBoxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pendaftaran-row-cb:checked:not(:disabled)'));
      const eligibleBoxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pendaftaran-row-cb:not(:disabled)'));
      const count = checkedBoxes.length;

      if (bulkBar) {
        if (count > 0) {
          bulkBar.classList.remove('hidden');
          bulkBar.classList.add('flex');
        } else {
          bulkBar.classList.add('hidden');
          bulkBar.classList.remove('flex');
        }
      }

      if (badge) {
        badge.innerText = `${count} Terpilih`;
      }

      if (selectAllCb) {
        selectAllCb.checked = eligibleBoxes.length > 0 && checkedBoxes.length === eligibleBoxes.length;
        selectAllCb.indeterminate = count > 0 && count < eligibleBoxes.length;
      }
    }

    // [FITUR PERSETUJUAN PENDAFTARAN MASSAL]
    // Eksklusif Master Admin & Admin TU dengan pemrosesan batch anti-lemot
    // ==========================================
    function handleBulkApproveRegistrations() {
      const canManageFull = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
      if (!canManageFull) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Ditolak', 'Akses ditolak: Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk menyetujui pendaftaran secara massal.', 'error');
        return;
      }

      const selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pendaftaran-row-cb:checked:not(:disabled)')).map(cb => cb.value);
      if (selected.length === 0) {
        Swal.fire('Perhatian', 'Pilih minimal satu berkas pendaftaran yang belum disetujui.', 'info');
        return;
      }

      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Konfirmasi Persetujuan Massal',
        text: `Apakah Anda yakin ingin menyetujui ${selected.length} pendaftaran yang dipilih sekaligus?`,
        icon: 'question',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: '✔ Ya, Setujui Sekaligus',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
        confirmButtonColor: '#059669',
        cancelButtonColor: '#64748b'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          Swal.fire({
            title: 'Memproses Persetujuan Massal...',
            html: `Memperbarui <b>${selected.length}</b> berkas secara batch ke database website...`,
            allowOutsideClick: false,
            didOpen: () => { Swal.showLoading(); }
          });

          const onBulkSuccess = (res) => {
            // Pembaruan array memori instan tanpa reload halaman
            const selectedSet = new Set(selected.map(String));
            (appData.pendaftaran || []).forEach(p => {
              if (selectedSet.has(String(p.ID))) {
                p['Status Persetujuan'] = 'Disetujui';
              }
            });

            // Reset seleksi
            const selectAllCb = document.getElementById('selectAllCb');
            if (selectAllCb) {
              selectAllCb.checked = false;
              selectAllCb.indeterminate = false;
            }

            // Perbarui UI secara langsung
            renderPendaftaranTable();
            renderExecutiveDashboard();
            updatePendaftaranSelectionUI();

            Swal.fire({
              icon: 'success',
              title: 'Persetujuan Selesai!',
              text: `${res?.count || selected.length} pendaftaran berhasil disetujui sekaligus.`,
              timer: 2000,
              showConfirmButton: false
            });
          };

          const onBulkError = (err) => {
            Swal.fire('Gagal Menyetujui', err?.message || String(err), 'error');
          };

          if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run) {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(onBulkSuccess)
              .withFailureHandler(onBulkError)
              .bulkApproveRegistrations(selected, getCurrentActorRole(), getCurrentActorName());
          } else {
            // Simulasi browser / offline testing
            setTimeout(() => {
              onBulkSuccess({ success: true, count: selected.length });
            }, 400);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function handleBulkApproval(status) {
      if (status === 'Disetujui') {
        handleBulkApproveRegistrations();
        return;
      }

      const selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.pendaftaran-row-cb:checked')).map(cb => cb.value);
      if (selected.length === 0) return;

      Swal.fire({
        title: `${status} ${selected.length} Berkas?`,
        icon: 'question',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: `Ya, ${status} Semua`,
        confirmButtonColor: status === 'Disetujui' ? '#059669' : '#e11d48'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(res => {
              Swal.fire('Selesai', res.message, 'success');
              loadAppData();
            })
            .bulkUpdateStatusApproval(selected, status, getCurrentActorRole(), getCurrentActorName());
        }
      });
    }

    // [MODUL SETTING STATUS PEMBAYARAN - REVISI POIN 4]
    // Pilihan Status: Belum Bayar <-> Lunas, update langsung di memori & server
    // ==========================================
    function openSettingPembayaranModal(id) {
      const item = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID).trim() === String(id).trim());
      if (!item) return;

      document.getElementById('setPayTargetId').value = item.ID;
      document.getElementById('setPayModalId').innerText = item.ID;
      document.getElementById('setPayModalMhs').innerText = `${item['Nama Mahasiswa'] || '-'} (${item.NPM || item.NIM || '-'})`;
      document.getElementById('setPayModalMatkul').innerText = item['Mata Kuliah'] || '-';
      document.getElementById('setPayModalNominal').innerText = 'Rp ' + Number(item.Nominal || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID');

      const currStatus = normalizePaymentStatusLabel(item['Status Pembayaran'], item.Nominal);
      const radLunas = document.getElementById('radioStatusLunas');
      const radBelum = document.getElementById('radioStatusBelumBayar');
      if (currStatus.toLowerCase() === 'lunas') {
        if (radLunas) radLunas.checked = true;
      } else {
        if (radBelum) radBelum.checked = true;
      }

      document.getElementById('setPayModalCatatan').value = item.Catatan || 'Pembayaran tunai via loket TU FEB UIKA';

      const modal = document.getElementById('modalSettingPembayaran');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        modal.classList.add('flex');
      }
    }

    function closeSettingPembayaranModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalSettingPembayaran');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
        modal.classList.remove('flex');
      }
    }

    function handleSaveStatusPembayaran(e) {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      const id = document.getElementById('setPayTargetId').value;
      const radLunas = document.getElementById('radioStatusLunas');
      const newStatus = radLunas && radLunas.checked ? 'Lunas' : 'Belum Bayar';
      const catatan = document.getElementById('setPayModalCatatan').value;
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnSaveStatusBayar');

      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-1"></i> Menyimpan...';
      }

      // Update in memory immediately
      const item = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID).trim() === String(id).trim());
      if (item) {
        item['Status Pembayaran'] = newStatus;
        item.Catatan = catatan;
      }

      const onComplete = (res) => {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerText = 'Simpan Status';
        }
        closeSettingPembayaranModal();
        renderPendaftaranTable();
        if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
        if (typeof renderInvoiceTable === 'function') renderInvoiceTable();
        Swal.fire('Berhasil Disimpan', `Status pembayaran ${id} berhasil diubah menjadi: ${newStatus}`, 'success');
      };

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(onComplete)
          .withFailureHandler(err => {
            if (btn) {
              btn.disabled = false;
              btn.innerText = 'Simpan Status';
            }
            Swal.fire('Peringatan', 'Status lokal diperbarui. Respons server: ' + (err.message || err), 'warning');
            closeSettingPembayaranModal();
            renderPendaftaranTable();
          })
          .updateStatusPayment(id, newStatus, catatan, getCurrentActorName(), getCurrentActorRole());
      } else {
        setTimeout(onComplete, 300);
      }
    }

    // ==========================================
    // [FITUR EXPORT EXCEL RESMI - REVISI POIN 3]
    // Membaca array data aktif di memori (filteredData / tableData)
    // ==========================================
    // [HELPER PENAMAAN FILE EKSPOR BERSIH TANPA UNDERSCORE + TAHUN AKADEMIK]
    // ==========================================
    function sanitizeExportFileSegment(str, maxLen = 50, fallback = '') {
      const cleaned = String(str || '')
        .replace(/[\/\\:*?"<>|_]+/g, ' ')
        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s\-]+/g, ' ')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim()
        .slice(0, maxLen)
        .trim();
      return cleaned || fallback;
    }

    function getExportAcademicPeriodLabel(customTa = '', customSem = '') {
      let rawTa = String(customTa || '').trim();
      let rawSem = String(customSem || '').trim();

      if (!rawTa || !rawSem) {
        const listTa = (typeof appData !== 'undefined' && appData && appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.tahunAkademik))
          ? appData.master.tahunAkademik
          : [];
        const activeTa = listTa.find(t => String(t.Status || t.status || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'aktif') || listTa[0];
        if (activeTa) {
          if (!rawTa) rawTa = String(activeTa['Tahun Akademik'] || activeTa.Tahun || '').trim();
          if (!rawSem) rawSem = String(activeTa.Semester || '').trim();
        }
      }

      if (!rawTa || !rawSem) {
        const listPrd = (typeof appData !== 'undefined' && appData && appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.periode))
          ? appData.master.periode
          : [];
        const activePrd = listPrd.find(p => String(p.Status || p.status || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'aktif') || listPrd[0];
        if (activePrd) {
          if (!rawTa) rawTa = String(activePrd['Tahun Akademik'] || '').trim();
          if (!rawSem) rawSem = String(activePrd.Semester || '').trim();
        }
      }

      if (!rawTa) rawTa = '2026/2027';
      const taMatch = rawTa.match(/(\d{4})\s*[\/\-]\s*(\d{4})/);
      const taFormatted = taMatch
        ? `${taMatch[1]}-${taMatch[2]}`
        : sanitizeExportFileSegment(rawTa, 20, '2026-2027');

      const semLower = rawSem.toLowerCase();
      const taLower = rawTa.toLowerCase();
      const semFormatted = semLower.includes('genap')
        ? 'Genap'
        : (semLower.includes('ganjil') ? 'Ganjil' : (taLower.includes('genap') ? 'Genap' : 'Ganjil'));

      return `${taFormatted} ${semFormatted}`.replace(/_+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    function exportToExcel() {
      const btn = document.querySelector('button[onclick*="loadAppData"] i.fa-spin');
      if (btn) {
        Swal.fire('Mohon Tunggu', 'Data sedang dimuat/diperbarui dari server, silakan coba sesaat lagi.', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      const list = appData.pendaftaran || [];
      if (!list || list.length === 0) {
        Swal.fire('Data Kosong', 'Tidak ada data pendaftaran yang aktif di memori untuk diekspor.', 'info');
        return;
      }

      // Filter sesuai pencarian, prodi, status & hak akses yang sedang aktif di UI
      const filterProdi = (document.getElementById('filterPendaftaranProdi')?.value || document.getElementById('pendaftaranFilterProdi')?.value || '').toUpperCase();
      const filtered = getFilteredPendaftaranList();

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        Swal.fire('Data Kosong', 'Tidak ada data pendaftaran yang cocok dengan filter saat ini.', 'info');
        return;
      }

      const exportRows = filtered.map(item => {
        let buktiLink = '-';
        const rawBukti = String(item['Bukti Foto'] || '').trim();
        if (rawBukti.startsWith('http://') || rawBukti.startsWith('https://')) {
          buktiLink = rawBukti;
        } else if (rawBukti.startsWith('data:') || rawBukti.length > 200) {
          buktiLink = '[Tersimpan di Sistem (Base64)]';
        }

        return {
          'ID Pendaftaran': item.ID || item.id,
          'Tanggal': item.Tanggal || item.tanggal || '',
          'NPM': item.NPM || item.NIM || item.npm || '',
          'Nama Mahasiswa': item['Nama Mahasiswa'] || item.nama || '',
          'Program Studi': item['Program Studi'] || item.prodi || '',
          'Semester': item.Semester || item.semester || '',
          'Kelas': item.Kelas || item.kelas || '',
          'Mata Kuliah': item['Mata Kuliah'] || item.matkul || '',
          'Dosen Pengampu': item['Dosen Pengampu'] || item.dosen || '',
          'Jenis Layanan': item['Jenis Layanan'] || item.layanan || '',
          'Bukti Foto': buktiLink,
          'Nominal Retribusi': Number(item.Nominal || item.nominal || 0),
          'Status Persetujuan': item['Status Persetujuan'] || item.statusApproval || 'Pending',
          'Status Pembayaran': normalizePaymentStatusLabel(item['Status Pembayaran'] || item.statusBayar, item.Nominal || item.nominal)
        };
      });

      const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const periodLabel = getExportAcademicPeriodLabel();
      const fileName = `Pendaftaran FEB UIKA ${periodLabel} ${dateStr}.xlsx`;

      if (typeof XLSX !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(exportRows);
          const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
          XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, 'Pendaftaran');
          XLSX.writeFile(wb, fileName);
          Swal.fire('Export Sukses', `File Excel (${fileName}) berisi ${exportRows.length} baris data berhasil diunduh.`, 'success');
          return;
        } catch(e) {
          console.warn('XLSX.writeFile gagal, menggunakan fallback .xls:', e);
        }
      }

      // Fallback .xls
      if (typeof downloadHtmlXls === 'function') {
        downloadHtmlXls('Pendaftaran', exportRows, dateStr);
        Swal.fire('Export Sukses', `File Excel berisi ${exportRows.length} baris data berhasil diunduh.`, 'success');
        return;
      }

      // Fallback UTF-8 CSV
      let csv = '\uFEFFID,Tanggal,NPM,Nama,Prodi,Semester,Kelas,Mata Kuliah,Dosen,Layanan,Bukti Foto,Nominal,Status Persetujuan,Status Pembayaran\n';
      exportRows.forEach(r => {
        csv += `"${r['ID Pendaftaran']}","${r['Tanggal']}","${r['NPM']}","${r['Nama Mahasiswa']}","${r['Program Studi']}","${r['Semester']}","${r['Kelas']}","${r['Mata Kuliah']}","${r['Dosen Pengampu']}","${r['Jenis Layanan']}","${r['Bukti Foto']}",${r['Nominal Retribusi']},"${r['Status Persetujuan']}","${r['Status Pembayaran']}"\n`;
      });
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.download = `Pendaftaran FEB UIKA ${periodLabel} ${dateStr}.csv`;
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      setTimeout(() => { document.body.removeChild(link); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 500);
      Swal.fire('Export Sukses', `Data berisi ${exportRows.length} baris berhasil diekspor.`, 'success');
    }

    function exportPendaftaranProdiGAS() {
      exportToExcel();
    }

    function handleBuktiFotoUpload(e) {
      const file = e.target.files[0];
      if (!file) return;

      // Batas ukuran berkas 5 MB (5 * 1024 * 1024 bytes)
      const maxBytes = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
      if (file.size > maxBytes) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Berkas Terlalu Besar',
          text: 'Maksimal ukuran berkas bukti adalah 5 MB. Silakan kompres atau pilih berkas lain.'
        });
        e.target.value = '';
        clearBuktiFoto();
        return;
      }

      // Validasi format berkas: JPG, PNG, atau PDF
      const allowedTypes = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/jpg', 'application/pdf'];
      const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();
      const isAllowedExt = ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'pdf'].includes(fileExt);

      if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type) && !isAllowedExt) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Format Berkas Tidak Didukung',
          text: 'Hanya format gambar (JPG, JPEG, PNG) dan dokumen PDF yang diizinkan untuk bukti pendaftaran.'
        });
        e.target.value = '';
        clearBuktiFoto();
        return;
      }

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(evt) {
        const base64 = evt.target.result;
        const base64Input = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiBase64');
        const fileNameInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiFileName');
        const mimeTypeInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiMimeType');

        if (base64Input) base64Input.value = base64;
        if (fileNameInput) fileNameInput.value = file.name;
        if (mimeTypeInput) mimeTypeInput.value = file.type || (fileExt === 'pdf' ? 'application/pdf' : 'image/jpeg');

        const box = document.getElementById('previewBuktiContainer');
        const img = document.getElementById('previewBuktiImg');
        const iconPdf = document.getElementById('previewBuktiIcon');
        const nameP = document.getElementById('previewBuktiName');
        const infoP = document.getElementById('previewBuktiInfo');

        const fileSizeKb = Math.round(file.size / 1024);
        const sizeStr = fileSizeKb > 1024 ? (file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2) + ' MB' : fileSizeKb + ' KB';

        if (nameP) nameP.innerText = file.name;
        if (infoP) infoP.innerHTML = `<span class="text-blue-900 font-bold">${sizeStr}</span> · <i class="fas fa-cloud-arrow-up text-emerald-600 mr-1"></i>Siap diunggah ke Google Drive`;

        if (file.type === 'application/pdf' || fileExt === 'pdf') {
          if (img) img.classList.add('hidden');
          if (iconPdf) {
            iconPdf.classList.remove('hidden');
            iconPdf.className = 'w-14 h-12 rounded-lg bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-rose-600 font-bold text-xs shrink-0';
            iconPdf.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-file-pdf text-lg text-rose-600 mb-0.5"></i><span class="text-[9px] font-mono">PDF</span>';
          }
        } else {
          if (iconPdf) iconPdf.classList.add('hidden');
          if (img) {
            img.classList.remove('hidden');
            img.src = base64;
          }
        }

        if (box) {
          box.classList.remove('hidden');
          box.classList.add('flex');
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    function clearBuktiFoto() {
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiFile');
      if (fileInput) {
        fileInput.value = '';
        fileInput.dataset.existingUrl = '';
      }
      const base64 = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiBase64');
      if (base64) base64.value = '';
      const fName = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiFileName');
      if (fName) fName.value = '';
      const fMime = document.getElementById('pendaftaranBuktiMimeType');
      if (fMime) fMime.value = '';

      const box = document.getElementById('previewBuktiContainer');
      if (box) {
        box.classList.add('hidden');
        box.classList.remove('flex');
      }
    }

      if (!src) return;
      const isDrive = src.includes('drive.google.com');
      const isPdf = src.toLowerCase().includes('.pdf') || src.includes('application/pdf');

          title: 'Berkas Bukti Pendaftaran',
          html: `
            <div class="space-y-3 text-left">
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-600">Berkas pendaftaran tersimpan aman di folder Google Drive Fakultas:</p>
              <div class="p-3 bg-blue-50/70 border border-blue-200 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden">
                  <i class="fab fa-google-drive text-emerald-600 text-xl shrink-0"></i>
                  <span class="text-xs font-mono text-slate-800 truncate">${escapeHtml(src)}</span>
                </div>
                <a href="${src}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-blue-800 shadow-sm shrink-0 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <i class="fas fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i> Buka Berkas
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>
          `,
          showCloseButton: true,
          confirmButtonText: 'Tutup',
          confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
        });
      } else if (isPdf) {
        Swal.fire({
          title: 'Dokumen Bukti PDF',
          html: `
            <div class="p-4 text-center">
              <div class="w-16 h-16 bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 border border-rose-200 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3 text-2xl">
                <i class="fas fa-file-pdf"></i>
              </div>
              <p class="text-xs text-slate-700 font-bold mb-3">Dokumen PDF Terlampir</p>
              <a href="${src}" target="_blank" download="Bukti_Pendaftaran.pdf" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-rose-600 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold hover:bg-rose-700 shadow-md">
                <i class="fas fa-download"></i> Unduh / Buka Dokumen PDF
              </a>
            </div>
          `,
          showCloseButton: true,
          confirmButtonText: 'Tutup',
          confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
        });
      } else {
        Swal.fire({
          imageUrl: src,
          imageAlt: 'Bukti Foto Pendaftaran',
          confirmButtonText: 'Tutup',
          confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a',
          showCloseButton: true
        });
      }
    }

    function handleExcelFileSelect(e) {
      const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
      if (!file) return;
      uploadedExcelFile = file;

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = function(evt) {
        try {
          const data = new Uint8Array(evt.target.result);
          if (typeof XLSX === 'undefined') {
            throw new Error('Pustaka XLSX belum tersedia.');
          }
          const workbook = XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
          const firstSheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
          const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[firstSheetName];
          const json = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { defval: '' });

          if (!json || json.length === 0) {
            Swal.fire('File Kosong', 'File Excel yang dipilih tidak memiliki baris data.', 'warning');
            const prev = document.getElementById('excelPreviewContainer');
            if (prev) prev.classList.add('hidden');
            const btn = document.getElementById('btnExecuteExcelSync');
            if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
            return;
          }

          const targetSelect = document.getElementById('excelTargetSheet');
          const target = targetSelect ? targetSelect.value : '';

          // [OTOMASI NORMALISASI KELAS & KALKULASI SEMESTER UNTUK EXCEL]
          if (target === 'User_Mahasiswa') {
            json.forEach((row, idx) => {
              let angkatanVal = row['Angkatan'] || row['angkatan'] || row['Tahun Angkatan'];
              const npmVal = String(row['NPM'] || row['npm'] || row['NIM'] || row['nim'] || '').trim();
              if (!angkatanVal && npmVal) {
                const m = npmVal.match(/^(\d{2})/);
                if (m) angkatanVal = 2000 + parseInt(m[1], 10);
              }
              if (angkatanVal) {
                row['Angkatan'] = parseInt(angkatanVal, 10);
                row['Semester'] = calculateSemesterFromAngkatan(angkatanVal);
              } else {
                row['Semester'] = row['Semester'] || 'Semester 1';
              }
              if (!row['Role'] && !row['role']) {
                row['Role'] = 'Mahasiswa';
              }
              // Bersihkan angka semester dari nama kelas
              const rawK = row['Kelas'] || row['kelas'] || 'Reguler A';
              row['Kelas'] = normalizeClassNameClient(rawK);
            });
          } else if (target === 'Master_Kelas') {
            json.forEach((row) => {
              const rawName = row['Nama Kelas'] || row['Kelas'] || row['nama kelas'] || 'Reguler A';
              row['Nama Kelas'] = normalizeClassNameClient(rawName);
              if (!row['Kategori']) {
                row['Kategori'] = detectCategoryFromClassClient(row['Nama Kelas']);
              }
            });
          } else if (target === 'Jadwal_Ujian') {
            json.forEach((row) => {
              if (row['Kelas']) row['Kelas'] = normalizeClassNameClient(row['Kelas']);
            });
          } else if (target === 'Pendaftaran') {
            json.forEach((row) => {
              if (row['Kelas']) row['Kelas'] = normalizeClassNameClient(row['Kelas']);
              if (!row['Kategori Kelas'] && row['Kelas']) {
                row['Kategori Kelas'] = detectCategoryFromClassClient(row['Kelas']);
              }
            });
          }

          uploadedParsedData = json;
          renderExcelUploadPreview(file, json);
        } catch (err) {
          Swal.fire('Format Tidak Didukung', 'Gagal membaca file Excel/CSV: ' + err.message, 'error');
        }
      };
      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
    }

    function renderExcelUploadPreview(file, rows) {
      const container = document.getElementById('excelPreviewContainer');
      const stats = document.getElementById('excelFileStats');
      const tableHead = document.getElementById('excelPreviewTableHead');
      const tableBody = document.getElementById('excelPreviewTableBody');
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnExecuteExcelSync');
      const targetSelect = document.getElementById('excelTargetSheet');
      const targetName = targetSelect ? targetSelect.options[targetSelect.selectedIndex].text : 'Data Master';

      if (!container) return;
      container.classList.remove('hidden');

      if (stats) {
        stats.innerHTML = `
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2.5 bg-emerald-50 rounded-xl border border-emerald-200">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <i class="fas fa-file-excel text-emerald-600 text-xl"></i>
              <div>
                <b class="text-slate-800 text-xs block">${file.name}</b>
                <span class="text-[11px] text-slate-500">${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB · <b>${rows.length}</b> baris terdeteksi</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">
              <i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> Siap disinkronkan ke ${targetName}
            </span>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      if (rows.length > 0 && tableHead && tableBody) {
        const sample = rows[0];
        const keys = Object.keys(sample);
        tableHead.innerHTML = '<tr><th class="p-2 border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-center text-[10px] w-8">#</th>' + 
          keys.map(k => `<th class="p-2 border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 text-left font-bold text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap text-slate-700">${k}</th>`).join('') + '</tr>';

        const previewRows = rows.slice(0, 4);
        tableBody.innerHTML = previewRows.map((r, idx) => {
          const cells = keys.map(k => `<td class="p-2 border border-slate-200 text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap text-slate-700">${r[k] !== undefined ? r[k] : ''}</td>`).join('');
          return `<tr class="hover:bg-slate-50"><td class="p-2 border border-slate-200 text-center text-slate-400 font-mono text-[10px]">${idx + 1}</td>${cells}</tr>`;
        }).join('');
      }

      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-cloud-arrow-up"></i><span>Mulai Sinkronisasi (${rows.length} Baris Data)</span>`;
      }
    }

    function executeExcelSync() {
      if (!uploadedParsedData || uploadedParsedData.length === 0) {
        Swal.fire('Info', 'Silakan pilih dan muat file Excel terlebih dahulu.', 'info');
        return;
      }

      const targetSheet = document.getElementById('excelTargetSheet')?.value || 'Master_Matkul';
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnExecuteExcelSync');
      const actor = getCurrentActorName();
      const actorRole = getCurrentActorRole();

      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-1.5"></i> Menyinkronkan ke Database...';
      }

      const onSyncSuccess = function(res) {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-cloud-arrow-up"></i><span>Mulai Sinkronisasi (${uploadedParsedData.length} Baris Data)</span>`;
        }
        if (res && res.success) {
          closeExcelSyncModal();
          Swal.fire({
            title: 'Sinkronisasi Berhasil!',
            text: res.message || `Data ${targetSheet} (${uploadedParsedData.length} baris) berhasil disinkronkan ke database website.`,
            icon: 'success',
            confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a'
          });
          loadAppData();
        } else {
          Swal.fire('Sinkronisasi Gagal', (res && res.message) || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem saat menyimpan data.', 'error');
        }
      };

      const onSyncError = function(err) {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-cloud-arrow-up"></i><span>Mulai Sinkronisasi (${uploadedParsedData.length} Baris Data)</span>`;
        }
        Swal.fire('Error Sistem', err?.message || String(err), 'error');
      };

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(onSyncSuccess)
          .withFailureHandler(onSyncError)
          .batchSyncMasterData(targetSheet, uploadedParsedData, actor, actorRole);
      } else {
        callGasApi('batchSyncMasterData', [targetSheet, uploadedParsedData, actor, actorRole], onSyncSuccess, onSyncError);
      }
    }
