    function previewBase64Bukti(id) {
      const list = appData.pendaftaran || [];
      const item = list.find(p => String(p.ID) === String(id) || String(p.id) === String(id)) || list[id];
      if (!item || !item['Bukti Foto']) {
        Swal.fire('Tidak Ditemukan', 'Berkas bukti untuk baris ini tidak ditemukan.', 'info');
        return;
      }
      const bukti = item['Bukti Foto'];
      if (bukti.startsWith('http://') || bukti.startsWith('https://')) {
        window.open(bukti, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
        return;
      }

      const isPdf = bukti.includes('application/pdf') || bukti.startsWith('data:application/pdf');
      const previewContent = isPdf
        ? `<div class="p-6 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-center space-y-3">
             <i class="fas fa-file-pdf text-rose-500 text-5xl"></i>
             <p class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">Dokumen PDF Terlampir (Base64)</p>
             <a href="${bukti}" download="Bukti_${item.ID || 'Pendaftaran'}.pdf" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-blue-900 text-white rounded-lg font-bold text-xs shadow-sm hover:bg-blue-800">
               <i class="fas fa-download"></i> Unduh Berkas PDF
             </a>
           </div>`
        : `<div class="max-h-[65vh] overflow-auto flex flex-col items-center">
             <img src="${bukti}" alt="Bukti Foto" class="max-w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-md object-contain" />
             <div class="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg">
               ${item['Nama Mahasiswa'] || 'Mahasiswa'} · NPM: ${item.NPM || item.NIM || '-'} · ${item.ID || ''}
             </div>
           </div>`;

      Swal.fire({
        title: `Pratinjau Bukti Pendaftaran (${item.ID || ''})`,
        html: previewContent,
        confirmButtonText: 'Tutup',
        confirmButtonColor: '#1E3A8A',
        width: 650
      });
    }

    function triggerMigrateBase64ToDrive() {
      const canManage = currentUser && ['master admin', 'master_admin', 'admin tu', 'admintu'].includes((currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase());
      if (!canManage) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Dibatasi', 'Fitur migrasi berkas bukti Google Drive hanya dapat dijalankan oleh Master Admin atau Admin TU.', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      const pendaftaranList = appData.pendaftaran || [];
      const base64Count = pendaftaranList.filter(p => {
        const b = String(p['Bukti Foto'] || '').trim();
        return b && (b.startsWith('data:') || b.length > 200) && !b.startsWith('http');
      }).length;

      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Migrasi Bukti ke Google Drive',
        html: `<div class="text-left text-xs space-y-2 text-slate-600">
          <p>Sistem akan memindai Google Spreadsheet dan mengunggah semua bukti foto yang masih berformat Base64 ke folder Google Drive:</p>
          <div class="p-2.5 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-lg text-blue-950 font-bold font-mono">
            📁 Berkas Bukti Pendaftaran FEB UIKA
          </div>
          <p class="text-slate-500">Terdeteksi saat ini: <b class="text-amber-700">${base64Count} berkas base64</b> di memori.</p>
        </div>`,
        icon: 'question',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: '<i class="fab fa-google-drive mr-1"></i> Mulai Migrasi',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
        confirmButtonColor: '#d97706',
        cancelButtonColor: '#64748b'
      }).then(r => {
        if (!r.isConfirmed) return;

        Swal.fire({
          title: 'Memproses Migrasi...',
          html: '<p class="text-xs text-slate-600 mb-2">Sedang mengunggah berkas bukti ke Google Drive dan memperbarui link di Google Sheets...</p><i class="fas fa-circle-notch fa-spin text-amber-600 text-3xl"></i>',
          allowOutsideClick: false,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });

        const onMigrateSuccess = function(res) {
          if (res && res.success) {
            Swal.fire({
              title: 'Migrasi Selesai!',
              text: res.message || `Berhasil mengonversi berkas bukti ke Google Drive!`,
              icon: 'success',
              confirmButtonText: 'Segarkan Data',
              confirmButtonColor: '#1E3A8A'
            }).then(() => {
              loadAppData(true);
            });
          } else {
            Swal.fire('Gagal Migrasi', (res && res.message) || 'Terjadi kendala saat mengunggah ke Google Drive.', 'error');
          }
        };

        const onMigrateError = function(err) {
          Swal.fire('Error Migrasi', err?.message || String(err), 'error');
        };

        const migActor = getCurrentActorName();
        const migRole = getCurrentActorRole();
        if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy && google.script.run.migrateBase64ToDrive) {
          google.script.run
            .withSuccessHandler(onMigrateSuccess)
            .withFailureHandler(onMigrateError)
            .migrateBase64ToDrive(migActor, migRole);
        } else {
          callGasApi('migrateBase64ToDrive', [migActor, migRole], onMigrateSuccess, onMigrateError);
        }
      });
    }

    function isPendaftarValidForJadwal(p, jadwalItem) {
      if (!p || !jadwalItem) return false;
      const jProdi = String(jadwalItem['Kode Prodi'] || jadwalItem.kodeProdi || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const pProdi = String(p['Kode Prodi'] || p.kodeProdi || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (jProdi && pProdi && jProdi !== pProdi) return false;

      const jSem = String(jadwalItem.Semester || jadwalItem.semester || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const pSem = String(p.Semester || p.semester || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (jSem && pSem && jSem !== pSem) return false;

      const normKelas = (val) => {
        if (typeof normalizeClassNameClient === 'function') return normalizeClassNameClient(val).toLowerCase();
        return String(val || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toLowerCase();
      };
      const jKelas = normKelas(jadwalItem.Kelas || jadwalItem.kelas || '');
      const pKelas = normKelas(p.Kelas || p.kelas || '');
      if (jKelas && pKelas && jKelas !== pKelas) return false;

      const jMatkul = String(jadwalItem['Mata Kuliah'] || jadwalItem.mataKuliah || '').trim();
      if (!jMatkul) return true;

      if (typeof isCourseNameMatched === 'function') {
        if (typeof extractMataKuliahList === 'function') {
          const cList = extractMataKuliahList(p);
          if (cList.some(c => isCourseNameMatched(jMatkul, c.mataKuliah || c.nama || ''))) return true;
        }
        return isCourseNameMatched(jMatkul, p['Mata Kuliah'] || '');
      }
      const pMat = String(p['Mata Kuliah'] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const jMatLower = jMatkul.toLowerCase();
      return Boolean(pMat && (pMat.includes(jMatLower) || jMatLower.includes(pMat)));
    }

    function resolveJadwalPeserta(jadwalItem) {
      if (!jadwalItem || typeof jadwalItem !== 'object') {
        return { participants: [], namaMahasiswa: '-', npm: '-' };
      }

      const pendaftaranList = Array.isArray(appData && appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
      const participants = [];
      const seenKeys = new Set();

      const addParticipant = (rawNama, rawNpm) => {
        const nama = String(rawNama || '').trim();
        const npm = String(rawNpm || '').trim();
        if ((!nama || nama === '-') && (!npm || npm === '-')) return;
        const cleanNama = (nama && nama !== '-') ? nama : '';
        const cleanNpm = (npm && npm !== '-') ? npm : '';
        const dedupKey = `${cleanNpm.toLowerCase()}||${cleanNama.toLowerCase()}`;
        if (seenKeys.has(dedupKey)) return;
        seenKeys.add(dedupKey);
        participants.push({
          nama: cleanNama || '-',
          npm: cleanNpm || '-'
        });
      };

      const ketStr = String(jadwalItem.Keterangan || jadwalItem.keterangan || '').trim();

      // 1. Cek referensi ID Pendaftaran eksplisit ([ID: REG-...] atau pendaftarId) & VALIDASI Prodi/Semester/Kelas/Matkul
      const directPId = String(jadwalItem.pendaftarId || jadwalItem.pendaftaranId || '').trim();
      const regTagMatches = [...ketStr.matchAll(/\[id:\s*(reg-\d+)\]/gi)].map(m => m[1].trim());
      const candidateRegIds = [];
      if (directPId) candidateRegIds.push(directPId);
      regTagMatches.forEach(rid => {
        if (!candidateRegIds.some(x => x.toUpperCase() === rid.toUpperCase())) candidateRegIds.push(rid);
      });

      let validRegCount = 0;
      candidateRegIds.forEach(regId => {
        const pMatch = pendaftaranList.find(p => String(p.ID || p.id || '').trim().toUpperCase() === regId.toUpperCase());
        if (pMatch && isPendaftarValidForJadwal(pMatch, jadwalItem)) {
          validRegCount++;
          addParticipant(pMatch['Nama Mahasiswa'] || pMatch.nama || '', pMatch.NPM || pMatch.NIM || pMatch.npm || '');
        }
      });

      // 2. Ekstrak pola "Peserta: Nama (NPM: 123)" dari Keterangan & validasi jika ada di data Pendaftaran
      const pesertaRegex = /Peserta\s*:\s*([^\(\n\[]+?)\s*\(\s*(?:NPM|NIM)\s*:\s*([^)\n\]]+)\s*\)/gi;
      let pRegexMatch;
      while ((pRegexMatch = pesertaRegex.exec(ketStr)) !== null) {
        const tagNama = String(pRegexMatch[1] || '').trim();
        const tagNpm = String(pRegexMatch[2] || '').trim();
        const alreadyResolvedByName = participants.some(pt => pt.nama && tagNama && pt.nama.toLowerCase() === tagNama.toLowerCase());
        if (alreadyResolvedByName) continue;

        const identityCandidates = pendaftaranList.filter(p => {
          const pNpm = String(p.NPM || p.NIM || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          const pNama = String(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.nama || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          const npmOk = !tagNpm || tagNpm === '-' || pNpm === tagNpm.toLowerCase();
          const namaOk = !tagNama || tagNama === '-' || pNama === tagNama.toLowerCase();
          return npmOk && namaOk;
        });
        if (identityCandidates.length > 0) {
          if (identityCandidates.some(p => isPendaftarValidForJadwal(p, jadwalItem))) {
            addParticipant(tagNama, tagNpm);
          }
        } else if (validRegCount === 0) {
          addParticipant(tagNama, tagNpm);
        }
      }

      // 3. Cek properti langsung di objek jadwal (jika tersedia & belum terselesaikan)
      if (participants.length === 0) {
        const directNama = String(jadwalItem['Nama Mahasiswa'] || jadwalItem.namaMahasiswa || '').trim();
        const directNpm = String(jadwalItem.NPM || jadwalItem.NIM || jadwalItem.npm || '').trim();
        if (directNama || directNpm) {
          let resolvedNama = directNama;
          let resolvedNpm = directNpm;
          const identityMatches = pendaftaranList.filter(p => {
            const pNpm = String(p.NPM || p.NIM || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            const pNama = String(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.nama || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            const npmOk = !resolvedNpm || resolvedNpm === '-' || pNpm === resolvedNpm.toLowerCase();
            const namaOk = !resolvedNama || resolvedNama === '-' || pNama === resolvedNama.toLowerCase();
            return npmOk && namaOk;
          });
          if (identityMatches.length > 0) {
            const validDirect = identityMatches.find(p => isPendaftarValidForJadwal(p, jadwalItem));
            if (validDirect) {
              addParticipant(validDirect['Nama Mahasiswa'] || validDirect.nama || resolvedNama, validDirect.NPM || validDirect.NIM || resolvedNpm);
            }
          } else {
            addParticipant(resolvedNama, resolvedNpm);
          }
        }
      }

      // 4. Fallback otomatis untuk jadwal lama yang belum mencatat peserta di Keterangan:
      //    Cocokkan ke data Pendaftaran berdasarkan Prodi + Semester + Kelas + Mata Kuliah
      if (participants.length === 0 && pendaftaranList.length > 0) {
        const jJenis = String(jadwalItem['Jenis Ujian'] || jadwalItem['Jenis Layanan'] || jadwalItem.jenisUjian || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const baseMatches = pendaftaranList.filter(p => isPendaftarValidForJadwal(p, jadwalItem));

        let finalMatches = baseMatches;
        if (jJenis && baseMatches.length > 0) {
          const strictJenisMatches = baseMatches.filter(p => {
            const pJenis = String(p['Jenis Layanan'] || p.layanan || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            return !pJenis || pJenis === jJenis;
          });
          if (strictJenisMatches.length > 0) finalMatches = strictJenisMatches;
        }

        finalMatches.forEach(p => {
          addParticipant(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.nama || '', p.NPM || p.NIM || p.npm || '');
        });
      }

      if (participants.length === 0) {
        return { participants: [], namaMahasiswa: '-', npm: '-' };
      }

      return {
        participants,
        namaMahasiswa: participants.map(pt => pt.nama).join(', '),
        npm: participants.map(pt => pt.npm).join(', ')
      };
    }

    function prepareSheetRowsForViewerOrExport(sheetName, rows, isForExport = false) {
      if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) return [];
      const isJadwalSheet = sheetName === 'Jadwal_Ujian';
      const skipKeys = new Set(['mataKuliahList', '_id']);
      if (isJadwalSheet) {
        ['pendaftarId', 'pendaftaranId', 'npm', 'namaMahasiswa', 'Nama Mahasiswa', 'NPM'].forEach(k => skipKeys.add(k));
      }

      // Kumpulkan urutan kolom standar secara konsisten
      const baseKeys = [];
      const seenKey = new Set();
      rows.forEach(item => {
        if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return;
        Object.keys(item).forEach(k => {
          if (k.startsWith('__') || skipKeys.has(k) || seenKey.has(k)) return;
          if (isJadwalSheet && /^(?:Nama Mahasiswa|NPM)\s*\d*$/i.test(k.trim())) return;
          seenKey.add(k);
          baseKeys.push(k);
        });
      });

      const resolvedPesertaList = isJadwalSheet ? rows.map(item => resolveJadwalPeserta(item)) : [];
      const maxParticipants = isJadwalSheet
        ? Math.max(1, ...resolvedPesertaList.map(res => (res.participants || []).length))
        : 0;

      return rows.map((item, rowIdx) => {
        const rowObj = {};
        baseKeys.forEach(key => {
          let val = item && item[key] !== undefined && item[key] !== null ? item[key] : '';
          if (isForExport) {
            if (key === 'Bukti Foto' || key.toLowerCase().includes('bukti')) {
              const strVal = String(val).trim();
              if (strVal.startsWith('http://') || strVal.startsWith('https://')) {
                val = strVal;
              } else if (strVal.startsWith('data:') || strVal.length > 200) {
                val = '[Tersimpan di Sistem (Base64)]';
              } else if (!strVal) {
                val = '-';
              }
            } else if (['Paraf Image', 'TTD Image', 'Data Gambar'].includes(key)) {
              const strVal = String(val).trim();
              val = strVal.startsWith('data:image') ? '[Spesimen PNG Digital]' : (strVal || '-');
            } else if (typeof val === 'object') {
              try {
                val = JSON.stringify(val);
              } catch(e) {
                val = '';
              }
            }
          }
          rowObj[key] = val;
        });

        // Khusus Jadwal_Ujian: tambahkan kolom peserta berderet ke samping (Nama Mahasiswa 1, NPM 1, dst.) di paling kanan
        if (isJadwalSheet) {
          const participants = (resolvedPesertaList[rowIdx] && resolvedPesertaList[rowIdx].participants) || [];
          for (let i = 0; i < maxParticipants; i++) {
            const pSlot = participants[i];
            const colNum = i + 1;
            if (pSlot) {
              rowObj[`Nama Mahasiswa ${colNum}`] = String(pSlot.nama || '-');
              rowObj[`NPM ${colNum}`] = String(pSlot.npm || '-');
            } else if (i === 0 && participants.length === 0) {
              rowObj[`Nama Mahasiswa ${colNum}`] = '-';
              rowObj[`NPM ${colNum}`] = '-';
            } else {
              rowObj[`Nama Mahasiswa ${colNum}`] = '';
              rowObj[`NPM ${colNum}`] = '';
            }
          }
        }

        return rowObj;
      });
    }

    function syncDatabaseSheetSelectorAccess() {
      const select = document.getElementById('activeSheetSelector');
      if (!select) return;
      const allowStaffSheet = (typeof isMasterAdmin === 'function') && isMasterAdmin();
      const allowTrashSheet = (typeof canManagePendaftaranTrash === 'function') && canManagePendaftaranTrash();
      let staffOpt = select.querySelector('option[value="User_Staff"]');
      let trashOpt = select.querySelector('option[value="Sampah_Pendaftaran"]');

      if (!allowStaffSheet) {
        if (staffOpt) staffOpt.remove();
        if (select.value === 'User_Staff' || !select.value) select.value = 'Pendaftaran';
      } else if (!staffOpt) {
        staffOpt = document.createElement('option');
        staffOpt.value = 'User_Staff';
        staffOpt.textContent = 'User Staff';
        const mhsOpt = select.querySelector('option[value="User_Mahasiswa"]');
        if (mhsOpt) select.insertBefore(staffOpt, mhsOpt);
        else select.appendChild(staffOpt);
      }

      if (!allowTrashSheet) {
        if (trashOpt) trashOpt.remove();
        if (select.value === 'Sampah_Pendaftaran' || !select.value) select.value = 'Pendaftaran';
      } else if (!trashOpt) {
        trashOpt = document.createElement('option');
        trashOpt.value = 'Sampah_Pendaftaran';
        trashOpt.textContent = 'Sampah Pendaftaran';
        const jdwOpt = select.querySelector('option[value="Jadwal_Ujian"]');
        if (jdwOpt) select.insertBefore(trashOpt, jdwOpt);
        else select.appendChild(trashOpt);
      }
    }

    function renderSpreadsheetWorkbook() {
      syncDatabaseSheetSelectorAccess();
      const select = document.getElementById('activeSheetSelector');
      let sheetName = select ? select.value : 'Pendaftaran';
      if (sheetName === 'User_Staff' && !(typeof isMasterAdmin === 'function' && isMasterAdmin())) {
        sheetName = 'Pendaftaran';
        if (select) select.value = 'Pendaftaran';
      }
      if (sheetName === 'Sampah_Pendaftaran' && !(typeof canManagePendaftaranTrash === 'function' && canManagePendaftaranTrash())) {
        sheetName = 'Pendaftaran';
        if (select) select.value = 'Pendaftaran';
      }
      const thead = document.getElementById('spreadsheetGridHead');
      const tbody = document.getElementById('spreadsheetGridBody');
      const sumElem = document.getElementById('sheetFormulaSum');
      const btnMigrate = document.getElementById('btnMigrateDrive');
      const btnSyncJadwal = document.getElementById('btnSyncJadwalSheet');

      if (btnMigrate) {
        btnMigrate.style.display = (sheetName === 'Pendaftaran') ? '' : 'none';
      }
      if (btnSyncJadwal) {
        btnSyncJadwal.style.display = (sheetName === 'Jadwal_Ujian') ? '' : 'none';
      }

      if (!thead || !tbody) return;

      let rows = [];
      const master = appData.master || {};
      if (sheetName === 'Pendaftaran') rows = appData.pendaftaran || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Sampah_Pendaftaran') rows = appData.sampahPendaftaran || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Jadwal_Ujian') rows = appData.jadwal || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Ruangan') rows = master.ruangan || appData.ruangan || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'User_Staff') rows = appData.users_staff || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'User_Mahasiswa') rows = appData.users_mahasiswa || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Periode_Pendaftaran') rows = master.periode || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Prodi') rows = master.prodi || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Matkul') rows = master.matkul || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Kelas') rows = master.kelas || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Dosen') rows = master.dosen || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Tahun_Akademik') rows = master.tahunAkademik || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Surat_Pengantar') rows = appData.suratPengantar || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Spesimen_TTD') rows = appData.spesimenTtd || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Log_Aktivitas') rows = master.logs || appData.activityLogs || [];

      if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
        thead.innerHTML = '<tr><th class="p-3 text-center">Status</th></tr>';
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td class="p-6 text-center text-slate-400">Tidak ada baris data pada sheet ' + sheetName + '</td></tr>';
        if (sumElem) sumElem.innerText = 'Rp 0';
        return;
      }

      const displayRows = prepareSheetRowsForViewerOrExport(sheetName, rows, false);
      const keys = Object.keys(displayRows[0]);

      thead.innerHTML = '<tr><th class="p-2 border border-blue-800 bg-blue-950 text-center w-12 text-[10px]">#</th>' + 
        keys.map(k => `<th class="p-2 border border-blue-800 text-left whitespace-nowrap text-xs">${escapeHtml(k)}</th>`).join('') + '</tr>';

      let totalNominal = 0;
      const bodyHtml = displayRows.map((r, idx) => {
        let cells = `<td class="p-2 border border-slate-200 text-center text-slate-400 font-mono text-[10px]">${idx + 1}</td>`;
        keys.forEach(k => {
          let rawVal = r[k] !== undefined && r[k] !== null ? r[k] : '';
          let cellHtml = '';

          // Kolom khusus Bukti Foto atau Spesimen PNG
          if (k === 'Bukti Foto' || k.toLowerCase().includes('bukti')) {
            const strVal = String(rawVal).trim();
            if (strVal.startsWith('http://') || strVal.startsWith('https://')) {
              cellHtml = `<a href="${strVal}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 hover:bg-blue-100 font-bold border border-blue-200 text-xs">
                <i class="fab fa-google-drive text-emerald-600"></i> Buka Bukti Drive
              </a>`;
            } else if (strVal.startsWith('data:') || strVal.length > 200) {
              const rowIdSafe = String(r.ID || r.id || idx).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
              cellHtml = `<button type="button" onclick="previewBase64Bukti('${rowIdSafe}')" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 hover:bg-amber-100 font-semibold border border-amber-300 text-xs cursor-pointer">
                <i class="fas fa-image text-amber-600"></i> Lihat Foto (Base64)
              </button>`;
            } else if (strVal) {
              cellHtml = `<span class="text-slate-600">${escapeHtml(strVal)}</span>`;
            } else {
              cellHtml = `<span class="text-slate-400 italic text-[11px]">-</span>`;
            }
          } else if (['Paraf Image', 'TTD Image', 'Data Gambar'].includes(k)) {
            const strVal = String(rawVal).trim();
            if (strVal.startsWith('data:image/')) {
              cellHtml = `<img src="${strVal}" alt="${escapeHtml(k)}" class="h-8 max-w-[90px] object-contain bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded px-1">`;
            } else {
              cellHtml = `<span class="text-slate-400 italic text-[11px]">-</span>`;
            }
          } else if (['Mahasiswa JSON', 'Meta JSON'].includes(k)) {
            const strVal = String(rawVal || '');
            cellHtml = `<span class="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500">${escapeHtml(strVal.length > 64 ? strVal.slice(0, 64) + '...' : (strVal || '-'))}</span>`;
          } else if (typeof rawVal === 'number') {
            if (k.toLowerCase().includes('nominal') || k.toLowerCase().includes('biaya')) {
              totalNominal += rawVal;
              cellHtml = '<b>Rp ' + rawVal.toLocaleString('id-ID') + '</b>';
            } else {
              cellHtml = String(rawVal);
            }
          } else if (typeof rawVal === 'object') {
            try {
              cellHtml = escapeHtml(JSON.stringify(rawVal));
            } catch(e) {
              cellHtml = '';
            }
          } else {
            cellHtml = escapeHtml(String(rawVal));
          }

          cells += `<td class="p-2 border border-slate-200 whitespace-nowrap text-slate-800">${cellHtml}</td>`;
        });
        return `<tr class="hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium">${cells}</tr>`;
      }).join('');

      tbody.innerHTML = bodyHtml;
      if (sumElem) sumElem.innerText = 'Rp ' + totalNominal.toLocaleString('id-ID');
    }

    // Fungsi Fallback Unduh File Excel HTML/XML (.xls) Standar
    function downloadHtmlXls(sheetName, cleanRows, dateStr) {
      if (!cleanRows || cleanRows.length === 0) return;
      const headers = Object.keys(cleanRows[0]);
      const xlHtmlOpen = '<' + 'html xmlns:o="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office" xmlns:x="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:excel" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/TR/REC-html40">';
      const xlHeadOpen = '<' + 'head>';
      const xlMetaTag = '<' + 'meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8" />';
      const xlMsoStart = '<' + '!--[if gte mso 9]>';
      const xlMsoEnd = '<' + '![endif]-' + '->';
      const xlStyleOpen = '<' + 'style>';
      const xlStyleClose = '</' + 'style>';
      const xlHeadClose = '</' + 'head>';
      const xlBodyOpen = '<' + 'body>';
      const xlBodyClose = '</' + 'body>';
      const xlHtmlClose = '</' + 'html>';
      let tableHtml = `${xlHtmlOpen}
      ${xlHeadOpen}
        ${xlMetaTag}
        ${xlMsoStart}
        <xml>
          <x:ExcelWorkbook>
            <x:ExcelWorksheets>
              <x:ExcelWorksheet>
                <x:Name>${sheetName.slice(0, 31)}</x:Name>
                <x:WorksheetOptions><x:DisplayGridlines/></x:WorksheetOptions>
              </x:ExcelWorksheet>
            </x:ExcelWorksheets>
          </x:ExcelWorkbook>
        </xml>
        ${xlMsoEnd}
        ${xlStyleOpen}
          table { border-collapse: collapse; font-family: Calibri, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; }
          th { background-color: #1E3A8A; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: bold; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; padding: 6px; }
          td { border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; padding: 5px; }
        ${xlStyleClose}
      ${xlHeadClose}
      ${xlBodyOpen}
        <table>
          <tr>${headers.map(h => `<th>${h}</th>`).join('')}</tr>
          ${cleanRows.map(r => `<tr>${headers.map(h => {
            const v = r[h] !== undefined && r[h] !== null ? r[h] : '';
            return `<td>${String(v).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')}</td>`;
          }).join('')}</tr>`).join('')}
        </table>
      ${xlBodyClose}
      ${xlHtmlClose}`;

      const blob = new Blob([tableHtml], { type: 'application/vnd.ms-excel;charset=utf-8' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      const sheetLabel = sanitizeExportFileSegment(sheetName, 40, 'Data');
      const periodLabel = getExportAcademicPeriodLabel();
      a.download = `${sheetLabel} FEB UIKA ${periodLabel} ${dateStr}.xls`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.body.removeChild(a);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      }, 500);
    }

    // Fungsi Utama Ekspor Excel (.xlsx standar dengan fallback .xls)
    function exportActiveSheetExcel() {
      syncDatabaseSheetSelectorAccess();
      const select = document.getElementById('activeSheetSelector');
      const sheetName = select ? select.value : 'Pendaftaran';
      if (sheetName === 'User_Staff' && !(typeof isMasterAdmin === 'function' && isMasterAdmin())) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Dibatasi', 'Sheet User Staff hanya dapat diakses dan diekspor oleh Master Admin.', 'warning');
        return;
      }
      if (sheetName === 'Sampah_Pendaftaran' && !(typeof canManagePendaftaranTrash === 'function' && canManagePendaftaranTrash())) {
        Swal.fire('Akses Dibatasi', 'Sheet Sampah Pendaftaran hanya dapat diakses oleh Master Admin dan Admin TU.', 'warning');
        return;
      }
      let rows = [];
      const master = appData.master || {};
      if (sheetName === 'Pendaftaran') rows = appData.pendaftaran || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Sampah_Pendaftaran') rows = appData.sampahPendaftaran || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Jadwal_Ujian') rows = appData.jadwal || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Ruangan') rows = master.ruangan || appData.ruangan || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'User_Staff') rows = appData.users_staff || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'User_Mahasiswa') rows = appData.users_mahasiswa || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Periode_Pendaftaran') rows = master.periode || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Prodi') rows = master.prodi || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Matkul') rows = master.matkul || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Kelas') rows = master.kelas || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Dosen') rows = master.dosen || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Master_Tahun_Akademik') rows = master.tahunAkademik || [];
      else if (sheetName === 'Log_Aktivitas') rows = master.logs || appData.activityLogs || [];

      if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
        Swal.fire('Data Kosong', `Tidak ada data pada sheet ${sheetName} untuk diekspor.`, 'info');
        return;
      }

      const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const sheetLabel = sanitizeExportFileSegment(sheetName, 40, 'Data');
      const periodLabel = getExportAcademicPeriodLabel();
      const fileNameXlsx = `${sheetLabel} FEB UIKA ${periodLabel} ${dateStr}.xlsx`;

      // Sanitasi Data & pengayaan kolom peserta (Nama Mahasiswa, NPM di paling kanan untuk Jadwal_Ujian)
      const cleanRows = prepareSheetRowsForViewerOrExport(sheetName, rows, true);

      let exportedSuccess = false;

      // Coba Ekspor Format Modern .xlsx dengan SheetJS
      if (typeof XLSX !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          const ws = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(cleanRows);
          const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
          XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, sheetName.slice(0, 31));
          XLSX.writeFile(wb, fileNameXlsx);
          exportedSuccess = true;
          Swal.fire({
            title: 'Export Berhasil!',
            text: `Data sheet ${sheetName} (${cleanRows.length} baris) berhasil diekspor ke file Excel (.xlsx)!`,
            icon: 'success',
            timer: 2500,
            showConfirmButton: false
          });
          return;
        } catch (xlsxErr) {
          console.warn('SheetJS XLSX.writeFile gagal, menggunakan fallback .xls:', xlsxErr);
        }
      }

      // Fallback ke .xls (Microsoft Excel HTML Table Blob) jika SheetJS tidak tersedia atau gagal
      try {
        downloadHtmlXls(sheetName, cleanRows, dateStr);
        exportedSuccess = true;
        Swal.fire({
          title: 'Export Berhasil!',
          text: `Data sheet ${sheetName} (${cleanRows.length} baris) berhasil diekspor ke file Excel (.xls)!`,
          icon: 'success',
          timer: 2500,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
        return;
      } catch (xlsErr) {
        console.warn('Fallback .xls gagal, beralih ke CSV:', xlsErr);
      }

      // Fallback Terakhir: CSV UTF-8 dengan BOM
      try {
        const keys = Object.keys(cleanRows[0]);
        let csv = '\uFEFF' + keys.join(',') + '\n';
        cleanRows.forEach(r => {
          csv += keys.map(k => `"${String(r[k] !== undefined && r[k] !== null ? r[k] : '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(',') + '\n';
        });
        const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.href = url;
        link.download = `${sheetLabel} FEB UIKA ${periodLabel} ${dateStr}.csv`;
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        setTimeout(() => { document.body.removeChild(link); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 500);
        Swal.fire({
          title: 'Export Berhasil!',
          text: `Data sheet ${sheetName} (${cleanRows.length} baris) berhasil diekspor ke file CSV (.csv)!`,
          icon: 'success',
          timer: 2500,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
      } catch (csvErr) {
        Swal.fire('Gagal Export', 'Terjadi kesalahan peramban saat mengekspor data: ' + csvErr.message, 'error');
      }
    }

    function resolveDateTimeString(val, fallbackDateTime) {
      if (!val) return fallbackDateTime;
      if (val instanceof Date && !isNaN(val.getTime())) return val;
      const s = String(val).trim();
      if (!s || s === '-' || s === 'undefined' || s === 'null') return fallbackDateTime;

      // Jika sudah berformat lengkap Indonesia dengan Pukul ... WIB
      if (s.includes('WIB') && (s.includes('Pukul') || s.includes('pukul'))) return s;

      // Jika formatnya range parsial seperti "00:00 s/d 23:59" atau "00:00 s.d. 23:59" tanpa tahun
      if (s.toLowerCase().includes('s/d') || s.toLowerCase().includes('s.d.')) {
        if (!/\b(20\d\d)\b/.test(s)) {
          return fallbackDateTime;
        }
        return s;
      }

      // Jika hanya berupa jam (misal "00:00", "23:59", atau "00:00:00")
      if (/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}(:\d{2})?$/.test(s)) {
        const timePart = s.length === 5 ? s + ':00' : s;
        const datePart = (fallbackDateTime && typeof fallbackDateTime === 'string' ? fallbackDateTime.split(' ')[0] : '2026-11-15');
        return `${datePart} ${timePart}`;
      }

      // Jika tidak ada komponen tahun 20xx
      if (!/\b(20\d\d)\b/.test(s)) {
        return fallbackDateTime;
      }

      return s;
    }

    function formatIndonesianFullDateTime(val) {
      if (!val) return '';
      if (typeof val === 'string') {
        const clean = val.trim();
        if (clean.includes('WIB') && (clean.includes('Pukul') || clean.includes('pukul'))) {
          return clean;
        }
      }

      let d = null;
      if (val instanceof Date && !isNaN(val.getTime())) {
        d = val;
      } else if (typeof val === 'string') {
        const clean = val.trim();

        if (/[Zz]|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2}$/.test(clean)) {
          const tzDate = new Date(clean);
          if (!isNaN(tzDate.getTime())) d = tzDate;
        }

        if (!d) {
          const idMonthMap = {
            januari: 0, jan: 0,
            februari: 1, feb: 1,
            maret: 2, mar: 2,
            april: 3, apr: 3,
            mei: 4, may: 4,
            juni: 5, jun: 5,
            juli: 6, jul: 6,
            agustus: 7, agu: 7, ags: 7, aug: 7,
            september: 8, sep: 8,
            oktober: 9, okt: 9, oct: 9,
            november: 10, nov: 10,
            desember: 11, des: 11, dec: 11
          };

          // Format Indonesia: e.g. [Minggu,] 15 November 2026 [Pukul 00:00[:00]]
          const idMatch = clean.match(/^(?:[a-zA-Z]+,?\s+)?(\d{1,2})\s+([a-zA-Z]+)\s+(\d{4})(?:[^\d]+(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?)?/i);
          if (idMatch && idMonthMap[idMatch[2].toLowerCase()] !== undefined) {
            const day = parseInt(idMatch[1], 10);
            const m = idMonthMap[idMatch[2].toLowerCase()];
            const y = parseInt(idMatch[3], 10);
            const h = parseInt(idMatch[4] || '0', 10);
            const min = parseInt(idMatch[5] || '0', 10);
            const sec = parseInt(idMatch[6] || '0', 10);
            d = new Date(y, m, day, h, min, sec);
          } else {
            // Format YYYY-MM-DD atau YYYY/MM/DD
            const isoMatch = clean.match(/^(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})(?:[T\s](\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?)?$/);
            if (isoMatch) {
              const y = parseInt(isoMatch[1], 10);
              const m = parseInt(isoMatch[2], 10) - 1;
              const day = parseInt(isoMatch[3], 10);
              const h = parseInt(isoMatch[4] || '0', 10);
              const min = parseInt(isoMatch[5] || '0', 10);
              const sec = parseInt(isoMatch[6] || '0', 10);
              d = new Date(y, m, day, h, min, sec);
            } else {
              // Format DD-MM-YYYY atau DD/MM/YYYY
              const dmyMatch = clean.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{4})(?:[T\s](\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?)?$/);
              if (dmyMatch) {
                const day = parseInt(dmyMatch[1], 10);
                const m = parseInt(dmyMatch[2], 10) - 1;
                const y = parseInt(dmyMatch[3], 10);
                const h = parseInt(dmyMatch[4] || '0', 10);
                const min = parseInt(dmyMatch[5] || '0', 10);
                const sec = parseInt(dmyMatch[6] || '0', 10);
                d = new Date(y, m, day, h, min, sec);
              } else {
                const parsed = new Date(clean.replace(' ', 'T'));
                if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) d = parsed;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(val);

      const days = ['Minggu', 'Senin', 'Selasa', 'Rabu', 'Kamis', 'Jumat', 'Sabtu'];
      const months = ['Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni', 'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember'];

      const dayName = days[d.getDay()];
      const dateNum = d.getDate();
      const monthName = months[d.getMonth()];
      const year = d.getFullYear();
      const hours = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
      const minutes = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');

      return `${dayName}, ${dateNum} ${monthName} ${year} Pukul ${hours}:${minutes} WIB`;
    }

    function formatIndonesianDateTimeRange(startVal, endVal) {
      if (typeof startVal === 'string' && (startVal.includes(' s.d. ') || startVal.includes(' s/d '))) {
        return startVal.replace(/\s+s\/d\s+/gi, ' s.d. ');
      }
      const s = formatIndonesianFullDateTime(startVal);
      const e = formatIndonesianFullDateTime(endVal);
      if (s && e) return `${s} s.d. ${e}`;
      return s || e || '-';
    }

    function parsePeriodeDateTime(val, isEnd = false) {
      if (!val) return null;
      let d = null;
      if (val instanceof Date && !isNaN(val.getTime())) {
        d = new Date(val.getTime());
      } else {
        const clean = String(val).trim();
        if (!clean || clean === '-' || clean === 'undefined' || clean === 'null') return null;

        if (/[Zz]|[+-]\d{2}:?\d{2}$/.test(clean)) {
          const tzDate = new Date(clean);
          if (!isNaN(tzDate.getTime())) d = tzDate;
        }

        if (!d) {
          const idMonthMap = {
            januari: 0, jan: 0,
            februari: 1, feb: 1,
            maret: 2, mar: 2,
            april: 3, apr: 3,
            mei: 4, may: 4,
            juni: 5, jun: 5,
            juli: 6, jul: 6,
            agustus: 7, agu: 7, ags: 7, aug: 7,
            september: 8, sep: 8,
            oktober: 9, okt: 9, oct: 9,
            november: 10, nov: 10,
            desember: 11, des: 11, dec: 11
          };
          const idMatch = clean.match(/^(?:[a-zA-Z]+,?\s+)?(\d{1,2})\s+([a-zA-Z]+)\s+(\d{4})(?:[^\d]+(\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?)?/i);
          if (idMatch && idMonthMap[idMatch[2].toLowerCase()] !== undefined) {
            const day = parseInt(idMatch[1], 10);
            const m = idMonthMap[idMatch[2].toLowerCase()];
            const y = parseInt(idMatch[3], 10);
            const h = parseInt(idMatch[4] || (isEnd ? '23' : '0'), 10);
            const min = parseInt(idMatch[5] || (isEnd ? '59' : '0'), 10);
            const sec = parseInt(idMatch[6] || '0', 10);
            d = new Date(y, m, day, h, min, sec);
          } else {
            const isoMatch = clean.match(/^(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})(?:[T\s](\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?)?$/);
            if (isoMatch) {
              const y = parseInt(isoMatch[1], 10);
              const m = parseInt(isoMatch[2], 10) - 1;
              const day = parseInt(isoMatch[3], 10);
              const h = parseInt(isoMatch[4] || (isEnd ? '23' : '0'), 10);
              const min = parseInt(isoMatch[5] || (isEnd ? '59' : '0'), 10);
              const sec = parseInt(isoMatch[6] || '0', 10);
              d = new Date(y, m, day, h, min, sec);
            } else {
              const dmyMatch = clean.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{4})(?:[T\s](\d{1,2}):(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{1,2}))?)?$/);
              if (dmyMatch) {
                const day = parseInt(dmyMatch[1], 10);
                const m = parseInt(dmyMatch[2], 10) - 1;
                const y = parseInt(dmyMatch[3], 10);
                const h = parseInt(dmyMatch[4] || (isEnd ? '23' : '0'), 10);
                const min = parseInt(dmyMatch[5] || (isEnd ? '59' : '0'), 10);
                const sec = parseInt(dmyMatch[6] || '0', 10);
                d = new Date(y, m, day, h, min, sec);
              } else {
                const parsed = new Date(clean.replace(' ', 'T'));
                if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) d = parsed;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (!d || isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
      if (isEnd && d.getHours() === 23 && d.getMinutes() === 59 && d.getSeconds() === 0) {
        d.setSeconds(59, 999);
      }
      return d;
    }

    function normalizeJenisLayananName(val) {
      const raw = String(val || '').trim();
      const lower = raw.toLowerCase();
      if (!raw) return '';
      if (lower.includes('remedial')) return 'Remedial Teaching';
      if (lower.includes('uas')) return 'UAS Susulan';
      if (lower.includes('uts')) return 'UTS Susulan';
      return raw;
    }

    function doesPeriodMatchKategoriKelas(periodKategori, targetKategori) {
      const pk = String(periodKategori || '').toLowerCase().trim();
      const tk = String(targetKategori || '').toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!tk || tk === 'semua' || tk === 'reguler & karyawan' || (tk.includes('reguler') && tk.includes('karyawan'))) {
        return true;
      }
      if (!pk || pk === 'semua' || pk === 'reguler & karyawan' || (pk.includes('reguler') && pk.includes('karyawan'))) {
        return true;
      }
      if (tk.includes('karyawan')) return pk.includes('karyawan');
      if (tk.includes('reguler')) return pk.includes('reguler');
      return pk === tk;
    }

    function getActivePeriodsForCategory(targetKategori = '') {
      const periodes = (appData && appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.periode)) ? appData.master.periode : [];
      const activeOnly = periodes.filter(p => String(p.Status || p.status || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'aktif');
      if (!targetKategori) return activeOnly;
      return activeOnly.filter(p => doesPeriodMatchKategoriKelas(p['Kategori Kelas'] || p.kategoriKelas || '', targetKategori));
    }

    function findMatchingActivePeriod(layananVal = '', kategoriKelas = '') {
      const candidates = getActivePeriodsForCategory(kategoriKelas);
      if (candidates.length === 0) return null;
      const targetNorm = normalizeJenisLayananName(layananVal).toLowerCase();
      if (targetNorm) {
        const exact = candidates.find(p => normalizeJenisLayananName(p['Jenis Layanan']).toLowerCase() === targetNorm);
        if (exact) return exact;
      }
      return candidates[0];
    }

    function evaluatePeriodWindow(period, nowDate = new Date()) {
      if (!period) {
        return { state: 'NO_ACTIVE_PERIOD', canRegister: false, isLate: false, biayaDenda: 0, normalStart: null, normalEnd: null, lateStart: null, lateEnd: null, effectiveEnd: null };
      }
      const now = (nowDate instanceof Date && !isNaN(nowDate.getTime())) ? nowDate : new Date();
      const normalStart = parsePeriodeDateTime(period['Tanggal & Jam Mulai'] || period['Tanggal Mulai'], false);
      const normalEnd = parsePeriodeDateTime(period['Tanggal & Jam Selesai'] || period['Tanggal Selesai'], true);
      const lateStartRaw = parsePeriodeDateTime(period['Mulai Terlambat'], false);
      const lateEnd = parsePeriodeDateTime(period['Selesai Terlambat'], true);
      const lateStart = lateStartRaw || (lateEnd && normalEnd ? new Date(normalEnd.getTime() + 1) : null);

      const rawBiaya = period['Biaya Keterlambatan'] !== undefined
        ? period['Biaya Keterlambatan']
        : (period.Biaya !== undefined ? period.Biaya : (period.biaya !== undefined ? period.biaya : (period.denda !== undefined ? period.denda : 50000)));
      const biayaDenda = (rawBiaya !== '' && rawBiaya !== null && !isNaN(Number(rawBiaya))) ? Math.max(0, Number(rawBiaya)) : 0;

      const effectiveEnd = (lateEnd && (!normalEnd || lateEnd >= normalEnd)) ? lateEnd : normalEnd;

      if (normalStart && now < normalStart) {
        return { state: 'BEFORE_START', canRegister: false, isLate: false, biayaDenda, normalStart, normalEnd, lateStart, lateEnd, effectiveEnd };
      }
      if (normalEnd && now <= normalEnd) {
        return { state: 'NORMAL', canRegister: true, isLate: false, biayaDenda, normalStart, normalEnd, lateStart, lateEnd, effectiveEnd };
      }
      if (lateEnd && now <= lateEnd && (!lateStart || now >= lateStart)) {
        return { state: 'LATE', canRegister: true, isLate: true, biayaDenda, normalStart, normalEnd, lateStart, lateEnd, effectiveEnd };
      }
      if (!lateEnd && lateStart && now >= lateStart) {
        return { state: 'LATE', canRegister: true, isLate: true, biayaDenda, normalStart, normalEnd, lateStart, lateEnd, effectiveEnd };
      }
      if (normalEnd && lateStart && now > normalEnd && now < lateStart) {
        return { state: 'BETWEEN_NORMAL_AND_LATE', canRegister: false, isLate: false, biayaDenda, normalStart, normalEnd, lateStart, lateEnd, effectiveEnd };
      }
      if ((effectiveEnd && now > effectiveEnd) || (normalEnd && !lateEnd && now > normalEnd)) {
        return { state: 'CLOSED', canRegister: false, isLate: false, biayaDenda, normalStart, normalEnd, lateStart, lateEnd, effectiveEnd };
      }
      return { state: 'NORMAL', canRegister: true, isLate: false, biayaDenda, normalStart, normalEnd, lateStart, lateEnd, effectiveEnd };
    }

    function buildPeriodWindowPopupHtml(periodList, nowDate = new Date()) {
      if (!periodList || periodList.length === 0) {
        return '<p class="text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">Saat ini belum ada <b>Jadwal &amp; Periode Masa Pendaftaran Resmi</b> berstatus <b>Aktif</b> untuk kategori kelas Anda. Silakan hubungi Admin TU FEB UIKA.</p>';
      }
      const itemsHtml = periodList.map(p => {
        const evalRes = evaluatePeriodWindow(p, nowDate);
        const normalTxt = formatPeriodeWaktuLengkap(p['Tanggal & Jam Mulai'] || p['Tanggal Mulai'], p['Tanggal & Jam Selesai'] || p['Tanggal Selesai']);
        const lateTxt = p['Mulai Terlambat'] || p['Selesai Terlambat']
          ? formatPeriodeWaktuLengkap(p['Mulai Terlambat'], p['Selesai Terlambat'])
          : 'Tidak tersedia';
        const dendaTxt = `Rp ${Number(evalRes.biayaDenda || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}/mata kuliah`;
        const statusLabel = evalRes.state === 'BEFORE_START'
          ? '<span class="text-blue-700 font-bold">Belum Dibuka</span>'
          : (evalRes.state === 'BETWEEN_NORMAL_AND_LATE'
            ? '<span class="text-amber-700 font-bold">Menunggu Masa Terlambat</span>'
            : '<span class="text-rose-700 font-bold">Sudah Ditutup</span>');

        return `
          <div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-left space-y-1 text-xs">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <b class="text-slate-900">${escapeHtml(p['Jenis Layanan'] || '-')} (${escapeHtml(p.Semester || '')} ${escapeHtml(p['Tahun Akademik'] || '')})</b>
              ${statusLabel}
            </div>
            <p class="text-slate-600"><b>Jadwal Normal:</b> ${escapeHtml(normalTxt)}</p>
            <p class="text-slate-600"><b>Jadwal Terlambat:</b> ${escapeHtml(lateTxt)} (Denda: <b>${escapeHtml(dendaTxt)}</b>)</p>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
      return `<div class="space-y-2 mt-1">${itemsHtml}</div>`;
    }

    function checkMahasiswaRegistrationAccess(studentCategory = 'Reguler', nowDate = new Date(), specificLayanan = '') {
      const activePeriods = getActivePeriodsForCategory(studentCategory);
      if (activePeriods.length === 0) {
        return {
          allowed: false,
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Belum Ada Periode Aktif',
          message: 'Belum ada jadwal periode pendaftaran berstatus Aktif untuk kategori kelas Anda.',
          html: `<p class="text-xs text-slate-600 mb-2">Anda belum dapat mendaftar karena tidak terdapat periode pendaftaran berstatus <b>Aktif</b> untuk kategori kelas <b>${escapeHtml(studentCategory)}</b>.</p>`
        };
      }

      let targetPeriods = activePeriods;
      if (specificLayanan) {
        const targetNorm = normalizeJenisLayananName(specificLayanan).toLowerCase();
        const filtered = activePeriods.filter(p => normalizeJenisLayananName(p['Jenis Layanan']).toLowerCase() === targetNorm);
        if (filtered.length === 0) {
          return {
            allowed: false,
            icon: 'error',
            title: 'Layanan Tidak Tersedia',
            message: `Jenis layanan ${specificLayanan} sedang tidak aktif pada Jadwal & Periode Masa Pendaftaran Resmi.`,
            html: `<p class="text-xs text-slate-600 mb-2">Layanan <b>${escapeHtml(specificLayanan)}</b> sedang tidak dibuka untuk kategori kelas <b>${escapeHtml(studentCategory)}</b>.</p>` + buildPeriodWindowPopupHtml(activePeriods, nowDate)
          };
        }
        targetPeriods = filtered;
      }

      const openPeriods = targetPeriods.filter(p => evaluatePeriodWindow(p, nowDate).canRegister);
      if (openPeriods.length > 0) {
        return { allowed: true, openPeriods, activePeriods: targetPeriods };
      }

      const hasBeforeStart = targetPeriods.some(p => {
        const st = evaluatePeriodWindow(p, nowDate).state;
        return st === 'BEFORE_START' || st === 'BETWEEN_NORMAL_AND_LATE';
      });

      return {
        allowed: false,
        icon: hasBeforeStart ? 'info' : 'error',
        title: hasBeforeStart ? 'Belum Bisa Mendaftar' : 'Tidak Bisa Mendaftar (Ditutup)',
        message: hasBeforeStart
          ? 'Masa pendaftaran resmi belum dibuka. Silakan mendaftar sesuai tanggal jadwal resmi.'
          : 'Masa pendaftaran resmi (normal maupun terlambat) telah berakhir.',
        html: (hasBeforeStart
          ? '<p class="text-xs text-slate-700 mb-2">Pendaftaran saat ini <b>belum dibuka</b> karena masih berada di luar tanggal jadwal resmi berikut:</p>'
          : '<p class="text-xs text-slate-700 mb-2">Anda <b>tidak dapat mendaftar</b> karena masa pendaftaran resmi (jadwal normal dan masa terlambat) telah berakhir:</p>')
          + buildPeriodWindowPopupHtml(targetPeriods, nowDate)
      };
    }

    function syncActivePeriodBanner() {
      const list = (appData.master && appData.master.periode) || [];
      const isMhs = currentUser && (currentUser.role || '').toLowerCase() === 'mahasiswa';
      const studentCategory = isMhs
        ? detectCategoryFromClassClient(normalizeClassNameClient(currentUser.kelas || 'Reguler A'))
        : '';

      const activeCandidates = getActivePeriodsForCategory(studentCategory);
      const now = new Date();

      const rankState = (st) => {
        if (st === 'NORMAL') return 0;
        if (st === 'LATE') return 1;
        if (st === 'BEFORE_START') return 2;
        if (st === 'BETWEEN_NORMAL_AND_LATE') return 3;
        return 4;
      };

      const sortedActive = [...activeCandidates].sort((a, b) => {
        return rankState(evaluatePeriodWindow(a, now).state) - rankState(evaluatePeriodWindow(b, now).state);
      });
      const active = sortedActive[0] || null;

      const namaElem = document.getElementById('bannerPeriodeNama');
      const kelasElem = document.getElementById('bannerPeriodeKelas');
      const normalElem = document.getElementById('bannerJadwalNormal');
      const lateElem = document.getElementById('bannerJadwalTerlambat');
      const dendaElem = document.getElementById('bannerNominalDenda');
      const statusBadge = document.getElementById('bannerPeriodeStatusBadge');
      const windowNote = document.getElementById('bannerPeriodeWindowNote');

      if (!active) {
        const listTa = (appData && appData.master && appData.master.tahunAkademik) || [];
        const activeTa = listTa.find(t => String(t.Status || t.status || '').toLowerCase() === 'aktif') || listTa[0];
        const taTxt = activeTa ? (activeTa['Tahun Akademik'] || '2026/2027') : '2026/2027';
        if (namaElem) namaElem.innerText = `Belum Ada Layanan Aktif (${taTxt})`;
        if (kelasElem) kelasElem.innerText = studentCategory || 'Semua Kategori';
        if (normalElem) normalElem.innerText = '-';
        if (lateElem) lateElem.innerText = '-';
        if (dendaElem) dendaElem.innerText = 'Rp 0/mata kuliah';
        if (statusBadge) {
          statusBadge.innerText = 'TIDAK ADA PERIODE AKTIF';
          statusBadge.className = 'px-3 py-1 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 border border-slate-300';
        }
        if (windowNote) {
          windowNote.classList.remove('hidden');
          windowNote.className = 'text-[11px] font-bold pt-0.5 text-rose-700';
          windowNote.innerText = 'Pendaftaran saat ini belum dibuka karena belum ada jadwal periode berstatus Aktif.';
        }
        return;
      }

      const uniqueServices = [];
      sortedActive.forEach(p => {
        const nm = normalizeJenisLayananName(p['Jenis Layanan']);
        if (nm && !uniqueServices.includes(nm)) uniqueServices.push(nm);
      });

      if (namaElem) {
        const serviceLabel = uniqueServices.length > 1 ? uniqueServices.join(' & ') : (active['Jenis Layanan'] || 'UTS Susulan');
        namaElem.innerText = `${serviceLabel} (${active['Tahun Akademik'] || '2026/2027'})`;
      }

      if (kelasElem) {
        const rawKat = String(active['Kategori Kelas'] || active.kategoriKelas || '').trim();
        if (!rawKat || rawKat.toLowerCase() === 'semua' || (rawKat.toLowerCase().includes('reguler') && rawKat.toLowerCase().includes('karyawan'))) {
          kelasElem.innerText = 'Reguler & Karyawan';
        } else {
          kelasElem.innerText = rawKat;
        }
      }

      const startNormal = resolveDateTimeString(active['Tanggal & Jam Mulai'] || active['Tanggal Mulai'], '');
      const endNormal = resolveDateTimeString(active['Tanggal & Jam Selesai'] || active['Tanggal Selesai'], '');
      if (normalElem) normalElem.innerText = startNormal ? formatIndonesianDateTimeRange(startNormal, endNormal) : '-';

      const hasLateWindow = Boolean(active['Mulai Terlambat'] || active['Selesai Terlambat']);
      const startLate = resolveDateTimeString(active['Mulai Terlambat'], '');
      const endLate = resolveDateTimeString(active['Selesai Terlambat'], '');
      if (lateElem) lateElem.innerText = hasLateWindow ? formatIndonesianDateTimeRange(startLate, endLate) : 'Tidak ada masa terlambat';

      const evalRes = evaluatePeriodWindow(active, now);
      if (dendaElem) dendaElem.innerText = `Rp ${Number(evalRes.biayaDenda || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}/mata kuliah`;

      if (statusBadge && windowNote) {
        if (evalRes.state === 'NORMAL') {
          statusBadge.innerText = 'DIBUKA · JADWAL NORMAL';
          statusBadge.className = 'px-3 py-1 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300';
          windowNote.classList.remove('hidden');
          windowNote.className = 'text-[11px] font-bold pt-0.5 text-emerald-800';
          windowNote.innerText = 'Pendaftaran sedang dibuka pada Jadwal Normal (Bebas Denda).';
        } else if (evalRes.state === 'LATE') {
          statusBadge.innerText = 'TERLAMBAT · DENDA BERLAKU';
          statusBadge.className = 'px-3 py-1 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border border-amber-300';
          windowNote.classList.remove('hidden');
          windowNote.className = 'text-[11px] font-bold pt-0.5 text-amber-900';
          windowNote.innerText = `Pendaftaran masih dibuka pada Masa Terlambat dengan denda Rp ${Number(evalRes.biayaDenda || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}/mata kuliah.`;
        } else if (evalRes.state === 'BEFORE_START' || evalRes.state === 'BETWEEN_NORMAL_AND_LATE') {
          statusBadge.innerText = 'BELUM DIBUKA';
          statusBadge.className = 'px-3 py-1 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 border border-blue-300';
          windowNote.classList.remove('hidden');
          windowNote.className = 'text-[11px] font-bold pt-0.5 text-rose-700';
          const openStartStr = evalRes.state === 'BETWEEN_NORMAL_AND_LATE'
            ? formatIndonesianFullDateTime(active['Mulai Terlambat'])
            : formatIndonesianFullDateTime(active['Tanggal & Jam Mulai'] || active['Tanggal Mulai']);
          windowNote.innerText = `Belum bisa mendaftar: pendaftaran baru dibuka mulai ${openStartStr}.`;
        } else {
          statusBadge.innerText = 'PENDAFTARAN DITUTUP';
          statusBadge.className = 'px-3 py-1 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-300';
          windowNote.classList.remove('hidden');
          windowNote.className = 'text-[11px] font-bold pt-0.5 text-rose-700';
          windowNote.innerText = 'Tidak bisa mendaftar: batas akhir jadwal normal dan keterlambatan telah berakhir.';
        }
      }
    }

    function renderRuanganTable() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('tableRuanganBody');
      if (!tbody) return;
      const list = (appData.master && appData.master.ruangan) || appData.ruangan || [];
      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      if (list.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="p-3 text-center text-slate-400">Belum ada data master ruangan</td></tr>';
        return;
      }
      list.forEach(r => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        const id = r.ID || r.id || '';
        const kode = r['Kode Ruangan'] || r.Kode || r.kode || '';
        const nama = r['Nama Ruangan'] || r.Nama || r.nama || '';
        const kap = r.Kapasitas || r.kapasitas || 30;
        const gdg = r.Gedung || r.gedung || '-';
        const ket = r.Keterangan || r.keterangan || '-';

        tr.innerHTML = `
          <td class="p-2.5 font-mono font-bold text-blue-900">${kode}</td>
          <td class="p-2.5 font-bold text-slate-800">${nama}</td>
          <td class="p-2.5 text-center font-mono">${kap} Kursi</td>
          <td class="p-2.5 text-slate-600">${gdg} (${ket})</td>
          <td class="p-2.5 text-center">
            <button onclick="deleteRuanganItem('${kode}', '${id}')" class="text-rose-600 font-bold hover:underline">
              <i class="fas fa-trash"></i> Hapus
            </button>
          </td>
        `;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
      });
    }

    function handleSaveRuangan(e) {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      const payload = {
        kodeRuangan: document.getElementById('ruanganKodeInput').value.trim(),
        namaRuangan: document.getElementById('ruanganNamaInput').value.trim(),
        kapasitas: Number(document.getElementById('ruanganKapasitasInput').value) || 30,
        gedung: document.getElementById('ruanganGedungInput').value.trim(),
        keterangan: document.getElementById('ruanganKeteranganInput').value.trim(),
        actor: getCurrentActorName(),
        role: getCurrentActorRole()
      };

      const onSaveRuanganSuccess = res => {
        if (res && res.success) {
          resetRuanganForm();
          Swal.fire('Berhasil', res.message || 'Ruangan berhasil disimpan.', 'success');
          loadAppData();
        } else {
          Swal.fire('Gagal', res ? res.message : 'Gagal menyimpan ruangan.', 'error');
        }
      };
      const onSaveRuanganError = err => {
        Swal.fire('Error', err?.message || 'Gagal menghubungi server.', 'error');
      };

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(onSaveRuanganSuccess)
          .withFailureHandler(onSaveRuanganError)
          .addRuangan(payload);
      } else {
        callGasApi('addRuangan', [payload], onSaveRuanganSuccess, onSaveRuanganError);
      }
    }

    function resetRuanganForm() {
      const form = document.getElementById('formRuangan');
      if (form) form.reset();
      document.getElementById('ruanganEditId').value = '';
    }

    function deleteRuanganItem(kode, id) {
      const targetIdentifier = id || kode;
      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Hapus Ruangan ' + kode + '?',
        text: 'Data ruangan akan dihapus secara permanen dari sistem.',
        icon: 'warning',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Hapus',
        confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal'
      }).then(r => {
        if (r.isConfirmed) {
          const delActor = getCurrentActorName();
          const delRole = getCurrentActorRole();
          const onDelSuccess = res => {
            if (res && res.success) {
              Swal.fire('Terhapus', res.message || 'Ruangan berhasil dihapus.', 'success');
              loadAppData();
            } else {
              Swal.fire('Gagal', res ? res.message : 'Gagal menghapus ruangan.', 'error');
            }
          };
          const onDelError = err => {
            Swal.fire('Error', err?.message || 'Gagal menghubungi server.', 'error');
          };
          if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run && !window.google.__isProxy) {
            google.script.run
              .withSuccessHandler(onDelSuccess)
              .withFailureHandler(onDelError)
              .deleteRuangan(targetIdentifier, delActor, delRole);
          } else {
            callGasApi('deleteRuangan', [targetIdentifier, delActor, delRole], onDelSuccess, onDelError);
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function forceSyncRuanganFromSpreadsheet() {
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnSyncRuangan');
      if (btn) {
        btn.classList.add('opacity-75');
        const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
        if (icon) icon.classList.add('fa-spin');
      }

      const finishSync = (res) => {
        if (btn) {
          btn.classList.remove('opacity-75');
          const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
          if (icon) icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
        }
        loadAppData();
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'Sinkronisasi Selesai',
          text: 'Data Master Ruangan telah berhasil disinkronkan!',
          timer: 1800,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
      };

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(finishSync)
          .withFailureHandler(err => {
            if (btn) {
              btn.classList.remove('opacity-75');
              const icon = btn.querySelector('i');
              if (icon) icon.classList.remove('fa-spin');
            }
            loadAppData();
          })
          .clearAllCache();
      } else {
        setTimeout(finishSync, 300);
      }
    }

    function terbilangRupiah(angka) {
      angka = Math.floor(Math.abs(Number(angka) || 0));
      if (angka === 0) return 'Nol';
      const satuan = ['', 'Satu', 'Dua', 'Tiga', 'Empat', 'Lima', 'Enam', 'Tujuh', 'Delapan', 'Sembilan', 'Sepuluh', 'Sebelas'];
      function convert(n) {
        if (n < 12) return satuan[n];
        if (n < 20) return convert(n - 10) + ' Belas';
        if (n < 100) return convert(Math.floor(n / 10)) + ' Puluh ' + convert(n % 10);
        if (n < 200) return 'Seratus ' + convert(n - 100);
        if (n < 1000) return convert(Math.floor(n / 100)) + ' Ratus ' + convert(n % 100);
        if (n < 2000) return 'Seribu ' + convert(n - 1000);
        if (n < 1000000) return convert(Math.floor(n / 1000)) + ' Ribu ' + convert(n % 1000);
        if (n < 1000000000) return convert(Math.floor(n / 1000000)) + ' Juta ' + convert(n % 1000000);
        if (n < 1000000000000) return convert(Math.floor(n / 1000000000)) + ' Miliar ' + convert(n % 1000000000);
        return '';
      }
      return convert(angka).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

      const lower = String(status || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (lower === 'lunas') {
