    function parseInvoiceDateMs(rawDate) {
      if (!rawDate) return 0;
      if (rawDate instanceof Date && !isNaN(rawDate.getTime())) return rawDate.getTime();
      const str = String(rawDate).trim();
      if (!str || str === '-') return 0;

      // DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY (with optional time)
      const dmyMatch = str.match(/^(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{4})/);
      if (dmyMatch) {
        const day = parseInt(dmyMatch[1], 10);
        const month = parseInt(dmyMatch[2], 10) - 1;
        const year = parseInt(dmyMatch[3], 10);
        const dt = new Date(year, month, day);
        if (!isNaN(dt.getTime())) return dt.getTime();
      }

      // YYYY-MM-DD
      const ymdMatch = str.match(/^(\d{4})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})/);
      if (ymdMatch) {
        const dt = new Date(parseInt(ymdMatch[1], 10), parseInt(ymdMatch[2], 10) - 1, parseInt(ymdMatch[3], 10));
        if (!isNaN(dt.getTime())) return dt.getTime();
      }

      // Indonesian month names (e.g. 20 November 2026)
      const idMonths = {
        januari: 0, jan: 0, februari: 1, feb: 1, maret: 2, mar: 2, april: 3, apr: 3,
        mei: 4, juni: 5, jun: 5, juli: 6, jul: 6, agustus: 7, agu: 7, agust: 7,
        september: 8, sep: 8, oktober: 9, okt: 9, november: 10, nov: 10, desember: 11, des: 11
      };
      const idMatch = str.toLowerCase().match(/(\d{1,2})\s+([a-z]+)\s+(\d{4})/);
      if (idMatch && idMonths[idMatch[2]] !== undefined) {
        const dt = new Date(parseInt(idMatch[3], 10), idMonths[idMatch[2]], parseInt(idMatch[1], 10));
        if (!isNaN(dt.getTime())) return dt.getTime();
      }

      const parsed = Date.parse(str);
      return isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed;
    }

    function extractNumericIdTail(idVal) {
      const m = String(idVal || '').match(/(\d+)/g);
      return m ? parseInt(m[m.length - 1], 10) || 0 : 0;
    }

    function resolveInvoiceProdiCode(p) {
      const rawCode = String((p && (p['Kode Prodi'] || p.kodeProdi)) || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (rawCode && ['MNJ', 'AKT', 'BD', 'PI', 'PKD'].includes(rawCode)) return rawCode;
      const nameLower = String((p && (p['Program Studi'] || p.prodi)) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (nameLower.includes('manajemen')) return 'MNJ';
      if (nameLower.includes('akuntansi')) return 'AKT';
      if (nameLower.includes('bisnis digital')) return 'BD';
      if (nameLower.includes('perdagangan')) return 'PI';
      if (nameLower.includes('perbankan')) return 'PKD';
      return rawCode;
    }

    function readInvoiceToolbarControls() {
      const elSearch = document.getElementById('searchInvoice');
      const elStatus = document.getElementById('filterInvoiceStatus');
      const elLayanan = document.getElementById('filterInvoiceLayanan');
      const elProdi = document.getElementById('filterInvoiceProdi');
      const elSort = document.getElementById('sortInvoice');

      if (elSearch) invoiceToolbarState.search = String(elSearch.value || '').trim();
      if (elStatus) invoiceToolbarState.status = String(elStatus.value || '').trim();
      if (elLayanan) invoiceToolbarState.layanan = String(elLayanan.value || '').trim();
      if (elProdi) invoiceToolbarState.prodi = String(elProdi.value || '').trim();
      if (elSort) invoiceToolbarState.sort = String(elSort.value || 'tanggal-desc').trim() || 'tanggal-desc';
    }

    function syncInvoiceToolbarVisualControls() {
      const btnClear = document.getElementById('btnClearSearchInvoice');
      if (btnClear) {
        btnClear.classList.toggle('hidden', !invoiceToolbarState.search);
      }

      const isDirty = Boolean(
        invoiceToolbarState.search ||
        invoiceToolbarState.status ||
        invoiceToolbarState.layanan ||
        invoiceToolbarState.prodi ||
        (invoiceToolbarState.sort && invoiceToolbarState.sort !== 'tanggal-desc')
      );
      const btnReset = document.getElementById('btnResetInvoiceToolbar');
      if (btnReset) {
        btnReset.classList.toggle('hidden', !isDirty);
        btnReset.classList.toggle('inline-flex', isDirty);
      }

      const elStatusFilter = document.getElementById('filterInvoiceStatus');
      if (elStatusFilter) {
        const baseFilterClasses = 'w-full lg:w-auto min-w-0 border rounded-xl px-2.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 cursor-pointer transition';
        if (invoiceToolbarState.status) {
          elStatusFilter.className = `${baseFilterClasses} ${getInvoicePaymentSelectStyle(invoiceToolbarState.status)}`;
        } else {
          elStatusFilter.className = `${baseFilterClasses} border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-700`;
        }
      }

      // Sinkronkan indikator ikon sortir pada header kolom tabel
      const s = invoiceToolbarState.sort;
      const setIcon = (id, ascKey, descKey) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el) return;
        if (s === ascKey) {
          el.className = 'fas fa-sort-up text-[10px] text-blue-900';
        } else if (s === descKey) {
          el.className = 'fas fa-sort-down text-[10px] text-blue-900';
        } else {
          el.className = 'fas fa-sort text-[10px] text-slate-400';
        }
      };
      setIcon('sortIconInvId', 'invoice-asc', 'invoice-desc');
      setIcon('sortIconInvTanggal', 'tanggal-asc', 'tanggal-desc');
      setIcon('sortIconInvNama', 'nama-asc', 'nama-desc');
      setIcon('sortIconInvNominal', 'nominal-asc', 'nominal-desc');
    }

    function getFilteredSortedInvoiceList() {
      readInvoiceToolbarControls();
      const rawList = Array.isArray(appData && appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
      let list = rawList.slice();

      if (invoiceToolbarState.status) {
        const targetStatus = invoiceToolbarState.status.toLowerCase();
        list = list.filter(p => {
          const st = String(p['Status Pembayaran'] || 'Belum Bayar').trim().toLowerCase();
          if (targetStatus === 'gratis (tepat waktu)') return st.startsWith('gratis');
          if (targetStatus === 'belum bayar') return st.startsWith('belum bayar');
          return st === targetStatus;
        });
      }

      if (invoiceToolbarState.layanan) {
        const targetLayanan = (typeof normalizeJenisLayananName === 'function'
          ? normalizeJenisLayananName(invoiceToolbarState.layanan)
          : invoiceToolbarState.layanan
        ).toLowerCase();
        list = list.filter(p => {
          const rawLyn = p['Jenis Layanan'] || p.Layanan || '';
          const normLyn = (typeof normalizeJenisLayananName === 'function'
            ? normalizeJenisLayananName(rawLyn)
            : String(rawLyn)
          ).trim().toLowerCase();
          return normLyn === targetLayanan;
        });
      }

      if (invoiceToolbarState.prodi) {
        const targetProdi = invoiceToolbarState.prodi.toUpperCase();
        list = list.filter(p => resolveInvoiceProdiCode(p) === targetProdi);
      }

      if (invoiceToolbarState.search) {
        const tokens = invoiceToolbarState.search.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        list = list.filter(p => {
          const idStr = String(p.ID || '').trim();
          const haystack = [
            `INV-${idStr}`,
            idStr,
            p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.Nama || '',
            p.NPM || p.NIM || '',
            p['Kode Prodi'] || '',
            p['Program Studi'] || '',
            p['Jenis Layanan'] || p.Layanan || '',
            p['Mata Kuliah'] || '',
            p['Dosen Pengampu'] || '',
            p['Status Pembayaran'] || 'Belum Bayar',
            p.Tanggal || ''
          ].join(' ').toLowerCase();
          return tokens.every(tok => haystack.includes(tok));
        });
      }

      const sortKey = invoiceToolbarState.sort || 'tanggal-desc';
      list.sort((a, b) => {
        if (sortKey === 'tanggal-desc' || sortKey === 'tanggal-asc') {
          const diff = parseInvoiceDateMs(a.Tanggal) - parseInvoiceDateMs(b.Tanggal);
          if (diff !== 0) return sortKey === 'tanggal-desc' ? -diff : diff;
          const idDiff = extractNumericIdTail(a.ID) - extractNumericIdTail(b.ID);
          return sortKey === 'tanggal-desc' ? -idDiff : idDiff;
        }
        if (sortKey === 'nominal-desc' || sortKey === 'nominal-asc') {
          const diff = (Number(a.Nominal) || 0) - (Number(b.Nominal) || 0);
          return sortKey === 'nominal-desc' ? -diff : diff;
        }
        if (sortKey === 'nama-asc' || sortKey === 'nama-desc') {
          const cmp = String(a['Nama Mahasiswa'] || a.Nama || '').localeCompare(String(b['Nama Mahasiswa'] || b.Nama || ''), 'id');
          return sortKey === 'nama-asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
        }
        if (sortKey === 'invoice-asc' || sortKey === 'invoice-desc') {
          const cmp = String(a.ID || '').localeCompare(String(b.ID || ''), 'id', { numeric: true });
          return sortKey === 'invoice-asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
        }
        return 0;
      });

      return list;
    }

    function updateInvoiceSummaryCards(filteredList) {
      const list = Array.isArray(filteredList) ? filteredList : [];
      const totalCount = list.length;
      const lunasCount = list.filter(p => String(p['Status Pembayaran'] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'lunas').length;
      const belumBayarCount = list.filter(p => {
        const s = String(p['Status Pembayaran'] || 'Belum Bayar').trim().toLowerCase();
        return s !== 'lunas' && !s.startsWith('gratis');
      }).length;
      const totalNominal = list.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (Number(p.Nominal) || 0), 0);

      const elTotal = document.getElementById('invTotalCount');
      const elLunas = document.getElementById('invLunasCount');
      const elBelum = document.getElementById('invBelumBayarCount');
      const elNominal = document.getElementById('invTotalNominal');

      if (elTotal) elTotal.innerText = totalCount;
      if (elLunas) elLunas.innerText = lunasCount;
      if (elBelum) elBelum.innerText = belumBayarCount;
      if (elNominal) elNominal.innerText = 'Rp ' + totalNominal.toLocaleString('id-ID');
    }

    function buildInvoiceTableRow(p) {
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.className = 'hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition align-top';

      const idRaw = String(p.ID || '').trim();
      const idAttr = escapeHtml(idRaw).replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
      const nominal = Number(p.Nominal) || 0;
      const statusBayar = normalizePaymentStatusLabel(p['Status Pembayaran'], nominal);
      const canEdit = canEditInvoicePaymentStatus();
      const kodeProdi = String(p['Kode Prodi'] || '-').trim() || '-';
      const namaProdi = String(p['Program Studi'] || '-').trim() || '-';
      const layananStr = String(p['Jenis Layanan'] || p.Layanan || '-').trim() || '-';

      const standardStatuses = ['Belum Bayar', 'Lunas', 'Gratis (Tepat Waktu)'];
      const hasExactMatch = standardStatuses.some(opt => opt.toLowerCase() === statusBayar.toLowerCase());
      const optionsHtml = [
        ...(hasExactMatch ? [] : [statusBayar]),
        ...standardStatuses
      ].map(opt => {
        const isSelected = opt.toLowerCase() === statusBayar.toLowerCase();
        const optStyleClass = getInvoicePaymentBadgeStyle(opt);
        return `<option value="${escapeHtml(opt)}" class="${optStyleClass} font-semibold" ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}>${escapeHtml(opt)}</option>`;
      }).join('');

      const statusCellHtml = canEdit
        ? `<select aria-label="Status Pembayaran INV-${escapeHtml(idRaw)}" data-invoice-id="${escapeHtml(idRaw)}" onchange="handleInlineInvoiceStatusChange('${idAttr}', this.value, this)" class="w-full max-w-[126px] text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg px-1.5 py-1.5 border cursor-pointer focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 transition truncate ${getInvoicePaymentSelectStyle(statusBayar)}">${optionsHtml}</select>`
        : `<span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] uppercase font-bold border break-words ${getInvoicePaymentBadgeStyle(statusBayar)}">${escapeHtml(statusBayar)}</span>`;

      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td class="px-2.5 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <div class="font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 text-[11px] leading-snug break-all tabular-nums">INV-${escapeHtml(idRaw)}</div>
          <div class="font-mono text-slate-400 text-[10px] leading-snug tabular-nums mt-0.5">${escapeHtml(p.Tanggal || '-')}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="px-2.5 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <b class="text-slate-800 block text-xs leading-snug break-words">${escapeHtml(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.Nama || '-')}</b>
          <div class="font-mono text-slate-500 text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] leading-snug tabular-nums mt-0.5 break-all">
            ${escapeHtml(p.NPM || p.NIM || '-')}
            <span class="lg:hidden font-sans font-bold text-slate-600"> · [${escapeHtml(kodeProdi)}]</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sm:hidden text-[10px] text-slate-500 leading-snug mt-0.5 truncate">${escapeHtml(layananStr)}</div>
        </td>
        <td class="hidden lg:table-cell px-2.5 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <span class="font-bold text-slate-700 block text-[11px] leading-snug">[${escapeHtml(kodeProdi)}]</span>
          <span class="text-slate-500 text-[11px] leading-snug break-words block">${escapeHtml(namaProdi)}</span>
        </td>
        <td class="hidden sm:table-cell px-2.5 py-2.5 min-w-0">
          <span class="font-semibold text-slate-800 block text-xs leading-snug">${escapeHtml(layananStr)}</span>
          <span class="text-slate-500 text-[11px] leading-snug line-clamp-2 break-words mt-0.5">${escapeHtml(p['Mata Kuliah'] || '-')}</span>
        </td>
        <td class="px-2.5 py-2.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700 text-[11px] sm:text-xs tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">
          Rp ${nominal.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
        </td>
        <td class="px-2 py-2.5 text-center min-w-0">
          ${statusCellHtml}
        </td>
        <td class="px-2 py-2.5 text-center">
          <div class="flex flex-col gap-1 items-stretch max-w-[82px] mx-auto">
            <button type="button" onclick="openInvoiceModal('${idAttr}')" title="Cetak Kwitansi Bukti Pembayaran Resmi" class="bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-xs transition whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer">
              <i class="fas fa-receipt text-[10px]" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span>Kwitansi</span>
            </button>
            <button type="button" onclick="openLateInvoiceModal('${idAttr}')" title="Cetak Invoice Tagihan Resmi" class="bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-xs transition whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer">
              <i class="fas fa-file-invoice text-[10px]" aria-hidden="true"></i> <span>Invoice</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </td>
      `;
      return tr;
    }

    function updateInvoiceSentinelAndCounts(renderedCount, totalFilteredCount) {
      const totalAll = Array.isArray(appData && appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran.length : 0;
      const countEl = document.getElementById('invoiceToolbarCountInfo');
      if (countEl) {
        if (totalFilteredCount === 0) {
          countEl.innerText = `Menampilkan 0 dari ${totalAll} dokumen`;
        } else {
          const suffix = totalFilteredCount !== totalAll ? ` (tersaring dari ${totalAll} total)` : '';
          countEl.innerText = `Menampilkan ${renderedCount} dari ${totalFilteredCount} dokumen${suffix}`;
        }
      }

      const sentinel = document.getElementById('invoiceInfiniteSentinel');
      if (!sentinel) return;

      if (totalFilteredCount === 0) {
        sentinel.classList.add('hidden');
        sentinel.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }

      sentinel.classList.remove('hidden');
      const remaining = totalFilteredCount - renderedCount;
      if (remaining > 0) {
        sentinel.innerHTML = `
          <span class="text-slate-500">Menampilkan <b class="text-slate-700 tabular-nums">${renderedCount}</b> dari <b class="text-slate-700 tabular-nums">${totalFilteredCount}</b> dokumen · Gulir ke bawah untuk memuat berikutnya</span>
          <button type="button" onclick="loadMoreInvoiceRows()" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-blue-900 font-bold text-[11px] transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap shrink-0">Muat +${Math.min(INVOICE_BATCH_SIZE, remaining)}</button>
        `;
      } else {
        sentinel.innerHTML = `<span class="text-slate-400">Seluruh <b class="text-slate-600 tabular-nums">${totalFilteredCount}</b> dokumen telah ditampilkan</span>`;
      }
    }

    function setupInvoiceInfiniteScroll() {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('invoiceTableScrollWrap');
      const sentinel = document.getElementById('invoiceInfiniteSentinel');
      if (!wrap || !sentinel || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;

      if (invoiceInfiniteObserver) {
        invoiceInfiniteObserver.disconnect();
      }
      invoiceInfiniteObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        if (entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting)) {
          loadMoreInvoiceRows();
        }
      }, {
        root: wrap,
        rootMargin: '120px'
      });
      invoiceInfiniteObserver.observe(sentinel);
    }

    function handleInvoiceScrollCheck() {
      const wrap = document.getElementById('invoiceTableScrollWrap');
      if (!wrap) return;
      const distanceFromBottom = wrap.scrollHeight - wrap.scrollTop - wrap.clientHeight;
      if (distanceFromBottom <= 120) {
        loadMoreInvoiceRows();
      }
    }

    function loadMoreInvoiceRows() {
      const total = invoiceFilteredCache.length;
      if (invoiceToolbarState.visibleCount >= total) return;

      const tbody = document.getElementById('tableInvoiceBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      const startIdx = invoiceToolbarState.visibleCount;
      const nextCount = Math.min(total, startIdx + INVOICE_BATCH_SIZE);
      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = startIdx; i < nextCount; i++) {
        frag.appendChild(buildInvoiceTableRow(invoiceFilteredCache[i]));
      }
      tbody.appendChild(frag);
      invoiceToolbarState.visibleCount = nextCount;
      updateInvoiceSentinelAndCounts(nextCount, total);
    }

    function handleInvoiceToolbarChange(resetScroll = true) {
      readInvoiceToolbarControls();
      invoiceToolbarState.visibleCount = INVOICE_BATCH_SIZE;
      renderInvoiceTable({ preserveScroll: !resetScroll });
    }

    function clearInvoiceSearch() {
      const input = document.getElementById('searchInvoice');
      if (input) {
        input.value = '';
        input.focus();
      }
      handleInvoiceToolbarChange(true);
    }

    function resetInvoiceToolbar() {
      const elSearch = document.getElementById('searchInvoice');
      const elStatus = document.getElementById('filterInvoiceStatus');
      const elLayanan = document.getElementById('filterInvoiceLayanan');
      const elProdi = document.getElementById('filterInvoiceProdi');
      const elSort = document.getElementById('sortInvoice');

      if (elSearch) elSearch.value = '';
      if (elStatus) elStatus.value = '';
      if (elLayanan) elLayanan.value = '';
      if (elProdi) elProdi.value = '';
      if (elSort) elSort.value = 'tanggal-desc';

      invoiceToolbarState.search = '';
      invoiceToolbarState.status = '';
      invoiceToolbarState.layanan = '';
      invoiceToolbarState.prodi = '';
      invoiceToolbarState.sort = 'tanggal-desc';
      invoiceToolbarState.visibleCount = INVOICE_BATCH_SIZE;

      renderInvoiceTable({ preserveScroll: false });
    }

    function toggleInvoiceColumnSort(col) {
      readInvoiceToolbarControls();
      const curr = invoiceToolbarState.sort;
      let next = 'tanggal-desc';
      if (col === 'tanggal') next = curr === 'tanggal-desc' ? 'tanggal-asc' : 'tanggal-desc';
      else if (col === 'nominal') next = curr === 'nominal-desc' ? 'nominal-asc' : 'nominal-desc';
      else if (col === 'nama') next = curr === 'nama-asc' ? 'nama-desc' : 'nama-asc';
      else if (col === 'invoice') next = curr === 'invoice-asc' ? 'invoice-desc' : 'invoice-asc';

      const elSort = document.getElementById('sortInvoice');
      if (elSort) {
        if (next === 'invoice-desc' && !elSort.querySelector('option[value="invoice-desc"]')) {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = 'invoice-desc';
          opt.text = 'No. Invoice Z–A';
          elSort.appendChild(opt);
        }
        elSort.value = next;
      }
      invoiceToolbarState.sort = next;
      handleInvoiceToolbarChange(true);
    }

    function handleInlineInvoiceStatusChange(id, newStatus, selectEl) {
      if (!canEditInvoicePaymentStatus()) {
        if (selectEl) {
          const existing = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID).trim() === String(id).trim());
          if (existing) selectEl.value = normalizePaymentStatusLabel(existing['Status Pembayaran'], existing.Nominal);
        }
        Swal.fire('Akses Ditolak', 'Hanya Admin TU atau Master Admin yang dapat mengubah status pembayaran.', 'warning');
        return;
      }

      const item = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(p => String(p.ID).trim() === String(id).trim());
      if (!item) return;

      const prevStatus = normalizePaymentStatusLabel(item['Status Pembayaran'], item.Nominal);
      if (prevStatus.toLowerCase() === String(newStatus || '').trim().toLowerCase()) return;

      const baseSelectClasses = 'w-full max-w-[126px] text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-bold rounded-lg px-1.5 py-1.5 border cursor-pointer focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900 transition truncate';
      item['Status Pembayaran'] = newStatus;
      if (selectEl) {
        selectEl.disabled = true;
        selectEl.className = `${baseSelectClasses} opacity-75 cursor-wait ${getInvoicePaymentSelectStyle(newStatus)}`;
      }
      if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
      updateInvoiceSummaryCards(getFilteredSortedInvoiceList());
      if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable();
      if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();

      const actorName = typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function' ? getCurrentActorName() : '';
      const actorRole = typeof getCurrentActorRole === 'function' ? getCurrentActorRole() : '';

      const rollbackInlineStatus = (errMsg) => {
        item['Status Pembayaran'] = prevStatus;
        if (selectEl) {
          selectEl.value = prevStatus;
          selectEl.disabled = false;
          selectEl.className = `${baseSelectClasses} ${getInvoicePaymentSelectStyle(prevStatus)}`;
        }
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        updateInvoiceSummaryCards(getFilteredSortedInvoiceList());
        if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable();
        if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
        Swal.fire('Gagal Memperbarui Status', errMsg || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat menyimpan status pembayaran ke server.', 'error');
      };

      const onComplete = (res) => {
        if (res && res.success === false) {
          rollbackInlineStatus(res.message);
          return;
        }
        if (selectEl) {
          selectEl.disabled = false;
          selectEl.className = `${baseSelectClasses} ${getInvoicePaymentSelectStyle(newStatus)}`;
        }
        if (typeof saveAppDataCache === 'function') saveAppDataCache(appData);
        updateInvoiceSummaryCards(getFilteredSortedInvoiceList());
        if (typeof renderPendaftaranTable === 'function') renderPendaftaranTable();
        if (typeof renderExecutiveDashboard === 'function') renderExecutiveDashboard();
        // Jika filter status aktif dan item tidak lagi cocok, sinkronkan ulang tanpa reset posisi scroll
        if (invoiceToolbarState.status) {
          renderInvoiceTable({ preserveScroll: true });
        }
        Swal.fire({
          toast: true,
          position: 'top-end',
          icon: 'success',
          title: `INV-${id} diperbarui: ${newStatus}`,
          showConfirmButton: false,
          timer: 1800,
          timerProgressBar: true
        });
      };

      const onError = (err) => {
        rollbackInlineStatus((err && err.message) || String(err || 'Koneksi ke server gagal.'));
      };

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(onComplete)
          .withFailureHandler(onError)
          .updateStatusPayment(id, newStatus, '', actorName, actorRole);
      } else if (typeof callGasApi === 'function') {
        callGasApi('updateStatusPayment', [id, newStatus, '', actorName, actorRole], onComplete, onError);
      } else {
        onComplete({ success: true });
      }
    }

    function renderInvoiceTable(opts = {}) {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('tableInvoiceBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      const wrap = document.getElementById('invoiceTableScrollWrap');
      const prevScrollTop = (opts && opts.preserveScroll && wrap) ? wrap.scrollTop : 0;

      const filtered = getFilteredSortedInvoiceList();
      invoiceFilteredCache = filtered;
      syncInvoiceToolbarVisualControls();
      updateInvoiceSummaryCards(filtered);

      const allCount = Array.isArray(appData && appData.pendaftaran) ? appData.pendaftaran.length : 0;
      tbody.innerHTML = '';

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        updateInvoiceSentinelAndCounts(0, 0);
        if (allCount === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 font-medium">Belum ada dokumen invoice atau kwitansi yang tercatat.</td></tr>';
        } else {
          tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="p-8 text-center text-slate-500">
            <div class="space-y-2">
              <p class="font-semibold text-slate-600">Tidak ada dokumen invoice atau kwitansi yang sesuai dengan pencarian atau filter.</p>
              <button type="button" onclick="resetInvoiceToolbar()" class="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer">Reset Filter</button>
            </div>
          </td></tr>`;
        }
        return;
      }

      const targetVisible = Math.min(
        filtered.length,
        Math.max(INVOICE_BATCH_SIZE, invoiceToolbarState.visibleCount || INVOICE_BATCH_SIZE)
      );
      invoiceToolbarState.visibleCount = targetVisible;

      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (let i = 0; i < targetVisible; i++) {
        frag.appendChild(buildInvoiceTableRow(filtered[i]));
      }
      tbody.appendChild(frag);
      updateInvoiceSentinelAndCounts(targetVisible, filtered.length);
      setupInvoiceInfiniteScroll();

      if (wrap) {
        wrap.scrollTop = opts && opts.preserveScroll ? prevScrollTop : 0;
      }
    }

    function openInvoiceModal(id) {
      const list = appData.pendaftaran || [];
      const item = list.find(p => String(p.ID) === String(id));
      if (!item) {
        Swal.fire('Data Tidak Ditemukan', 'Dokumen tidak ditemukan dalam database.', 'error');
        return;
      }

      const nominal = Number(item.Nominal) || 0;
      const statusBayar = normalizePaymentStatusLabel(item['Status Pembayaran'] || 'Lunas', nominal);
      const isLunas = statusBayar.toLowerCase() === 'lunas';

      // Set value ke elemen modal Kwitansi
      const elNo = document.getElementById('invModalNo');
      const elNama = document.getElementById('invModalNama');
      const elNim = document.getElementById('invModalNim');
      const elProdi = document.getElementById('invModalProdi');
      const elKelas = document.getElementById('invModalKelas');
      const elLayanan = document.getElementById('invModalLayanan');
      const elMatkul = document.getElementById('invModalMatkul');
      const elTerbilang = document.getElementById('invModalTerbilang');
      const elStatus = document.getElementById('invModalStatus');
      const elNominal = document.getElementById('invModalNominal');
      const elTgl = document.getElementById('invModalTglCetak');

      if (elNo) elNo.innerText = 'NO: KWT-FEB/2026/INV-' + item.ID;
      if (elNama) elNama.innerText = item['Nama Mahasiswa'] || item.Nama || '-';
      if (elNim) elNim.innerText = item.NPM || item.NIM || '-';
      if (elProdi) elProdi.innerText = '[' + (item['Kode Prodi'] || '-') + '] ' + (item['Program Studi'] || '-');
      if (elKelas) elKelas.innerText = (item.Semester || 'Semester 3') + ' · ' + (item.Kelas || 'Reguler');
      if (elLayanan) elLayanan.innerText = item['Jenis Layanan'] || item.Layanan || '-';
      if (elMatkul) {
        if (Array.isArray(item.mataKuliahList) && item.mataKuliahList.length > 0) {
          elMatkul.innerHTML = item.mataKuliahList.map((m, idx) => {
            const num = item.mataKuliahList.length > 1 ? `${idx + 1}. ` : '';
            const remedialNote = m.nilaiHuruf ? ` <span class="font-bold text-indigo-700">[Nilai Asal: ${m.nilaiHuruf}]</span>` : '';
            const dosenLaluNote = m.dosenLalu ? `<div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 italic pl-3">Dosen Saat Mengambil: ${escapeHtml(m.dosenLalu)}</div>` : '';
            return `<div class="mb-1">${num}<b>${escapeHtml(m.nama || m.mataKuliah || '')}</b> (${m.sks || 3} SKS)${remedialNote}${dosenLaluNote}</div>`;
          }).join('');
        } else {
          elMatkul.innerText = item['Mata Kuliah'] || '-';
        }
      }
      if (elTerbilang) elTerbilang.innerText = terbilangRupiah(nominal) + ' Rupiah';
      if (elStatus) {
        elStatus.innerText = statusBayar.toUpperCase();
        elStatus.className = 'px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] uppercase font-bold ' + (isLunas ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300');
      }
      if (elNominal) elNominal.innerText = 'Rp ' + nominal.toLocaleString('id-ID');
      if (elTgl) {
        const today = new Date();
        const opts = { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' };
        elTgl.innerText = today.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', opts);
      }

      // Atur printable-active
      const printInv = document.getElementById('printableInvoiceModal');
      const printLate = document.getElementById('printableLateInvoiceModal');
      if (printInv) printInv.classList.add('printable-active');
      if (printLate) printLate.classList.remove('printable-active');

      const modal = document.getElementById('modalPrintInvoice');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        modal.classList.add('flex');
      }
    }

    function closeInvoiceModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalPrintInvoice');
      if (modal) {

        modal.classList.remove('flex');
      }
      const printInv = document.getElementById('printableInvoiceModal');
      if (printInv) printInv.classList.remove('printable-active');
    }

    function formatExportPdfCoursesHtml(p) {
      const entries = [];
      if (Array.isArray(p.mataKuliahList) && p.mataKuliahList.length > 0) {
        p.mataKuliahList.forEach(m => {
          const baseName = String((m && (m.nama || m.mataKuliah)) || '').trim();
          if (!baseName) return;
          const sksVal = Number(m && m.sks ? m.sks : 0);
          const hasSksLabel = /\(\s*\d+\s*SKS\s*\)/i.test(baseName);
          const text = sksVal > 0 && !hasSksLabel ? `${baseName} (${sksVal} SKS)` : baseName;
          const nilai = String((m && m.nilaiHuruf) || '').trim();
          entries.push({ text, nilai });
        });
      }

      if (entries.length === 0) {
        const raw = String(p['Mata Kuliah'] || '').trim();
        if (raw && raw !== '-') {
          const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/);
          lines.forEach(line => {
            const trimmedLine = line.trim();
            if (!trimmedLine) return;
            const splitInline = trimmedLine.split(/(?=(?:^|\s)\d+\.\s+)/);
            splitInline.forEach(part => {
              const cleaned = part.trim().replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '').trim();
              if (cleaned) entries.push({ text: cleaned, nilai: '' });
            });
          });
        }
      }

      if (entries.length === 0) {
        return '<span class="text-slate-400">-</span>';
      }

      if (entries.length === 1) {
        const only = entries[0];
        const nilaiHtml = only.nilai
          ? ` <span class="text-[9.5px] font-bold text-indigo-800">[Nilai: ${escapeHtml(only.nilai)}]</span>`
          : '';
        return `<div class="leading-snug text-slate-800 font-medium break-words">${escapeHtml(only.text)}${nilaiHtml}</div>`;
      }

      return `<div class="space-y-1">${entries.map((entry, idx) => {
        const nilaiHtml = entry.nilai
          ? ` <span class="text-[9.5px] font-bold text-indigo-800">[Nilai: ${escapeHtml(entry.nilai)}]</span>`
          : '';
        return `
          <div class="flex items-baseline gap-1.5 leading-snug text-slate-800">
            <span class="font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 shrink-0 tabular-nums w-4 text-right">${idx + 1}.</span>
            <span class="font-medium break-words min-w-0">${escapeHtml(entry.text)}${nilaiHtml}</span>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('')}</div>`;
    }

    function printExportPdfReport() {
      const prevTitle = document.title;
      const periodLabel = typeof getExportAcademicPeriodLabel === 'function'
        ? getExportAcademicPeriodLabel()
        : '2026-2027 Ganjil';
      document.title = `Rekapitulasi Pendaftaran Ujian FEB UIKA ${periodLabel}`.replace(/_+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      const restoreTitle = () => { document.title = prevTitle; };
      window.addEventListener('afterprint', restoreTitle, { once: true });
      window.print();
      setTimeout(restoreTitle, 1500);
    }

    function openExportPdfModal() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('exportPdfTableBody');
      if (!tbody) return;

      const list = getFilteredPendaftaranList();

      const total = list.length;
      const approved = list.filter(p => (p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').toLowerCase() === 'disetujui').length;
      const pending = list.filter(p => (p['Status Persetujuan'] || '').toLowerCase() === 'pending').length;
      const nominal = list.reduce((acc, p) => acc + (Number(p.Nominal) || 0), 0);
      const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
      const periodLabel = typeof getExportAcademicPeriodLabel === 'function'
        ? getExportAcademicPeriodLabel()
        : '2026-2027 Ganjil';
      const periodMatch = periodLabel.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{4})\s+(Ganjil|Genap)$/i);
      const academicDisplay = periodMatch
        ? `${periodMatch[1].replace('-', '/')} (${periodMatch[2]})`
        : periodLabel;

      const elTotal = document.getElementById('pdfStatTotal');
      const elApp = document.getElementById('pdfStatApproved');
      const elPend = document.getElementById('pdfStatPending');
      const elNom = document.getElementById('pdfStatNominal');
      const elRepDate = document.getElementById('pdfReportDate');
      const elSignDate = document.getElementById('pdfSignDate');
      const elTaText = document.getElementById('pdfAcademicYearText');

      if (elTotal) elTotal.innerText = total + ' Berkas';
      if (elApp) elApp.innerText = approved + ' Berkas';
      if (elPend) elPend.innerText = pending + ' Berkas';
      if (elNom) elNom.innerText = 'Rp ' + nominal.toLocaleString('id-ID');
      if (elRepDate) elRepDate.innerText = 'Tanggal Cetak: ' + today;
      if (elSignDate) elSignDate.innerText = 'Bogor, ' + today;
      if (elTaText) elTaText.innerText = 'Tahun Akademik: ' + academicDisplay;

      tbody.innerHTML = '';
      if (list.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="9" class="p-4 text-center text-slate-400">Tidak ada data pendaftaran yang sesuai filter</td></tr>';
      } else {
        list.forEach((p, i) => {
          const nominalVal = Number(p.Nominal || 0);
          const statusBayar = normalizePaymentStatusLabel(p['Status Pembayaran'], nominalVal);
          const bayarLower = statusBayar.toLowerCase();
          const bayarColor = bayarLower.includes('lunas')
            ? 'text-emerald-700'
            : (bayarLower.includes('gratis') ? 'text-blue-700' : 'text-rose-700');

          const statusApp = String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending').trim();
          const statusLower = statusApp.toLowerCase();
          const statusColor = statusLower === 'disetujui'
            ? 'text-emerald-700'
            : (statusLower === 'ditolak' ? 'text-rose-700' : 'text-amber-700');

          const tr = document.createElement('tr');
          tr.className = 'border-b border-slate-200 text-[11px] hover:bg-slate-50/70';
          tr.innerHTML = `
            <td class="p-2 align-top text-center font-mono text-slate-500 tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">${i + 1}</td>
            <td class="p-2 align-top font-mono font-bold text-blue-900 tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">${escapeHtml(p.ID || '-')}</td>
            <td class="p-2 align-top font-mono text-slate-700 tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">${escapeHtml(p.NPM || p.NIM || '-')}</td>
            <td class="p-2 align-top font-bold text-slate-900 leading-snug">${escapeHtml(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || '-')}</td>
            <td class="p-2 align-top text-slate-700 leading-snug">[${escapeHtml(p['Kode Prodi'] || '-')}] ${escapeHtml(p['Program Studi'] || '-')}</td>
            <td class="p-2 align-top text-slate-800">${formatExportPdfCoursesHtml(p)}</td>
            <td class="p-2 align-top text-slate-700 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">${escapeHtml(p['Jenis Layanan'] || '-')}</td>
            <td class="p-2 align-top text-right whitespace-nowrap">
              <div class="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 tabular-nums whitespace-nowrap">Rp ${nominalVal.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</div>
              <div class="text-[9.5px] font-semibold leading-tight mt-0.5 whitespace-nowrap ${bayarColor}">${escapeHtml(statusBayar)}</div>
            </td>
            <td class="p-2 align-top text-center font-bold whitespace-nowrap ${statusColor}">${escapeHtml(statusApp)}</td>
          `;
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
        });
      }

      document.body.classList.add('printing-rekap-pdf');
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalExportPdf');
      const printable = document.getElementById('printableExportPdfModal');
      if (printable) printable.classList.add('printable-active');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        modal.classList.add('flex');
      }
    }

    function openChangePasswordModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalChangePassword');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        modal.classList.add('flex');
        const oldInput = document.getElementById('oldPassInput');
        const newInput = document.getElementById('newPassInput');
        const confirmInput = document.getElementById('confirmPassInput');
        if (oldInput) oldInput.value = '';
        if (newInput) newInput.value = '';
        if (confirmInput) confirmInput.value = '';
        if (oldInput) oldInput.focus();
      }
    }

    function closeChangePasswordModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalChangePassword');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
        modal.classList.remove('flex');
      }
    }

    function submitChangePassword(e) {
      if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
      const oldPass = (document.getElementById('oldPassInput')?.value || '').trim();
      const newPass = (document.getElementById('newPassInput')?.value || '').trim();
      const confirmPass = (document.getElementById('confirmPassInput')?.value || '').trim();

      if (!oldPass || !newPass || !confirmPass) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Data Belum Lengkap',
          text: 'Harap isi semua kolom password.'
        });
        return;
      }

      if (newPass !== confirmPass) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Password Tidak Cocok',
          text: 'Konfirmasi password baru tidak sesuai dengan password baru.'
        });
        return;
      }

      if (newPass.length < 6) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Password Terlalu Pendek',
          text: 'Password baru minimal harus 6 karakter.'
        });
        return;
      }

      const btn = document.getElementById('btnSubmitChangePass');
      const originalText = btn ? btn.innerHTML : 'Update Password';
      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin mr-1"></i> Menyimpan...';
      }

      const username = currentUser ? (currentUser.username || currentUser.npm || 'admin') : 'admin';
      const actorName = getCurrentActorName(username);
      const actorRole = getCurrentActorRole('User');

      if (typeof google !== 'undefined' && google.script && google.script.run) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(res) {
            if (btn) {
              btn.disabled = false;
              btn.innerHTML = originalText;
            }
            if (res && res.success) {
              closeChangePasswordModal();
              Swal.fire({
                icon: 'success',
                title: 'Berhasil!',
                text: res.message || 'Password berhasil diperbarui.',
                timer: 2000,
                showConfirmButton: false
              });
            } else {
              Swal.fire({
                icon: 'error',
                title: 'Gagal Ganti Password',
                text: res && res.message ? res.message : 'Terjadi kesalahan saat mengganti password.'
              });
            }
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(err) {
            if (btn) {
              btn.disabled = false;
              btn.innerHTML = originalText;
            }
            Swal.fire({
              icon: 'error',
              title: 'Koneksi Server Gagal',
              text: err ? (err.message || String(err)) : 'Gagal menghubungi server GAS.'
            });
          })
          .changePassword(username, oldPass, newPass, actorName, actorRole);
      } else {
        // Mode browser standalone / dev preview
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (btn) {
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.innerHTML = originalText;
          }
          closeChangePasswordModal();
          Swal.fire({
            icon: 'success',
            title: 'Berhasil!',
            text: 'Password berhasil diperbarui (tersimpan di sesi aktif).',
            timer: 2000,
            showConfirmButton: false
          });
        }, 500);
      }
    }
  </script>
