    const SURAT_HIJRI_MONTHS_ID = [
      'Muharram', 'Safar', 'Rabiul Awal', 'Rabiul Akhir',
      'Jumadil Awal', 'Jumadil Akhir', 'Rajab', "Sya'ban",
      'Ramadhan', 'Syawal', 'Dzulqaidah', 'Dzulhijjah'
    ];

    const SURAT_MASEHI_MONTHS_ID = [
      'Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni',
      'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember'
    ];

    function getLocalIsoTodayForSurat() {
      const now = new Date();
      const y = now.getFullYear();
      const m = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      const d = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
    }

    function parseIsoDateLocalSurat(isoStr) {
      const match = String(isoStr || '').trim().match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
      if (!match) return new Date();
      return new Date(parseInt(match[1], 10), parseInt(match[2], 10) - 1, parseInt(match[3], 10), 12, 0, 0);
    }

    function formatTanggalMasehiSurat(isoStr) {
      const dt = parseIsoDateLocalSurat(isoStr);
      const day = dt.getDate();
      const monthName = SURAT_MASEHI_MONTHS_ID[dt.getMonth()] || 'November';
      const year = dt.getFullYear();
      return `${day} ${monthName} ${year} M`;
    }

    function formatTanggalHijriahSurat(isoStr) {
      try {
        const dt = parseIsoDateLocalSurat(isoStr);
        const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-u-ca-islamic-umalqura', {
          day: 'numeric',
          month: 'numeric',
          year: 'numeric'
        });
        const parts = fmt.formatToParts(dt);
        const dayVal = parseInt((parts.find(p => p.type === 'day') || {}).value || '1', 10);
        const monthVal = parseInt((parts.find(p => p.type === 'month') || {}).value || '1', 10);
        const yearStr = String((parts.find(p => p.type === 'year') || {}).value || '1448').replace(/\D/g, '') || '1448';
        const dayPadded = String(dayVal).padStart(2, '0');
        const monthName = SURAT_HIJRI_MONTHS_ID[monthVal - 1] || 'Jumadil Akhir';
        return `${dayPadded} ${monthName} ${yearStr} H`;
      } catch (e) {
        return '09 Jumadil Akhir 1448 H';
      }
    }

    function getSuratProdiMeta(kodeProdi) {
      const code = String(kodeProdi || 'MNJ').trim().toUpperCase();
      const base = SURAT_PRODI_OFFICIAL_META[code] || SURAT_PRODI_OFFICIAL_META.MNJ;
      const staffList = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.users_staff)) ? appData.users_staff : [];
      const kaprodiStaff = staffList.find(s => {
        const role = String(s.Role || s.role || '').toLowerCase();
        const prodi = String(s['Kode Prodi'] || s.kodeProdi || '').toUpperCase();
        return role.includes('ketua program studi') && prodi === code;
      });
      const namaKaprodi = (kaprodiStaff && (kaprodiStaff['Nama Lengkap'] || kaprodiStaff.nama)) ? String(kaprodiStaff['Nama Lengkap'] || kaprodiStaff.nama).trim() : base.kaprodi;
      let nikNidn = base.nikNidn;
      if (kaprodiStaff && kaprodiStaff.NIK && String(kaprodiStaff.NIK).trim()) {
        const staffNik = String(kaprodiStaff.NIK).trim();
        if (staffNik.includes('/') || !base.nikNidn.includes('/')) {
          nikNidn = staffNik;
        }
      }
      return {
        kodeProdi: code,
        nama: base.nama,
        kodeSurat: base.kodeSurat,
        kaprodi: namaKaprodi,
        nikNidn: nikNidn
      };
    }

    const initialSuratTodayIso = getLocalIsoTodayForSurat();
    const initialSuratYearStr = String(parseIsoDateLocalSurat(initialSuratTodayIso).getFullYear());

    const suratDosenState = {
      currentRecordId: '',
      recordStatus: 'Draft Baru',
      isLocked: false,
      includeSignaturesInExport: true,
      parafImage: '',
      ttdImage: '',
      parafSummary: '',
      ttdSummary: '',
      parafBy: '',
      parafAt: '',
      ttdBy: '',
      ttdAt: '',
      createdBy: '',
      createdAt: '',
      revisionNote: '',
      comboKey: '',
      layanan: 'UTS Susulan',
      kodeProdi: 'MNJ',
      dosen: '',
      mataKuliah: '',
      kelasSemester: '',
      statusFilter: 'ALL',
      nomorUrut: '',
      nomorTahun: initialSuratYearStr,
      kodeArsipXX: '',
      kodeArsipTahun: initialSuratYearStr,
      nomorSurat: `xxx/K.7/MA/FEB-UIKA/${initialSuratYearStr}`,
      kodeArsip: `TU/MA/XX/${initialSuratYearStr}`,
      lampiran: '1 (satu) Berkas',
      tanggalMasehi: initialSuratTodayIso,
      tanggalHijriah: formatTanggalHijriahSurat(initialSuratTodayIso),
      semester: 'Ganjil',
      tahunAkademik: '2026/2027',
      kaprodiNama: SURAT_PRODI_OFFICIAL_META.MNJ.kaprodi,
      kaprodiNikNidn: SURAT_PRODI_OFFICIAL_META.MNJ.nikNidn,
      tenggatNilai: '1 (satu) minggu',
      padToMinRows: false,
      minRows: 0,
      rows: []
    };

    function cleanCourseLabelForSurat(raw) {
      return String(raw || '')
        .replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '')
        .replace(/\[(?:Nilai|Nilai Asal)\s*:\s*[^\]]+\]/gi, '')
        .replace(/\(\s*\d+\s*SKS\s*\)/gi, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    }

    function cleanDosenLabelForSurat(raw) {
      return String(raw || '')
        .replace(/^\d+\.\s*/, '')
        .replace(/\((?:Dosen Lalu|Dosen Kelas Lalu|Dosen Saat Mengambil)\s*:[^)]+\)/gi, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        .trim();
    }

    function formatSemesterKelasForSurat(semVal, kelasVal) {
      const semRaw = String(semVal || '').trim();
      const kelasRaw = String(kelasVal || '').trim();
      const semMatch = semRaw.match(/\d+/);
      const semLabel = semMatch ? `Semester ${semMatch[0]}` : semRaw;
      if (semLabel && kelasRaw) return `${semLabel} / ${kelasRaw}`;
      return semLabel || kelasRaw || '-';
    }

    function extractCourseRegistrationsForSurat() {
      const pendaftaran = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.pendaftaran)) ? appData.pendaftaran : [];
      const entries = [];

      pendaftaran.forEach(p => {
        if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') return;
        const regId = String(p.ID || p.id || '').trim();
        const namaMhs = String(p['Nama Mahasiswa'] || p.namaMahasiswa || p.nama || '').trim();
        const npm = String(p.NPM || p.NIM || p.npm || p.nim || '').trim();
        const kodeProdi = String(p['Kode Prodi'] || p.kodeProdi || 'MNJ').trim().toUpperCase();
        const namaProdi = String(p['Program Studi'] || p.prodi || getSuratProdiMeta(kodeProdi).nama).trim();
        const kelas = String(p.Kelas || p.kelas || '').trim();
        const semMahasiswa = String(p.Semester || p.semester || '').trim();
        const semesterKelas = formatSemesterKelasForSurat(semMahasiswa, kelas);
        const layanan = normalizeJenisLayananName(p['Jenis Layanan'] || p.jenisLayanan || 'UTS Susulan') || 'UTS Susulan';
        const statusPersetujuan = String(p['Status Persetujuan'] || 'Pending').trim();
        const tahunAkademik = String(p['Tahun Akademik'] || '2026/2027').trim();
        const semesterPeriode = String(p['Semester Type'] || (semMahasiswa.toLowerCase().includes('genap') ? 'Genap' : 'Ganjil')).trim();

        if (Array.isArray(p.mataKuliahList) && p.mataKuliahList.length > 0) {
          p.mataKuliahList.forEach((mkItem, idx) => {
            const mkName = cleanCourseLabelForSurat(mkItem && typeof mkItem === 'object' ? (mkItem.nama || mkItem.mataKuliah) : mkItem);
            const dosenName = cleanDosenLabelForSurat(mkItem && typeof mkItem === 'object' ? (mkItem.dosenPengampu || mkItem.dosen) : '');
            if (!mkName && !dosenName) return;
            entries.push({
              uid: `${regId || 'REG'}_${idx}_${npm}`,
              regId,
              nama: namaMhs,
              npm,
              kodeProdi,
              namaProdi,
              kelas,
              semesterKelas,
              mataKuliah: mkName,
              dosen: dosenName || cleanDosenLabelForSurat(p['Dosen Pengampu'] || p.dosenPengampu || ''),
              layanan,
              statusPersetujuan,
              tahunAkademik,
              semesterPeriode: (semesterPeriode === 'Genap' || semesterPeriode === 'Ganjil') ? semesterPeriode : 'Ganjil'
            });
          });
          return;
        }

        const rawMatkul = String(p['Mata Kuliah'] || p.mataKuliah || '').trim();
        const rawDosen = String(p['Dosen Pengampu'] || p.dosenPengampu || '').trim();
        const mkLines = rawMatkul.split(/\n|\|/).map(cleanCourseLabelForSurat).filter(Boolean);
        const dsnLines = rawDosen.split(/\n|\|/).map(cleanDosenLabelForSurat).filter(Boolean);

        const maxLen = Math.max(mkLines.length, dsnLines.length, 1);
        for (let i = 0; i < maxLen; i++) {
          const mkName = mkLines[i] || mkLines[0] || '';
          const dosenName = dsnLines[i] || (dsnLines.length === 1 ? dsnLines[0] : '') || '';
          if (!mkName && !dosenName) continue;
          entries.push({
            uid: `${regId || 'REG'}_${i}_${npm}`,
            regId,
            nama: namaMhs,
            npm,
            kodeProdi,
            namaProdi,
            kelas,
            semesterKelas,
            mataKuliah: mkName,
            dosen: dosenName,
            layanan,
            statusPersetujuan,
            tahunAkademik,
            semesterPeriode: (semesterPeriode === 'Genap' || semesterPeriode === 'Ganjil') ? semesterPeriode : 'Ganjil'
          });
        }
      });

      return entries;
    }

    function buildSuratQuickCombos(entries) {
      const map = new Map();
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (!e.dosen && !e.mataKuliah) return;
        const key = `${e.layanan}|||${e.kodeProdi}|||${e.dosen}|||${e.mataKuliah}`;
        if (!map.has(key)) {
          map.set(key, {
            key,
            layanan: e.layanan,
            kodeProdi: e.kodeProdi,
            dosen: e.dosen,
            mataKuliah: e.mataKuliah,
            count: 0
          });
        }
        map.get(key).count += 1;
      });
      return Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => a.dosen.localeCompare(b.dosen) || a.mataKuliah.localeCompare(b.mataKuliah));
    }

    function getSuratDefaultYear() {
      return String(parseIsoDateLocalSurat(suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi).getFullYear());
    }

    function composeSuratNomorSurat(kodeSurat) {
      const prodiKode = String(kodeSurat || getSuratProdiMeta(suratDosenState.kodeProdi || 'MNJ').kodeSurat || 'MA').trim();
      const urut = String(suratDosenState.nomorUrut || '').trim() || 'xxx';
      const thn = String(suratDosenState.nomorTahun || '').trim() || getSuratDefaultYear();
      return `${urut}/K.7/${prodiKode}/FEB-UIKA/${thn}`;
    }

    function composeSuratKodeArsip(kodeSurat) {
      const prodiKode = String(kodeSurat || getSuratProdiMeta(suratDosenState.kodeProdi || 'MNJ').kodeSurat || 'MA').trim();
      const xx = String(suratDosenState.kodeArsipXX || '').trim() || 'XX';
      const thn = String(suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun || '').trim() || getSuratDefaultYear();
      return `TU/${prodiKode}/${xx}/${thn}`;
    }

    function refreshSuratComposedCodes() {
      const meta = getSuratProdiMeta(suratDosenState.kodeProdi || 'MNJ');
      suratDosenState.nomorSurat = composeSuratNomorSurat(meta.kodeSurat);
      suratDosenState.kodeArsip = composeSuratKodeArsip(meta.kodeSurat);
    }

    function onSuratNomorPartChange(part, val) {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        syncSuratInputsFromState();
        return;
      }
      if (part === 'urut') suratDosenState.nomorUrut = String(val || '');
      else if (part === 'tahun') suratDosenState.nomorTahun = String(val || '');
      refreshSuratComposedCodes();
      renderSuratDosenPreview();
    }

    function onSuratKodeArsipPartChange(part, val) {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        syncSuratInputsFromState();
        return;
      }
      if (part === 'xx') suratDosenState.kodeArsipXX = String(val || '');
      else if (part === 'tahun') suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun = String(val || '');
      refreshSuratComposedCodes();
      renderSuratDosenPreview();
    }

    function syncSuratProdiDefaults(kodeProdi) {
      const meta = getSuratProdiMeta(kodeProdi);
      const yearStr = getSuratDefaultYear();
      suratDosenState.kodeProdi = meta.kodeProdi;
      suratDosenState.kaprodiNama = meta.kaprodi;
      suratDosenState.kaprodiNikNidn = meta.nikNidn;
      if (!String(suratDosenState.nomorTahun || '').trim()) suratDosenState.nomorTahun = yearStr;
      if (!String(suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun || '').trim()) suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun = yearStr;
      refreshSuratComposedCodes();
    }

    function syncSuratInputsFromState() {
      const setVal = (id, val) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.value = val ?? '';
      };
      const meta = getSuratProdiMeta(suratDosenState.kodeProdi || 'MNJ');
      const lockedMidEl = document.getElementById('suratNomorLockedMid');
      if (lockedMidEl) lockedMidEl.innerText = `/K.7/${meta.kodeSurat}/FEB-UIKA/`;
      const lockedArsipEl = document.getElementById('suratKodeArsipLockedPrefix');
      if (lockedArsipEl) lockedArsipEl.innerText = `TU/${meta.kodeSurat}/`;

      setVal('suratQuickCombo', suratDosenState.comboKey);
      setVal('suratFilterLayanan', suratDosenState.layanan);
      setVal('suratFilterProdi', suratDosenState.kodeProdi);
      setVal('suratSelectDosen', suratDosenState.dosen);
      setVal('suratInputDosenManual', suratDosenState.dosen);
      setVal('suratSelectMatkul', suratDosenState.mataKuliah);
      setVal('suratInputMatkulManual', suratDosenState.mataKuliah);
      setVal('suratFilterKelas', suratDosenState.kelasSemester);
      setVal('suratFilterStatus', suratDosenState.statusFilter);
      setVal('suratInputNomorUrut', suratDosenState.nomorUrut);
      setVal('suratInputNomorTahun', suratDosenState.nomorTahun);
      setVal('suratInputKodeArsipXX', suratDosenState.kodeArsipXX);
      setVal('suratInputKodeArsipTahun', suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun);
      setVal('suratInputTanggalMasehi', suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi);
      setVal('suratInputTanggalHijriah', suratDosenState.tanggalHijriah);
      setVal('suratInputSemester', suratDosenState.semester);
      setVal('suratInputTahunAkademik', suratDosenState.tahunAkademik);
      setVal('suratInputLampiran', suratDosenState.lampiran);
      setVal('suratInputKaprodiNama', suratDosenState.kaprodiNama);
      setVal('suratInputKaprodiNik', suratDosenState.kaprodiNikNidn);
      setVal('suratInputTenggatNilai', suratDosenState.tenggatNilai);
      const padCb = document.getElementById('suratPadMinRowsCheckbox');
      if (padCb) padCb.checked = Boolean(suratDosenState.padToMinRows);
      setVal('suratMinRowsSelect', String(suratDosenState.minRows));
    }

    function populateSuratFilterOptions(entries) {
      const combos = buildSuratQuickCombos(entries);
      const comboCountEl = document.getElementById('suratDosenComboCount');
      if (comboCountEl) comboCountEl.innerText = `${combos.length} paket terdeteksi`;

      const quickSel = document.getElementById('suratQuickCombo');
      if (quickSel) {
        const prev = suratDosenState.comboKey;
        quickSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Pilih Kombinasi Dosen &amp; Matkul Otomatis --</option>';
        combos.forEach(c => {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = c.key;
          opt.textContent = `${c.dosen || '-'} — ${c.mataKuliah || '-'} [${c.kodeProdi} · ${c.layanan} · ${c.count} mhs]`;
          quickSel.appendChild(opt);
        });
        quickSel.value = combos.some(c => c.key === prev) ? prev : '';
      }

      // Kumpulkan daftar Dosen dari Pendaftaran + Master Mata Kuliah (Master_Matkul)
      const dosenSet = new Set();
      entries.forEach(e => { if (e.dosen) dosenSet.add(e.dosen); });
      getMasterMatkulDosenCatalog().forEach(d => {
        if (d.nama) dosenSet.add(d.nama);
      });
      if (suratDosenState.dosen) dosenSet.add(suratDosenState.dosen);

      const dosenSel = document.getElementById('suratSelectDosen');
      if (dosenSel) {
        dosenSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Pilih Dosen Pengampu --</option>';
        Array.from(dosenSet).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)).forEach(nm => {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = nm;
          opt.textContent = nm;
          dosenSel.appendChild(opt);
        });
        dosenSel.value = suratDosenState.dosen || '';
      }

      // Kumpulkan daftar Mata Kuliah (utamakan matkul milik dosen/prodi yang dipilih, plus sisanya)
      const mkSet = new Set();
      const dosenLower = String(suratDosenState.dosen || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (!e.mataKuliah) return;
        if (!dosenLower || e.dosen.toLowerCase().includes(dosenLower) || dosenLower.includes(e.dosen.toLowerCase())) {
          mkSet.add(e.mataKuliah);
        }
      });
      if (mkSet.size === 0) {
        entries.forEach(e => { if (e.mataKuliah) mkSet.add(e.mataKuliah); });
      }
      ((appData.master && appData.master.matkul) || []).forEach(m => {
        const mk = String(m['Nama Mata Kuliah'] || m.nama || '').trim();
        const dsn = String(m['Dosen Pengampu'] || m.dosen || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!mk) return;
        if (!dosenLower || !dsn || dsn.includes(dosenLower) || dosenLower.includes(dsn)) {
          mkSet.add(mk);
        }
      });
      if (suratDosenState.mataKuliah) mkSet.add(suratDosenState.mataKuliah);

      const mkSel = document.getElementById('suratSelectMatkul');
      if (mkSel) {
        mkSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Pilih Mata Kuliah --</option>';
        Array.from(mkSet).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)).forEach(mk => {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = mk;
          opt.textContent = mk;
          mkSel.appendChild(opt);
        });
        mkSel.value = suratDosenState.mataKuliah || '';
      }

      // Kumpulkan daftar Semester/Kelas yang tersedia
      const kelasSet = new Set();
      entries.forEach(e => {
        if (e.semesterKelas && e.semesterKelas !== '-') kelasSet.add(e.semesterKelas);
      });
      if (suratDosenState.kelasSemester) kelasSet.add(suratDosenState.kelasSemester);

      const kelasSel = document.getElementById('suratFilterKelas');
      if (kelasSel) {
        kelasSel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Semua Semester &amp; Kelas</option>';
        Array.from(kelasSet).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b)).forEach(kl => {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = kl;
          opt.textContent = kl;
          kelasSel.appendChild(opt);
        });
        kelasSel.value = suratDosenState.kelasSemester || '';
      }
    }

    function rebuildSuratStudentRowsFromFilters() {
      const entries = extractCourseRegistrationsForSurat();
      const targetLayanan = String(suratDosenState.layanan || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const targetProdi = String(suratDosenState.kodeProdi || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const targetDosen = String(suratDosenState.dosen || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const targetMatkul = String(suratDosenState.mataKuliah || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const targetKelas = String(suratDosenState.kelasSemester || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const targetStatus = String(suratDosenState.statusFilter || 'ALL').trim().toLowerCase();

      if (!targetDosen && !targetMatkul) {
        suratDosenState.rows = [];
        renderSuratStudentRowsChecklist();
        renderSuratDosenPreview();
        return;
      }

      const matched = entries.filter(e => {
        if (targetLayanan && e.layanan.toLowerCase() !== targetLayanan) return false;
        if (targetProdi && e.kodeProdi !== targetProdi) return false;
        if (targetDosen) {
          const d = e.dosen.toLowerCase();
          if (!d || (!d.includes(targetDosen) && !targetDosen.includes(d))) return false;
        }
        if (targetMatkul) {
          const m = e.mataKuliah.toLowerCase();
          if (!m || (!m.includes(targetMatkul) && !targetMatkul.includes(m))) return false;
        }
        if (targetKelas && e.semesterKelas.toLowerCase() !== targetKelas) return false;
        if (targetStatus !== 'all' && e.statusPersetujuan.toLowerCase() !== targetStatus) return false;
        return true;
      });

      // Hindari duplikasi mahasiswa (NPM + Nama + Semester/Kelas) pada surat yang sama
      const seen = new Set();
      const rows = [];
      matched.forEach(e => {
        const dedupeKey = `${e.npm.toLowerCase()}|${e.nama.toLowerCase()}|${e.semesterKelas.toLowerCase()}`;
        if (seen.has(dedupeKey)) return;
        seen.add(dedupeKey);
        rows.push({
          uid: e.uid,
          selected: true,
          nama: e.nama,
          npm: e.npm,
          semesterKelas: e.semesterKelas,
          status: e.statusPersetujuan
        });
      });

      suratDosenState.rows = rows;
      renderSuratStudentRowsChecklist();
      renderSuratDosenPreview();
    }

    function applySuratQuickCombo(comboKey) {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        syncSuratInputsFromState();
        return;
      }
      suratDosenState.comboKey = comboKey || '';
      if (!comboKey) {
        renderSuratDosenPreview();
        return;
      }
      const parts = comboKey.split('|||');
      suratDosenState.layanan = parts[0] || 'UTS Susulan';
      const newProdi = parts[1] || 'MNJ';
      suratDosenState.dosen = parts[2] || '';
      suratDosenState.mataKuliah = parts[3] || '';
      suratDosenState.kelasSemester = '';
      syncSuratProdiDefaults(newProdi);

      const entries = extractCourseRegistrationsForSurat();
      populateSuratFilterOptions(entries);
      syncSuratInputsFromState();
      rebuildSuratStudentRowsFromFilters();
    }

    function onSuratFilterChange(source) {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        syncSuratInputsFromState();
        return;
      }
      if (source === 'layanan') {
        suratDosenState.layanan = document.getElementById('suratFilterLayanan')?.value || '';
        suratDosenState.comboKey = '';
      } else if (source === 'prodi') {
        const newProdi = document.getElementById('suratFilterProdi')?.value || 'MNJ';
        suratDosenState.comboKey = '';
        if (newProdi) syncSuratProdiDefaults(newProdi);
        else suratDosenState.kodeProdi = '';
      } else if (source === 'dosen') {
        suratDosenState.dosen = document.getElementById('suratSelectDosen')?.value || '';
        suratDosenState.comboKey = '';
      } else if (source === 'matkul') {
        suratDosenState.mataKuliah = document.getElementById('suratSelectMatkul')?.value || '';
        suratDosenState.comboKey = '';
      } else if (source === 'kelas') {
        suratDosenState.kelasSemester = document.getElementById('suratFilterKelas')?.value || '';
      } else if (source === 'status') {
        suratDosenState.statusFilter = document.getElementById('suratFilterStatus')?.value || 'ALL';
      }

      const entries = extractCourseRegistrationsForSurat();
      populateSuratFilterOptions(entries);
      syncSuratInputsFromState();
      rebuildSuratStudentRowsFromFilters();
    }

    function onSuratDateChange(isoVal) {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        syncSuratInputsFromState();
        return;
      }
      suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi = isoVal || getLocalIsoTodayForSurat();
      suratDosenState.tanggalHijriah = formatTanggalHijriahSurat(suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi);
      const newYear = String(parseIsoDateLocalSurat(suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi).getFullYear());
      suratDosenState.nomorTahun = newYear;
      suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun = newYear;
      refreshSuratComposedCodes();

      const hijriInput = document.getElementById('suratInputTanggalHijriah');
      if (hijriInput) hijriInput.value = suratDosenState.tanggalHijriah;
      const nomorTahunInput = document.getElementById('suratInputNomorTahun');
      if (nomorTahunInput) nomorTahunInput.value = suratDosenState.nomorTahun;
      const arsipTahunInput = document.getElementById('suratInputKodeArsipTahun');
      if (arsipTahunInput) arsipTahunInput.value = suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun;
      renderSuratDosenPreview();
    }

    function resetSuratDosenState() {
      const todayIso = getLocalIsoTodayForSurat();
      const todayYear = String(parseIsoDateLocalSurat(todayIso).getFullYear());
      suratDosenState.currentRecordId = '';
      suratDosenState.recordStatus = 'Draft Baru';
      suratDosenState.isLocked = false;
      suratDosenState.parafImage = '';
      suratDosenState.ttdImage = '';
      suratDosenState.parafSummary = '';
      suratDosenState.ttdSummary = '';
      suratDosenState.parafBy = '';
      suratDosenState.parafAt = '';
      suratDosenState.ttdBy = '';
      suratDosenState.ttdAt = '';
      suratDosenState.createdBy = '';
      suratDosenState.createdAt = '';
      suratDosenState.revisionNote = '';
      suratDosenState.comboKey = '';
      suratDosenState.layanan = 'UTS Susulan';
      suratDosenState.dosen = '';
      suratDosenState.mataKuliah = '';
      suratDosenState.kelasSemester = '';
      suratDosenState.statusFilter = 'ALL';
      suratDosenState.nomorUrut = '';
      suratDosenState.nomorTahun = todayYear;
      suratDosenState.kodeArsipXX = '';
      suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun = todayYear;
      suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi = todayIso;
      suratDosenState.tanggalHijriah = formatTanggalHijriahSurat(todayIso);
      suratDosenState.padToMinRows = false;
      suratDosenState.minRows = 0;
      suratDosenState.rows = [];
      syncSuratProdiDefaults('MNJ');
      renderSuratDosenWorkspace();
    }

    function toggleSuratRowSelected(idx, checked) {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        renderSuratStudentRowsChecklist();
        return;
      }
      if (suratDosenState.rows[idx]) {
        suratDosenState.rows[idx].selected = Boolean(checked);
        updateSuratSelectedSummary();
        renderSuratDosenPreview();
      }
    }

    function updateSuratRowField(idx, field, val) {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        return;
      }
      if (suratDosenState.rows[idx]) {
        suratDosenState.rows[idx][field] = val;
        renderSuratDosenPreview();
      }
    }

    function removeSuratRow(idx) {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        return;
      }
      suratDosenState.rows.splice(idx, 1);
      renderSuratStudentRowsChecklist();
      renderSuratDosenPreview();
    }

    function toggleAllSuratRows(checked) {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        return;
      }
      suratDosenState.rows.forEach(r => { r.selected = Boolean(checked); });
      renderSuratStudentRowsChecklist();
      renderSuratDosenPreview();
    }

    function addManualSuratStudentRow() {
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked || (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' && !isSuratCanEditDraft())) {
        return;
      }
      suratDosenState.rows.push({
        uid: 'MANUAL_' + Date.now(),
        selected: true,
        nama: '',
        npm: '',
        semesterKelas: suratDosenState.kelasSemester || 'Semester 3 / Reguler G',
        status: 'Manual'
      });
      renderSuratStudentRowsChecklist();
      renderSuratDosenPreview();
    }

    function isSuratRowChecked(r) {
      return Boolean(r && r.selected !== false && String(r.selected).toLowerCase() !== 'false');
    }

    function updateSuratSelectedSummary() {
      const total = suratDosenState.rows.length;
      const selected = suratDosenState.rows.filter(isSuratRowChecked).length;
      const el = document.getElementById('suratSelectedSummaryText');
      if (el) el.innerText = `${selected} terpilih dari ${total} mahasiswa`;
    }

    function renderSuratStudentRowsChecklist() {
      const container = document.getElementById('suratStudentRowsContainer');
      if (!container) return;
      updateSuratSelectedSummary();

      if (suratDosenState.rows.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="p-4 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 text-center text-xs text-slate-500 space-y-1.5">
            <p class="font-semibold text-slate-700">Belum ada mahasiswa terpilih untuk kombinasi filter saat ini.</p>
            <p class="text-[11px]">Pilih paket Dosen &amp; Mata Kuliah di atas, atau klik <b>+ Baris</b> untuk mengisi manual (dokumen tetap bisa dicetak sebagai blangko).</p>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      const selectedCount = suratDosenState.rows.filter(isSuratRowChecked).length;
      const canEditRows = !suratDosenState.isLocked && (typeof isSuratCanEditDraft !== 'function' || isSuratCanEditDraft());
      const unselectedBannerHtml = (selectedCount === 0)
        ? `
          <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px] text-amber-950">
            <span class="font-semibold">Belum ada mahasiswa dicentang (0 dari ${suratDosenState.rows.length}) sehingga tabel pratinjau masih kosong.</span>
            ${canEditRows ? '<button type="button" onclick="toggleAllSuratRows(true)" class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-800 hover:bg-amber-900 text-white text-[11px] font-bold whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer">Pilih Semua</button>' : ''}
          </div>
        `
        : '';

      container.innerHTML = unselectedBannerHtml + suratDosenState.rows.map((r, idx) => {
        const checked = isSuratRowChecked(r);
        const approvalStatus = String(r.status || 'Pending').trim();
        const approvalCls = approvalStatus.toLowerCase() === 'disetujui' ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-amber-700';
        const includeText = checked ? 'Masuk Surat' : 'Tidak Masuk Surat';
        const includeCls = checked ? 'text-blue-800' : 'text-slate-600';
        return `
        <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl border ${checked ? 'border-blue-300 bg-blue-50/35' : 'border-slate-300 bg-white'} space-y-1.5">
          <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 cursor-pointer min-w-0">
              <input type="checkbox" ${checked ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleSuratRowSelected(${idx}, this.checked)" class="rounded text-blue-900 cursor-pointer shrink-0">
              <span class="font-mono tabular-nums text-[11px] text-blue-900">#${idx + 1}</span>
              <span class="truncate">${escapeHtml(r.nama || 'Mahasiswa Baru')}</span>
            </label>
            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold shrink-0">
              <span class="${includeCls}">${includeText}</span>
              <span class="text-slate-300" aria-hidden="true">&middot;</span>
              <span class="${approvalCls} font-bold">${escapeHtml(approvalStatus)}</span>
              <button type="button" onclick="removeSuratRow(${idx})" title="Hapus baris" class="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 px-1 cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-trash text-[11px]"></i></button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="space-y-1.5">
            <input type="text" value="${escapeHtml(r.nama)}" oninput="updateSuratRowField(${idx}, 'nama', this.value)" placeholder="Nama Lengkap Mahasiswa" aria-label="Nama Mahasiswa" class="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-900 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-900">
            <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">
              <input type="text" value="${escapeHtml(r.npm)}" oninput="updateSuratRowField(${idx}, 'npm', this.value)" placeholder="NPM" aria-label="NPM Mahasiswa" class="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-900 font-mono tabular-nums bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-900">
              <input type="text" value="${escapeHtml(r.semesterKelas)}" oninput="updateSuratRowField(${idx}, 'semesterKelas', this.value)" placeholder="Semester / Kelas" aria-label="Semester dan Kelas" class="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-900 bg-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-900">
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function getSuratDocumentModel() {
      const prodiMeta = getSuratProdiMeta(suratDosenState.kodeProdi || 'MNJ');
      const layananClean = normalizeJenisLayananName(suratDosenState.layanan || 'UTS Susulan') || 'UTS Susulan';
      const isUas = layananClean.toLowerCase().includes('uas');
      const isRemedial = layananClean.toLowerCase().includes('remedial');

      const perihalSingkat = isRemedial
        ? 'Remedial Teaching'
        : (isUas ? 'Ujian Akhir Semester Susulan' : 'Ujian Tengah Semester Susulan');

      const layananDalamIsi = isRemedial
        ? 'Remedial Teaching'
        : (isUas ? 'Ujian Akhir Semester (UAS) Susulan' : 'Ujian Tengah Semester (UTS) Susulan');

      const namaUjianNormal = isRemedial
        ? 'perkuliahan reguler'
        : (isUas ? 'Ujian Akhir Semester' : 'Ujian Tengah Semester');

      const labelFormulir = isRemedial
        ? 'Formulir Daftar Hadir Remedial Teaching'
        : 'Formulir Daftar Hadir Ujian Susulan';

      const selectedRows = suratDosenState.rows
        .filter(isSuratRowChecked)
        .map(r => ({
          nama: String(r.nama || '').trim(),
          npm: String(r.npm || '').trim(),
          semesterKelas: String(r.semesterKelas || '').trim()
        }));

      const targetRows = [...selectedRows];
      const minCount = suratDosenState.padToMinRows ? Math.max(0, Number(suratDosenState.minRows || 0)) : 0;
      while (targetRows.length < minCount) {
        targetRows.push({ nama: '', npm: '', semesterKelas: '' });
      }
      if (targetRows.length === 0) {
        targetRows.push({ nama: '', npm: '', semesterKelas: '' });
      }

      const includeSignatures = suratDosenState.includeSignaturesInExport !== false;

      return {
        currentRecordId: suratDosenState.currentRecordId || '',
        statusVerifikasi: suratDosenState.recordStatus || 'Draft Baru',
        isLocked: Boolean(suratDosenState.isLocked),
        isFinalVerified: String(suratDosenState.recordStatus || '').trim() === 'Terverifikasi Final',
        includeSignatures: includeSignatures,
        parafImage: includeSignatures ? (suratDosenState.parafImage || '') : '',
        ttdImage: includeSignatures ? (suratDosenState.ttdImage || '') : '',
        parafBy: suratDosenState.parafBy || '',
        parafAt: suratDosenState.parafAt || '',
        ttdBy: suratDosenState.ttdBy || '',
        ttdAt: suratDosenState.ttdAt || '',
        nomorSurat: composeSuratNomorSurat(prodiMeta.kodeSurat),
        kodeArsip: composeSuratKodeArsip(prodiMeta.kodeSurat),
        lampiran: suratDosenState.lampiran || '1 (satu) Berkas',
        perihalSingkat,
        layananDalamIsi,
        namaUjianNormal,
        labelFormulir,
        isRemedial,
        semester: suratDosenState.semester || 'Ganjil',
        tahunAkademik: suratDosenState.tahunAkademik || '2026/2027',
        tanggalMasehiText: formatTanggalMasehiSurat(suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi),
        tanggalHijriahText: suratDosenState.tanggalHijriah || formatTanggalHijriahSurat(suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi),
        dosenNama: suratDosenState.dosen || 'Dosen Pengampu Mata Kuliah',
        mataKuliah: suratDosenState.mataKuliah || '-',
        prodiNama: prodiMeta.nama,
        kaprodiNama: suratDosenState.kaprodiNama || prodiMeta.kaprodi,
        kaprodiNikNidn: suratDosenState.kaprodiNikNidn || prodiMeta.nikNidn,
        tenggatNilai: suratDosenState.tenggatNilai || '1 (satu) minggu',
        rows: targetRows
      };
    }

    function buildSuratTwoPageInnerHtml(model, options = {}) {
      const m = model || getSuratDocumentModel();
      const forWord = Boolean(options && options.forWord);
      const forPdfCapture = Boolean(options && options.forPdfCapture);
      const forPrintPortal = Boolean(options && options.forPrintPortal);

      const rowCount = m.rows.length;
      const p1RowHeight = rowCount > 10 ? 20 : 24;
      const p1RowPad = rowCount > 10 ? '2px 6px' : '3px 6px';
      const p2RowHeight = rowCount > 11 ? 30 : (rowCount > 7 ? 40 : 58);

      const cursiveStyle = "font-family: 'Monotype Corsiva', 'Marck Script', 'Apple Chancery', 'URW Chancery L', cursive, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 14pt; line-height: 1.25;";
      const bodyFontStyle = "font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; color: #000000;";

      let sheet1Style = "";
      let sheet2Style = "";
      if (forWord) {
        sheet1Style = `${bodyFontStyle} background: #ffffff; font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.28; width: 100%;`;
        sheet2Style = `${bodyFontStyle} background: #ffffff; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.28; width: 100%;`;
      } else if (forPdfCapture) {
        sheet1Style = `${bodyFontStyle} background: #ffffff; font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.25; width: 816px; min-height: 1248px; margin: 0; padding: 4px 0 14px 0; border: none; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; box-sizing: border-box;`;
        sheet2Style = `${bodyFontStyle} background: #ffffff; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.28; width: 816px; min-height: 1248px; margin: 0; padding: 44px 0 14px 0; border: none; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; box-sizing: border-box;`;
      } else if (forPrintPortal) {
        sheet1Style = `${bodyFontStyle} background: #ffffff; font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.25; width: 100%; min-height: 318mm; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 0 2mm 0; border: none; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; box-sizing: border-box;`;
        sheet2Style = `${bodyFontStyle} background: #ffffff; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.28; width: 100%; min-height: 318mm; margin: 0 auto; padding: 10mm 0 2mm 0; border: none; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; box-sizing: border-box;`;
      } else {
        sheet1Style = `${bodyFontStyle} background: #ffffff; font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.25; width: 816px; min-height: 1248px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 4px 0 14px 0; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; box-sizing: border-box;`;
        sheet2Style = `${bodyFontStyle} background: #ffffff; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.28; width: 816px; min-height: 1248px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 44px 0 14px 0; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; box-sizing: border-box;`;
      }

      const trStyleP1 = forWord ? ` style="height: ${Math.round(p1RowHeight * 0.75)}pt; mso-height-rule: exactly;"` : '';
      const trStyleP2 = forWord ? ` style="height: ${Math.round(p2RowHeight * 0.75)}pt; mso-height-rule: exactly;"` : '';

      const rowsPage1 = m.rows.map((r, i) => `
        <tr${trStyleP1}>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: ${p1RowPad}; height: ${p1RowHeight}px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; width: 46px; color: #000000;">${i + 1}.</td>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: ${p1RowPad}; height: ${p1RowHeight}px; vertical-align: middle; color: #000000;">${escapeHtml(r.nama)}</td>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: ${p1RowPad}; height: ${p1RowHeight}px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; width: 124px; color: #000000;">${escapeHtml(r.npm)}</td>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: ${p1RowPad}; height: ${p1RowHeight}px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; width: 120px; color: #000000;">${escapeHtml(r.semesterKelas)}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('');

      const rowsPage2 = m.rows.map((r, i) => `
        <tr${trStyleP2}>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: 6px 4px; height: ${p2RowHeight}px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top; width: 38px; color: #000000;">${i + 1}.</td>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: 6px 8px; height: ${p2RowHeight}px; vertical-align: top; color: #000000;">${escapeHtml(r.nama)}</td>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: 6px 6px; height: ${p2RowHeight}px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top; width: 112px; color: #000000;">${escapeHtml(r.npm)}</td>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: 6px 6px; height: ${p2RowHeight}px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top; width: 100px; color: #000000;">${escapeHtml(r.semesterKelas)}</td>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: 6px 6px; height: ${p2RowHeight}px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top; width: 96px; color: #000000;"></td>
          <td style="border: 1px solid #000000; padding: 6px 6px; height: ${p2RowHeight}px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top; width: 116px; color: #000000;"></td>
        </tr>
      `).join('');

      const alasanParagraf = m.isRemedial
        ? `${escapeHtml(m.layananDalamIsi)} ini dilaksanakan guna memberikan kesempatan perbaikan nilai bagi mahasiswa yang bersangkutan sesuai ketentuan akademik yang berlaku.`
        : `${escapeHtml(m.perihalSingkat)} ini perlu dilaksanakan karena mahasiswa yang bersangkutan tidak dapat mengikuti ${escapeHtml(m.namaUjianNormal)} pada waktu yang telah ditentukan.`;

      const tindakLanjutParagraf = `Bersama ini kami lampirkan ${escapeHtml(m.labelFormulir)}, dan nilai hasil ${m.isRemedial ? 'remedial' : 'ujian'} diharapkan dapat disampaikan kepada Tata Usaha Program Studi paling lambat ${escapeHtml(m.tenggatNilai)} setelah ${m.isRemedial ? 'Remedial Teaching' : 'Ujian Susulan'} dilaksanakan.`;

      // Padding/margin horisontal sesuai F4 816px
      const kopWrapStyle = forWord ? "margin-left: 0; margin-bottom: 4pt;" : "padding: 0 38px; margin-bottom: 2px;";
      const p1BodyWrapStyle = forWord ? "margin-left: 1.24cm;" : "padding: 0 75px 0 95px;";
      const p1IndentStyle = forWord ? "margin-left: 2.85cm;" : "margin-left: 108px;";
      const p1KaprodiStyle = forWord ? "margin-left: 8.74cm; font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.25;" : "margin-left: 330px; font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.25;";
      const p1TembusanStyle = forWord ? "margin-top: 4pt; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.25;" : "margin-top: 2px; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.25;";

      const p2TopMetaStyle = forWord ? "margin-left: 0; margin-bottom: 24pt;" : "padding: 0 75px 0 28px; margin-bottom: 42px;";
      const p2TitleWrapStyle = forWord ? "margin-left: 1.77cm; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 22pt;" : "padding: 0 75px 0 95px; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 32px;";
      const p2MetaMKStyle = forWord ? "margin-left: 1.77cm; margin-bottom: 14pt;" : "padding: 0 75px 0 95px; margin-bottom: 18px;";
      const p2TableWrapStyle = forWord ? "margin-left: 1.95cm; width: 17.2cm; margin-bottom: 22pt;" : "padding: 0 64px 0 102px; margin-bottom: 30px;";
      const p2DosenSigStyle = forWord ? "margin-left: 10.65cm; margin-top: 20pt; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.28;" : "margin-left: 431px; margin-top: 34px; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.28;";

      const parafImgHtml = (m.parafImage && String(m.parafImage).startsWith('data:image/'))
        ? `<img src="${m.parafImage}" alt="Paraf Sek.Prodi" style="position: absolute; left: -22px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 0.5cm; height: 0.5cm; max-width: 0.5cm; max-height: 0.5cm; object-fit: contain; pointer-events: none;" />`
        : '';
      const ttdImgHtml = (m.ttdImage && String(m.ttdImage).startsWith('data:image/'))
        ? `<img src="${m.ttdImage}" alt="TTD KaProdi" style="position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); max-height: 62px; max-width: 195px; width: auto; height: auto; object-fit: contain; pointer-events: none;" />`
        : '';

      const kaprodiSpacerHtml = forWord
        ? '<table style="border-collapse:collapse;"><tr><td style="height: 50pt; mso-height-rule: exactly; font-size: 1pt; line-height: 1pt;">&nbsp;</td></tr></table>'
        : `<div style="position: relative; height: 66px; overflow: visible;">${ttdImgHtml}</div>`;
      const dosenSpacerHtml = forWord
        ? '<table style="border-collapse:collapse;"><tr><td style="height: 73pt; mso-height-rule: exactly; font-size: 1pt; line-height: 1pt;">&nbsp;</td></tr></table>'
        : '<div style="height: 98px;"></div>';

      const page1Class = forWord
        ? 'WordSectionPage1'
        : `surat-f4-sheet surat-a4-sheet surat-pdf-page-1 ${forPrintPortal ? 'surat-f4-print-page ' : ''}surat-page-break`;
      const page2Class = forWord
        ? 'WordSectionPage2'
        : `surat-f4-sheet surat-a4-sheet surat-pdf-page-2${forPrintPortal ? ' surat-f4-print-page' : ''}`;

      const officialFooterBarHtml = `
        <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 12px;">
          <tr>
            <td style="width: 190px; box-sizing: border-box; padding-left: 95px; vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 6px; font-family: Arial, 'Microsoft Sans Serif', sans-serif; font-size: 6.5pt; color: #000000; line-height: 1;">${escapeHtml(m.kodeArsip)}</td>
            <td align="center" style="width: 436px; text-align: center; vertical-align: bottom;">
              <img src="${KOP_FOOTER_FEB_BASE64}" alt="Footer Resmi FEB UIKA Bogor" style="width: 430px; max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: inline-block;" />
            </td>
            <td style="width: 190px; box-sizing: border-box;"></td>
          </tr>
        </table>
      `;

      const page1FooterHtml = forWord ? '' : officialFooterBarHtml;
      const page2FooterHtml = forWord ? '' : officialFooterBarHtml;
      const isLivePreview = !forWord && !forPdfCapture && !forPrintPortal;

      return `
        ${isLivePreview ? '<div class="surat-preview-page-slot">' : ''}
        <div class="${page1Class}" style="${sheet1Style}">
          <div>
            <div style="${kopWrapStyle}">
              <img src="${KOP_HEADER_FEB_BASE64}" alt="Kop Surat Resmi FEB UIKA Bogor" ${forWord ? 'width="693" height="155"' : ''} style="${forWord ? 'width: 693px; height: 155px;' : 'width: 100%; height: auto;'} display: block;" />
            </div>

            <div style="${p1BodyWrapStyle}">
              <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 12pt; line-height: 1.25;">
