    let suratPreviewResizeObserver = null;
    let suratPreviewResizeBound = false;
    const suratPreviewState = {
      activePage: '1',
      fitMode: 'page',
      zoomLevel: 65,
      mobilePane: 'form'
    };

    function syncSuratPreviewToolbarUi() {
      const pageMap = {
        '1': 'btnSuratPage1',
        '2': 'btnSuratPage2',
        'all': 'btnSuratPageAll'
      };
      Object.entries(pageMap).forEach(([key, id]) => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!btn) return;
        const active = suratPreviewState.activePage === key;
        btn.classList.toggle('bg-blue-900', active);
        btn.classList.toggle('text-white', active);
        btn.classList.toggle('shadow-xs', active);
        btn.classList.toggle('text-slate-600', !active);
        btn.classList.toggle('hover:text-slate-900', !active);
      });

      const fitMap = {
        page: 'btnSuratFitPage',
        width: 'btnSuratFitWidth'
      };
      Object.entries(fitMap).forEach(([key, id]) => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!btn) return;
        const active = suratPreviewState.fitMode === key;
        btn.classList.toggle('bg-slate-800', active);
        btn.classList.toggle('text-white', active);
        btn.classList.toggle('text-slate-600', !active);
        btn.classList.toggle('hover:text-slate-900', !active);
      });
    }

    function setSuratMobilePane(pane) {
      const nextPane = pane === 'preview' ? 'preview' : 'form';
      suratPreviewState.mobilePane = nextPane;

      const formPane = document.getElementById('suratFormPane');
      const previewPane = document.getElementById('suratPreviewPane');
      const btnForm = document.getElementById('btnSuratPaneForm');
      const btnPreview = document.getElementById('btnSuratPanePreview');

      if (formPane) {
        formPane.classList.toggle('hidden', nextPane !== 'form');
        formPane.classList.add('xl:block');
      }
      if (previewPane) {
        previewPane.classList.toggle('hidden', nextPane !== 'preview');
        previewPane.classList.add('xl:block');
      }
      if (btnForm) {
        const active = nextPane === 'form';
        btnForm.classList.toggle('bg-blue-900', active);
        btnForm.classList.toggle('text-white', active);
        btnForm.classList.toggle('shadow-sm', active);
        btnForm.classList.toggle('bg-slate-100', !active);
        btnForm.classList.toggle('text-slate-700', !active);
        btnForm.classList.toggle('hover:bg-slate-200', !active);
      }
      if (btnPreview) {
        const active = nextPane === 'preview';
        btnPreview.classList.toggle('bg-blue-900', active);
        btnPreview.classList.toggle('text-white', active);
        btnPreview.classList.toggle('shadow-sm', active);
        btnPreview.classList.toggle('bg-slate-100', !active);
        btnPreview.classList.toggle('text-slate-700', !active);
        btnPreview.classList.toggle('hover:bg-slate-200', !active);
      }

      if (nextPane === 'preview') {
        if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => fitSuratPreviewSheets());
        }
        setTimeout(fitSuratPreviewSheets, 40);
      }
    }

    function setSuratPreviewPage(page) {
      suratPreviewState.activePage = (page === '2' || page === 'all') ? page : '1';
      syncSuratPreviewToolbarUi();
      const scrollArea = document.getElementById('suratDosenPreviewScrollArea');
      if (scrollArea) scrollArea.scrollTop = 0;
      fitSuratPreviewSheets();
    }

    function setSuratPreviewFitMode(mode) {
      suratPreviewState.fitMode = mode === 'width' ? 'width' : 'page';
      syncSuratPreviewToolbarUi();
      fitSuratPreviewSheets();
    }

    function adjustSuratPreviewZoom(delta) {
      const base = Number(suratPreviewState.zoomLevel || 65);
      suratPreviewState.zoomLevel = Math.max(35, Math.min(130, base + Number(delta || 0)));
      suratPreviewState.fitMode = 'custom';
      syncSuratPreviewToolbarUi();
      fitSuratPreviewSheets();
    }

    let suratPreviewRafId = null;

    function fitSuratPreviewSheets() {
      const root = document.getElementById('suratDosenPreviewRoot');
      const scrollArea = document.getElementById('suratDosenPreviewScrollArea');
      const viewport = document.getElementById('suratDosenPreviewViewport');
      if (!root) return;

      const slots = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.surat-preview-page-slot'));
      const sheets = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.surat-f4-sheet'));
      if (!sheets.length) return;

      slots.forEach((slot, idx) => {
        const show =
          suratPreviewState.activePage === 'all' ||
          (suratPreviewState.activePage === '1' && idx === 0) ||
          (suratPreviewState.activePage === '2' && idx === 1);
        slot.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      });

      const host = scrollArea || viewport || root;
      const hostRectW = host.clientWidth || 0;
      const hostRectH = host.clientHeight || 0;
      if (hostRectW <= 40) return;

      let padX = window.innerWidth < 640 ? 24 : 36;
      let padY = window.innerWidth < 640 ? 24 : 36;
      if (typeof window.getComputedStyle === 'function' && scrollArea) {
        const cs = window.getComputedStyle(scrollArea);
        padX = (parseFloat(cs.paddingLeft) || 0) + (parseFloat(cs.paddingRight) || 0) + 6;
        padY = (parseFloat(cs.paddingTop) || 0) + (parseFloat(cs.paddingBottom) || 0) + 6;
      }

      const availableWidth = Math.max(120, hostRectW - padX);
      const availableHeight = Math.max(160, hostRectH - padY);

      const firstVisibleSheet = sheets.find(s => !s.parentNode || !s.parentNode.classList || !s.parentNode.classList.contains('hidden')) || sheets[0];
      const naturalFallbackWidth = firstVisibleSheet.offsetWidth || 816;
      const naturalFallbackHeight = firstVisibleSheet.offsetHeight || 1248;

      let scale = 0.65;
      if (suratPreviewState.fitMode === 'custom') {
        scale = Math.max(0.35, Math.min(1.3, Number(suratPreviewState.zoomLevel || 70) / 100));
      } else if (suratPreviewState.fitMode === 'width') {
        scale = Math.max(0.30, Math.min(1.05, availableWidth / naturalFallbackWidth));
      } else {
        const scaleW = availableWidth / naturalFallbackWidth;
        const scaleH = availableHeight / naturalFallbackHeight;
        scale = Math.max(0.28, Math.min(0.95, Math.min(scaleW, scaleH)));
      }

      suratPreviewState.zoomLevel = Math.round(scale * 100);

      let maxScaledW = 0;
      sheets.forEach((sheet) => {
        const slot = sheet.parentNode;
        if (slot && slot.classList && slot.classList.contains('hidden')) return;
        const naturalW = sheet.offsetWidth || naturalFallbackWidth;
        const naturalH = sheet.offsetHeight || naturalFallbackHeight;
        const scaledW = Math.floor(naturalW * scale);
        const scaledH = Math.floor(naturalH * scale);
        if (scaledW > maxScaledW) maxScaledW = scaledW;
        if (slot && slot.classList && slot.classList.contains('surat-preview-page-slot')) {
          const nextW = `${scaledW}px`;
          const nextH = `${scaledH}px`;
          if (slot.style.width !== nextW) slot.style.width = nextW;
          if (slot.style.height !== nextH) slot.style.height = nextH;
        }
        const nextTransform = `scale(${scale.toFixed(4)})`;
        if (sheet.style.transform !== nextTransform) sheet.style.transform = nextTransform;
      });

      const nextMinWidth = maxScaledW > availableWidth ? `${maxScaledW}px` : '100%';
      if (root.style.minWidth !== nextMinWidth) root.style.minWidth = nextMinWidth;

      const scaleLabel = document.getElementById('suratPreviewScaleLabel');
      const nextLabel = `${Math.round(scale * 100)}%`;
      if (scaleLabel && scaleLabel.innerText !== nextLabel) {
        scaleLabel.innerText = nextLabel;
      }
      syncSuratPreviewToolbarUi();
    }

    function scheduleFitSuratPreviewSheets() {
      if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        if (suratPreviewRafId !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(suratPreviewRafId);
        suratPreviewRafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          suratPreviewRafId = null;
          fitSuratPreviewSheets();
        });
      } else {
        fitSuratPreviewSheets();
      }
    }

    function initSuratPreviewAutoFit() {
      const target = document.getElementById('suratDosenPreviewViewport') || document.getElementById('suratDosenPreviewScrollArea');
      if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'function' && target && !suratPreviewResizeObserver) {
        suratPreviewResizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
          scheduleFitSuratPreviewSheets();
        });
        suratPreviewResizeObserver.observe(target);
      }
      if (!suratPreviewResizeBound && typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.addEventListener === 'function') {
        window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleFitSuratPreviewSheets);
        suratPreviewResizeBound = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSuratDosenPreview() {
      const root = document.getElementById('suratDosenPreviewRoot');
      if (!root) return;
      const model = getSuratDocumentModel();
      root.innerHTML = buildSuratTwoPageInnerHtml(model);
      initSuratPreviewAutoFit();
      syncSuratPreviewToolbarUi();
      fitSuratPreviewSheets();
      if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => fitSuratPreviewSheets());
      }
    }

    function renderSuratDosenWorkspace() {
      setSuratMobilePane(suratPreviewState.mobilePane || 'form');
      const entries = extractCourseRegistrationsForSurat();
      const canEdit = typeof isSuratCanEditDraft === 'function' ? isSuratCanEditDraft() : true;
      const savedRecords = Array.isArray(appData && appData.suratPengantar) ? appData.suratPengantar : [];

      if (suratDosenState.currentRecordId) {
        const latestRec = savedRecords.find(r => String(r.ID || r.id || '').trim() === String(suratDosenState.currentRecordId).trim());
        if (latestRec && typeof applySuratRecordToState === 'function') {
          applySuratRecordToState(latestRec);
        }
      } else if (!canEdit && savedRecords.length > 0 && typeof pickDefaultRecordForVerifier === 'function') {
        const defRec = pickDefaultRecordForVerifier(savedRecords);
        if (defRec && typeof applySuratRecordToState === 'function') {
          applySuratRecordToState(defRec);
        }
      }

      // Auto-sync tahun akademik / semester dari periode aktif jika masih default & belum ada pilihan manual
      const activePeriode = (appData.master && Array.isArray(appData.master.periode))
        ? appData.master.periode.find(p => String(p.Status || '').toLowerCase() === 'aktif')
        : null;
      if (canEdit && !suratDosenState.currentRecordId && activePeriode && !suratDosenState.comboKey && !suratDosenState.dosen) {
        if (activePeriode['Tahun Akademik']) suratDosenState.tahunAkademik = activePeriode['Tahun Akademik'];
        if (activePeriode.Semester) suratDosenState.semester = activePeriode.Semester;
        if (activePeriode['Jenis Layanan']) suratDosenState.layanan = normalizeJenisLayananName(activePeriode['Jenis Layanan']) || suratDosenState.layanan;
      }

      // Jika belum ada dosen terpilih sama sekali dan ada paket di pendaftaran, pilih paket pertama secara otomatis agar user langsung melihat hasil nyata
      if (canEdit && !suratDosenState.currentRecordId && !suratDosenState.dosen && !suratDosenState.mataKuliah && entries.length > 0) {
        const combos = buildSuratQuickCombos(entries);
        if (combos.length > 0) {
          const first = combos[0];
          suratDosenState.comboKey = first.key;
          suratDosenState.layanan = first.layanan;
          suratDosenState.dosen = first.dosen;
          suratDosenState.mataKuliah = first.mataKuliah;
          syncSuratProdiDefaults(first.kodeProdi);
        }
      }

      populateSuratFilterOptions(entries);
      syncSuratInputsFromState();
      if (suratDosenState.rows.length === 0 && (suratDosenState.dosen || suratDosenState.mataKuliah) && !suratDosenState.currentRecordId) {
        rebuildSuratStudentRowsFromFilters();
      } else {
        if (!suratDosenState.currentRecordId && suratDosenState.rows.length > 0 && suratDosenState.rows.every(r => !isSuratRowChecked(r))) {
          suratDosenState.rows.forEach(r => { r.selected = true; });
        }
        renderSuratStudentRowsChecklist();
        renderSuratDosenPreview();
      }
      if (typeof renderSuratRecordsTable === 'function') renderSuratRecordsTable();
      if (typeof renderSuratRecordWorkflowBanner === 'function') renderSuratRecordWorkflowBanner();
      if (typeof renderSuratSignerReadonlyPanel === 'function') renderSuratSignerReadonlyPanel();
      if (typeof syncSuratWorkflowUiControls === 'function') syncSuratWorkflowUiControls();

      if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => fitSuratPreviewSheets());
      }
      setTimeout(fitSuratPreviewSheets, 60);
    }

    function openSuratDosenFromPendaftaran(regId) {
      const p = (appData.pendaftaran || []).find(item => String(item.ID || item.id) === String(regId));
      if (!p) {
        switchTab('suratdosen');
        return;
      }
      const entries = extractCourseRegistrationsForSurat().filter(e => String(e.regId) === String(regId));
      if (entries.length > 0) {
        const first = entries[0];
        suratDosenState.currentRecordId = '';
        suratDosenState.recordStatus = 'Draft Baru';
        suratDosenState.isLocked = false;
        suratDosenState.parafImage = '';
        suratDosenState.ttdImage = '';
        suratDosenState.parafBy = '';
        suratDosenState.parafAt = '';
        suratDosenState.ttdBy = '';
        suratDosenState.ttdAt = '';
        suratDosenState.revisionNote = '';
        suratDosenState.comboKey = `${first.layanan}|||${first.kodeProdi}|||${first.dosen}|||${first.mataKuliah}`;
        suratDosenState.layanan = first.layanan;
        suratDosenState.dosen = first.dosen;
        suratDosenState.mataKuliah = first.mataKuliah;
        suratDosenState.kelasSemester = '';
        suratDosenState.statusFilter = 'ALL';
        suratDosenState.tahunAkademik = first.tahunAkademik || suratDosenState.tahunAkademik;
        suratDosenState.semester = first.semesterPeriode || suratDosenState.semester;
        syncSuratProdiDefaults(first.kodeProdi);
        suratDosenState.rows = [];
      }
      switchTab('suratdosen');
    }

    function buildSuratSafeFileName(model, ext) {
      const cleanExt = String(ext || 'pdf').replace(/^\.+/, '');
      const periodLabel = getExportAcademicPeriodLabel(
        model && model.tahunAkademik,
        model && model.semester
      );
      const parts = [
        'Surat Pengantar',
        sanitizeExportFileSegment(model && model.perihalSingkat, 40, 'Dokumen'),
        sanitizeExportFileSegment(model && model.mataKuliah, 45, 'Mata Kuliah'),
        sanitizeExportFileSegment(model && model.dosenNama, 45, 'Dosen'),
        periodLabel
      ];
      if (model && model.includeSignatures === false) {
        parts.push('Tanpa TTD');
      }
      const baseName = parts.filter(Boolean).join(' ').replace(/_+/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      return `${baseName}.${cleanExt}`;
    }

    function ensurePdfLibrariesLoaded() {
      const hasCanvas = () => typeof window.html2canvas === 'function';
      const hasJsPdf = () => Boolean(window.jspdf && typeof window.jspdf.jsPDF === 'function');
      if (hasCanvas() && hasJsPdf()) return Promise.resolve();

      const loadScript = (src) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const existing = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script')).find(s => s.src === src);
        if (existing) {
          existing.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(), { once: true });
          existing.addEventListener('error', () => reject(new Error(`Gagal memuat ${src}`)), { once: true });
          return;
        }
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = src;
        script.async = true;
        script.onload = () => resolve();
        script.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Gagal memuat ${src}`));
        document.head.appendChild(script);
      });

      const tasks = [];
      if (!hasCanvas()) tasks.push(loadScript('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html2canvas@1.4.1/dist/html2canvas.min.js'));
      if (!hasJsPdf()) tasks.push(loadScript('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js'));
      return Promise.all(tasks).then(() => {
        if (!hasCanvas() || !hasJsPdf()) {
          throw new Error('Komponen pembuat PDF belum tersedia di browser.');
        }
      });
    }

    function guardSuratFinalExportAllowed(model) {
      if (model && model.includeSignatures === false) return true;
      if (model && model.isFinalVerified) return true;
      const statusText = (model && model.statusVerifikasi) ? model.statusVerifikasi : 'Draft Baru';
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'warning',
        title: 'Ekspor Final Terkunci',
        html: `<div class="text-xs text-slate-600 space-y-2 text-left">
          <p>Dokumen PDF, Cetak, dan Word (.docx) bertanda tangan digital hanya dapat diunduh setelah menyelesaikan verifikasi 3 tahap:</p>
          <ol class="list-decimal pl-5 space-y-1 font-medium text-slate-700">
            <li><b>Konfirmasi &amp; Simpan</b> form isian oleh Master Admin / Admin TU</li>
            <li><b>Paraf Sek.Prodi</b> (1-klik, mengunci edit)</li>
            <li><b>TTD Final KaProdi</b> (1-klik, membuka dokumen final)</li>
          </ol>
          <p class="pt-1 text-slate-600">Untuk cetak atau tanda tangan basah secara langsung, alihkan mode di atas ke <b>Tanpa Paraf &amp; TTD</b>.</p>
          <p class="pt-0.5 font-bold text-blue-900">Status saat ini: ${escapeHtml(statusText)}</p>
        </div>`,
        confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a',
        confirmButtonText: 'Mengerti'
      });
      return false;
    }

    async function downloadSuratPengantarPdf() {
      const model = getSuratDocumentModel();
      if (!guardSuratFinalExportAllowed(model)) return;
      const fileName = buildSuratSafeFileName(model, 'pdf');
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnDownloadSuratPdf');
      const origHtml = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';
      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> <span>Membuat PDF...</span>';
      }

      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Membuat File PDF (F4)...',
        text: 'Menyiapkan 2 halaman resmi berukuran 8.5 x 13 in.',
        allowOutsideClick: false,
        didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading()
      });

      let stage = null;
      try {
        await ensurePdfLibrariesLoaded();
        stage = document.createElement('div');
        stage.id = 'suratPdfCaptureStage';
        stage.style.cssText = 'position: fixed; left: -99999px; top: 0; width: 816px; background: #ffffff; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none;';
        stage.innerHTML = buildSuratTwoPageInnerHtml(model, { forPdfCapture: true });
        document.body.appendChild(stage);

        if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
          await document.fonts.ready.catch(() => {});
        }
        const imgs = Array.from(stage.querySelectorAll('img'));
        await Promise.all(imgs.map(img => {
          if (img.complete) {
            return typeof img.decode === 'function' ? img.decode().catch(() => {}) : Promise.resolve();
          }
          return new Promise(res => {
            img.onload = res;
            img.onerror = res;
          });
        }));

        const pages = [
          stage.querySelector('.surat-pdf-page-1'),
          stage.querySelector('.surat-pdf-page-2')
        ].filter(Boolean);

        if (!pages.length) {
          throw new Error('Elemen halaman surat tidak ditemukan.');
        }

        const F4_WIDTH_MM = 215.9;
        const F4_HEIGHT_MM = 330.2;
        const pdf = new window.jspdf.jsPDF({
          orientation: 'portrait',
          unit: 'mm',
          format: [F4_WIDTH_MM, F4_HEIGHT_MM],
          compress: true
        });

        for (let idx = 0; idx < pages.length; idx++) {
          const canvas = await window.html2canvas(pages[idx], {
            scale: 2,
            useCORS: true,
            backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            width: 816,
            windowWidth: 816,
            logging: false
          });
          if (idx > 0) {
            pdf.addPage([F4_WIDTH_MM, F4_HEIGHT_MM], 'portrait');
          }
          const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.96);
          const rawHeightMm = (canvas.height * F4_WIDTH_MM) / canvas.width;
          let renderW = F4_WIDTH_MM;
          let renderH = rawHeightMm;
          let offsetX = 0;
          if (rawHeightMm > F4_HEIGHT_MM) {
            const fitScale = F4_HEIGHT_MM / rawHeightMm;
            renderW = F4_WIDTH_MM * fitScale;
            renderH = F4_HEIGHT_MM;
            offsetX = (F4_WIDTH_MM - renderW) / 2;
          }
          pdf.addImage(imgData, 'JPEG', offsetX, 0, renderW, renderH, undefined, 'FAST');
        }

        pdf.save(fileName);
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'File PDF (F4) Siap!',
          text: `Dokumen "${fileName}" berukuran 8.5 x 13 in berhasil diunduh (2 halaman).`,
          timer: 2600,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
      } catch (err) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'error',
          title: 'Gagal Membuat PDF',
          text: (err && err.message) ? err.message : 'Silakan gunakan tombol Cetak / Print atau Download Word (.docx).'
        });
      } finally {
        if (stage && stage.parentNode) {
          stage.parentNode.removeChild(stage);
        }
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
        }
      }
    }

    function printSuratPengantarDosen() {
      const model = getSuratDocumentModel();
      if (!guardSuratFinalExportAllowed(model)) return;
      let portal = document.getElementById('suratPrintPortal');
      if (!portal) {
        portal = document.createElement('div');
        portal.id = 'suratPrintPortal';
        document.body.appendChild(portal);
      }
      portal.innerHTML = buildSuratTwoPageInnerHtml(model, { forPrintPortal: true });
      document.body.classList.add('printing-surat-dosen');

      let pageStyle = document.getElementById('dynamicSuratPrintPageStyle');
      if (!pageStyle) {
        pageStyle = document.createElement('style');
        pageStyle.id = 'dynamicSuratPrintPageStyle';
        document.head.appendChild(pageStyle);
      }
      pageStyle.textContent = '@page { size: 8.5in 13in; margin: 2mm 4mm 4mm 4mm; }';

      const cleanup = () => {
        document.body.classList.remove('printing-surat-dosen');
        const p = document.getElementById('suratPrintPortal');
        if (p) p.innerHTML = '';
        const ps = document.getElementById('dynamicSuratPrintPageStyle');
        if (ps) ps.remove();
        window.removeEventListener('afterprint', cleanup);
      };
      window.addEventListener('afterprint', cleanup);

      try {
        window.print();
      } catch (err) {
        cleanup();
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'info',
          title: 'Dialog Cetak Dibatasi Browser',
          text: 'Gunakan tombol "Simpan PDF (.pdf)" untuk langsung mengunduh file PDF F4.'
        });
      }
    }

    function ensureDocxLibraryLoaded() {
      if (typeof window.JSZip === 'function') return Promise.resolve();
      const src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jszip@3.10.1/dist/jszip.min.js';
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const existing = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script')).find(s => s.src === src);
        if (existing) {
          existing.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(), { once: true });
          existing.addEventListener('error', () => reject(new Error('Gagal memuat library pembentuk .docx')), { once: true });
          return;
        }
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = src;
        script.async = true;
        script.onload = () => resolve();
        script.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Gagal memuat library pembentuk .docx'));
        document.head.appendChild(script);
      }).then(() => {
        if (typeof window.JSZip !== 'function') {
          throw new Error('Library JSZip untuk file .docx belum tersedia.');
        }
      });
    }

    function escapeXmlSurat(str) {
      return String(str == null ? '' : str)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&apos;');
    }

    function base64DataUriToUint8Array(dataUri) {
      const raw = String(dataUri || '');
      const commaIdx = raw.indexOf(',');
      const b64 = commaIdx >= 0 ? raw.slice(commaIdx + 1) : raw;
      const bin = atob(b64);
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
      for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) {
        bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
      }
      return bytes;
    }

    function getPngDimensionsFromBytes(uint8) {
      if (uint8 && uint8.length >= 24 && uint8[12] === 0x49 && uint8[13] === 0x48 && uint8[14] === 0x44 && uint8[15] === 0x52) {
        const w = ((uint8[16] << 24) >>> 0) + (uint8[17] << 16) + (uint8[18] << 8) + uint8[19];
        const h = ((uint8[20] << 24) >>> 0) + (uint8[21] << 16) + (uint8[22] << 8) + uint8[23];
        if (w > 0 && h > 0) return { width: w, height: h };
      }
      return { width: 240, height: 110 };
    }

    function fitPngEmuWithin(uint8, maxCx, maxCy) {
      const dim = getPngDimensionsFromBytes(uint8);
      const ratio = Math.min(maxCx / dim.width, maxCy / dim.height);
      return {
        cx: Math.max(91440, Math.round(dim.width * ratio)),
        cy: Math.max(91440, Math.round(dim.height * ratio))
      };
    }

    function buildOoxmlRun(text, opts = {}) {
      const sz = opts.sz || 24;
      const font = opts.font || 'Times New Roman';
      const color = opts.color || '000000';
      const boldXml = opts.bold ? '<w:b/><w:bCs/>' : '';
      const italicXml = opts.italic ? '<w:i/><w:iCs/>' : '';
      const underlineXml = opts.underline ? '<w:u w:val="single"/>' : '';
      return `<w:r><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="${font}" w:hAnsi="${font}" w:cs="${font}"/>${boldXml}${italicXml}${underlineXml}<w:color w:val="${color}"/><w:sz w:val="${sz}"/><w:szCs w:val="${sz}"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">${escapeXmlSurat(text)}</w:t></w:r>`;
    }

    function buildOoxmlParagraph(runsXml, opts = {}) {
      const indLeft = opts.indLeft ? `<w:ind w:left="${opts.indLeft}"/>` : '';
      const jc = opts.jc ? `<w:jc w:val="${opts.jc}"/>` : '';
      const before = opts.before != null ? opts.before : 0;
      const after = opts.after != null ? opts.after : 0;
      const line = opts.line != null ? opts.line : 264;
      const lineRule = opts.lineRule || 'auto';
      return `<w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="${before}" w:after="${after}" w:line="${line}" w:lineRule="${lineRule}"/>${indLeft}${jc}</w:pPr>${runsXml}</w:p>`;
    }

    function buildOoxmlDrawingInline(rId, cx, cy, docPrId, name) {
      return `<w:r><w:drawing><wp:inline distT="0" distB="0" distL="0" distR="0" xmlns:wp="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing"><wp:extent cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}"/><wp:effectExtent l="0" t="0" r="0" b="0"/><wp:docPr id="${docPrId}" name="${escapeXmlSurat(name)}"/><wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphicFrameLocks xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" noChangeAspect="1"/></wp:cNvGraphicFramePr><a:graphic xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"><a:graphicData uri="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:pic xmlns:pic="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/picture"><pic:nvPicPr><pic:cNvPr id="${docPrId}" name="${escapeXmlSurat(name)}"/><pic:cNvPicPr/></pic:nvPicPr><pic:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="${rId}" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></pic:blipFill><pic:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom></pic:spPr></pic:pic></a:graphicData></a:graphic></wp:inline></w:drawing></w:r>`;
    }

    function buildOoxmlBordersXml(visible) {
      if (!visible) {
        return `<w:tblBorders><w:top w:val="none" w:sz="0" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:left w:val="none" w:sz="0" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:bottom w:val="none" w:sz="0" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:right w:val="none" w:sz="0" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:insideH w:val="none" w:sz="0" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/><w:insideV w:val="none" w:sz="0" w:space="0" w:color="auto"/></w:tblBorders>`;
      }
      return `<w:tblBorders><w:top w:val="single" w:sz="6" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/><w:left w:val="single" w:sz="6" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/><w:bottom w:val="single" w:sz="6" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/><w:right w:val="single" w:sz="6" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/><w:insideH w:val="single" w:sz="6" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/><w:insideV w:val="single" w:sz="6" w:space="0" w:color="000000"/></w:tblBorders>`;
    }

    function buildOoxmlCell(innerParagraphsXml, widthTwips, opts = {}) {
      const spanXml = opts.gridSpan && opts.gridSpan > 1 ? `<w:gridSpan w:val="${opts.gridSpan}"/>` : '';
      const shdXml = opts.fill ? `<w:shd w:val="clear" w:color="auto" w:fill="${opts.fill}"/>` : '';
      const vAlignXml = opts.vAlign ? `<w:vAlign w:val="${opts.vAlign}"/>` : '<w:vAlign w:val="top"/>';
      const padV = opts.padV != null ? opts.padV : 40;
      const padH = opts.padH != null ? opts.padH : 70;
      const marXml = `<w:tcMar><w:top w:w="${padV}" w:type="dxa"/><w:bottom w:w="${padV}" w:type="dxa"/><w:left w:w="${padH}" w:type="dxa"/><w:right w:w="${padH}" w:type="dxa"/></w:tcMar>`;
      return `<w:tc><w:tcPr><w:tcW w:w="${widthTwips}" w:type="dxa"/>${spanXml}${shdXml}${marXml}${vAlignXml}</w:tcPr>${innerParagraphsXml}</w:tc>`;
    }

    function buildOoxmlFooterXml(kodeArsip, leftWidth, centerWidth, rightWidth, kodeIndent, docPrId) {
      const totalWidth = leftWidth + centerWidth + rightWidth;
      const leftCell = buildOoxmlCell(
        buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(kodeArsip, { sz: 11, font: 'Arial', color: '000000' }), { indLeft: kodeIndent, before: 0, after: 40, line: 220, lineRule: 'auto' }),
        leftWidth,
        { vAlign: 'bottom', padV: 0, padH: 0 }
      );
      const centerCell = buildOoxmlCell(
        buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlDrawingInline('rIdImg2', 4000500, 439399, docPrId, 'Footer Resmi FEB UIKA Bogor'), { jc: 'center', before: 0, after: 0, line: 240, lineRule: 'auto' }),
        centerWidth,
        { vAlign: 'bottom', padV: 0, padH: 0 }
      );
      const rightCell = buildOoxmlCell(
        buildOoxmlParagraph('', { before: 0, after: 0 }),
        rightWidth,
        { vAlign: 'bottom', padV: 0, padH: 0 }
      );
      return `${'<' + '?'}xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"${'?' + '>'}
<w:ftr xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships">
  <w:tbl>
    <w:tblPr><w:tblW w:w="${totalWidth}" w:type="dxa"/>${buildOoxmlBordersXml(false)}<w:tblLayout w:type="fixed"/></w:tblPr>
    <w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="${leftWidth}"/><w:gridCol w:w="${centerWidth}"/><w:gridCol w:w="${rightWidth}"/></w:tblGrid>
    <w:tr><w:trPr><w:cantSplit/></w:trPr>${leftCell}${centerCell}${rightCell}</w:tr>
  </w:tbl>
  <w:p><w:pPr><w:spacing w:before="0" w:after="0" w:line="20" w:lineRule="exact"/></w:pPr></w:p>
</w:ftr>`;
    }

    async function buildSuratDocxBlob(model) {
      await ensureDocxLibraryLoaded();
      const m = model || getSuratDocumentModel();
      const zip = new window.JSZip();

      const rowCount = m.rows.length;
      const p1RowTwips = rowCount > 10 ? 300 : 350;
      const p2RowTwips = rowCount > 11 ? 450 : (rowCount > 7 ? 600 : 870);
      const cursiveFont = 'Monotype Corsiva';

      // Page 1 top metadata table (indented 700 twips from left=720 => x=1420 twips = 71pt)
      const p1TopRows = [
        {
          label: 'Nomor',
          valRuns: buildOoxmlRun(m.nomorSurat, { sz: 24 }),
          c4: buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun('Bogor,', { sz: 24 }), { after: 0 }),
          c5: buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(m.tanggalMasehiText, { sz: 24, underline: true }), { after: 0 })
        },
        {
          label: 'Lampiran',
          valRuns: buildOoxmlRun(m.lampiran, { sz: 24 }),
          c4: buildOoxmlParagraph('', { after: 0 }),
          c5: buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(m.tanggalHijriahText, { sz: 24 }), { after: 0 })
        },
        {
          label: 'Perihal',
          valRuns: buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(m.perihalSingkat, { sz: 24 }), { after: 0 }) +
            buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(`Semester ${m.semester} TA. ${m.tahunAkademik}`, { sz: 24 }), { after: 0 }),
          isMultiParaVal: true,
          c4: buildOoxmlParagraph('', { after: 0 }),
          c5: buildOoxmlParagraph('', { after: 0 })
        }
      ].map(r => {
        const valCellXml = r.isMultiParaVal ? r.valRuns : buildOoxmlParagraph(r.valRuns, { after: 0 });
        return `<w:tr><w:trPr><w:cantSplit/></w:trPr>` +
          buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(r.label, { sz: 24 }), { after: 0 }), 1220, { padV: 15, padH: 20 }) +
          buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(':', { sz: 24 }), { after: 0 }), 200, { padV: 15, padH: 10 }) +
          buildOoxmlCell(valCellXml, 4420, { padV: 15, padH: 20 }) +
          buildOoxmlCell(r.c4, 840, { padV: 15, padH: 20 }) +
          buildOoxmlCell(r.c5, 3020, { padV: 15, padH: 20 }) +
          `</w:tr>`;
      }).join('');

      const p1TopMetaTable = `<w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblW w:w="9700" w:type="dxa"/><w:tblInd w:w="700" w:type="dxa"/>${buildOoxmlBordersXml(false)}<w:tblLayout w:type="fixed"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="1220"/><w:gridCol w:w="200"/><w:gridCol w:w="4420"/><w:gridCol w:w="840"/><w:gridCol w:w="3020"/></w:tblGrid>${p1TopRows}</w:tbl>`;

      // Page 1 Student Table (indented 2320 twips from left=720 => x=3040 twips = 152pt, total width 8080 twips)
      const p1TableHeaderRow = `<w:tr><w:trPr><w:cantSplit/><w:tblHeader/></w:trPr>` +
        buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun('No', { sz: 24, bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF' }), { jc: 'center', after: 0 }), 660, { fill: '000000', vAlign: 'center', padV: 60, padH: 40 }) +
        buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun('Nama Mahasiswa', { sz: 24, bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF' }), { jc: 'center', after: 0 }), 3720, { fill: '000000', vAlign: 'center', padV: 60, padH: 70 }) +
        buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun('NPM', { sz: 24, bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF' }), { jc: 'center', after: 0 }), 1850, { fill: '000000', vAlign: 'center', padV: 60, padH: 60 }) +
        buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun('Semester/Kelas', { sz: 24, bold: true, color: 'FFFFFF' }), { jc: 'center', after: 0 }), 1850, { fill: '000000', vAlign: 'center', padV: 60, padH: 60 }) +
        `</w:tr>`;

      const p1StudentRows = m.rows.map((r, i) => `<w:tr><w:trPr><w:cantSplit/><w:trHeight w:val="${p1RowTwips}" w:hRule="atLeast"/></w:trPr>` +
        buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(`${i + 1}.`, { sz: 24 }), { jc: 'center', after: 0 }), 660, { vAlign: 'center', padV: 30, padH: 40 }) +
        buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(r.nama, { sz: 24 }), { after: 0 }), 3720, { vAlign: 'center', padV: 30, padH: 70 }) +
        buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(r.npm, { sz: 24 }), { jc: 'center', after: 0 }), 1850, { vAlign: 'center', padV: 30, padH: 60 }) +
        buildOoxmlCell(buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlRun(r.semesterKelas, { sz: 24 }), { jc: 'center', after: 0 }), 1850, { vAlign: 'center', padV: 30, padH: 60 }) +
        `</w:tr>`).join('');

      const p1StudentTable = `<w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblW w:w="8080" w:type="dxa"/><w:tblInd w:w="2320" w:type="dxa"/>${buildOoxmlBordersXml(true)}<w:tblLayout w:type="fixed"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="660"/><w:gridCol w:w="3720"/><w:gridCol w:w="1850"/><w:gridCol w:w="1850"/></w:tblGrid>${p1TableHeaderRow}${p1StudentRows}</w:tbl>`;

      const alasanText = m.isRemedial
        ? `${m.layananDalamIsi} ini dilaksanakan guna memberikan kesempatan perbaikan nilai bagi mahasiswa yang bersangkutan sesuai ketentuan akademik yang berlaku.`
        : `${m.perihalSingkat} ini perlu dilaksanakan karena mahasiswa yang bersangkutan tidak dapat mengikuti ${m.namaUjianNormal} pada waktu yang telah ditentukan.`;
      const tindakLanjutText = `Bersama ini kami lampirkan ${m.labelFormulir}, dan nilai hasil ${m.isRemedial ? 'remedial' : 'ujian'} diharapkan dapat disampaikan kepada Tata Usaha Program Studi paling lambat ${m.tenggatNilai} setelah ${m.isRemedial ? 'Remedial Teaching' : 'Ujian Susulan'} dilaksanakan.`;

      const hasParafImg = Boolean(m.parafImage && String(m.parafImage).startsWith('data:image/'));
      const hasTtdImg = Boolean(m.ttdImage && String(m.ttdImage).startsWith('data:image/'));
      const parafBytes = hasParafImg ? base64DataUriToUint8Array(m.parafImage) : null;
      const ttdBytes = hasTtdImg ? base64DataUriToUint8Array(m.ttdImage) : null;
      const parafEmu = parafBytes ? fitPngEmuWithin(parafBytes, 180000, 180000) : null;
      const ttdEmu = ttdBytes ? fitPngEmuWithin(ttdBytes, 1750000, 620000) : null;

      const kaprodiTtdCellXml = buildOoxmlCell(
        ttdEmu
          ? buildOoxmlParagraph(buildOoxmlDrawingInline('rIdImgTtd', ttdEmu.cx, ttdEmu.cy, 5, 'TTD KaProdi'), { jc: 'left', before: 0, after: 0, line: 240, lineRule: 'auto' })
          : buildOoxmlParagraph('', { after: 0 }),
        4500,
