    async function downloadSuratPengantarWord() {
      const model = getSuratDocumentModel();
      if (!guardSuratFinalExportAllowed(model)) return;
      const fileName = buildSuratSafeFileName(model, 'docx');
      const btn = document.getElementById('btnDownloadSuratWord');
      const origHtml = btn ? btn.innerHTML : '';
      if (btn) {
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> <span>Membuat Word...</span>';
      }

      Swal.fire({
        title: 'Membuat File Word (.docx)...',
        text: 'Menyusun 2 halaman F4 (8.5 x 13 in) kompatibel MS Word & Google Docs.',
        allowOutsideClick: false,
        didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading()
      });

      try {
        const blob = await buildSuratDocxBlob(model);
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = url;
        a.download = fileName;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1500);

        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'File Word (.docx) Siap!',
          text: `Dokumen "${fileName}" berukuran F4 (8.5 x 13 in) berhasil diunduh (2 halaman identik).`,
          timer: 2600,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
      } catch (err) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'error',
          title: 'Gagal Membuat File Word (.docx)',
          text: (err && err.message) ? err.message : 'Silakan gunakan tombol Simpan PDF (.pdf) atau Cetak / Print.'
        });
      } finally {
        if (btn) {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.innerHTML = origHtml;
        }
      }
    }
  </script>

  <!-- WORKFLOW VERIFIKASI 3 TAHAP & SPESIMEN PARAF/TTD DIGITAL -->
  <script>
    let suratRecordStatusFilter = 'ALL';

    function getSuratNormalizedRole() {
      return String((currentUser && currentUser.role) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    }

    function isSuratMasterRole() {
      const r = getSuratNormalizedRole();
      return r === 'master admin' || r === 'master_admin';
    }

    function isSuratAdminTuRole() {
      const r = getSuratNormalizedRole();
      return r === 'admin tu' || r === 'admintu' || r === 'admin';
    }

    function isSuratCanEditDraft() {
      return isSuratMasterRole() || isSuratAdminTuRole();
    }

    function isSuratRoleSekprodi() {
      const r = getSuratNormalizedRole();
      return r.includes('sekretaris') || r.includes('sekprodi') || r.includes('sek.prodi');
    }

    function isSuratRoleKaprodi() {
      const r = getSuratNormalizedRole();
      return r.includes('ketua program studi') || r.includes('kaprodi');
    }

    function getSuratUserScopeProdi() {
      if (!currentUser) return '';
      const direct = String(currentUser.kodeProdi || currentUser['Kode Prodi'] || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      if (direct) return direct;
      const uname = String(currentUser.username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const staff = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.users_staff)) ? appData.users_staff : [];
      const hit = staff.find(s => String(s.Username || s.username || '').trim().toLowerCase() === uname);
      return hit ? String(hit['Kode Prodi'] || hit.kodeProdi || '').trim().toUpperCase() : '';
    }

    function hasSuratProdiAccess(kodeProdi) {
      if (isSuratMasterRole() || isSuratAdminTuRole()) return true;
      const scope = getSuratUserScopeProdi();
      if (!scope || scope === 'ALL' || scope === 'SEMUA') return true;
      return scope === String(kodeProdi || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    }

    function parseSuratJsonSafe(raw, fallbackVal) {
      if (raw && typeof raw === 'object') return raw;
      const str = String(raw || '').trim();
      if (!str) return fallbackVal;
      try {
        return JSON.parse(str);
      } catch (e) {
        return fallbackVal;
      }
    }

    function normalizeSuratDateIso(rawDate) {
      const str = String(rawDate || '').trim();
      if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(str)) return str.slice(0, 10);
      return getLocalIsoTodayForSurat();
    }

    function normalizeSuratRecordItem(rec) {
      if (!rec || typeof rec !== 'object') return null;
      const id = String(rec.ID || rec.id || '').trim();
      if (!id) return null;
      const status = String(rec['Status Verifikasi'] || rec.statusVerifikasi || 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi').trim();
      const lockedRaw = String(rec.Locked || rec.locked || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const isLocked = lockedRaw === 'ya' || lockedRaw === 'true' || status === 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi' || status === 'Terverifikasi Final';
      const meta = parseSuratJsonSafe(rec['Meta JSON'] || rec.meta, {});
      const rows = parseSuratJsonSafe(rec['Mahasiswa JSON'] || rec.rows, []);
      const kodeProdi = String(rec['Kode Prodi'] || rec.kodeProdi || 'MNJ').trim().toUpperCase();
      const nomorSurat = String(rec['Nomor Surat'] || rec.nomorSurat || '').trim();
      const kodeArsip = String(rec['Kode Arsip'] || rec.kodeArsip || '').trim();

      const parsedRows = (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).map((x, idx) => ({
        uid: (x && x.uid) || `${id}_${idx}`,
        selected: x ? (x.selected !== false && String(x.selected).toLowerCase() !== 'false') : true,
        nama: String((x && x.nama) || ''),
        npm: String((x && x.npm) || ''),
        semesterKelas: String((x && x.semesterKelas) || ''),
        status: String((x && x.status) || 'Disetujui')
      }));
      if (parsedRows.length > 0 && parsedRows.every(x => !x.selected)) {
        parsedRows.forEach(x => { x.selected = true; });
      }

      return {
        id,
        nomorSurat,
        kodeArsip,
        kodeProdi,
        programStudi: String(rec['Program Studi'] || rec.programStudi || getSuratProdiMeta(kodeProdi).nama).trim(),
        layanan: String(rec['Jenis Layanan'] || rec.layanan || 'UTS Susulan').trim(),
        dosen: String(rec['Dosen Pengampu'] || rec.dosen || '').trim(),
        mataKuliah: String(rec['Mata Kuliah'] || rec.mataKuliah || '').trim(),
        semester: String(rec.Semester || rec.semester || 'Ganjil').trim(),
        tahunAkademik: String(rec['Tahun Akademik'] || rec.tahunAkademik || '2026/2027').trim(),
        tanggalMasehi: normalizeSuratDateIso(rec['Tanggal Masehi'] || rec.tanggalMasehi),
        tanggalHijriah: String(rec['Tanggal Hijriah'] || rec.tanggalHijriah || '').trim(),
        lampiran: String(rec.Lampiran || rec.lampiran || '1 (satu) Berkas').trim(),
        tenggatNilai: String(rec['Tenggat Nilai'] || rec.tenggatNilai || '1 (satu) minggu').trim(),
        kaprodiNama: String(rec['Kaprodi Nama'] || rec.kaprodiNama || getSuratProdiMeta(kodeProdi).kaprodi).trim(),
        kaprodiNikNidn: String(rec['Kaprodi NIK'] || rec.kaprodiNikNidn || getSuratProdiMeta(kodeProdi).nikNidn).trim(),
        rows: parsedRows,
        statusVerifikasi: status,
        isLocked,
        parafSummary: String(rec['Paraf SekProdi'] || rec.parafSummary || '').trim(),
        ttdSummary: String(rec['TTD KaProdi'] || rec.ttdSummary || '').trim(),
        parafImage: String(rec['Paraf Image'] || rec.parafImage || '').trim(),
        ttdImage: String(rec['TTD Image'] || rec.ttdImage || '').trim(),
        meta: meta && typeof meta === 'object' ? meta : {}
      };
    }

    function applySuratRecordToState(rawRec) {
      const rec = normalizeSuratRecordItem(rawRec);
      if (!rec) return;
      const meta = rec.meta || {};
      const nomorParts = rec.nomorSurat.split('/');
      const arsipParts = rec.kodeArsip.split('/');
      const parsedUrut = meta.nomorUrut != null ? String(meta.nomorUrut) : (nomorParts[0] && nomorParts[0] !== 'xxx' ? nomorParts[0] : '');
      const parsedNomorThn = meta.nomorTahun != null ? String(meta.nomorTahun) : (nomorParts[4] || getSuratDefaultYear());
      const parsedArsipXX = meta.kodeArsipXX != null ? String(meta.kodeArsipXX) : (arsipParts[2] && arsipParts[2] !== 'XX' ? arsipParts[2] : '');
      const parsedArsipThn = meta.kodeArsipTahun != null ? String(meta.kodeArsipTahun) : (arsipParts[3] || getSuratDefaultYear());

      suratDosenState.currentRecordId = rec.id;
      suratDosenState.recordStatus = rec.statusVerifikasi;
      suratDosenState.isLocked = rec.isLocked;
      suratDosenState.parafImage = rec.parafImage;
      suratDosenState.ttdImage = rec.ttdImage;
      suratDosenState.parafSummary = rec.parafSummary;
      suratDosenState.ttdSummary = rec.ttdSummary;
      suratDosenState.parafBy = String(meta.parafBy || rec.parafSummary || '').trim();
      suratDosenState.parafAt = String(meta.parafAt || '').trim();
      suratDosenState.ttdBy = String(meta.ttdBy || rec.ttdSummary || '').trim();
      suratDosenState.ttdAt = String(meta.ttdAt || '').trim();
      suratDosenState.createdBy = String(meta.createdBy || '').trim();
      suratDosenState.createdAt = String(meta.createdAt || '').trim();
      suratDosenState.revisionNote = String(meta.revisionNote || '').trim();

      suratDosenState.comboKey = String(meta.comboKey || '');
      suratDosenState.layanan = rec.layanan;
      suratDosenState.kodeProdi = rec.kodeProdi;
      suratDosenState.dosen = rec.dosen;
      suratDosenState.mataKuliah = rec.mataKuliah;
      suratDosenState.kelasSemester = String(meta.kelasSemester || '');
      suratDosenState.statusFilter = String(meta.statusFilter || 'ALL');
      suratDosenState.nomorUrut = parsedUrut;
      suratDosenState.nomorTahun = parsedNomorThn;
      suratDosenState.kodeArsipXX = parsedArsipXX;
      suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun = parsedArsipThn;
      suratDosenState.nomorSurat = rec.nomorSurat || composeSuratNomorSurat(getSuratProdiMeta(rec.kodeProdi).kodeSurat);
      suratDosenState.kodeArsip = rec.kodeArsip || composeSuratKodeArsip(getSuratProdiMeta(rec.kodeProdi).kodeSurat);
      suratDosenState.lampiran = rec.lampiran;
      suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi = rec.tanggalMasehi;
      suratDosenState.tanggalHijriah = rec.tanggalHijriah || formatTanggalHijriahSurat(rec.tanggalMasehi);
      suratDosenState.semester = rec.semester;
      suratDosenState.tahunAkademik = rec.tahunAkademik;
      suratDosenState.kaprodiNama = rec.kaprodiNama;
      suratDosenState.kaprodiNikNidn = rec.kaprodiNikNidn;
      suratDosenState.tenggatNilai = rec.tenggatNilai;
      suratDosenState.padToMinRows = false;
      suratDosenState.minRows = 0;
      suratDosenState.rows = rec.rows.map((r, idx) => ({
        uid: r.uid || `${rec.id}_${idx}`,
        selected: isSuratRowChecked(r),
        nama: String(r.nama || ''),
        npm: String(r.npm || ''),
        semesterKelas: String(r.semesterKelas || ''),
        status: String(r.status || 'Disetujui')
      }));
    }

    function pickDefaultRecordForVerifier(rawList) {
      const normalized = (rawList || []).map(normalizeSuratRecordItem).filter(Boolean).filter(r => hasSuratProdiAccess(r.kodeProdi));
      if (!normalized.length) return null;
      if (isSuratRoleSekprodi()) {
        const hit = normalized.find(r => r.statusVerifikasi === 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi');
        if (hit) return hit;
      }
      if (isSuratRoleKaprodi()) {
        const hit = normalized.find(r => r.statusVerifikasi === 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi');
        if (hit) return hit;
      }
      return normalized[0];
    }

    function findActiveSpecimenRecord(kodeProdi, jenisSpesimen, preferredUsername) {
      const list = Array.isArray(appData && appData.spesimenTtd) ? appData.spesimenTtd : [];
      const targetKind = String(jenisSpesimen || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'paraf' ? 'paraf' : 'ttd';
      const targetUser = String(preferredUsername || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      const targetProdi = String(kodeProdi || '').trim().toUpperCase();

      if (targetUser) {
        const byUser = list.find(s =>
          String(s['Jenis Spesimen'] || s.jenisSpesimen || '').trim().toLowerCase() === targetKind &&
          String(s.Username || s.username || '').trim().toLowerCase() === targetUser &&
          String(s['Data Gambar'] || s.imageDataUri || '').startsWith('data:image/')
        );
        if (byUser) return byUser;
      }
      if (targetProdi) {
        const byProdi = list.find(s =>
          String(s['Jenis Spesimen'] || s.jenisSpesimen || '').trim().toLowerCase() === targetKind &&
          String(s['Kode Prodi'] || s.kodeProdi || '').trim().toUpperCase() === targetProdi &&
          String(s['Data Gambar'] || s.imageDataUri || '').startsWith('data:image/')
        );
        if (byProdi) return byProdi;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function loadSuratRecordIntoWorkspace(recordId, switchMobilePreview = false) {
      const raw = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.suratPengantar))
        ? appData.suratPengantar.find(r => String(r.ID || r.id || '').trim() === String(recordId || '').trim())
        : null;
      if (!raw) return;

      applySuratRecordToState(raw);
      const entries = extractCourseRegistrationsForSurat();
      populateSuratFilterOptions(entries);
      syncSuratInputsFromState();
      renderSuratStudentRowsChecklist();
      renderSuratDosenPreview();
      renderSuratRecordsTable();
      renderSuratRecordWorkflowBanner();
      renderSuratSignerReadonlyPanel();
      syncSuratWorkflowUiControls();

      if (switchMobilePreview && window.innerWidth < 1280) {
        setSuratMobilePane(isSuratCanEditDraft() ? 'preview' : 'form');
      }
    }

    function createNewSuratDraft() {
      if (!isSuratCanEditDraft()) return;
      resetSuratDosenState();
      const Toast = Swal.mixin({ toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 1600 });
      Toast.fire({ icon: 'info', title: 'Draft Surat Baru Disiapkan' });
    }

    async function confirmAndSaveSuratPengantar() {
      if (!isSuratCanEditDraft()) {
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Akses Ditolak', text: 'Hanya Master Admin atau Admin TU yang dapat mengonfirmasi surat pengantar.' });
        return;
      }
      if (suratDosenState.isLocked) {
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'warning', title: 'Dokumen Dikunci', text: 'Surat sudah diparaf Sek.Prodi sehingga edit dikunci.' });
        return;
      }
      const dosenName = String(suratDosenState.dosen || '').trim();
      const matkulName = String(suratDosenState.mataKuliah || '').trim();
      if (!dosenName || !matkulName) {
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'warning', title: 'Data Belum Lengkap', text: 'Silakan pilih atau ketik Nama Dosen Pengampu dan Mata Kuliah terlebih dahulu.' });
        return;
      }

      const model = getSuratDocumentModel();
      const selectedCount = suratDosenState.rows.filter(isSuratRowChecked).length;
      const confirmRes = await Swal.fire({
        icon: 'question',
        title: suratDosenState.currentRecordId ? 'Simpan Ulang & Ajukan Verifikasi?' : 'Konfirmasi Form Isian Selesai?',
        html: `<div class="text-xs text-slate-600 text-left space-y-1.5">
          <p>Record surat akan disimpan ke database dan masuk tahap <b>2. Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi</b>.</p>
          <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-1">
            <div><b>Nomor:</b> <span class="font-mono">${escapeHtml(model.nomorSurat)}</span></div>
            <div><b>Prodi:</b> ${escapeHtml(model.prodiNama)} (${escapeHtml(suratDosenState.kodeProdi)})</div>
            <div><b>Dosen / MK:</b> ${escapeHtml(dosenName)} &mdash; ${escapeHtml(matkulName)}</div>
            <div><b>Mahasiswa Terpilih:</b> ${selectedCount} mahasiswa</div>
          </div>
        </div>`,
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Konfirmasi & Simpan'
      });
      if (!confirmRes.isConfirmed) return;

      const actorName = (typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function')
        ? getCurrentActorName(currentUser && currentUser.nama, currentUser && currentUser.role)
        : (currentUser && (currentUser.nama || currentUser.username)) || 'Admin TU';

      const payload = {
        id: suratDosenState.currentRecordId || '',
        nomorSurat: model.nomorSurat,
        kodeArsip: model.kodeArsip,
        kodeProdi: suratDosenState.kodeProdi || 'MNJ',
        programStudi: model.prodiNama,
        layanan: suratDosenState.layanan || 'UTS Susulan',
        dosen: dosenName,
        mataKuliah: matkulName,
        semester: suratDosenState.semester || 'Ganjil',
        tahunAkademik: suratDosenState.tahunAkademik || '2026/2027',
        tanggalMasehi: suratDosenState.tanggalMasehi,
        tanggalHijriah: model.tanggalHijriahText,
        lampiran: model.lampiran,
        tenggatNilai: model.tenggatNilai,
        kaprodiNama: model.kaprodiNama,
        kaprodiNikNidn: model.kaprodiNikNidn,
        rows: suratDosenState.rows,
        actorName: actorName,
        actorRole: currentUser && currentUser.role,
        username: currentUser && currentUser.username,
        meta: {
          comboKey: suratDosenState.comboKey || '',
          kelasSemester: suratDosenState.kelasSemester || '',
          statusFilter: suratDosenState.statusFilter || 'ALL',
          nomorUrut: suratDosenState.nomorUrut || '',
          nomorTahun: suratDosenState.nomorTahun || getSuratDefaultYear(),
          kodeArsipXX: suratDosenState.kodeArsipXX || '',
          kodeArsipTahun: suratDosenState.kodeArsipTahun || getSuratDefaultYear(),
          padToMinRows: Boolean(suratDosenState.padToMinRows),
          minRows: Number(suratDosenState.minRows ?? 0)
        }
      };

      Swal.fire({ title: 'Menyimpan Record Surat...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
      callGasApi('saveSuratPengantarRecord', [payload], (res) => {
        if (!res || !res.success) {
          Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Gagal Menyimpan', text: (res && res.message) || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat menyimpan record surat.' });
          return;
        }
        if (res.record) {
          if (!Array.isArray(appData.suratPengantar)) appData.suratPengantar = [];
          const recId = String(res.record.ID || res.id || '');
          const idx = appData.suratPengantar.findIndex(item => String(item.ID || item.id) === recId);
          if (idx >= 0) appData.suratPengantar[idx] = res.record;
          else appData.suratPengantar.unshift(res.record);
          saveAppDataCache(appData);
          loadSuratRecordIntoWorkspace(recId, false);
        }
        if (!res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') loadAppData(true);
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'Form Dikonfirmasi & Tersimpan',
          text: res.message || 'Record masuk tahap 2: Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi.',
          timer: 2200,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
      }, (err) => {
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Gagal Menyimpan', text: (err && err.message) || 'Koneksi ke server bermasalah.' });
      });
    }

    function setSuratRecordStatusFilter(statusVal) {
      suratRecordStatusFilter = statusVal || 'ALL';
      document.querySelectorAll('.surat-rec-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
        const active = btn.getAttribute('data-surat-rec-filter') === suratRecordStatusFilter;
        btn.classList.toggle('bg-slate-800', active);
        btn.classList.toggle('text-white', active);
        btn.classList.toggle('text-slate-600', !active);
        btn.classList.toggle('hover:text-slate-900', !active);
      });
      renderSuratRecordsTable();
    }

    function renderSuratStatusStagesHtml(rec) {
      const st = rec.statusVerifikasi;
      const doneForm = true;
      const doneParaf = st === 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi' || st === 'Terverifikasi Final';
      const doneTtd = st === 'Terverifikasi Final';
      const isRevisi = st === 'Perlu Revisi';

      const stepItem = (label, done, active) => {
        const cls = done
          ? 'text-emerald-700 font-bold'
          : (active ? 'text-amber-700 font-bold' : 'text-slate-400');
        const icon = done ? 'fa-circle-check' : (active ? 'fa-clock' : 'fa-circle');
        return `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${cls}"><i class="fas ${icon} text-[10px]"></i><span>${label}</span></span>`;
      };

      const mainLine = `<div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
        ${stepItem('1. Form', doneForm, false)}
        <span class="text-slate-300">&rarr;</span>
        ${stepItem('2. Paraf', doneParaf, st === 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi')}
        <span class="text-slate-300">&rarr;</span>
        ${stepItem('3. TTD Final', doneTtd, st === 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi')}
      </div>`;

      const statusSub = isRevisi
        ? `<div class="text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-700 mt-0.5"><i class="fas fa-rotate-left mr-1"></i>Perlu Revisi</div>`
        : (rec.isLocked
          ? `<div class="text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-500 mt-0.5"><i class="fas fa-lock mr-1"></i>${doneTtd ? 'Final &bull; Ekspor Terbuka' : 'Edit Dikunci'}</div>`
          : `<div class="text-[10px] font-semibold text-blue-800 mt-0.5">Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi</div>`);

      return mainLine + statusSub;
    }

    function renderSuratRecordsTable() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('suratRecordsTableBody');
      const counterEl = document.getElementById('suratRecordsCounterText');
      if (!tbody) return;

      const rawList = Array.isArray(appData && appData.suratPengantar) ? appData.suratPengantar : [];
      const allRecords = rawList.map(normalizeSuratRecordItem).filter(Boolean).filter(r => hasSuratProdiAccess(r.kodeProdi));

      const prodiFilterEl = document.getElementById('suratRecordProdiFilter');
      if (prodiFilterEl && !isSuratCanEditDraft()) {
        const scope = getSuratUserScopeProdi();
        if (scope && scope !== 'ALL' && scope !== 'SEMUA') {
          prodiFilterEl.value = scope;
        }
      }

      const selectedProdi = String((prodiFilterEl && prodiFilterEl.value) || '').trim().toUpperCase();
      const searchQ = String((document.getElementById('suratRecordSearchInput') && document.getElementById('suratRecordSearchInput').value) || '').trim().toLowerCase();

      const filtered = allRecords.filter(r => {
        if (suratRecordStatusFilter !== 'ALL' && r.statusVerifikasi !== suratRecordStatusFilter) return false;
        if (selectedProdi && r.kodeProdi !== selectedProdi) return false;
        if (searchQ) {
          const hay = `${r.id} ${r.nomorSurat} ${r.dosen} ${r.mataKuliah} ${r.programStudi} ${r.layanan}`.toLowerCase();
          if (!hay.includes(searchQ)) return false;
        }
        return true;
      });

      if (counterEl) {
        counterEl.innerText = `${filtered.length} dari ${allRecords.length} record`;
      }

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        tbody.innerHTML = `
          <tr>
            <td colspan="6" class="px-4 py-7 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
              Belum ada record surat pengantar yang sesuai filter. ${isSuratCanEditDraft() ? 'Lengkapi form di bawah lalu klik <b>Konfirmasi &amp; Simpan</b> untuk membuat record.' : ''}
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
        return;
      }

      tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(r => {
        const isActive = r.id === suratDosenState.currentRecordId;
        const mhsCount = r.rows.filter(x => isSuratRowChecked(x) && (x.nama || x.npm)).length;
        const canParaf = (isSuratRoleSekprodi() || isSuratMasterRole()) && r.statusVerifikasi === 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi';
        const canTtd = (isSuratRoleKaprodi() || isSuratMasterRole()) && r.statusVerifikasi === 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi';
        const canReopen = isSuratMasterRole() && r.isLocked;
        const canDelete = isSuratMasterRole() || (isSuratAdminTuRole() && !r.isLocked);

        return `
          <tr class="${isActive ? 'bg-blue-50/70' : 'hover:bg-slate-50'} transition">
            <td class="px-3 py-2.5 align-top whitespace-nowrap">
              <div class="font-mono tabular-nums font-bold text-slate-900">${escapeHtml(r.id)}</div>
              <div class="font-mono tabular-nums text-[11px] text-slate-600">${escapeHtml(r.nomorSurat)}</div>
            </td>
            <td class="px-3 py-2.5 align-top whitespace-nowrap">
              <div class="font-bold text-slate-800">${escapeHtml(r.kodeProdi)} &middot; ${escapeHtml(r.programStudi)}</div>
              <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-500">${escapeHtml(r.layanan)} (${escapeHtml(r.semester)})</div>
            </td>
            <td class="px-3 py-2.5 align-top">
              <div class="font-bold text-slate-900">${escapeHtml(r.dosen || '-')}</div>
              <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-600">${escapeHtml(r.mataKuliah || '-')}</div>
            </td>
            <td class="px-3 py-2.5 align-top text-right font-mono tabular-nums font-bold text-slate-800 whitespace-nowrap">${mhsCount}</td>
            <td class="px-3 py-2.5 align-top whitespace-nowrap">${renderSuratStatusStagesHtml(r)}</td>
            <td class="px-3 py-2.5 align-top text-right whitespace-nowrap">
              <div class="inline-flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                <button type="button" onclick="loadSuratRecordIntoWorkspace('${escapeHtml(r.id)}', true)" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-800 cursor-pointer">
                  ${isActive ? 'Aktif' : 'Buka'}
                </button>
                ${canParaf ? `<button type="button" onclick="verifySuratRecordOneClick('${escapeHtml(r.id)}', 'PARAF_SEKPRODI')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-pen-nib mr-1"></i>Paraf 1-Klik</button>` : ''}
                ${canTtd ? `<button type="button" onclick="verifySuratRecordOneClick('${escapeHtml(r.id)}', 'TTD_KAPRODI')" class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-signature mr-1"></i>TTD 1-Klik</button>` : ''}
                ${canReopen ? `<button type="button" onclick="reopenSuratDraftAdmin('${escapeHtml(r.id)}')" title="Buka Kunci (Master Admin)" class="px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-lock-open"></i></button>` : ''}
                ${canDelete ? `<button type="button" onclick="deleteSuratRecordPrompt('${escapeHtml(r.id)}')" title="Hapus Record" class="px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>` : ''}
              </div>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function renderSuratRecordWorkflowBanner() {
      const banner = document.getElementById('suratRecordWorkflowBanner');
      if (!banner) return;
      const id = suratDosenState.currentRecordId;
      if (!id) {
        banner.classList.add('hidden');
        banner.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }
      banner.classList.remove('hidden');
      const st = suratDosenState.recordStatus || 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi';
      const doneForm = true;
      const doneParaf = st === 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi' || st === 'Terverifikasi Final';
      const doneTtd = st === 'Terverifikasi Final';

      const canParaf = (isSuratRoleSekprodi() || isSuratMasterRole()) && st === 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi';
      const canTtd = (isSuratRoleKaprodi() || isSuratMasterRole()) && st === 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi';
      const canRevise = (isSuratRoleSekprodi() || isSuratRoleKaprodi() || isSuratMasterRole()) && !doneTtd && st !== 'Perlu Revisi';
      const canReopen = isSuratMasterRole() && suratDosenState.isLocked;

      const stepBox = (num, title, subtitle, isDone, isCurr) => `
        <div class="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-2.5 rounded-xl border ${isDone ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/60' : (isCurr ? 'border-blue-300 bg-blue-50/70' : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-50')}">
          <div class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-extrabold shrink-0 ${isDone ? 'bg-emerald-700 text-white' : (isCurr ? 'bg-blue-900 text-white' : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-600')}">
            ${isDone ? '<i class="fas fa-check text-[10px]"></i>' : num}
          </div>
          <div class="min-w-0">
            <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900">${title}</div>
            <div class="text-[11px] text-slate-600 truncate">${escapeHtml(subtitle)}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      banner.innerHTML = `
        <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 flex-1">
            ${stepBox('1', 'Form Isian Selesai', suratDosenState.createdBy ? `${suratDosenState.createdBy}` : 'Admin TU / Master Admin', doneForm, st === 'Perlu Revisi')}
            ${stepBox('2', 'Paraf Sek.Prodi', doneParaf ? (suratDosenState.parafSummary || suratDosenState.parafBy || 'Terparaf') : 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi', doneParaf, st === 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi')}
            ${stepBox('3', 'TTD Final KaProdi', doneTtd ? (suratDosenState.ttdSummary || suratDosenState.ttdBy || 'Terverifikasi Final') : 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi', doneTtd, st === 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi')}
          </div>
          <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            ${canParaf ? `<button type="button" onclick="verifySuratRecordOneClick('${escapeHtml(id)}', 'PARAF_SEKPRODI')" class="px-4 min-h-[40px] py-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-800 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-sm cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-pen-nib mr-1.5"></i>Verifikasi &amp; Paraf (1-Klik)</button>` : ''}
            ${canTtd ? `<button type="button" onclick="verifySuratRecordOneClick('${escapeHtml(id)}', 'TTD_KAPRODI')" class="px-4 min-h-[40px] py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-sm cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-signature mr-1.5"></i>Verifikasi &amp; TTD Final (1-Klik)</button>` : ''}
            ${canRevise ? `<button type="button" onclick="requestSuratRevisionPrompt('${escapeHtml(id)}')" class="px-3 min-h-[40px] py-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-rotate-left mr-1"></i>Kembalikan Revisi</button>` : ''}
            ${canReopen ? `<button type="button" onclick="reopenSuratDraftAdmin('${escapeHtml(id)}')" class="px-3 min-h-[40px] py-2 rounded-xl border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"><i class="fas fa-lock-open mr-1"></i>Buka Kunci Edit</button>` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
        ${suratDosenState.revisionNote ? `<div class="mt-2.5 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-xs text-rose-800"><b>Catatan Revisi:</b> ${escapeHtml(suratDosenState.revisionNote)}</div>` : ''}
      `;
    }

    function renderSuratSignerReadonlyPanel() {
      const panel = document.getElementById('suratSignerReadonlyPanel');
      if (!panel) return;
      if (isSuratCanEditDraft()) {
        panel.classList.add('hidden');
        panel.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }
      panel.classList.remove('hidden');

      if (!suratDosenState.currentRecordId) {
        panel.innerHTML = `
          <div class="p-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-500 space-y-1">
            <p class="font-bold text-slate-700">Belum Ada Record Surat Dipilih</p>
            <p>Pilih salah satu record pada tabel di atas untuk meninjau dokumen F4 serta menerapkan Paraf / TTD Digital 1-klik.</p>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      const model = getSuratDocumentModel();
      const selectedRows = suratDosenState.rows.filter(r => isSuratRowChecked(r) && (r.nama || r.npm));
      panel.innerHTML = `
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-2">
          <h4 class="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700">Ringkasan Verifikasi Surat</h4>
          <span class="font-mono tabular-nums text-xs font-bold text-blue-900">${escapeHtml(suratDosenState.currentRecordId)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 text-xs">
          <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-1">
            <div><span class="text-slate-500">Nomor Surat:</span> <b class="font-mono">${escapeHtml(model.nomorSurat)}</b></div>
            <div><span class="text-slate-500">Program Studi:</span> <b>${escapeHtml(model.prodiNama)} (${escapeHtml(suratDosenState.kodeProdi)})</b></div>
            <div><span class="text-slate-500">Layanan / TA:</span> <b>${escapeHtml(suratDosenState.layanan)} &middot; ${escapeHtml(model.semester)} ${escapeHtml(model.tahunAkademik)}</b></div>
            <div><span class="text-slate-500">Dosen Tujuan:</span> <b>${escapeHtml(model.dosenNama)}</b></div>
            <div><span class="text-slate-500">Mata Kuliah:</span> <b>${escapeHtml(model.mataKuliah)}</b></div>
          </div>
          <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200 space-y-1.5">
            <div class="font-bold text-slate-700">Daftar Mahasiswa (${selectedRows.length})</div>
            <div class="max-h-48 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-100">
              ${selectedRows.length ? selectedRows.map((r, i) => `
                <div class="py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[11px]">
                  <span class="font-semibold text-slate-800 truncate">${i + 1}. ${escapeHtml(r.nama || '-')}</span>
                  <span class="font-mono tabular-nums text-slate-500 shrink-0">${escapeHtml(r.npm || '-')}</span>
                </div>
              `).join('') : '<div class="py-2 text-slate-400">Tidak ada baris mahasiswa</div>'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function setSuratExportIncludeSignatures(includeSig) {
      suratDosenState.includeSignaturesInExport = Boolean(includeSig);
      syncSuratWorkflowUiControls();
      if (typeof renderSuratDosenPreview === 'function') renderSuratDosenPreview();
    }

    function syncSuratWorkflowUiControls() {
      const canEditRole = isSuratCanEditDraft();
      const isVerifierRole = isSuratRoleSekprodi() || isSuratRoleKaprodi();
      const isFinal = String(suratDosenState.recordStatus || '').trim() === 'Terverifikasi Final';
      const includeSignatures = suratDosenState.includeSignaturesInExport !== false;
      const canExportNow = isFinal || !includeSignatures;
      const formLocked = Boolean(suratDosenState.isLocked) || !canEditRole;

      const btnWithTtd = document.getElementById('btnSuratModeWithTtd');
      const btnNoTtd = document.getElementById('btnSuratModeNoTtd');
      if (btnWithTtd) {
        btnWithTtd.setAttribute('aria-pressed', includeSignatures ? 'true' : 'false');
        btnWithTtd.className = includeSignatures
          ? 'px-2.5 py-1.5 min-h-[34px] rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer bg-blue-900 text-white shadow-xs'
          : 'px-2.5 py-1.5 min-h-[34px] rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900';
      }
      if (btnNoTtd) {
        btnNoTtd.setAttribute('aria-pressed', !includeSignatures ? 'true' : 'false');
        btnNoTtd.className = !includeSignatures
          ? 'px-2.5 py-1.5 min-h-[34px] rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer bg-slate-800 text-white shadow-xs'
          : 'px-2.5 py-1.5 min-h-[34px] rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold transition whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900';
      }

      const setFlexVisible = (id, show) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el) return;
        el.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
        el.classList.toggle('flex', Boolean(show));
      };

      setFlexVisible('btnManageSpesimenTtd', isSuratMasterRole() || isVerifierRole);
      setFlexVisible('btnNewSuratDraft', canEditRole);
      setFlexVisible('btnKonfirmasiSimpanSurat', canEditRole && !suratDosenState.isLocked);

      const activeMetaEl = document.getElementById('suratActiveRecordMetaText');
      if (activeMetaEl) {
        activeMetaEl.innerText = suratDosenState.currentRecordId
          ? `${suratDosenState.currentRecordId} · ${suratDosenState.recordStatus}`
          : 'Draft Baru';
      }

      const paneLabel = document.getElementById('suratPaneFormLabel');
      if (paneLabel) paneLabel.innerText = canEditRole ? '1. Form Isian' : '1. Ringkasan Surat';

      const editableGroup = document.getElementById('suratFormEditableGroup');
      if (editableGroup) {
        editableGroup.classList.toggle('hidden', !canEditRole);
        editableGroup.querySelectorAll('input, select, button').forEach(ctrl => {
          ctrl.disabled = formLocked;
          ctrl.classList.toggle('opacity-60', formLocked);
          ctrl.classList.toggle('cursor-not-allowed', formLocked);
        });
      }

      const lockNotice = document.getElementById('suratFormLockedNotice');
      const lockBadge = document.getElementById('suratFormLockedBadgeText');
      const lockDesc = document.getElementById('suratFormLockedDesc');
      if (lockNotice) {
        const showLockBanner = canEditRole && Boolean(suratDosenState.isLocked);
        lockNotice.classList.toggle('hidden', !showLockBanner);
        if (lockBadge) lockBadge.innerText = suratDosenState.recordStatus || 'Terkunci';
        if (lockDesc) {
          lockDesc.innerText = isFinal
            ? 'Dokumen telah terverifikasi final (Paraf Sek.Prodi & TTD KaProdi). Form terkunci permanen dan PDF/Cetak/Word final siap diunduh.'
            : 'Surat telah melewati verifikasi Paraf Sek.Prodi sehingga isi surat tidak dapat diubah lagi. Ekspor PDF/Cetak/Word bertanda tangan digital terbuka setelah TTD KaProdi (atau alihkan ke Tanpa Paraf & TTD untuk cetak langsung).';
        }
      }

      const exportIds = ['btnDownloadSuratWord', 'btnDownloadSuratPdf', 'btnPrintSuratDosen'];
      exportIds.forEach(id => {
        const btn = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!btn) return;
        btn.classList.toggle('opacity-55', !canExportNow);
        btn.title = !includeSignatures
          ? 'Siap diekspor (Mode Tanpa Paraf & TTD untuk tanda tangan basah)'
          : (isFinal ? 'Siap diekspor (Dokumen Terverifikasi Final)' : 'Terkunci hingga TTD Final KaProdi (ubah ke Tanpa Paraf & TTD untuk cetak langsung)');
      });
    }

    async function verifySuratRecordOneClick(recordId, stepType) {
      const raw = (appData && Array.isArray(appData.suratPengantar))
        ? appData.suratPengantar.find(r => String(r.ID || r.id || '').trim() === String(recordId || '').trim())
        : null;
      const rec = normalizeSuratRecordItem(raw);
      if (!rec) {
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Record Tidak Ditemukan', text: 'Muat ulang data terlebih dahulu.' });
        return;
      }

      const isParaf = stepType === 'PARAF_SEKPRODI';
      const kind = isParaf ? 'Paraf' : 'TTD';
      const specimenRec = findActiveSpecimenRecord(rec.kodeProdi, kind, currentUser && currentUser.username);
      const specimenDataUri = specimenRec ? String(specimenRec['Data Gambar'] || specimenRec.imageDataUri || '').trim() : '';

      if (!specimenDataUri || !specimenDataUri.startsWith('data:image/')) {
        const promptOpen = await Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: `Spesimen ${kind} Belum Tersedia`,
          text: `Anda perlu menggambar di canvas atau mengunggah PNG transparan spesimen ${kind} untuk Prodi ${rec.kodeProdi} satu kali sebelum verifikasi 1-klik.`,
          showCancelButton: true,
          confirmButtonColor: '#1e3a8a',
          cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
          confirmButtonText: `Buat Spesimen ${kind} Sekarang`
        });
        if (promptOpen.isConfirmed) {
          openSpesimenTtdModal(kind, rec.kodeProdi);
        }
        return;
      }

      const confirmRes = await Swal.fire({
        title: isParaf ? 'Terapkan Paraf Sek.Prodi (1-Klik)?' : 'Terapkan TTD Final KaProdi (1-Klik)?',
        html: `<div class="text-xs text-slate-600 space-y-2.5 text-left">
          <p>${isParaf
            ? 'Setelah diparaf, <b>penyuntingan form akan dikunci</b> dan surat diteruskan ke Ketua Program Studi.'
            : 'Setelah TTD Final KaProdi, surat berstatus <b>Terverifikasi Final</b> dan unduhan PDF/Cetak/Word F4 akan terbuka.'}</p>
          <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-1">
            <div><b>ID / Nomor:</b> <span class="font-mono">${escapeHtml(rec.id)} &middot; ${escapeHtml(rec.nomorSurat)}</span></div>
            <div><b>Dosen / MK:</b> ${escapeHtml(rec.dosen)} &mdash; ${escapeHtml(rec.mataKuliah)}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="p-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
            <span class="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Spesimen ${kind} yang Akan Diterapkan</span>
            <img src="${specimenDataUri}" alt="Spesimen ${kind}" style="max-height: 64px; max-width: 180px; object-fit: contain;" />
          </div>
        </div>`,
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonColor: isParaf ? '#1e3a8a' : '#047857',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
        confirmButtonText: isParaf ? 'Ya, Paraf Sekarang' : 'Ya, TTD Final Sekarang'
      });
      if (!confirmRes.isConfirmed) return;

      const actorUsername = (currentUser && (currentUser.username || currentUser.nama)) || '';
      const actorRole = (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '';

      Swal.fire({ title: `Menerapkan ${kind} Digital...`, allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
      callGasApi('verifySuratPengantarStep', [rec.id, stepType, actorUsername, actorRole, specimenDataUri, ''], (res) => {
        if (!res || !res.success) {
          Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: `Gagal Verifikasi ${kind}`, text: (res && res.message) || 'Terjadi kesalahan verifikasi.' });
          return;
        }
        const targetIdx = (appData.suratPengantar || []).findIndex(item => String(item.ID || item.id) === rec.id);
        if (targetIdx >= 0) {
          const item = appData.suratPengantar[targetIdx];
          item['Status Verifikasi'] = res.status || (isParaf ? 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi' : 'Terverifikasi Final');
          item['Locked'] = res.locked || 'Ya';
          if (isParaf) {
            item['Paraf SekProdi'] = res.parafSummary || '';
            item['Paraf Image'] = res.parafImage || specimenDataUri;
          } else {
            item['TTD KaProdi'] = res.ttdSummary || '';
            item['TTD Image'] = res.ttdImage || specimenDataUri;
          }
          if (res.meta) item['Meta JSON'] = JSON.stringify(res.meta);
          saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        loadSuratRecordIntoWorkspace(rec.id, false);
        if (!res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') loadAppData(true);
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: isParaf ? 'Paraf Sek.Prodi Diterapkan' : 'TTD Final KaProdi Diterapkan',
          text: res.message || 'Verifikasi berhasil disimpan.',
          timer: 2200,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
      }, (err) => {
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Gagal Verifikasi', text: (err && err.message) || 'Koneksi gagal.' });
      });
    }

    async function requestSuratRevisionPrompt(recordId) {
      const { value: note, isConfirmed } = await Swal.fire({
        title: 'Kembalikan untuk Revisi?',
        input: 'textarea',
        inputLabel: 'Catatan perbaikan untuk Admin TU / Master Admin',
        inputPlaceholder: 'Contoh: Koreksi nomor surat atau nama mahasiswa pada baris ke-2...',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonColor: '#be123c',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
        confirmButtonText: 'Kembalikan Revisi'
      });
      if (!isConfirmed) return;

      const actorUsername = (currentUser && (currentUser.username || currentUser.nama)) || '';
      const actorRole = (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '';
      Swal.fire({ title: 'Memproses Revisi...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
      callGasApi('verifySuratPengantarStep', [recordId, 'REQUEST_REVISION', actorUsername, actorRole, '', note || ''], (res) => {
        if (!res || !res.success) {
          Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Gagal', text: (res && res.message) || 'Gagal mengembalikan revisi.' });
          return;
        }
        const targetIdx = (appData.suratPengantar || []).findIndex(item => String(item.ID || item.id) === String(recordId));
        if (targetIdx >= 0) {
          const item = appData.suratPengantar[targetIdx];
          item['Status Verifikasi'] = 'Perlu Revisi';
          item['Locked'] = 'Tidak';
          item['Paraf SekProdi'] = '';
          item['TTD KaProdi'] = '';
          item['Paraf Image'] = '';
          item['TTD Image'] = '';
          if (res.meta) item['Meta JSON'] = JSON.stringify(res.meta);
          saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        loadSuratRecordIntoWorkspace(recordId, false);
        if (!res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') loadAppData(true);
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'success', title: 'Dikembalikan untuk Revisi', timer: 1800, showConfirmButton: false });
      });
    }

    async function reopenSuratDraftAdmin(recordId) {
      const confirmRes = await Swal.fire({
        icon: 'warning',
        title: 'Buka Kunci Dokumen?',
        text: 'Membuka kunci akan mereset Paraf & TTD pada record ini agar dapat disunting ulang oleh Master Admin / Admin TU.',
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonColor: '#b45309',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Buka Kunci'
      });
      if (!confirmRes.isConfirmed) return;

      const actorUsername = (currentUser && (currentUser.username || currentUser.nama)) || '';
      const actorRole = (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '';
      Swal.fire({ title: 'Membuka Kunci...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
      callGasApi('verifySuratPengantarStep', [recordId, 'REOPEN_DRAFT', actorUsername, actorRole, '', ''], (res) => {
        if (!res || !res.success) {
          Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Gagal', text: (res && res.message) || 'Gagal membuka kunci.' });
          return;
        }
        const targetIdx = (appData.suratPengantar || []).findIndex(item => String(item.ID || item.id) === String(recordId));
        if (targetIdx >= 0) {
          const item = appData.suratPengantar[targetIdx];
          item['Status Verifikasi'] = 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi';
          item['Locked'] = 'Tidak';
          item['Paraf SekProdi'] = '';
          item['TTD KaProdi'] = '';
          item['Paraf Image'] = '';
          item['TTD Image'] = '';
          if (res.meta) item['Meta JSON'] = JSON.stringify(res.meta);
          saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        loadSuratRecordIntoWorkspace(recordId, false);
        if (!res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') loadAppData(true);
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'success', title: 'Kunci Dibuka', timer: 1800, showConfirmButton: false });
      });
    }

    async function deleteSuratRecordPrompt(recordId) {
      const confirmRes = await Swal.fire({
        icon: 'warning',
        title: 'Hapus Record Surat?',
        text: `Record ${recordId} akan dihapus permanen dari daftar Surat Pengantar.`,
        showCancelButton: true,
        confirmButtonColor: '#be123c',
        cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
        confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Hapus'
      });
      if (!confirmRes.isConfirmed) return;

      const actorUsername = (currentUser && (currentUser.username || currentUser.nama)) || '';
      const actorRole = (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '';
      Swal.fire({ title: 'Menghapus Record...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
      callGasApi('deleteSuratPengantarRecord', [recordId, actorUsername, actorRole], (res) => {
        if (!res || !res.success) {
          Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Gagal Menghapus', text: (res && res.message) || 'Tidak dapat menghapus record.' });
          return;
        }
        appData.suratPengantar = (appData.suratPengantar || []).filter(item => String(item.ID || item.id) !== String(recordId));
        saveAppDataCache(appData);
        if (suratDosenState.currentRecordId === recordId) {
          resetSuratDosenState();
        } else {
          renderSuratRecordsTable();
          renderSuratRecordWorkflowBanner();
        }
        if (!res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') loadAppData(true);
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'success', title: 'Record Dihapus', timer: 1600, showConfirmButton: false });
      });
    }

    // === ENGINE SPESIMEN PARAF & TTD DIGITAL (CANVAS + PNG TRANSPARAN) ===
    const spesimenModalState = {
      kind: 'Paraf',
      method: 'canvas',
      inkColor: '#0f172a',
      strokeWidth: 3,
      strokes: [],
      isDrawing: false,
      currentPoints: [],
      canvasInitialized: false,
      uploadedRawDataUrl: '',
      processedUploadDataUrl: '',
      targets: []
    };

    function buildSpecimenSignerTargets() {
      const list = [];
      const seen = new Set();
      const prodiCodes = ['MNJ', 'AKT', 'BD', 'PI', 'PKD'];
      const staffPool = [].concat(
        Array.isArray(appData && appData.officialSigners) ? appData.officialSigners : [],
        Array.isArray(appData && appData.users_staff) ? appData.users_staff : []
      );

      if (!isSuratMasterRole()) {
        const myProdi = getSuratUserScopeProdi() || suratDosenState.kodeProdi || 'MNJ';
        const myKind = isSuratRoleSekprodi() ? 'Paraf' : 'TTD';
        const myName = (currentUser && currentUser.nama) || (currentUser && currentUser.username) || myKind;
        list.push({
          key: `${currentUser && currentUser.username}|${myProdi}|${myKind}`,
          username: (currentUser && currentUser.username) || '',
          nama: myName,
          role: (currentUser && currentUser.role) || (myKind === 'Paraf' ? 'Sekretaris Program Studi' : 'Ketua Program Studi'),
          kodeProdi: myProdi,
          kind: myKind
        });
        return list;
      }

      staffPool.forEach(s => {
        const role = String(s.Role || s.role || '').trim();
        const rl = role.toLowerCase();
        const isSek = rl.includes('sekretaris') || rl.includes('sekprodi');
        const isKap = rl.includes('ketua program studi') || rl.includes('kaprodi');
        if (!isSek && !isKap) return;
        const kind = isSek ? 'Paraf' : 'TTD';
        const kodeProdi = String(s['Kode Prodi'] || s.kodeProdi || 'MNJ').trim().toUpperCase();
        const username = String(s.Username || s.username || `${kind.toLowerCase()}_${kodeProdi.toLowerCase()}`).trim();
        const nama = String(s['Nama Lengkap'] || s.nama || username).trim();
        const key = `${kodeProdi}|${kind}|${username.toLowerCase()}`;
        if (seen.has(key)) return;
        seen.add(key);
        list.push({ key, username, nama, role, kodeProdi, kind });
      });

      prodiCodes.forEach(code => {
        const meta = getSuratProdiMeta(code);
        if (!list.some(t => t.kodeProdi === code && t.kind === 'Paraf')) {
          list.push({
            key: `${code}|Paraf|sekprodi_${code.toLowerCase()}`,
            username: `sekprodi_${code.toLowerCase()}`,
            nama: `Sek.Prodi ${meta.nama}`,
            role: 'Sekretaris Program Studi',
            kodeProdi: code,
            kind: 'Paraf'
          });
        }
        if (!list.some(t => t.kodeProdi === code && t.kind === 'TTD')) {
          list.push({
            key: `${code}|TTD|kaprodi_${code.toLowerCase()}`,
            username: `kaprodi_${code.toLowerCase()}`,
            nama: meta.kaprodi,
            role: 'Ketua Program Studi',
            kodeProdi: code,
            kind: 'TTD'
          });
        }
      });

      return list.sort((a, b) => a.kodeProdi.localeCompare(b.kodeProdi) || a.kind.localeCompare(b.kind));
    }

    function openSpesimenTtdModal(presetKind, presetProdi) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalSpesimenTtd');
      if (!modal) return;
      spesimenModalState.targets = buildSpecimenSignerTargets();
      const selectEl = document.getElementById('spesimenSignerSelect');
      if (selectEl) {
        selectEl.innerHTML = spesimenModalState.targets.map(t =>
          `<option value="${escapeHtml(t.key)}">[${escapeHtml(t.kodeProdi)}] ${escapeHtml(t.kind === 'Paraf' ? 'Sek.Prodi' : 'KaProdi')} &mdash; ${escapeHtml(t.nama)}</option>`
        ).join('');
        const targetKind = presetKind || (isSuratRoleSekprodi() ? 'Paraf' : (isSuratRoleKaprodi() ? 'TTD' : 'Paraf'));
        const targetProdi = String(presetProdi || suratDosenState.kodeProdi || 'MNJ').toUpperCase();
        const match = spesimenModalState.targets.find(t => t.kodeProdi === targetProdi && t.kind === targetKind) || spesimenModalState.targets[0];
        if (match) {
          selectEl.value = match.key;
          spesimenModalState.kind = match.kind;
        }
        selectEl.disabled = !isSuratMasterRole();
      }

      const btnParaf = document.getElementById('btnSpesimenKindParaf');
      const btnTtd = document.getElementById('btnSpesimenKindTtd');
      if (btnParaf) btnParaf.disabled = isSuratRoleKaprodi() && !isSuratMasterRole();
      if (btnTtd) btnTtd.disabled = isSuratRoleSekprodi() && !isSuratMasterRole();

      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
      initSpesimenCanvasEvents();
      clearSpesimenCanvas();
      spesimenModalState.uploadedRawDataUrl = '';
      spesimenModalState.processedUploadDataUrl = '';
      const upBox = document.getElementById('spesimenUploadPreviewBox');
      if (upBox) { upBox.classList.add('hidden'); upBox.innerHTML = ''; }
      const fileInp = document.getElementById('spesimenPngFileInput');
      if (fileInp) fileInp.value = '';
      setSpesimenInputMethod('canvas');
      setSpesimenKind(spesimenModalState.kind, true);
    }

    function closeSpesimenTtdModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modalSpesimenTtd');
      if (!modal) return;
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
      modal.classList.remove('flex');
    }

    function getSelectedSpecimenTarget() {
      const sel = document.getElementById('spesimenSignerSelect');
      const key = sel ? sel.value : '';
      return spesimenModalState.targets.find(t => t.key === key) || spesimenModalState.targets[0] || {
        username: (currentUser && currentUser.username) || '',
        nama: (currentUser && currentUser.nama) || 'Pejabat Prodi',
        role: (currentUser && currentUser.role) || 'Sekretaris Program Studi',
        kodeProdi: suratDosenState.kodeProdi || 'MNJ',
        kind: spesimenModalState.kind
      };
    }

    function onSpesimenSignerTargetChange() {
      const target = getSelectedSpecimenTarget();
      spesimenModalState.kind = target.kind;
      syncSpesimenKindButtons();
      refreshSpecimenModalPreview();
    }

    function setSpesimenKind(kind, skipSelectMatch) {
      const cleanKind = String(kind || '').toLowerCase() === 'ttd' ? 'TTD' : 'Paraf';
      spesimenModalState.kind = cleanKind;
      if (!skipSelectMatch && isSuratMasterRole()) {
        const curr = getSelectedSpecimenTarget();
        const match = spesimenModalState.targets.find(t => t.kodeProdi === curr.kodeProdi && t.kind === cleanKind);
        const sel = document.getElementById('spesimenSignerSelect');
        if (match && sel) sel.value = match.key;
      }
      syncSpesimenKindButtons();
      refreshSpecimenModalPreview();
    }

    function syncSpesimenKindButtons() {
      const btnP = document.getElementById('btnSpesimenKindParaf');
      const btnT = document.getElementById('btnSpesimenKindTtd');
      const isP = spesimenModalState.kind === 'Paraf';
      if (btnP) {
        btnP.classList.toggle('bg-blue-900', isP);
        btnP.classList.toggle('text-white', isP);
        btnP.classList.toggle('border-blue-900', isP);
        btnP.classList.toggle('bg-white', !isP);
        btnP.classList.toggle('text-slate-700', !isP);
        btnP.classList.toggle('border-slate-300', !isP);
      }
      if (btnT) {
        btnT.classList.toggle('bg-emerald-700', !isP);
        btnT.classList.toggle('text-white', !isP);
        btnT.classList.toggle('border-emerald-700', !isP);
        btnT.classList.toggle('bg-white', isP);
        btnT.classList.toggle('text-slate-700', isP);
        btnT.classList.toggle('border-slate-300', isP);
      }
    }

    function refreshSpecimenModalPreview() {
      const target = getSelectedSpecimenTarget();
      const saved = findActiveSpecimenRecord(target.kodeProdi, spesimenModalState.kind, target.username);
      const previewBox = document.getElementById('spesimenSavedPreviewBox');
      const tsEl = document.getElementById('spesimenSavedTimestamp');
      if (previewBox) {
        const imgUrl = saved ? String(saved['Data Gambar'] || saved.imageDataUri || '') : '';
        previewBox.innerHTML = imgUrl.startsWith('data:image/')
          ? `<img src="${imgUrl}" alt="Spesimen Tersimpan" class="max-h-20 max-w-full object-contain" />`
          : `<span class="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Belum ada spesimen ${escapeHtml(spesimenModalState.kind)} untuk ${escapeHtml(target.kodeProdi)}</span>`;
      }
      if (tsEl) {
        tsEl.innerText = saved && (saved['Updated At'] || saved.updatedAt) ? String(saved['Updated At'] || saved.updatedAt) : 'Belum ada';
      }

      const parafSaved = findActiveSpecimenRecord(target.kodeProdi, 'Paraf');
      const ttdSaved = findActiveSpecimenRecord(target.kodeProdi, 'TTD');
      const simParaf = document.getElementById('spesimenSimParafImg');
      const simTtd = document.getElementById('spesimenSimTtdImg');
      const simName = document.getElementById('spesimenSimSignerName');

      const draftPreview = spesimenModalState.method === 'upload'
        ? spesimenModalState.processedUploadDataUrl
        : (spesimenModalState.strokes.length ? exportTrimmedCanvasSpecimen() : '');

      const finalParaf = (spesimenModalState.kind === 'Paraf' && draftPreview)
        ? draftPreview
        : (parafSaved ? String(parafSaved['Data Gambar'] || '') : '');
      const finalTtd = (spesimenModalState.kind === 'TTD' && draftPreview)
        ? draftPreview
        : (ttdSaved ? String(ttdSaved['Data Gambar'] || '') : '');

      if (simParaf) {
        simParaf.src = finalParaf || '';
        simParaf.classList.toggle('hidden', !finalParaf.startsWith('data:image/'));
      }
      if (simTtd) {
        simTtd.src = finalTtd || '';
        simTtd.classList.toggle('hidden', !finalTtd.startsWith('data:image/'));
      }
      if (simName) {
        simName.innerText = getSuratProdiMeta(target.kodeProdi).kaprodi;
      }
    }

    function setSpesimenInputMethod(method) {
      spesimenModalState.method = method === 'upload' ? 'upload' : 'canvas';
      const isCanvas = spesimenModalState.method === 'canvas';
      const btnC = document.getElementById('btnSpesimenMethodCanvas');
      const btnU = document.getElementById('btnSpesimenMethodUpload');
      const secC = document.getElementById('spesimenCanvasSection');
      const secU = document.getElementById('spesimenUploadSection');
      if (btnC) {
        btnC.classList.toggle('bg-blue-900', isCanvas);
        btnC.classList.toggle('text-white', isCanvas);
        btnC.classList.toggle('text-slate-600', !isCanvas);
      }
      if (btnU) {
        btnU.classList.toggle('bg-blue-900', !isCanvas);
        btnU.classList.toggle('text-white', !isCanvas);
        btnU.classList.toggle('text-slate-600', isCanvas);
      }
      if (secC) secC.classList.toggle('hidden', !isCanvas);
      if (secU) secU.classList.toggle('hidden', isCanvas);
      refreshSpecimenModalPreview();
    }

    function setSpesimenInkColor(hex) {
      spesimenModalState.inkColor = hex || '#0f172a';
      document.querySelectorAll('.spesimen-ink-btn').forEach(btn => {
        const match = btn.getAttribute('data-spesimen-ink') === spesimenModalState.inkColor;
        btn.classList.toggle('border-blue-600', match);
        btn.classList.toggle('border-transparent', !match);
      });
    }

    function initSpesimenCanvasEvents() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('spesimenDrawCanvas');
      if (!canvas || spesimenModalState.canvasInitialized) return;
      spesimenModalState.canvasInitialized = true;

      const getPos = (evt) => {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const scaleX = canvas.width / Math.max(1, rect.width);
        const scaleY = canvas.height / Math.max(1, rect.height);
        return {
          x: (evt.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX,
          y: (evt.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY
        };
      };

      canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (canvas.setPointerCapture) canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        spesimenModalState.isDrawing = true;
        const pt = getPos(e);
        spesimenModalState.currentPoints = [pt];
        const hint = document.getElementById('spesimenCanvasHint');
        if (hint) hint.classList.add('hidden');
      });

      canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        if (!spesimenModalState.isDrawing) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const pt = getPos(e);
        spesimenModalState.currentPoints.push(pt);
        redrawSpesimenCanvas();
      });

      const finishStroke = () => {
        if (!spesimenModalState.isDrawing) return;
        spesimenModalState.isDrawing = false;
        if (spesimenModalState.currentPoints.length > 0) {
          spesimenModalState.strokes.push({
            color: spesimenModalState.inkColor,
            width: Number(spesimenModalState.strokeWidth || 3),
            points: spesimenModalState.currentPoints.slice()
          });
        }
        spesimenModalState.currentPoints = [];
        redrawSpesimenCanvas();
        refreshSpecimenModalPreview();
      };

      canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', finishStroke);
      canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', finishStroke);
    }

    function redrawSpesimenCanvas() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('spesimenDrawCanvas');
      if (!canvas) return;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      const drawStroke = (pts, color, width) => {
        if (!pts || !pts.length) return;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = color;
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        ctx.lineWidth = width;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        if (pts.length === 1) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(pts[0].x, pts[0].y, width / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        } else {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
          for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
            const mx = (pts[i].x + pts[i + 1].x) / 2;
            const my = (pts[i].y + pts[i + 1].y) / 2;
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y, mx, my);
          }
          ctx.lineTo(pts[pts.length - 1].x, pts[pts.length - 1].y);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      };

      spesimenModalState.strokes.forEach(s => drawStroke(s.points, s.color, s.width));
      if (spesimenModalState.isDrawing && spesimenModalState.currentPoints.length) {
        drawStroke(spesimenModalState.currentPoints, spesimenModalState.inkColor, Number(spesimenModalState.strokeWidth || 3));
      }

      const hint = document.getElementById('spesimenCanvasHint');
      if (hint) hint.classList.toggle('hidden', spesimenModalState.strokes.length > 0 || spesimenModalState.isDrawing);
    }

    function undoSpesimenCanvas() {
      spesimenModalState.strokes.pop();
      redrawSpesimenCanvas();
      refreshSpecimenModalPreview();
    }

    function clearSpesimenCanvas() {
      spesimenModalState.strokes = [];
      spesimenModalState.currentPoints = [];
      spesimenModalState.isDrawing = false;
      redrawSpesimenCanvas();
      refreshSpecimenModalPreview();
    }

    function trimAndCompressSpecimenCanvas(sourceCanvas, kind) {
      const ctx = sourceCanvas.getContext('2d');
      const w = sourceCanvas.width;
      const h = sourceCanvas.height;
      const imgData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h);
      const data = imgData.data;

      let minX = w, minY = h, maxX = -1, maxY = -1;
      for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
          const alpha = data[(y * w + x) * 4 + 3];
          if (alpha > 12) {
            if (x < minX) minX = x;
            if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
            if (y < minY) minY = y;
            if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
          }
        }
      }
      if (maxX < minX || maxY < minY) return '';

      const pad = 6;
      const sx = Math.max(0, minX - pad);
      const sy = Math.max(0, minY - pad);
      const sw = Math.min(w - sx, maxX - minX + 1 + pad * 2);
      const sh = Math.min(h - sy, maxY - minY + 1 + pad * 2);

      const isParaf = String(kind || '').toLowerCase() === 'paraf';
      let maxW = isParaf ? 220 : 340;
      let maxH = isParaf ? 120 : 150;
      let resultUrl = '';

      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 4; attempt++) {
        const scale = Math.min(1, maxW / sw, maxH / sh);
        const tw = Math.max(24, Math.round(sw * scale));
        const th = Math.max(20, Math.round(sh * scale));
        const outCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        outCanvas.width = tw;
        outCanvas.height = th;
        const outCtx = outCanvas.getContext('2d');
        outCtx.clearRect(0, 0, tw, th);
        outCtx.drawImage(sourceCanvas, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, tw, th);
        resultUrl = outCanvas.toDataURL('image/png');
        if (resultUrl.length <= 42000) break;
        maxW = Math.round(maxW * 0.72);
        maxH = Math.round(maxH * 0.72);
      }
      return resultUrl;
    }

    function exportTrimmedCanvasSpecimen() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('spesimenDrawCanvas');
      if (!canvas || !spesimenModalState.strokes.length) return '';
      return trimAndCompressSpecimenCanvas(canvas, spesimenModalState.kind);
    }

    function handleSpesimenPngUpload(inputEl) {
      const file = inputEl && inputEl.files && inputEl.files[0];
      if (!file) return;
      if (file.type !== 'image/png' && !file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.png')) {
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'warning', title: 'Format Wajib PNG', text: 'Gunakan file gambar berformat .png (disarankan transparan).' });
        inputEl.value = '';
        return;
      }
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        spesimenModalState.uploadedRawDataUrl = String(reader.result || '');
        reprocessUploadedSpecimenPng();
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }

    function reprocessUploadedSpecimenPng() {
      if (!spesimenModalState.uploadedRawDataUrl) return;
      const removeWhite = Boolean(document.getElementById('spesimenAutoRemoveWhiteCb') && document.getElementById('spesimenAutoRemoveWhiteCb').checked);
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        const tmp = document.createElement('canvas');
        tmp.width = Math.min(900, img.naturalWidth || 400);
        tmp.height = Math.max(40, Math.round((img.naturalHeight || 200) * (tmp.width / Math.max(1, img.naturalWidth || 400))));
        const ctx = tmp.getContext('2d');
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, tmp.width, tmp.height);

        if (removeWhite) {
          const imgData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, tmp.width, tmp.height);
          const d = imgData.data;
          for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
            const r = d[i], g = d[i + 1], b = d[i + 2], a = d[i + 3];
            if (a > 0 && r > 228 && g > 228 && b > 228) {
              d[i + 3] = 0;
            }
          }
          ctx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
        }

        const compressed = trimAndCompressSpecimenCanvas(tmp, spesimenModalState.kind);
        spesimenModalState.processedUploadDataUrl = compressed;

        const box = document.getElementById('spesimenUploadPreviewBox');
        if (box) {
          box.classList.remove('hidden');
          box.innerHTML = compressed
            ? `<img src="${compressed}" alt="Hasil PNG Transparan" class="max-h-24 max-w-full object-contain" />`
            : `<span class="text-xs text-rose-600 font-bold">Gambar kosong atau seluruh piksel transparan.</span>`;
        }
        const info = document.getElementById('spesimenSizeInfoText');
        if (info && compressed) {
          info.innerText = `Ukuran sel Spreadsheet: ${compressed.length.toLocaleString('id-ID')} / 48.000 karakter`;
        }
        refreshSpecimenModalPreview();
      };
      img.src = spesimenModalState.uploadedRawDataUrl;
    }

    function saveCurrentSpesimenDigital() {
      const target = getSelectedSpecimenTarget();
      const dataUri = spesimenModalState.method === 'upload'
        ? spesimenModalState.processedUploadDataUrl
        : exportTrimmedCanvasSpecimen();

      if (!dataUri || !dataUri.startsWith('data:image/')) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Spesimen Belum Diisi',
          text: spesimenModalState.method === 'upload'
            ? 'Silakan pilih file PNG terlebih dahulu.'
            : 'Silakan goreskan paraf atau tanda tangan Anda di canvas terlebih dahulu.'
        });
        return;
      }
      if (dataUri.length > 48000) {
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Ukuran Terlalu Besar', text: 'Hasil gambar melebihi batas sel Google Sheets (48.000 karakter).' });
        return;
      }

      const actorName = (typeof getCurrentActorName === 'function')
        ? getCurrentActorName(currentUser && currentUser.nama, currentUser && currentUser.role)
        : (currentUser && (currentUser.nama || currentUser.username)) || '';

      const payload = {
        actorUsername: (currentUser && currentUser.username) || '',
        actorName: actorName,
        actorRole: (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '',
        targetUsername: target.username,
        targetNama: target.nama,
        targetRole: target.role,
        kodeProdi: target.kodeProdi,
        jenisSpesimen: spesimenModalState.kind,
        imageDataUri: dataUri
      };

      Swal.fire({ title: 'Menyimpan Spesimen...', allowOutsideClick: false, didOpen: () => Swal.showLoading() });
      callGasApi('saveDigitalSpecimen', [payload], (res) => {
        if (!res || !res.success) {
          Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Gagal Menyimpan Spesimen', text: (res && res.message) || 'Terjadi kesalahan.' });
          return;
        }
        if (res.specimen) {
          if (!Array.isArray(appData.spesimenTtd)) appData.spesimenTtd = [];
          const spId = String(res.specimen.ID || '');
          const idx = appData.spesimenTtd.findIndex(item => String(item.ID || '') === spId);
          if (idx >= 0) appData.spesimenTtd[idx] = res.specimen;
          else appData.spesimenTtd.unshift(res.specimen);
          saveAppDataCache(appData);
        }
        refreshSpecimenModalPreview();
        renderSuratRecordsTable();
        if (!res.isLocalFallback && typeof loadAppData === 'function') loadAppData(true);
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'Spesimen Tersimpan',
          text: res.message || 'Spesimen siap digunakan untuk verifikasi 1-klik.',
          timer: 2000,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
      }, (err) => {
        Swal.fire({ icon: 'error', title: 'Gagal Menyimpan', text: (err && err.message) || 'Koneksi gagal.' });
      });
    }

    function handleLocalSuratGasFallback(action, args, onSuccess) {
      if (!appData || typeof appData !== 'object') appData = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(appData.suratPengantar)) appData.suratPengantar = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(appData.spesimenTtd)) appData.spesimenTtd = [];
      const nowStr = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19);

      if (action === 'saveSuratPengantarRecord') {
        const p = (args && args[0]) || {};
        const recId = String(p.id || '').trim() || ('SRT-' + nowStr.slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '') + '-' + String(appData.suratPengantar.length + 1).padStart(3, '0'));
        const actor = String(p.actorName || (currentUser && currentUser.nama) || 'Admin TU');
        const rowObj = {
          'ID': recId,
          'Nomor Surat': p.nomorSurat || '',
          'Kode Arsip': p.kodeArsip || '',
          'Kode Prodi': p.kodeProdi || 'MNJ',
          'Program Studi': p.programStudi || '',
          'Jenis Layanan': p.layanan || 'UTS Susulan',
          'Dosen Pengampu': p.dosen || '',
          'Mata Kuliah': p.mataKuliah || '',
          'Semester': p.semester || 'Ganjil',
          'Tahun Akademik': p.tahunAkademik || '2026/2027',
          'Tanggal Masehi': p.tanggalMasehi || getLocalIsoTodayForSurat(),
          'Tanggal Hijriah': p.tanggalHijriah || '',
          'Lampiran': p.lampiran || '1 (satu) Berkas',
          'Tenggat Nilai': p.tenggatNilai || '1 (satu) minggu',
          'Kaprodi Nama': p.kaprodiNama || '',
          'Kaprodi NIK': p.kaprodiNikNidn || '',
          'Mahasiswa JSON': JSON.stringify(Array.isArray(p.rows) ? p.rows : []),
          'Status Verifikasi': 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi',
          'Locked': 'Tidak',
          'Paraf SekProdi': '',
          'TTD KaProdi': '',
          'Paraf Image': '',
          'TTD Image': '',
          'Meta JSON': JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, p.meta || {}, { createdBy: actor, createdAt: nowStr, updatedBy: actor, updatedAt: nowStr }))
        };
        const idx = appData.suratPengantar.findIndex(r => String(r.ID || r.id) === recId);
        if (idx >= 0) appData.suratPengantar[idx] = rowObj;
        else appData.suratPengantar.unshift(rowObj);
        saveAppDataCache(appData);
        appendLocalActivityLog(actor, 'Konfirmasi Surat Pengantar', recId, 'Disimpan di memori lokal', p.actorRole || 'Admin TU');
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, id: recId, record: rowObj, message: 'Surat berhasil dikonfirmasi & disimpan (lokal).' });
        return;
      }

      if (action === 'verifySuratPengantarStep') {
        const recId = String((args && args[0]) || '').trim();
        const step = String((args && args[1]) || '').trim().toUpperCase();
        const actor = String((args && args[2]) || (currentUser && currentUser.nama) || 'Pejabat');
        const role = String((args && args[3]) || (currentUser && currentUser.role) || '');
        const img = String((args && args[4]) || '');
        const note = String((args && args[5]) || '');
        const rec = appData.suratPengantar.find(r => String(r.ID || r.id) === recId);
        if (!rec) {
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: false, message: 'Record tidak ditemukan di memori lokal.' });
          return;
        }
        const meta = parseSuratJsonSafe(rec['Meta JSON'], {});
        if (step === 'PARAF_SEKPRODI') {
          rec['Status Verifikasi'] = 'Menunggu TTD KaProdi';
          rec['Locked'] = 'Ya';
          rec['Paraf SekProdi'] = `${actor} (${nowStr})`;
          rec['Paraf Image'] = img;
          meta.parafBy = actor; meta.parafAt = nowStr; meta.revisionNote = '';
        } else if (step === 'TTD_KAPRODI') {
          rec['Status Verifikasi'] = 'Terverifikasi Final';
          rec['Locked'] = 'Ya';
          rec['TTD KaProdi'] = `${actor} (${nowStr})`;
          rec['TTD Image'] = img;
          meta.ttdBy = actor; meta.ttdAt = nowStr;
        } else {
          rec['Status Verifikasi'] = step === 'REOPEN_DRAFT' ? 'Menunggu Paraf Sek.Prodi' : 'Perlu Revisi';
          rec['Locked'] = 'Tidak';
          rec['Paraf SekProdi'] = '';
          rec['TTD KaProdi'] = '';
          rec['Paraf Image'] = '';
          rec['TTD Image'] = '';
          meta.revisionNote = note || 'Perlu perbaikan';
        }
        rec['Meta JSON'] = JSON.stringify(meta);
        saveAppDataCache(appData);
        appendLocalActivityLog(actor, step, recId, 'Pembaruan verifikasi surat (lokal)', role);
        if (onSuccess) {
          onSuccess({
            success: true,
            isLocalFallback: true,
            status: rec['Status Verifikasi'],
            locked: rec['Locked'],
            parafSummary: rec['Paraf SekProdi'],
            ttdSummary: rec['TTD KaProdi'],
            parafImage: rec['Paraf Image'],
            ttdImage: rec['TTD Image'],
            meta
          });
        }
        return;
      }

      if (action === 'deleteSuratPengantarRecord') {
        const recId = String((args && args[0]) || '').trim();
        appData.suratPengantar = appData.suratPengantar.filter(r => String(r.ID || r.id) !== recId);
        saveAppDataCache(appData);
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, id: recId, message: 'Record surat dihapus (lokal).' });
        return;
      }

      if (action === 'saveDigitalSpecimen') {
        const p = (args && args[0]) || {};
        const jenis = String(p.jenisSpesimen || 'Paraf').toLowerCase() === 'ttd' ? 'TTD' : 'Paraf';
        const kodeProdi = String(p.kodeProdi || 'MNJ').toUpperCase();
        const targetUsername = String(p.targetUsername || '').trim();
        const existingIdx = appData.spesimenTtd.findIndex(s =>
          String(s['Jenis Spesimen'] || '').toLowerCase() === jenis.toLowerCase() &&
          (String(s.Username || '').toLowerCase() === targetUsername.toLowerCase() || String(s['Kode Prodi'] || '').toUpperCase() === kodeProdi)
        );
        const spmObj = {
          'ID': existingIdx >= 0 ? appData.spesimenTtd[existingIdx].ID : ('SPM-' + Date.now()),
          'Username': targetUsername,
          'Nama Lengkap': p.targetNama || targetUsername,
          'Role': p.targetRole || p.actorRole || '',
          'Kode Prodi': kodeProdi,
          'Jenis Spesimen': jenis,
          'Data Gambar': p.imageDataUri || '',
          'Updated At': nowStr,
          'Updated By': p.actorName || targetUsername
        };
        if (existingIdx >= 0) appData.spesimenTtd[existingIdx] = spmObj;
        else appData.spesimenTtd.unshift(spmObj);
        saveAppDataCache(appData);
        appendLocalActivityLog(p.actorName || 'Admin', `Simpan Spesimen ${jenis}`, `${kodeProdi}`, 'Spesimen digital tersimpan (lokal)', p.actorRole || '');
        if (onSuccess) onSuccess({ success: true, isLocalFallback: true, specimen: spmObj, message: `Spesimen ${jenis} tersimpan (lokal).` });
      }
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
